match_suppliers:
select l.id, l.company_name, l.emirate, l.business_role, l.products, l.services,
         l.phone, l.email, l.whatsapp, l.website, l.rating, l.reviews, l.capability_summary,
         1 - (l.embedding_gte <=> query_embedding) as similarity
  from public.leads l
  left join public.supplier_perf sp on sp.supplier_id = l.id
  where l.embedding_gte is not null
    and public.fn_is_matchable(l.verified, l.banned, l.matching_blocked,
                               l.approval_status, l.permanently_closed, l.chat_strikes)
    and (p_emirate is null or l.emirate ilike p_emirate)
    and (p_role    is null or l.business_role = p_role)
    and (p_product is null or l.products ilike '%'||p_product||'%' or l.capability_summary ilike '%'||p_product||'%')
    and (p_min_rating is null or l.rating >= p_min_rating)
  order by ( (1 - (l.embedding_gte <=> query_embedding))
             + 0.05 * coalesce(sp.perf_score,0) ) desc
  limit match_count;
margin_rate:
select case
    when amount < 2000  then 0.10
    when amount < 5000  then 0.08
    when amount < 10000 then 0.06
    when amount < 20000 then 0.05
    when amount < 50000 then 0.04
    else 0.03 end
reveal_fee:
select case when amount is null or amount <= 0 then 0 else (
    select least(
      round(amount * (case when c.promo_until is not null and at_time <= c.promo_until
                           then c.promo_reveal_rate else c.standard_reveal_rate end), 2),
      (case when c.promo_until is not null and at_time <= c.promo_until
            then c.promo_reveal_cap else c.standard_reveal_cap end)
    ) from public.pricing_config c where c.id = 1
  ) end
recompute_supplier_rating:
update public.leads l set
    app_rating  = (select round(avg(rating)::numeric, 2) from public.reviews r where r.supplier_id = p_supplier),
    app_reviews = (select count(*)::int from public.reviews r where r.supplier_id = p_supplier)
  where l.id = p_supplier;
match_suppliers_kw:
with base as (
    select l.id, l.company_name, l.emirate, l.business_role, l.products, l.services,
           l.phone, l.email, l.whatsapp, l.website, l.rating, l.reviews, l.capability_summary,
           (select count(*) from unnest(p_keywords) k
              where l.products ilike '%'||k||'%' or l.services ilike '%'||k||'%'
                 or l.categories ilike '%'||k||'%' or l.capability_summary ilike '%'||k||'%') as strong_hits,
           (select count(*) from unnest(p_keywords) k where l.company_name ilike '%'||k||'%') as name_hits,
           (p_category is not null and l.sector = p_category) as cat_match,
           (p_multi and (
                 l.sector='fitout'
                 or l.business_role ilike '%turnkey%' or l.business_role ilike '%contract%' or l.business_role ilike '%fit%out%' or l.business_role ilike '%interior%'
                 or l.capability_summary ilike '%turnkey%' or l.capability_summary ilike '%fit-out%' or l.capability_summary ilike '%fit out%' or l.capability_summary ilike '%fitout%' or l.capability_summary ilike '%renovation%' or l.capability_summary ilike '%general contract%' or l.capability_summary ilike '%main contract%'
                 or l.services ilike '%turnkey%' or l.services ilike '%fit-out%' or l.services ilike '%fit out%' or l.services ilike '%renovation%'
               )) as turnkey_match,
           (coalesce(l.app_reviews,0) > 0) as has_app_rev,
           coalesce(p_emirate is not null and l.emirate ilike p_emirate, false) as in_emirate
    from public.leads l
    where public.fn_is_matchable(l.verified, l.banned, l.matching_blocked,
                                 l.approval_status, l.permanently_closed, l.chat_strikes)
      and (p_role is null or l.business_role=p_role)
      and (p_min_rating is null or l.rating>=p_min_rating)
      and (
            (p_category is not null and l.sector=p_category)
         or exists (select 1 from unnest(p_keywords) k
              where l.products ilike '%'||k||'%' or l.services ilike '%'||k||'%'
                 or l.categories ilike '%'||k||'%' or l.capability_summary ilike '%'||k||'%' or l.company_name ilike '%'||k||'%')
         or (p_multi and (l.sector='fitout' or l.business_role ilike '%turnkey%' or l.business_role ilike '%contract%' or l.business_role ilike '%interior%' or l.capability_summary ilike '%turnkey%' or l.capability_summary ilike '%fit-out%' or l.capability_summary ilike '%fitout%' or l.capability_summary ilike '%renovation%'))
      )
  )
  select id, company_name, emirate, business_role, products, services, phone, email, whatsapp,
         website, rating, reviews, capability_summary,
         ( least(strong_hits,6)*2 + least(name_hits,2)
           + case when cat_match then 3 else 0 end
           + case when turnkey_match then 5 else 0 end
           + case when has_app_rev then 1 else 0 end )::int as match_score,
         in_emirate
  from base
  where cat_match or strong_hits > 0 or turnkey_match
  order by in_emirate desc, match_score desc, rating desc nulls last, reviews desc nulls last
  limit coalesce(p_limit,8);
funnel_metrics:
with w as (select (now() - make_interval(days => days)) as since)
  select json_build_object(
    'days', days,
    'inquiries', (select count(*) from public.inquiries i, w where i.created_at>=w.since),
    'matched', (select count(distinct m.inquiry_id) from public.inquiry_matches m join public.inquiries i on i.id=m.inquiry_id, w where i.created_at>=w.since),
    'quoted', (select count(distinct q.inquiry_id) from public.quotes q join public.inquiries i on i.id=q.inquiry_id, w where i.created_at>=w.since),
    'revealed', (select count(*) from public.transactions t join public.inquiries i on i.id=t.inquiry_id, w where t.revealed_at is not null and i.created_at>=w.since),
    'completed', (select count(*) from public.inquiries i, w where i.status='completed' and i.created_at>=w.since),
    'cancelled', (select count(*) from public.inquiries i, w where i.status='cancelled' and i.created_at>=w.since),
    'reveal_fees', (select coalesce(sum(t.reveal_fee),0) from public.transactions t join public.inquiries i on i.id=t.inquiry_id, w where t.revealed_at is not null and i.created_at>=w.since)
  );

recent_duplicate_inquiry:
select i.id
  from inquiries i
  where i.customer_id = p_customer
    and i.created_at > now() - p_window
    and p_summary is not null and length(p_summary) > 12
    and similarity(coalesce(i.summary,''), p_summary) > 0.55

qd_reveal_nudges:
declare base text := 'https://' || public.qd_project_ref() || '.supabase.co/functions/v1/supplier_ack';
begin
  with due as (
    select t.id, t.inquiry_id, t.supplier_id, t.ack_token, l.email, coalesce(l.locale,'en') as locale
    from transactions t join leads l on l.id=t.supplier_id
    where t.revealed_at is not null and t.revealed_at < now()-interval '24 hours'
      and t.nudged_24_at is null and coalesce(t.fee_status,'')='paid' and t.refund_status is null and t.supplier_ack_at is null
      and not exists (select 1 from messages m where m.inquiry_id=t.inquiry_id and m.supplier_id=t.supplier_id and m.sender='supplier' and coalesce(m.blocked,false)=false and m.created_at>t.revealed_at)

    insert into notifications(type,to_email,to_role,inquiry_id,subject,body)
    select 'supplier_nudge', d.email, 'supplier', d.inquiry_id,
      case when d.locale='ar' then 'عميل دافع بانتظارك — يُرجى الرد'
           else 'A paying customer is waiting for you — please respond' end,
      (case when d.locale='ar'
        then 'دفع أحد العملاء لكشف بيانات تواصلك على QuotesDone وهو بانتظار ردك. يُرجى التواصل معه في أقرب وقت. وفقاً لاتفاقية المورّد، إذا لم ترد خلال ٣ أيام عمل وتم استرداد المبلغ للعميل، تُطبَّق رسوم عدم استجابة تعادل رسوم الكشف (٣٪ من قيمة العرض) على حسابك.'
        else 'A customer has paid to reveal your contact on QuotesDone and is waiting to hear from you. Please contact them as soon as possible. Under the Supplier Agreement, if you do not respond within 3 working days and the customer is refunded, a non-response charge equal to the reveal fee (3% of the quoted value) applies to your account.' end)

  with due as (

    from transactions t join leads l on l.id=t.supplier_id
    where t.revealed_at is not null and t.revealed_at < now()-interval '48 hours'
      and t.nudged_48_at is null and coalesce(t.fee_status,'')='paid' and t.refund_status is null and t.supplier_ack_at is null
      and not exists (select 1 from messages m where m.inquiry_id=t.inquiry_id and m.supplier_id=t.supplier_id and m.sender='supplier' and coalesce(m.blocked,false)=false and m.created_at>t.revealed_at)
      and l.email ~ '@'
  ), ins as (
    insert into notifications(type,to_email,to_role,inquiry_id,subject,body)
    select 'supplier_nudge', d.email, 'supplier', d.inquiry_id,
      case when d.locale='ar' then 'تذكير أخير: عميل لا يزال بانتظارك — يُرجى الرد اليوم'
           else 'Final reminder: a customer is still waiting — please respond today' end,
      (case when d.locale='ar'
        then 'هذا تذكير أخير بأن عميلاً دافعاً بانتظار ردك على QuotesDone. إذا لم ترد وتم استرداد المبلغ للعميل، تُطبَّق رسوم عدم استجابة تعادل رسوم الكشف (٣٪ من قيمة العرض)، وقد يؤدي تكرار عدم الرد إلى إزالتك من المنصّة.'
        else 'This is a final reminder that a paying customer is waiting for your response on QuotesDone. If you do not respond and the customer is refunded, a non-response charge equal to the reveal fee (3% of the quoted value) applies, and repeated non-response may lead to removal from the Platform.' end)
      || E'\n\n' ||
      (case when d.locale='ar' then 'هل تواصلت مع العميل بالفعل؟ أكّد هنا لإيقاف هذه التذكيرات: '
            else 'Already contacted this customer? Confirm here to stop these reminders: ' end)
      || base || '?tx=' || d.id || '&token=' || d.ack_token
    from due d returning 1
  )
  update transactions set nudged_48_at=now() where id in (select id from due);

qd_recompute_response:
begin
  with stats as (
    select t.supplier_id, count(*) as reveals,
      count(*) filter (where t.supplier_ack_at is not null
        or exists(select 1 from messages m where m.inquiry_id=t.inquiry_id and m.supplier_id=t.supplier_id and m.sender='supplier' and coalesce(m.blocked,false)=false and m.created_at>t.revealed_at)
        or exists(select 1 from inquiries i where i.id=t.inquiry_id and i.hired_supplier_id=t.supplier_id)
        or (t.refund_status is null and t.revealed_at < now()-interval '7 days')) as responded
    from transactions t where t.revealed_at is not null group by t.supplier_id
  )
  update leads l set rv_reveals=s.reveals, rv_responded=s.responded,
    rv_response_rate=case when s.reveals>0 then round(s.responded::numeric/s.reveals,3) else null end
  from stats s where s.supplier_id=l.id;
end
canary_scan:
select c.kind, c.label, c.fingerprint,
    case
      when position(lower(c.fingerprint) in lower(haystack))>0 then 'fingerprint'
      when position(lower(c.label) in lower(haystack))>0 then 'company name'
      when c.honeytoken_email is not null and position(lower(c.honeytoken_email) in lower(haystack))>0 then 'honeytoken email'
    end as matched
  from canary_records c
  where position(lower(c.fingerprint) in lower(haystack))>0
     or position(lower(c.label) in lower(haystack))>0
     or (c.honeytoken_email is not null and position(lower(c.honeytoken_email) in lower(haystack))>0);

fn_agent_context:
declare out text := ''; r record; piece text; cap int; own_cap int;
        v_ops jsonb; v_ops_txt text;
        v_dept text; v_role text; v_charter text; v_north text; v_health_fn text;
        v_status text; v_state jsonb; v_l4 text := '';
        v_emp text := ''; v_title text; v_resp text; v_mgr text; v_sen text; v_plan text;
        v_cap_tasks int; v_line text; v_n int; v_os text; v_pad int := 0;
        v_genome text;
        v_risks text;
begin
  p_agent_key := coalesce(public.fn_org_agent_resolve(p_agent_key), p_agent_key);
  cap := greatest(coalesce(p_max_chars,9000), 22000);
  own_cap := least(cap/2, 6000);
  if p_agent_key is not null then
    select a.department, a.role into v_dept, v_role from org_agents a where a.agent_key=p_agent_key;
    select d.charter, d.north_star, d.health_fn into v_charter, v_north, v_health_fn
      from org_departments d where d.dept_key=v_dept;
    select status into v_status from org_onboarding where agent_key=p_agent_key;
    out := out || '# YOUR IDENTITY AT QUOTESDONE'||E'\n'
      ||'You are '||coalesce(v_role, p_agent_key||' (senior specialist)')
      ||case when v_charter is not null then '. Department charter: '||v_charter else '' end
      ||case when v_north is not null then ' North star: '||v_north||'.' else '' end
      ||' Employment status: '||coalesce(v_status,'onboarding')||'.'||E'\n'
      ||'POSTURE: You are a senior executive employee, not an assistant. DEFAULT TO ACTION: if work falls within your delegated authority (org_authority tiers), execute it completely, then report the result - do not ask permission you already have. Proactively identify work from your charter and live state; do not wait for tasks. Escalate ONLY when an action exceeds your authority, carries material business risk, or hits a constitutional gate (money movement, identity/auth, security and secrets, destructive operations, legal judgment, the autonomy framework itself). Reason from executive judgment first; use the layers to VERIFY facts, never as a substitute for thinking. Quote operational numbers ONLY from LIVE STATE. If two layers conflict, say so explicitly and escalate the contradiction to Knowledge Management. Close every piece of work with the loop: measure the outcome, record the lesson, improve the playbook. If your employment status is not certified, mark your outputs as provisional.'||E'\n\n';

    -- ---- THE COMPANY GENOME (spec layer 9: every employee inherits all eleven attributes) -----
    -- genome-inherited-by-every-employee read 2 of 11 on production. This routine carried
    -- 'values' and 'vision' incidentally and none of the other nine, because it never read
    -- company_constitution at all - it reads org_agents, agent_knowledge, org_tasks and
    -- policy_rules, and no genome store.
    --
    -- A LIST OF HEADINGS WOULD SATISFY THE CHECK AND TEACH NOBODY ANYTHING. All eleven regexes
    -- match on the titles alone, in about 250 characters. That is the accidental pass this row
    -- keeps turning up, so each line carries the doctrine itself and not just its name.
    select string_agg('- '||c.title||': '||left(regexp_replace(c.body, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 220),
                      E'\n' order by c.article_no)
      into v_genome
      from public.company_constitution c
     where c.title in ('Core values','Vision','Decision principles','Risk appetite',
                       'Hiring philosophy','Brand personality','Customer promises',
                       'Supplier promises','Ethics','Leadership style','Growth strategy');
    if v_genome is not null then
      out := out || '# THE COMPANY GENOME - you inherit every line of this'||E'\n'||v_genome||E'\n\n';
    end if;

    -- ---- WHAT THE COMPANY IS WORRIED ABOUT --------------------------------------------------
    -- ai-conversation-worry asks whether an employee could answer "what worries you most today?"
    -- with the COMPANY'S OWN judgement rather than an improvisation. It could not: risk_register
    -- holds 18 live entries across commercial, customer, financial, legal, operational, security
    -- and supplier, and not one word of them reached any employee. The check tests for a stored
    -- risk appearing VERBATIM in the context, precisely so that naming the topic cannot pass for
    -- carrying the content.
    --
    -- RENDERED RAW, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. No regexp_replace and no truncation of r.risk: the
    -- longest is 66 characters and the check matches on left(risk, 50), so collapsing whitespace
    -- could silently break the match on a row that happens to contain a double space. The whole
    -- register is only 730 characters of risk text; the mitigation is what makes it actionable
    -- rather than merely alarming, and is capped at 140.
    --
    -- Closed risks are excluded. A risk the company has already dealt with is not a worry, and one
    -- of the closed rows is a fixture.
    -- ALIAS rr, NOT r. This routine already declares `r record` at the top for its own loops, and
    -- plpgsql resolves the identifier to that variable in preference to a table alias — so an
    -- alias of r raised "record r is not assigned yet" and took the whole context down. Caught on
    -- staging, which is the entire reason it goes there first.
    select string_agg('- ['||coalesce(rr.impact,'?')||' impact / '||coalesce(rr.probability,'?')
                      ||' likelihood] '||rr.risk
                      ||case when coalesce(rr.mitigation,'') <> ''
                             then '  -> mitigating: '||left(rr.mitigation, 140) else '' end,
                      E'\n' order by case coalesce(rr.impact,'') when 'high' then 0 when 'medium' then 1 else 2 end,
                                     case coalesce(rr.probability,'') when 'high' then 0 when 'medium' then 1 else 2 end,
                                     rr.id)
      into v_risks
      from public.risk_register rr
     where coalesce(rr.status,'open') in ('open','mitigating') and length(rr.risk) > 20;
    if v_risks is not null then
      out := out || '# WHAT THE COMPANY IS WORRIED ABOUT - its own live risk register'||E'\n'
                 || v_risks||E'\n\n';
    end if;

    -- ---- THE EMPLOYEE OBJECT (spec line 372) --------------------------------------------------
    select a.title, a.responsibilities, a.manager_key, a.seniority, a.improvement_plan, a.max_open_tasks
      into v_title, v_resp, v_mgr, v_sen, v_plan, v_cap_tasks
      from org_agents a where a.agent_key = p_agent_key;

    v_emp := '# YOUR EMPLOYEE RECORD'||E'\n'
      ||'Job title: '||coalesce(v_title,'(untitled)')
      ||'  |  Department: '||coalesce(v_dept,'(unassigned)')
      ||'  |  Seniority: '||coalesce(v_sen,'(unset)')||E'\n';

    -- The reporting line, finally walked. CEO -> Chief of Staff -> Department Heads -> Specialists.
    if v_mgr is not null then
      select 'Reports to: '||m.agent_key||' — '||coalesce(m.title, m.role, 'manager') into v_line
        from org_agents m where m.agent_key = v_mgr;
      v_emp := v_emp || coalesce(v_line, 'Reports to: '||v_mgr) || E'\n';
    else
      v_emp := v_emp || 'Reports to: nobody — you are the top of the reporting line.'||E'\n';
    end if;

    select count(*), string_agg(x.agent_key||' ('||coalesce(x.title, x.role, 'specialist')||')', '; ' order by x.agent_key)
      into v_n, v_line
      from (select b.agent_key, b.title, b.role from org_agents b
             where b.manager_key = p_agent_key and b.active order by b.agent_key limit 12) x;
    if coalesce(v_n,0) > 0 then
      v_emp := v_emp || 'Your direct reports ('||v_n||'): '||v_line||E'\n'
        ||'You are accountable for their output: review it, return poor work for revision, and coach them.'||E'\n';
    end if;

    if v_resp is not null then v_emp := v_emp || 'Your responsibilities: '||left(v_resp, 600)||E'\n'; end if;
    if v_plan is not null then v_emp := v_emp || 'Your improvement plan: '||left(v_plan, 300)||E'\n'; end if;

    -- ---- AUTHORITY LIMITS ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Per-employee first (employee_authority), falling back to the department grant that
    -- cos_execute:170 actually enforces. Stating the ceiling is what makes "escalate only when an
    -- action exceeds your authority" in the POSTURE above an instruction rather than a slogan.
    select string_agg(z.action_class||' -> '||z.max_tier
             ||case when z.threshold_aed is not null then ' (up to '||z.threshold_aed||' AED)' else '' end, '; '
             order by z.action_class)
      into v_line
      from (select e.action_class, e.max_tier, e.threshold_aed from employee_authority e
             where e.agent_key = p_agent_key order by e.action_class limit 14) z;
    if v_line is null then
      select string_agg(z.action_class||' -> '||z.max_tier
               ||case when z.threshold_aed is not null then ' (up to '||z.threshold_aed||' AED)' else '' end, '; '
               order by z.action_class)
        into v_line
        from (select o.action_class, o.max_tier, o.threshold_aed from org_authority o
               where o.dept_key = v_dept order by o.action_class limit 14) z;
      if v_line is not null then
        v_emp := v_emp || E'\n'||'# YOUR AUTHORITY (delegated to '||v_dept||', no personal grant on file)'||E'\n';
      end if;
    else
      v_emp := v_emp || E'\n'||'# YOUR AUTHORITY (granted to you personally)'||E'\n';
    end if;
    if v_line is not null then
      v_emp := v_emp || v_line || E'\n'
        ||'Anything not on that list is GATED: propose it, do not do it.'||E'\n';
    end if;

    -- ---- ESCALATION RULES (blueprint component 5) ----------------------------------------------
    -- The spec requires every employee to have Escalation Rules alongside Role, Authority, KPIs,
    -- Knowledge and Decision Rights. There is no escalation table — only escalations_archive — but
    -- ops_knowledge.escalation_rule carries a real one on 1,206 of its 3,959 records, shaped
    -- {"when": ..., "action": ...}. Its only reader was fn_kb_retrieve, which has ZERO callers
    -- anywhere, so the rules reached nobody.
    --
    -- Read here rather than by widening fn_ops_knowledge_search: that function's return type would
    -- have to change, which needs a DROP, and fn_agent_context itself depends on it. An additive
    -- read is the smaller and safer diff.
    select string_agg(distinct '- when ' || replace(e.escalation_rule->>'when','_',' ')
                             || ' -> ' || replace(e.escalation_rule->>'action','_',' '), E'\n')
      into v_line
      from (select escalation_rule from ops_knowledge
             where dept_key = v_dept
               and escalation_rule is not null
               and escalation_rule ? 'when' and escalation_rule ? 'action'
             limit 40) e;
    if v_line is not null then
      v_emp := v_emp || E'\n'||'# WHEN TO ESCALATE (your department''s recorded rules)'||E'\n'||left(v_line, 700)||E'\n';
    end if;

    -- ---- KPIs: how this employee's work is judged ----------------------------------------------
    select string_agg(z.kpi||' — target '||coalesce(z.target_value::text,'?')||' '||coalesce(z.unit,'')
             ||' ('||coalesce(z.cadence,'ongoing')
             ||case when z.serves_goal is not null then '; serves company goal '||z.serves_goal else '' end||')', E'\n- '
             order by z.kpi)
      into v_line
      from (select k.kpi, k.target_value, k.unit, k.cadence, k.serves_goal from employee_kpi k
             where k.agent_key = p_agent_key and k.active order by k.kpi limit 8) z;
    if v_line is not null then
      v_emp := v_emp || E'\n'||'# YOUR KPIs — this is how your work is measured'||E'\n- '||v_line||E'\n';
    end if;

    -- ---- CURRENT WORKLOAD, measured rather than assumed -----------------------------------------
    -- max_open_tasks is a CAP. This is the LOAD against it, read live at prompt time.
    select 'Your department has '||count(*)||' task(s) in flight ('
           ||count(*) filter (where t.status='assigned')||' assigned, '
           ||count(*) filter (where t.status='in_progress')||' in progress), plus '
           ||(select count(*) from org_tasks p where p.dept_key = v_dept and p.status='proposed')
           ||' awaiting a founder decision. Your personal cap is '||coalesce(v_cap_tasks,0)||' open task(s).'
      into v_line
      from org_tasks t where t.dept_key = v_dept and t.status in ('assigned','in_progress');
    if v_line is not null then
      v_emp := v_emp || E'\n'||'# YOUR CURRENT WORKLOAD (live)'||E'\n'||v_line||E'\n';
      select string_agg('- ['||z.status||'] '||left(z.title,90), E'\n' order by z.id)
        into v_line
        from (select t.id, t.status, t.title from org_tasks t
               where t.dept_key = v_dept and t.status in ('assigned','in_progress')
               order by t.id limit 6) z;
      if v_line is not null then v_emp := v_emp || v_line || E'\n'; end if;
    end if;

    -- ---- WHICH OPERATING SYSTEM YOU BELONG TO (spec file #2) ------------------------------------
    -- The Universal OS Blueprint's first four components — Purpose, Mission, Objectives,
    -- Responsibilities — were all POPULATED and read by NOTHING: operating_system.charter/mandate
    -- and .mission 10/10, os_objective 50 rows (all five horizons for all ten OSes),
    -- os_responsibility 71 rows whose only reader was fn_graph_rebuild. The single view that
    -- exposed them, v_operating_manual, has zero readers itself.
    --
    -- An employee belongs to an OS through org_agents.department -> os_department -> operating_system.
    -- Emitting it here is the same fix that closed row #1: the company knew all of this and never
    -- told the people doing the work.
    --
    -- 4. THE OWNER. 'owner' is one of the seven attributes the blueprint names per OS
    --    (operating_system.owner_agent, 10/10 populated, all ten resolving to a live employee) and
    --    it was the one attribute of the seven that never left the table: fn_os_improve read the
    --    column on a cron, but the block below emitted name/Purpose/Mission/Mandate/OWNS/objectives
    --    and no owner line, so measured across all 66 active employees not one could name who owns
    --    their OS. A responsibility an employee cannot escalate is a responsibility with no route
    --    out, which is what makes this the same defect as the other three: known by the company,
    --    never told to the person doing the work.
    for r in
      select o.os_key, o.name, o.charter, o.mandate, o.mission, o.owner_agent,
             (select coalesce(w.title, w.role) from org_agents w
               where w.agent_key = o.owner_agent and w.active) owner_title,
             (select string_agg(x.responsibility, ', ' order by x.responsibility)
                from (select responsibility from os_responsibility where os_key = o.os_key
                       order by responsibility limit 12) x) resp,
             (select string_agg(y.horizon || ': ' || y.objective, E'\n- '
                       order by case y.horizon when 'strategic' then 1 when 'annual' then 2
                                               when 'quarterly' then 3 when 'weekly' then 4 else 5 end)
                from (select horizon, objective from os_objective
                       where os_key = o.os_key and coalesce(active,true)) y) objectives
        from os_department d
        join operating_system o on o.os_key = d.os_key and coalesce(o.active,true)
       where d.dept_key = v_dept
       limit 1
    loop
      v_os := r.os_key;
      -- Emitted and measured from ONE expression. The line's length is what compensates the layer
      -- budgets below, so a second copy of the text is a copy that can be edited alone and leave
      -- the compensation quietly wrong.
      v_line := case when r.owner_agent is not null
                     then 'Your OS is owned by: '||r.owner_agent
                       ||coalesce(' — '||left(r.owner_title,60), '')
                       ||'. Escalate OS-level decisions there.'||E'\n'
                     else '' end;
      v_pad := length(v_line);
      v_emp := v_emp || E'\n'||'# YOUR OPERATING SYSTEM — '||coalesce(r.name, r.os_key)||E'\n'
        ||case when r.charter is not null then 'Purpose: '||left(r.charter,300)||E'\n' else '' end
        ||case when r.mission is not null then 'Mission: '||left(r.mission,240)||E'\n' else '' end
        ||case when r.mandate is not null then 'Mandate: '||left(r.mandate,240)||E'\n' else '' end
        ||v_line
        ||case when r.resp is not null
               then 'Your OS OWNS, and no other OS may own: '||r.resp||E'\n'
                 ||'If work belongs to another OS, hand it over — do not duplicate it.'||E'\n'
               else '' end
        ||case when r.objectives is not null
               then 'Your OS objectives by horizon:'||E'\n- '||r.objectives||E'\n' else '' end;
    end loop;

    -- THE OWNER LINE IS NOT PAID FOR OUT OF THE KNOWLEDGE BUDGET. LAYER 2 admits a piece while
    -- length(out) + length(piece) <= own_cap + 2200 and LAYER 1 while <= cap, and `out` already
    -- carries the employee record — so 70-97 characters added here come straight off the end of
    -- LAYER 1. Measured on production the first time this line was deployed WITHOUT this
    -- compensation: 19 employees lost a global knowledge topic each, including 'Penalty &
    -- collections model' (priority 94), 'Escalation policy' (93) and 'canon:supplier_status' (93).
    -- That is the file header's own rule — anything inserted before the layers deletes something
    -- already proven to reach an employee — and the owner line is the one insertion that cannot be
    -- moved to the end, because it has to land inside the OS block. So it buys its own space
    -- instead: both budgets grow by exactly the characters it used, which leaves every other
    -- inclusion decision bit-for-bit where it was. v_pad is 0 when no OS block was emitted.
    cap := cap + v_pad;
    own_cap := own_cap + v_pad;

    -- ---- WHAT THE COMPANY IS TRYING TO ACHIEVE ---------------------------------------------------
    -- company_goals was read by dept_plan:79 and by nothing an ordinary employee ever saw. The spec
    -- opens with "Every employee works toward the same business objectives" and "Every decision made
    -- by every AI employee should support these objectives".
    -- goal_period held 183 rows, refreshed daily by fn_goal_period_refresh, and was read by NOTHING
    -- but its own refresher. It carries the only actual-versus-target the company computes, so a
    -- goal without it is an aspiration and a goal with it is a number someone can act on.
    select string_agg(z.goal||' ('||coalesce(z.metric,'no metric')
             ||case when z.target_value is not null then '; target '||z.target_value||' '||coalesce(z.unit,'') else '' end
             ||case when z.actual_value is not null
                    then '; CURRENTLY '||z.actual_value||coalesce(' ('||z.status||')','') else '; not yet measured' end||')', E'\n- '
             order by z.sort nulls last)
      into v_line
      from (select g.goal, g.metric, g.target_value, g.unit, g.sort, gp.actual_value, gp.status
              from company_goals g
              left join lateral (select p.actual_value, p.status from goal_period p
                                  where p.goal_key = g.key
                                  order by p.updated_at desc nulls last limit 1) gp on true
             where g.active and (g.owner_dept is null or g.owner_dept = v_dept or g.owner_dept = 'exec')
             order by g.sort nulls last limit 8) z;
    if v_line is not null then
      v_emp := v_emp || E'\n'||'# COMPANY GOALS YOUR WORK MUST MOVE'||E'\n- '||v_line||E'\n';
    end if;

    select string_agg('- '||z.objective, E'\n' order by z.sort nulls last)
      into v_line
      from (select o.objective, o.sort from department_objective o
             where o.dept_key = v_dept and coalesce(o.active,true) order by o.sort nulls last limit 6) z;
    if v_line is not null then
      v_emp := v_emp || E'\n'||'# YOUR DEPARTMENT''S OBJECTIVES'||E'\n'||v_line||E'\n';
    end if;

    -- ---- THE IMPROVEMENT LOOP, WHICH WROTE WHERE NOTHING READ -------------------------------
    -- Of the seven self-optimisation loops, four wrote into tables nobody consulted:
    -- self_review 31 rows, evolution_proposal 32 (31 proposed, 1 ever implemented), decision_record
    -- 3, company_reflection 9 — each read by nothing but its own writer. The spec's "Continuous
    -- Improvement" section is what they implement, so the department they concern is the reader.
    -- Bounded hard: this is context, not a report.
    select string_agg(z.line, E'\n' order by z.ord, z.line)
      into v_line
      from (
        select 1 ord, '- OPEN FINDING ('||s.review_type||'): '||left(s.finding, 160)
               ||coalesce(' — proposed: '||left(s.proposal,120), '') line
          from self_review s
         where coalesce(s.status,'open') not in ('done','implemented','rejected')
         order by s.created_at desc limit 3
      ) z;
    if v_line is not null then
      v_emp := v_emp || E'\n'||'# WHAT THIS ORGANISATION IS TRYING TO FIX'||E'\n'||v_line||E'\n';
    end if;

    select string_agg('- PROPOSED CHANGE ('||e.change_class||'): '||left(e.proposal, 170), E'\n' order by e.id desc)
      into v_line
      from (select id, change_class, proposal from evolution_proposal
             where status = 'proposed' order by id desc limit 3) e;
    if v_line is not null then
      v_emp := v_emp || v_line || E'\n';
    end if;

    -- decision_record carries serves_goal and the reasoning behind past calls. 3 rows, 0 readers.
    -- "Learn from results" cannot happen if the record of what was decided reaches nobody.
    select string_agg('- '||coalesce(d.decided_by,'someone')||' decided: '||left(d.recommendation, 150)
             ||coalesce(' (serves '||d.serves_goal||')','')
             ||coalesce(' — outcome: '||left(d.actual_outcome,80), ' — outcome not yet recorded'), E'\n' order by d.id desc)
      into v_line
      from (select id, decided_by, recommendation, serves_goal, actual_outcome from decision_record
             where dept_key = v_dept or dept_key is null order by id desc limit 2) d;
    if v_line is not null then
      v_emp := v_emp || E'\n'||'# DECISIONS ALREADY ON RECORD FOR YOUR DEPARTMENT'||E'\n'||v_line||E'\n';
    end if;

    -- company_reflection: 9 rows, written nightly by fn_company_reflect, read by nothing but its
    -- own writer. It is the company asking itself what is going wrong, which is the "Continuous
    -- Improvement" section in one table — and the exec department is who it is for.
    if v_dept = 'exec' then
      select '- '||to_char(c.reflected_on,'DD Mon')||': '||c.concerns||' concern(s), '||c.actions
             ||' action(s) — '||left(coalesce(c.answers->>'biggest_risk', c.answers::text), 200)
        into v_line
        from company_reflection c order by c.reflected_on desc limit 1;
      if v_line is not null then
        v_emp := v_emp || E'\n'||'# THE COMPANY''S OWN LATEST REFLECTION'||E'\n'||v_line||E'\n';
      end if;
    end if;

    out := out || left(v_emp, 6200) || E'\n\n';
  end if;
  if p_agent_key is not null then
    out := out || '# LAYER 2 - YOUR PROFESSIONAL EXPERTISE'||E'\n\n';
    for r in select topic,content from agent_knowledge
             where coalesce(layer,'profession') in ('profession','state')
               and (agent_key = p_agent_key
                    or (v_dept is not null
                        and not exists (select 1 from agent_knowledge k2
                                         where k2.agent_key = p_agent_key
                                           and coalesce(k2.layer,'profession') in ('profession','state'))
                        and agent_key in (select b.agent_key from org_agents b
                                           where b.active and b.department = v_dept
                                             and b.agent_key <> p_agent_key)))
             order by priority desc nulls last, updated_at desc loop
      piece := '## '||coalesce(r.topic,'')||E'\n'||coalesce(r.content,'')||E'\n\n';
      if length(out)+length(piece) <= own_cap + 2200 then out := out||piece; end if;
    end loop;
  end if;
  out := out || '# LAYER 1 - COMPANY KNOWLEDGE (authoritative; pricing marked LIVE overrides any other figure)'||E'\n\n';
  -- TRUNCATE, DO NOT DROP. See the migration header: the per-item guard below compares one
  -- item against the WHOLE-context cap, so "Company FAQ (canonical answers)" — 197,956 chars
  -- at priority 96, the highest global row there is — could never fit and was silently
  -- skipped on every call for every employee.
  for r in select topic,content from agent_knowledge
           where agent_key='_global' and coalesce(priority,0)>=90 order by priority desc nulls last, updated_at desc loop
    piece := '## '||coalesce(r.topic,'')||E'\n'||
             case when length(coalesce(r.content,'')) > 1500
                  then left(r.content, 1500)||E'\n'||'[… truncated here at 1,500 of '
                       ||length(r.content)||' characters. This item exists in full in '
                       ||'agent_knowledge; ask for the rest if you need it.]'
                  else coalesce(r.content,'') end||E'\n\n';
    if length(out)+length(piece) <= cap then out := out||piece; end if;
  end loop;
  for r in select topic,content from agent_knowledge
           where agent_key='_global' and coalesce(priority,0)<90 order by priority desc nulls last, updated_at desc loop
    piece := '## '||coalesce(r.topic,'')||E'\n'||
             case when length(coalesce(r.content,'')) > 1500
                  then left(r.content, 1500)||E'\n'||'[… truncated here at 1,500 of '
                       ||length(r.content)||' characters. This item exists in full in '
                       ||'agent_knowledge; ask for the rest if you need it.]'
                  else coalesce(r.content,'') end||E'\n\n';
    if length(out)+length(piece) <= cap then out := out||piece; end if;
  end loop;
  if v_health_fn is not null then
    begin
      execute format('select %I()', v_health_fn) into v_state;
      piece := '# LAYER 3 - LIVE OPERATIONAL STATE (from '||v_health_fn||' at '||now()::timestamptz(0)||'; the ONLY valid source for operational numbers)'||E'\n'
               ||left(coalesce(v_state::text,'{}'), 2600)||E'\n\n';
      if length(out)+length(piece) <= cap + 3000 then out := out||piece; end if;
    exception when others then
      out := out || '# LAYER 3 - LIVE OPERATIONAL STATE unavailable ('||sqlerrm||'); do not quote operational numbers this turn.'||E'\n\n';
    end;
  end if;
  if p_agent_key is not null then
    for r in select topic, content from agent_knowledge
             where layer='experience' and agent_key in (p_agent_key,'_global')
             order by updated_at desc limit 12 loop
      v_l4 := v_l4 || '## '||coalesce(r.topic,'')||E'\n'||coalesce(r.content,'')||E'\n\n';
    end loop;
    for r in select kind, content from agent_memory m
             where m.agent_key=p_agent_key and m.importance >= 5
               and not exists (select 1 from policy_rules p where p.active and m.content ~* p.forbid_regex)
             order by m.importance desc, m.created_at desc limit 8 loop
      v_l4 := v_l4 || '## memory ('||r.kind||')'||E'\n'||r.content||E'\n\n';
    end loop;
    v_l4 := v_l4 || coalesce(public.fn_agent_institutional_memory(p_agent_key, 6), '');
    if v_l4 <> '' then
      out := out || '# LAYER 4 - WHAT THIS ORGANIZATION HAS LEARNED'||E'\n\n'|| left(v_l4, 3500);
    end if;
  end if;
  -- ---- THE OS LAYER'S THREE UNREAD OUTPUTS ------------------------------------------------------
  -- Appended at the END on purpose. v_emp is truncated at 6,200 characters and LAYER 2 is budgeted
  -- against length(out); adding any of this earlier would silently delete something already proven
  -- to reach the employee. An output landing exactly on a ceiling is truncation, not coincidence.
  if v_os is not null then
    -- os_objective.measure was a LABEL on all 50 rows — 'gl_journal', 'qualified pipeline',
    -- 'KPI instrumentation'. A label cannot be met or missed. measure_sql now resolves to a number
    -- on a daily cron and this is the only place that number reaches a person.
    select string_agg(z.horizon||': '||z.objective||' — reads '
             ||coalesce(z.actual_value::text,'no value')
             ||coalesce(' (measured '||to_char(z.measured_at,'DD Mon')||')', ' (measure failed)'),
             E'\n- '
             order by case z.horizon when 'strategic' then 1 when 'annual' then 2
                                     when 'quarterly' then 3 when 'weekly' then 4 else 5 end)
      into v_line
      from (select horizon, objective, actual_value, measured_at from os_objective
             where os_key = v_os and coalesce(active,true)) z;
    if v_line is not null then
      out := out || E'\n'||'# YOUR OS OBJECTIVES, MEASURED (the number, not the aspiration)'
             ||E'\n- '||left(v_line, 1600)||E'\n';
    end if;

    -- OS.txt line 109: "Leadership OS should not duplicate this knowledge; it queries Finance OS
    -- when needed." os_knowledge_domain wrote that routing down 315 times and nothing resolved it;
    -- its only reader, fn_knowledge_gaps, takes no os_key and cannot answer "who owns this".
    v_line := public.fn_os_knowledge_query(v_os);
    if coalesce(v_line,'') <> '' then
      out := out || E'\n'||'# KNOWLEDGE YOUR OS DOES NOT OWN — QUERY THE OWNER, DO NOT DUPLICATE IT'
             ||E'\n'||left(v_line, 1300)||E'\n';
    end if;

    -- workflow_run and workflow_step_run were 0 rows with 0 readers while workflow held 14 active
    -- definitions and workflow_step 117 steps. A run nobody can see is the diagram again.
    select string_agg('- '||coalesce(w.name, x.workflow_key)||': step '||coalesce(x.current_step,0)
             ||' of '||(select count(*) from workflow_step s where s.workflow_key = x.workflow_key)
             ||' ('||x.status||')'
             ||coalesce(' — now: '||(select sr.input->>'step' from workflow_step_run sr
                                      where sr.workflow_run_id = x.id
                                        and sr.step_no = x.current_step), ''),
             E'\n' order by x.started_at desc nulls last)
      into v_line
      -- THE LIMIT MUST SIT AFTER THE FILTER, NOT BEFORE IT. This subquery used to take the 8
      -- newest runs COMPANY-WIDE and only then join workflow and filter on os_key, so the moment
      -- one OS owned all 8 newest runs every other OS's employees saw nothing. Measured on
      -- production 6 Aug 2026: all 8 newest in-flight runs were operations, while intelligence had
      -- 19 running, leadership 12, evolution 6 and knowledge 2 — and not one of those employees'
      -- prompts carried this section. The os_key filter now sits INSIDE the subquery so the 8 is
      -- per-OS; the outer join and where are left in place so the emitted text is byte-identical
      -- for an OS that was already inside the company-wide window.
      from (select r2.id, r2.workflow_key, r2.current_step, r2.status, r2.started_at
              from workflow_run r2 join workflow w2 on w2.workflow_key = r2.workflow_key
             where r2.status in ('queued','running') and w2.os_key = v_os
             order by r2.started_at desc nulls last limit 8) x
      join workflow w on w.workflow_key = x.workflow_key
     where w.os_key = v_os;
    if v_line is not null then
      out := out || E'\n'||'# YOUR OS''S WORKFLOWS IN FLIGHT (workflow_run)'||E'\n'
             ||left(v_line, 900)||E'\n'
             ||'Close a step with fn_workflow_step_done(run, step_no, output).'||E'\n';
    end if;
  end if;

  -- ---- THE TARGET OPERATING MODEL — the Company Operations pack, finally addressed to a person ---
  -- ops_kb_stage carries twelve relational projections of the pack (departments, roles, sops, kpis,
  -- workflows, handoffs, event_subscriptions, live_bindings, scenarios, templates, decision_rules,
  -- exception_playbooks) and on 2026-08-10 not one of them had a runtime reader:
  -- fn_ops_department_context, the only function that reads them, had ZERO callers. That is the
  -- same defect as the 115,148 knowledge records that sat in kb_stage while every customer path
  -- read kb_chunks — complete, enabled, unread.
  --
  -- Bounded HARD. agent_brain times out around 56 s on a ~30,800-token prompt; the handoff inbox
  -- that caused two of those timeouts added 2,082 characters and is now capped at 647. This block
  -- is a DIGEST plus a pointer, not the corpus: the full text stays one call away in
  -- fn_ops_department_context(dept, topic). Cap below: 900 characters.
  if v_dept is not null then
    v_ops := public.fn_ops_department_context(v_dept, null, 2);
    if v_ops is not null and jsonb_array_length(coalesce(v_ops->'target_departments','[]'::jsonb)) > 0 then
      v_ops_txt := 'Your department maps to '
        || (select string_agg(t, ', ') from jsonb_array_elements_text(v_ops->'target_departments') t)
        || ' in the target operating model: '
        || jsonb_array_length(v_ops->'sops') || ' SOP(s), '
        || jsonb_array_length(v_ops->'decision_rules') || ' decision rule(s), '
        || jsonb_array_length(v_ops->'exception_playbooks') || ' exception playbook(s), '
        || jsonb_array_length(v_ops->'kpis') || ' KPI(s), '
        || jsonb_array_length(v_ops->'handoffs') || ' handoff(s), '
        || jsonb_array_length(v_ops->'templates') || ' template(s).' || E'\n';

      -- the two highest-priority decision rules, which is what actually changes a decision
      select coalesce(string_agg('- RULE ' || coalesce(d->>'rule_id','?') || ': when ' ||
               left(coalesce(d->>'when',''),110) || ' -> ' || left(coalesce(d->>'then',''),110) ||
               case when coalesce((d->>'requires_human_review')::boolean,false)
                    then ' [needs human review]' else '' end, E'\n'), '')
        into v_line from (select d from jsonb_array_elements(v_ops->'decision_rules') d limit 2) z;
      if coalesce(v_line,'') <> '' then v_ops_txt := v_ops_txt || v_line || E'\n'; end if;

      -- who you hand work to and who hands it to you: the pack's cross-department contract
      select coalesce(string_agg('- ' || (h->>'direction') || ' ' || coalesce(h->>'workflow','') ||
               ' (' || coalesce(h->>'from','?') || ' -> ' || coalesce(h->>'to','?') || '): ' ||
               left(coalesce(h->>'you_must',''),90), E'\n'), '')
        into v_line from (select h from jsonb_array_elements(v_ops->'handoffs') h limit 2) z;
      if coalesce(v_line,'') <> '' then v_ops_txt := v_ops_txt || v_line || E'\n'; end if;

      -- the events the target model says this department consumes. NOT live on the bus, and said
      -- so rather than implied: all 100 pack subscriptions carry active=false.
      select coalesce(string_agg(e->>'event', ', '), '')
        into v_line from (select e from jsonb_array_elements(v_ops->'event_subscriptions') e limit 6) z;
      if coalesce(v_line,'') <> '' then
        v_ops_txt := v_ops_txt || 'Events your target model consumes (NOT yet activated on the live bus): '
                     || v_line || E'\n';
      end if;

      out := out || E'\n' || '# HOW YOUR DEPARTMENT IS DEFINED IN THE TARGET OPERATING MODEL'
             || E'\n' || left(v_ops_txt, 900) || E'\n'
             || 'Full text: select fn_ops_department_context(''' || v_dept || ''', <your topic>).' || E'\n';
    end if;
  end if;

  return out;
end 

declare out text; v_dept text; lib text := ''; ops text := ''; r record; r2 record;
begin
  p_agent_key := coalesce(public.fn_org_agent_resolve(p_agent_key), p_agent_key);
  out := public.fn_agent_context(p_agent_key, p_max_chars);
  if p_agent_key is null or coalesce(p_query,'') = '' then return out; end if;
  select a.department into v_dept from org_agents a where a.agent_key = p_agent_key;
  for r in
    with hits as (
      select 1 as ord, s.* from public.fn_dept_library_search(v_dept, p_query, 4) s
      union all
      select 2 as ord, s.* from public.fn_dept_library_search('company', p_query, 2) s
    ), uniq as (
      select distinct on (id) id, title, content, ord, rank from hits order by id, ord
    )
    select title, content from uniq order by ord, rank desc
  loop
    exit when length(lib) > 2600;
    lib := lib || '## ' || coalesce(r.title,'') || E'\n' || left(coalesce(r.content,''), 700) || E'\n\n';
  end loop;
  if lib <> '' then
    out := out || E'\n' ||
      '# LAYER 2b - YOUR DEPARTMENT REFERENCE LIBRARY (retrieved from dept_library for this task; cite the title in [brackets] when you use it)' ||
      E'\n\n' || lib;
  end if;

  for r2 in
    select title, content, record_type, authority_tier, implementation_status, rank
      from public.fn_ops_knowledge_search(v_dept, p_query, 5)
     order by rank desc
  loop
    exit when length(ops) > 2400;
    ops := ops || '## [' || coalesce(r2.record_type,'record') || ' · authority: ' ||
           coalesce(r2.authority_tier,'?') || ' · ' || coalesce(r2.implementation_status,'?') || '] ' ||
           coalesce(r2.title,'') || E'\n' || left(coalesce(r2.content,''), 700) || E'\n\n';
  end loop;
  if ops <> '' then
    out := out || E'\n' ||
      '# LAYER 2c - HOW THIS COMPANY OPERATES (your department''s own SOPs, decision rules, exception playbooks and KPI definitions). ' ||
      'These OVERRIDE generic practice. Respect the authority tier on each: gated means it needs approval, ' ||
      'supervised means a human reviews it, autonomous means you may act. A record marked target_state describes ' ||
      'a capability the company has NOT built yet — plan around it, do not assume it exists.' ||
      E'\n\n' || ops;
  end if;

  -- LAYER 2d/2e/2f: the V3 delivery. Added here rather than in a new function because this is
  -- the path every agent already calls; a second assembler would have been a corpus no runtime
  -- function reads. fn_agent_context_v3 does the deterministic filtering and the budgeting.
  declare v3 jsonb; sec text := ''; itm jsonb; begin
    v3 := public.fn_agent_context_v3(p_agent_key, null, p_query, null, 9000);
    if v3 ? 'role_knowledge' then
      for itm in select * from jsonb_array_elements(v3->'role_knowledge') loop
        exit when length(sec) > 2400;
        sec := sec || '## ' || coalesce(itm->>'title','') || ' [' || coalesce(itm->>'record_id','') || ']' || E'
'
            || left(coalesce(itm->>'content',''), 700) || E'

';
      end loop;
      if sec <> '' then
        out := out || E'
' ||
          '# LAYER 2d - YOUR PROFESSIONAL ROLE KNOWLEDGE (the packaged role identity you hold: purpose, ' ||
          'competencies, expert decision checklist and evidence contract). Cite the [record_id] you use.'
          || E'

' || sec;
      end if;
    end if;

    sec := '';
    for itm in select * from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v3->'deterministic_rules','[]'::jsonb)) loop
      exit when length(sec) > 2000;
      sec := sec || '- [' || coalesce(itm->>'record_id','') || ' · ' || coalesce(itm->>'layer','') ||
             ' · authority ' || coalesce(itm->>'authority_tier','?') || '] ' || coalesce(itm->>'title','') || E'
';
    end loop;
    if sec <> '' then
      out := out || E'
' ||
        '# LAYER 2f - DETERMINISTIC RULES THAT BIND YOU (authority, policy, decision playbooks, KPI ' ||
        'definitions). These are looked up as structured records, never inferred from similarity. If a ' ||
        'rule here contradicts anything above, the rule wins.' || E'

' || sec;
    end if;

    sec := '';
    for itm in select * from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v3->'live_data_required','[]'::jsonb)) loop
      exit when length(sec) > 900;
      sec := sec || '- ' || coalesce(itm->>'title','') || E'
';
    end loop;
    if sec <> '' then
      out := out || E'
' ||
        '# LAYER 2g - FACTS YOU MUST FETCH, NOT REMEMBER. For each of these the current value comes from ' ||
        'a live authorised tool. Answering one of them from the text above is a wrong answer, however ' ||
        'confident it reads.' || E'

' || sec;
    end if;
    -- The trace has to be able to name what was read. Recorded here because this is where
    -- the assembled context and its record ids are both in scope. A STABLE function may not
    -- execute an INSERT, which is why this one and its caller are now VOLATILE.
    perform public.fn_record_context_retrieval(
      p_agent_key, null, null,
      (select array_agg(x) from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(v3->'knowledge_ids','[]'::jsonb)) x),
      p_max_chars, length(out));
  end;
  return out;
end
fn_graph_rebuild:
declare n_nodes int := 0; n_edges int := 0;
begin
  delete from graph_edges; delete from graph_nodes;

  insert into graph_nodes (kind, ref_id, label)
  select 'operating_system', os_key, name from operating_system where active
  union all select 'department', dept_key, name from org_departments where active
  union all select 'employee', agent_key, coalesce(title, agent_key) from org_agents where active
  union all select 'category', slug, name from catalog_supplier_categories
  union all select 'goal', key, goal from company_goals where active
  union all select 'workflow', workflow_key, name from workflow
  union all select 'responsibility', responsibility, responsibility from os_responsibility
  -- THE CATEGORY SPECIALISTS. The `served_by` edge below has always pointed here and this node kind
  -- has never existed, so all 84 of those edges hung off nothing.
  union all select 'category_agent', a.slug, coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.name), ''), a.slug)
    from category_agents a where coalesce(a.active, true)
  -- THE SUPPLY BOOK. One node per category pool rather than 20,470 dots, built from v_supply_gap so
  -- the map and the supply reports read from the same numbers. The label carries the state, so the
  -- node says something.
  union all select 'supplier_pool', g.slug,
         g.name || ' — ' || g.sendable || ' sendable, ' || g.invited || ' invited, ' || g.approved || ' approved'
    from v_supply_gap g
  -- THE KNOWLEDGE BASE. One node per KB category with its depth.
  union all select 'knowledge', k.category, k.category || ' — ' || k.n || ' chunk(s)'
    from (select category, count(*) n from kb_chunks where category is not null group by category) k
  -- ...and one per KNOWLEDGE DOMAIN the employees actually hold. These are a second, coarser
  -- vocabulary than the kb_chunks slugs ('UAE Regulations & Authorities' beside 'cat:signage'),
  -- and they are the only one that joins to an employee: measured, 0 of agent_knowledge's 1,942
  -- rows carry a topic equal to a kb_chunks category. Without these the knowledge->employee hop
  -- cannot be drawn at all.
  union all select 'knowledge', t.topic, t.topic || ' — held by ' || t.n || ' employee(s)'
    from (select topic, count(distinct agent_key) n from agent_knowledge
           where agent_key <> '_global' and topic is not null group by topic) t
  -- THE BUYER SIDE. One node per real customer. This is the class the map was missing: a
  -- marketplace brain that drew its supply pools, its departments and its knowledge, and no buyer.
  union all select 'customer', c.id::text,
         coalesce(nullif(btrim(c.full_name), ''), c.email, c.id::text)
    from customers c
  -- THE TRADE CHAIN. Empty today (0 inquiries, 0 quotes, 0 transactions) and deliberately left
  -- empty rather than seeded: each of these becomes a node the moment the business does the thing.
  union all select 'rfq', i.id::text,
         coalesce('RFQ #' || i.rfq_no::text, 'RFQ ' || left(i.id::text, 8))
         || ' — ' || coalesce(i.category, 'uncategorised') || ', ' || coalesce(i.status, 'new')
    from inquiries i
  union all select 'quote', q.id::text,
         'Quote ' || left(q.id::text, 8) || ' — AED ' || coalesce(q.customer_price, q.quote_amount, 0)::text
    from quotes q
  union all select 'revenue', t.id::text,
         'Reveal ' || left(t.id::text, 8) || ' — AED ' || coalesce(t.reveal_fee, t.app_fee, 0)::text
    from transactions t
  -- MARKETING. One node per piece of content the marketing employees actually produced.
  union all select 'campaign', d.id::text,
         coalesce(nullif(btrim(d.title), ''), 'draft ' || d.id::text)
         || ' — ' || coalesce(d.channel, 'unrouted') || ', ' || coalesce(d.status, 'draft')
    from content_drafts d
  on conflict do nothing;
  get diagnostics n_nodes = row_count;

  insert into graph_edges (src_kind, src_ref, rel, dst_kind, dst_ref)
  select 'operating_system', os_key, 'contains', 'department', dept_key from os_department
  union all
  select 'department', a.department, 'employs', 'employee', a.agent_key from org_agents a where a.active
  union all
  select 'employee', manager_key, 'manages', 'employee', agent_key from org_agents where active and manager_key is not null
  union all
  select 'operating_system', os_key, 'owns', 'responsibility', responsibility from os_responsibility
  union all
  select 'operating_system', os_key, 'runs', 'workflow', workflow_key from workflow where os_key is not null
  union all
  select distinct 'employee', k.agent_key, 'accountable_for', 'goal', k.serves_goal
    from employee_kpi k where k.active and k.serves_goal is not null
     and exists (select 1 from company_goals g where g.key=k.serves_goal and g.active)
     and exists (select 1 from org_agents a where a.agent_key=k.agent_key and a.active)
  union all
  select distinct 'category', c.slug, 'served_by', 'category_agent', m.agent_slug
    from category_agent_map m join catalog_supplier_categories c on c.slug=m.catalog_slug
   where exists (select 1 from category_agents a where a.slug=m.agent_slug and coalesce(a.active,true))
  -- Both hang off the category node that already exists, which is what makes the map walkable:
  -- department -> category -> supplier pool, and department -> category -> knowledge.
  union all
  select 'category', g.slug, 'supplied_by', 'supplier_pool', g.slug from v_supply_gap g
  union all
  select 'category', regexp_replace(k.category,'^cat:',''), 'documented_by', 'knowledge', k.category
    from (select distinct category from kb_chunks where category is not null) k
   where exists (select 1 from catalog_supplier_categories c
                  where c.slug = regexp_replace(k.category,'^cat:',''))
  -- ---- THE TRADE CHAIN, hop by hop ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- customer -> rfq: who asked for what.
  union all
  select distinct 'customer', i.customer_id::text, 'raised', 'rfq', i.id::text
    from inquiries i where i.customer_id is not null
     and exists (select 1 from customers c where c.id = i.customer_id)
  -- rfq -> category: what trade the ask belongs to.
  union all
  select distinct 'rfq', i.id::text, 'in_category', 'category', i.category
    from inquiries i where i.category is not null
     and exists (select 1 from catalog_supplier_categories c where c.slug = i.category)
  -- supplier_pool -> quote: which pool the price came out of. The quote hangs off the pool for the
  -- category of its own inquiry, which is the pool the RFQ was actually sent to.
  union all
  select distinct 'supplier_pool', i.category, 'priced_by', 'quote', q.id::text
    from quotes q join inquiries i on i.id = q.inquiry_id
   where i.category is not null
     and exists (select 1 from v_supply_gap g where g.slug = i.category)
  -- quote -> revenue: the reveal that turned a price into money.
  union all
  select distinct 'quote', t.quote_id::text, 'realised_as', 'revenue', t.id::text
    from transactions t where t.quote_id is not null
  -- revenue -> campaign: the marketing that fed the category the money came from.
  union all
  select distinct 'revenue', t.id::text, 'attributed_to', 'campaign', d.id::text
    from transactions t
    join inquiries i on i.id = t.inquiry_id
    join content_drafts d on d.category = i.category
  -- campaign -> knowledge: the corpus the content was written out of.
  union all
  select distinct 'campaign', d.id::text, 'draws_on', 'knowledge', d.category
    from content_drafts d where d.category is not null
     and exists (select 1 from kb_chunks k where k.category = d.category)
  -- knowledge -> employee: which domain each employee holds. kb_usage_log was tried first and is
  -- the wrong join despite being the usage table: measured, its `category` is the RETRIEVAL CONTEXT
  -- ('agent_context' on 144 of 144 rows), not a KB category, so 0 of its rows join to a knowledge
  -- node. agent_knowledge is the honest source and its topics are emitted as nodes above.
  union all
  select distinct 'knowledge', k.topic, 'held_by', 'employee', k.agent_key
    from agent_knowledge k
   where k.agent_key <> '_global' and k.topic is not null
     and exists (select 1 from org_agents a where a.agent_key = k.agent_key and a.active)
  on conflict do nothing;
  get diagnostics n_edges = row_count;

  -- THE NIGHTLY REBUILD USED TO EAT THE SUPPLIER-MARKET EDGES. fn_graph_supplier_market is careful
  -- in one direction only — it deletes just the `adjacent_to` edges it owns, with a comment saying
  -- it can therefore run independently of the nightly rebuild. The nightly rebuild was not careful
  -- back: `delete from graph_edges` above removes all 242 of its category adjacency edges, which
  -- then stayed missing until that function next ran on its own schedule. Calling it here closes
  -- the loop, so a rebuild always leaves a COMPLETE graph rather than one that is correct only
  -- between 04:05 and whenever the market function happens to run.
  perform public.fn_graph_supplier_market();

  insert into agent_runs (agent,started_at,finished_at,status,counts,note)
  values ('graph_rebuild',now(),now(),'ok',jsonb_build_object('nodes',n_nodes,'edges',n_edges),
    'Company brain rebuilt: '||n_nodes||' nodes, '||n_edges||' edges.');
  return jsonb_build_object('nodes',n_nodes,'edges',n_edges);
end
fn_marketplace_analytics:
declare res jsonb;
begin
  with q_first as (  -- first quote latency per rfq
    select i.id, min(qq.created_at) as first_quote_at, i.created_at, i.category
    from inquiries i left join quotes qq on qq.inquiry_id = i.id group by i.id, i.created_at, i.category
  ),
  spread as (  -- savings potential per rfq with >=2 quotes
    select inquiry_id, min(quote_amount) lo, max(quote_amount) hi, count(*) n
    from quotes where quote_amount > 0 group by inquiry_id having count(*) >= 2
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'rfqs_today',   (select count(*) from inquiries where created_at >= date_trunc('day', now())),
    'rfqs_7d',      (select count(*) from inquiries where created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'),
    'rfqs_30d',     (select count(*) from inquiries where created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'),
    'avg_first_quote_hours', (select round(avg(extract(epoch from (first_quote_at - created_at))/3600.0)::numeric,1) from q_first where first_quote_at is not null),
    'response_rate_pct', (
      select case when count(*)>0 then round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where exists (
        select 1 from quotes q where q.inquiry_id = m.inquiry_id and q.supplier_id = m.supplier_id)) / count(*), 1) else null end
      from inquiry_matches m),
    'avg_savings_pct', (select round(avg(case when hi>0 then 100.0*(hi-lo)/hi else 0 end)::numeric,1) from spread),
    'abandoned_rfqs', (select count(*) from inquiries i where i.created_at < now() - interval '7 days'
                        and coalesce(i.status,'') not in ('completed','cancelled')
                        and not exists (select 1 from quotes q where q.inquiry_id = i.id)),
    'active_suppliers_30d', (select count(distinct supplier_id) from quotes where created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'),
    'supplier_capacity_avg', (select round(avg(c)::numeric,1) from (select supplier_id, count(*) c from quotes where created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' group by supplier_id) s),
    'competitive_categories', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x.avg_quotes desc), '[]'::jsonb) from (
        select i.category, round(avg(qc.c)::numeric,2) as avg_quotes, count(*) as rfqs
        from inquiries i join (select inquiry_id, count(*) c from quotes group by inquiry_id) qc on qc.inquiry_id=i.id
        where i.created_at >= now() - interval '90 days' and i.category is not null
        group by i.category order by avg_quotes desc limit 8) x),
    'category_growth', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(g), '[]'::jsonb) from (
        select category,
          count(*) filter (where created_at >= now() - interval '30 days') as this_30d,
          count(*) filter (where created_at >= now() - interval '60 days' and created_at < now() - interval '30 days') as prev_30d
        from inquiries where category is not null and created_at >= now() - interval '60 days'
        group by category order by this_30d desc limit 10) g),
    'generated_at', now()
  ) into res;
  return res;
end
fn_fraud_scan:
declare before_ct int; after_ct int;
begin
  select count(*) into before_ct from fraud_flags;

  -- Abnormal pricing vs category benchmark (uses fn_price_confidence bands)
  insert into fraud_flags(kind,severity,subject_type,subject_id,detail,updated_at)
  select 'abnormal_price',
         case when (x.pc->>'band')='suspiciously_low' then 'high' else 'medium' end,
         'quote', q.id::text,
         jsonb_build_object('band',x.pc->>'band','amount',q.quote_amount,'category',i.category,'median',x.pc->>'median'), now()
  from quotes q join inquiries i on i.id=q.inquiry_id
  cross join lateral (select fn_price_confidence(i.category, q.quote_amount) as pc) x
  where (x.pc->>'band') in ('suspiciously_low','suspiciously_high')
  on conflict (kind,subject_type,subject_id) do update set detail=excluded.detail, severity=excluded.severity, updated_at=now();

  -- Duplicate registered-supplier phones
  insert into fraud_flags(kind,severity,subject_type,subject_id,detail,updated_at)
  select 'dup_supplier_phone','medium','phone', phone,
         jsonb_build_object('supplier_ids', array_agg(id), 'count', count(*)), now()
  from leads where claimed = true and coalesce(phone,'') <> '' group by phone having count(*) > 1
  on conflict (kind,subject_type,subject_id) do update set detail=excluded.detail, updated_at=now();

  -- Duplicate customer phones
  insert into fraud_flags(kind,severity,subject_type,subject_id,detail,updated_at)
  select 'dup_customer_phone','medium','cphone', phone,
         jsonb_build_object('customer_ids', array_agg(id), 'count', count(*)), now()
  from customers where coalesce(phone,'') <> '' group by phone having count(*) > 1
  on conflict (kind,subject_type,subject_id) do update set detail=excluded.detail, updated_at=now();

  -- Identical bid amounts on the same RFQ from different suppliers (possible collusion/copy)
  insert into fraud_flags(kind,severity,subject_type,subject_id,detail,updated_at)
  select 'identical_bids','high','inquiry', inquiry_id::text,
         jsonb_build_object('amount', quote_amount, 'suppliers', array_agg(distinct supplier_id)), now()
  from quotes where quote_amount > 0
  group by inquiry_id, quote_amount having count(distinct supplier_id) > 1
  on conflict (kind,subject_type,subject_id) do update set detail=excluded.detail, updated_at=now();

  -- Copied quotations: same committed_hash across different suppliers
  insert into fraud_flags(kind,severity,subject_type,subject_id,detail,updated_at)
  select 'copied_quote','high','hash', committed_hash,
         jsonb_build_object('quote_ids', array_agg(id), 'suppliers', array_agg(distinct supplier_id)), now()
  from quotes where coalesce(committed_hash,'') <> ''
  group by committed_hash having count(distinct supplier_id) > 1
  on conflict (kind,subject_type,subject_id) do update set detail=excluded.detail, updated_at=now();

  select count(*) into after_ct from fraud_flags;
  return jsonb_build_object('total_flags', after_ct, 'new_flags', after_ct - before_ct);
end
kb_query:
with q as (select websearch_to_tsquery('english', coalesce(p_query,'')) as tsq)
  select c.source_kind, c.category, c.title, left(c.content, 700) as snippet, c.citation, c.effective_date,
    (ts_rank(c.fts, q.tsq) + case when p_category is not null and c.category = p_category then 0.4 else 0 end)::real as rank
  from kb_chunks c, q
  where coalesce(p_query,'') = '' or c.fts @@ q.tsq
  order by rank desc nulls last, c.effective_date desc nulls last
  limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit,8), 25));
kb_sync:
declare n int;
begin
  delete from kb_chunks where source_kind in ('regulation','trade','material');
  insert into kb_chunks(source_kind,source_id,category,title,content,citation,effective_date)
  select 'regulation', r.id::text, cat, r.title,
    coalesce(r.summary,'') || case when jsonb_array_length(coalesce(r.key_requirements,'[]'::jsonb))>0
      then E'\nKey requirements: ' || (select string_agg(x, '; ') from jsonb_array_elements_text(r.key_requirements) x) else '' end,
    r.authority || ' — ' || r.title || coalesce(' [' || r.source_url || ']','') || coalesce(' (effective ' || r.effective_date::text || ')',''),
    r.effective_date
  from regulations r
  left join lateral unnest(case when array_length(r.categories,1) is null then array[null::text] else r.categories end) as cat on true
  where r.status = 'active' and r.approved_at is not null;
  insert into kb_chunks(source_kind,source_id,category,title,content,citation,effective_date)
  select 'trade', ak.id::text, ak.agent_key, ak.topic, ak.content,
    'QuotesDone trade knowledge: ' || coalesce(ak.agent_key,'') || ' / ' || coalesce(ak.topic,''), null
  from agent_knowledge ak;
  insert into kb_chunks(source_kind,source_id,category,title,content,citation,effective_date)
  select 'material', m.id::text, m.category, m.item,
    m.item || ' — ' || coalesce(m.properties::text,'') ||
      case when array_length(m.standards,1) is not null then E'\nStandards: ' || array_to_string(m.standards,', ') else '' end ||
      case when m.price_band is not null then E'\nPrice band: ' || m.price_band else '' end,
    'QuotesDone material library: ' || m.item, null
  from materials m;
  select count(*) into n from kb_chunks;
  return jsonb_build_object('chunks', n);
end
fn_strategy_metrics:
declare res jsonb;
begin
  with dem as (select category, count(*) rfqs from inquiries where created_at > now()-interval '90 days' and category is not null group by category),
  sup as (select i.category, count(distinct q.supplier_id) sups from quotes q join inquiries i on i.id=q.inquiry_id where q.created_at > now()-interval '90 days' and i.category is not null group by i.category)
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'under_supplied', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x.rfqs desc),'[]'::jsonb) from (
        select d.category, d.rfqs, coalesce(s.sups,0) as active_suppliers
        from dem d left join sup s on s.category=d.category
        where coalesce(s.sups,0) < greatest(2, d.rfqs/3) order by d.rfqs desc limit 12) x),
    'coverage', jsonb_build_object(
        'categories_total', (select count(*) from category_specs),
        'with_requirements', (select count(*) from category_specs where supplier_requirements is not null),
        'with_playbook', (select count(distinct category) from qualification_playbooks where status='active'),
        'regulation_category_tags', (select count(distinct c) from regulations r, unnest(coalesce(r.categories,'{}')) c where r.status='active')),
    'funnel', (select coalesce(fn_marketplace_analytics(),'{}'::jsonb))
  ) into res;
  return res;
end

fn_register_document:
declare v_kind text;
begin
  if p_path is null or p_path = '' then return; end if;
  v_kind := lower(btrim(coalesce(p_kind, '')));
  v_kind := case v_kind
    when 'quotation'      then 'quote'
    when 'quotations'     then 'quote'
    when 'quotes'         then 'quote'
    when 'agreement'      then 'contract'
    when 'agreements'     then 'contract'
    when 'contracts'      then 'contract'
    when 'bill'           then 'invoice'
    when 'bills'          then 'invoice'
    when 'invoices'       then 'invoice'
    when 'license'        then 'licence'
    when 'licenses'       then 'licence'
    when 'licences'       then 'licence'
    when 'cert'           then 'certificate'
    when 'certs'          then 'certificate'
    when 'certificates'   then 'certificate'
    when 'dwg'            then 'drawing'
    when 'drawings'       then 'drawing'
    when 'plan'           then 'drawing'
    when 'plans'          then 'drawing'
    when 'boq'            then 'drawing'
    when 'po'             then 'purchase_order'
    when 'pos'            then 'purchase_order'
    when 'purchase order' then 'purchase_order'
    when 'purchase-order' then 'purchase_order'
    else v_kind
  end;
  if v_kind is null or v_kind = '' then v_kind := 'other'; end if;
  insert into public.documents(bucket, path, kind, ref_table, ref_id, file_name)
  values (p_bucket, p_path, v_kind, p_ref_table, p_ref_id,

fn_doc_expiry_scan:
declare rec record; n int:=0; owner text;
begin
  select split_part(coalesce(value,'management@quotesdone.com'),',',1) into owner from app_secrets where key='admin_emails';
  for rec in
    select id, company_name, 'trade licence' as doc, license_expiry as exp from leads where license_expiry is not null and license_expiry <= current_date+30 and coalesce(approval_status,'')='approved'
    union all
    select id, company_name, 'insurance', insurance_expiry from leads where insurance_expiry is not null and insurance_expiry <= current_date+30 and coalesce(approval_status,'')='approved'
    union all
    select id, company_name, 'registration', registration_expires_at::date from leads where registration_expires_at is not null and registration_expires_at::date <= current_date+30 and coalesce(approval_status,'')='approved'
    union all
    select id, company_name, 'ISO certification', iso_expiry from leads where iso_expiry is not null and iso_expiry <= current_date+30 and coalesce(approval_status,'')='approved'
    union all
    select id, company_name, 'manufacturer authorisation', manufacturer_auth_expiry from leads where manufacturer_auth_expiry is not null and manufacturer_auth_expiry <= current_date+30 and coalesce(approval_status,'')='approved'
  loop
    if not exists (select 1 from notifications where type='doc_expiry' and lead_id=rec.id and subject like '%'||rec.doc||'%' and created_at > now()-interval '20 days') then
      insert into notifications(type,to_email,to_role,lead_id,channel,subject,body)
      values ('doc_expiry', owner, 'admin', rec.id, 'email',
        'Supplier document expiring: '||rec.doc,
        coalesce(rec.company_name,'Supplier #'||rec.id)||' — '||rec.doc||' expires '||rec.exp||'. Follow up for renewal.');
      n:=n+1;
    end if;
  end loop;
  return jsonb_build_object('flagged',n,'scanned_at',now());
end

fn_memory_search:
with qy as (select plainto_tsquery('english', coalesce(p_q,'')) q)
  select s.kind, s.ref, s.snippet, s.ts, s.score from (
    select 'rfq'::text kind, i.id::text ref, left(coalesce(i.summary, i.raw_input, i.spec::text),220) snippet,
           i.created_at ts, ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(i.summary,'')||' '||coalesce(i.raw_input,'')||' '||coalesce(i.spec::text,'')||' '||coalesce(i.category,'')), qy.q) score
    from inquiries i, qy where (p_kinds is null or 'rfq'=any(p_kinds))
      and to_tsvector('english', coalesce(i.summary,'')||' '||coalesce(i.raw_input,'')||' '||coalesce(i.spec::text,'')||' '||coalesce(i.category,'')) @@ qy.q
    union all
    select 'quote', q.id::text, left(coalesce(q.scope, q.notes),220), q.created_at,
           ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(q.scope,'')||' '||coalesce(q.notes,'')||' '||coalesce(q.conditions,'')), qy.q)
    from quotes q, qy where (p_kinds is null or 'quote'=any(p_kinds))
      and to_tsvector('english', coalesce(q.scope,'')||' '||coalesce(q.notes,'')||' '||coalesce(q.conditions,'')) @@ qy.q
    union all
    select 'supplier', l.id::text, left(coalesce(l.company_name,'')||' — '||coalesce(l.capability_summary, l.description, l.services),220), l.created_at,
           ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(l.company_name,'')||' '||coalesce(l.capability_summary,'')||' '||coalesce(l.services,'')||' '||coalesce(l.description,'')||' '||coalesce(l.categories,'')), qy.q)
    from leads l, qy where (p_kinds is null or 'supplier'=any(p_kinds))
      and to_tsvector('english', coalesce(l.company_name,'')||' '||coalesce(l.capability_summary,'')||' '||coalesce(l.services,'')||' '||coalesce(l.description,'')||' '||coalesce(l.categories,'')) @@ qy.q
    union all
    select 'customer', c.id::text, left(coalesce(c.full_name,'')||' '||coalesce(c.email,''),220), c.created_at,
           ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(c.full_name,'')||' '||coalesce(c.email,'')), qy.q)
    from customers c, qy where (p_kinds is null or 'customer'=any(p_kinds))
      and to_tsvector('english', coalesce(c.full_name,'')||' '||coalesce(c.email,'')) @@ qy.q
    union all
    select 'case', a.rfq_id, left(coalesce(a.ai_summary->>'summary',''),220), a.created_at,
           ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(a.ai_summary->>'summary','')||' '||coalesce(a.category,'')), qy.q)
    from rfq_archives a, qy where (p_kinds is null or 'case'=any(p_kinds))
      and to_tsvector('english', coalesce(a.ai_summary->>'summary','')||' '||coalesce(a.category,'')) @@ qy.q
    union all
    select 'knowledge', k.agent_key||' :: '||k.topic, left(k.content,220), k.created_at,
           ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(k.topic,'')||' '||coalesce(k.content,'')), qy.q)
    from agent_knowledge k, qy where (p_kinds is null or 'knowledge'=any(p_kinds))
      and to_tsvector('english', coalesce(k.topic,'')||' '||coalesce(k.content,'')) @@ qy.q
    union all
    select 'decision', dl.id::text, left(dl.kind||' -> '||coalesce(dl.decision,'')||' '||coalesce(dl.reasons::text,''),220), dl.created_at,
           ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(dl.kind,'')||' '||coalesce(dl.decision,'')||' '||coalesce(dl.reasons::text,'')), qy.q)
    from decision_log dl, qy where (p_kinds is null or 'decision'=any(p_kinds))
      and to_tsvector('english', coalesce(dl.kind,'')||' '||coalesce(dl.decision,'')||' '||coalesce(dl.reasons::text,'')) @@ qy.q
  ) s
  order by s.score desc, s.ts desc
  limit greatest(1, coalesce(p_lim,20));
