end
fn_agent_silence_watch:
declare r record; n int:=0; f int:=0; g int:=0; nr int:=0; v_email text; v_run bigint;
begin
  insert into agent_runs(agent, started_at) values ('agent_silence_watch', clock_timestamp()) returning id into v_run;

  select to_email into v_email from notifications
   where type='founder_brief' and to_email is not null order by created_at desc limit 1;

  insert into cron_job_seen (jobid, jobname, schedule)
  select j.jobid, j.jobname, j.schedule from cron.job j where j.active
  on conflict (jobid) do update set last_seen = now(), jobname = excluded.jobname, schedule = excluded.schedule;

  -- Record successes BEFORE evaluating, so they survive the 14-day history prune.
  update cron_job_seen s
     set last_success = h.last_ok
    from (select jobid, max(start_time) as last_ok
            from cron.job_run_details where status='succeeded' group by jobid) h
   where h.jobid = s.jobid
     and (s.last_success is null or s.last_success < h.last_ok);

  for r in
    -- ONE AGGREGATE, NOT THREE CORRELATED SUBQUERIES PER JOB. This loop used to ask
    -- cron.job_run_details three separate questions for each of 165 active jobs against an 80 MB
    -- heap with no usable index, and on 11 Aug 2026 it began exceeding the statement timeout and
    -- stopped watching anything at all. A watchdog that dies silently is worse than no watchdog:
    -- fn_agent_silence_watch is the routine that would have reported its own absence.
    with h as (
      select jobid,
             count(*)                                                        as history_rows,
             max(start_time) filter (where status='succeeded')               as last_ok_live,
             count(*) filter (where status='failed'
                              and start_time > now() - interval '24 hours')  as fails_24h
        from cron.job_run_details
       group by jobid)
    select j.jobid, j.jobname,
           case when split_part(j.schedule,' ',5) <> '*' then 336
                when split_part(j.schedule,' ',3) <> '*' then 1440
                when split_part(j.schedule,' ',2) =  '*' then 6
                else 72 end as thresh_h,
           coalesce(h.history_rows, 0) as history_rows,
           greatest(h.last_ok_live, s.last_success) as last_ok,
           coalesce(h.fails_24h, 0) as fails_24h,
           s.first_seen,
           s.last_success as stored_ok
      from cron.job j
      left join h on h.jobid = j.jobid
      left join cron_job_seen s on s.jobid = j.jobid
     where j.active
  loop
    -- Never-run: only when there is NO history AND we have never recorded a success.
    if r.history_rows = 0 and r.stored_ok is null then
      if r.first_seen is not null and r.first_seen < now() - (r.thresh_h||' hours')::interval then
        if not exists (select 1 from founder_alerts where event='cron_never_ran'
                        and detail like '%"'||r.jobname||'"%'
                        and created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') then
          insert into founder_alerts(level,event,detail,channel)
          values ('high','cron_never_ran', jsonb_build_object(
            'job', r.jobname,
            'first_seen', r.first_seen::text,
            'known_for_hours', round(extract(epoch from (now()-r.first_seen))/3600),
            'expected_within_hours', r.thresh_h)::text, 'email');
          if v_email is not null then
            insert into notifications(type,to_email,subject,body,status)
            values ('agent_silence', v_email, 'Scheduled job has never run: '||r.jobname,
              'Job "'||r.jobname||'" is active but has no run history at all. It has been registered since '||
              r.first_seen::text||' and should have run at least every '||r.thresh_h||' hours. It is likely misregistered.','pending');
          end if;
          nr := nr + 1;
        end if;
      else
        g := g + 1;
      end if;
      continue;
    end if;

    if r.last_ok is null or r.last_ok < now() - (r.thresh_h||' hours')::interval then
      if not exists (select 1 from founder_alerts where event='cron_silent'
                      and detail like '%"'||r.jobname||'"%'
                      and created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') then
        insert into founder_alerts(level,event,detail,channel)
        values ('high','cron_silent', jsonb_build_object(
          'job',r.jobname,'last_success',coalesce(r.last_ok::text,'no success on record'),
          'silent_hours',round(extract(epoch from (now()-r.last_ok))/3600),
          'expected_within_hours',r.thresh_h)::text,'email');
        if v_email is not null then
          insert into notifications(type,to_email,subject,body,status)
          values ('agent_silence',v_email,'Scheduled job stopped: '||r.jobname,
            'Job "'||r.jobname||'" last succeeded '||coalesce(r.last_ok::text,'unknown')||
            '. Expected at least every '||r.thresh_h||' hours.','pending');
        end if;
        n := n + 1;
      end if;
    end if;

    if r.fails_24h > 0 then
      if not exists (select 1 from founder_alerts where event='cron_failing'
                      and detail like '%"'||r.jobname||'"%'
                      and created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') then
        insert into founder_alerts(level,event,detail,channel)
        values ('high','cron_failing',
          jsonb_build_object('job',r.jobname,'failures_24h',r.fails_24h,
                             'last_success',coalesce(r.last_ok::text,'unknown'))::text,'email');
        if v_email is not null then
          insert into notifications(type,to_email,subject,body,status)
          values ('agent_silence',v_email,'Scheduled job failing: '||r.jobname,
            'Job "'||r.jobname||'" has failed '||r.fails_24h||' time(s) in the last 24 hours. Last success: '||
            coalesce(r.last_ok::text,'unknown')||'. Check cron.job_run_details for the error text.','pending');
        end if;
        f := f + 1;
      end if;
    end if;
  end loop;

  update agent_runs
     set finished_at=clock_timestamp(), status='ok',
         counts=jsonb_build_object('active_jobs',(select count(*) from cron.job where active),
                                   'in_grace',g,'silent',n,'failing',f,'never_ran',nr)
   where id=v_run;

  return jsonb_build_object('ran_at',now(),
    'active_jobs',(select count(*) from cron.job where active),
    'in_grace',g,'silent_alerts',n,'failing_alerts',f,'never_ran_alerts',nr);
exception when others then
  update agent_runs set finished_at=clock_timestamp(), status='error', note=left(sqlerrm,500) where id=v_run;
  raise;
end
fn_accrue_dues_interest:
declare v_rate numeric; v_updated int := 0;
begin
  v_rate := coalesce((select num_value from public.gl_settings where key='clawback_interest_monthly_pct'), 0.75) / 100.0;

  with calc as (
    select d.id,
           round(coalesce(d.amount_due,0) * v_rate *
                 greatest(0, (date_part('year',  age(current_date, d.due_date::date)) * 12
                            + date_part('month', age(current_date, d.due_date::date)))::int), 2) as want
    from public.supplier_dues d
    where d.paid_at is null
      -- H6 (OS audit): once collections_legal has escalated a due it FREEZES the interest; the monthly
      -- accrual must not overwrite that frozen figure, so exclude legal-stage dues here.
      and coalesce(d.status,'') not in ('paid','settled','waived','cancelled','legal')
      and d.legal_stage is null
      and coalesce(d.amount_due,0) > 0
      and d.due_date is not null
  )
  update public.supplier_dues d
     set interest_amount = c.want
    from calc c
   where c.id = d.id
     and coalesce(d.interest_amount,0) is distinct from c.want;

  get diagnostics v_updated = row_count;
  return v_updated;
end;
fn_ban_overdue_dues:
declare r record; v_days int; v_n int := 0; v_admin text;
begin
  v_days  := coalesce((select num_value from public.gl_settings where key='clawback_ban_days'), 90)::int;
  v_admin := coalesce((select split_part(value,',',1) from public.app_secrets where key='admin_emails'),'management@quotesdone.com');

  for r in
    select d.id, d.supplier_id, d.amount_due, d.admin_fee, d.interest_amount, d.due_date,
           l.company_name, coalesce(l.claimed_by,l.email) as email,
           l.accepted_terms_at, l.accepted_terms_version, l.signed_terms_path, l.banned
    from public.supplier_dues d
    join public.leads l on l.id = d.supplier_id
    where d.paid_at is null
      and coalesce(d.status,'') not in ('paid','settled','waived','cancelled')
      and coalesce(d.amount_due,0) > 0
      and d.due_date is not null
      and current_date >= (d.due_date::date + v_days)
      and d.legal_escalated_at is null
  loop
    update public.supplier_dues
       set status = 'legal', legal_stage = 'pending_case', legal_escalated_at = now()
     where id = r.id;

    update public.leads
       set banned = true,
           banned_reason = 'Unpaid refund clawback of AED ' ||
                           round(coalesce(r.amount_due,0)+coalesce(r.admin_fee,0)+coalesce(r.interest_amount,0),2) ||
                           ' more than ' || v_days || ' days past due (due ' || r.due_date::date || ').',
           matching_blocked = true,
           matching_block_reason = 'Banned: unpaid refund clawback escalated to legal'
     where id = r.supplier_id;

    insert into public.founder_alerts(level, event, detail, channel)
    values ('crit', 'supplier_banned_legal',
      coalesce(r.company_name,'Supplier #'||r.supplier_id) || ' has been banned and due #' || r.id ||
      ' escalated to legal: AED ' || round(coalesce(r.amount_due,0)+coalesce(r.admin_fee,0)+coalesce(r.interest_amount,0),2) ||
      ' unpaid for over ' || v_days || ' days. ' ||
      case when r.accepted_terms_at is null
           then '*** NO SIGNED TERMS ON RECORD - the supplier agreement cannot be produced as evidence, so a filing may not be supportable. Verify before instructing the legal agent. ***'
           else 'Terms accepted ' || r.accepted_terms_at::date || ' (version ' || coalesce(r.accepted_terms_version,'?') || ') - available as supporting evidence.'
      end, 'system');

    v_n := v_n + 1;
  end loop;

  return v_n;
end;
fn_reconcile_doc_blocks:
declare
  v_lic_susp int := 0; v_ins_susp int := 0; v_restored int := 0;
  v_cut date := current_date - make_interval(days => p_grace_days);
  rec record;
begin
  -- ---- SUSPEND: trade licence expired -------------------------------------------------
  -- Only touches rows that are unblocked or already blocked for a document reason, so a
  -- manual block set by the team is never overwritten or silently cleared.
  for rec in
    select id, company_name, claimed_by, email, phone, whatsapp, license_expiry
      from leads
     where approval_status = 'approved' and coalesce(banned,false) = false
       and license_expiry is not null and license_expiry < v_cut
       and (coalesce(matching_blocked,false) = false
            or matching_block_reason in ('licence_expired','insurance_expired'))
       and coalesce(matching_block_reason,'') is distinct from 'licence_expired'
  loop
    update leads set matching_blocked = true, matching_block_reason = 'licence_expired'
     where id = rec.id;
    v_lic_susp := v_lic_susp + 1;
    insert into notifications(type,to_email,to_role,lead_id,channel,subject,body,status)
    values ('doc_suspended', coalesce(rec.claimed_by, rec.email), 'supplier', rec.id, 'email',
      'Your QuotesDone account is paused - trade licence expired',
      'Dear ' || coalesce(rec.company_name,'supplier') || ',' || chr(10) || chr(10) ||
      'Your trade licence expired on ' || rec.license_expiry || ', so your account has been temporarily paused and you will not receive new customer requests until it is renewed.' || chr(10) || chr(10) ||
      'To restore your account: reply to this email with the renewed licence attached, or upload it in the Documents tab of your supplier portal. Your account is restored automatically as soon as we have a valid copy - nothing else is needed and no fee applies.',
      'queued');
  end loop;

  -- ---- SUSPEND: insurance expired -----------------------------------------------------
  for rec in
    select id, company_name, claimed_by, email, insurance_expiry
      from leads
     where approval_status = 'approved' and coalesce(banned,false) = false
       and insurance_expiry is not null and insurance_expiry < v_cut
       and (coalesce(matching_blocked,false) = false
            or matching_block_reason in ('licence_expired','insurance_expired'))
       and coalesce(matching_block_reason,'') is distinct from 'insurance_expired'
       -- a licence block is the more serious of the two, so do not downgrade its reason
       and coalesce(matching_block_reason,'') is distinct from 'licence_expired'
  loop
    update leads set matching_blocked = true, matching_block_reason = 'insurance_expired'
     where id = rec.id;
    v_ins_susp := v_ins_susp + 1;
    insert into notifications(type,to_email,to_role,lead_id,channel,subject,body,status)
    values ('doc_suspended', coalesce(rec.claimed_by, rec.email), 'supplier', rec.id, 'email',
      'Your QuotesDone account is paused - insurance expired',
      'Dear ' || coalesce(rec.company_name,'supplier') || ',' || chr(10) || chr(10) ||
      'Your insurance certificate expired on ' || rec.insurance_expiry || ', so your account has been temporarily paused and you will not receive new customer requests until it is renewed.' || chr(10) || chr(10) ||
      'To restore your account: reply to this email with the renewed certificate attached, or upload it in the Documents tab of your supplier portal. Your account is restored automatically as soon as we have a valid copy.',
      'queued');
  end loop;

  -- ---- RESTORE: the blocking document is valid again -----------------------------------
  -- Only clears blocks this job set. A manual block stays put.
  for rec in
    select id, company_name, claimed_by, email, matching_block_reason
      from leads
     where matching_block_reason in ('licence_expired','insurance_expired')
       and ((matching_block_reason = 'licence_expired'
             and (license_expiry is null or license_expiry >= v_cut))
         or (matching_block_reason = 'insurance_expired'
             and (insurance_expiry is null or insurance_expiry >= v_cut)))
  loop
    update leads set matching_blocked = false, matching_block_reason = null where id = rec.id;
    v_restored := v_restored + 1;
    insert into notifications(type,to_email,to_role,lead_id,channel,subject,body,status)
    values ('doc_restored', coalesce(rec.claimed_by, rec.email), 'supplier', rec.id, 'email',
      'Your QuotesDone account is active again',
      'Dear ' || coalesce(rec.company_name,'supplier') || ',' || chr(10) || chr(10) ||
      'Thank you - your documents are up to date and your account is active again. You will start receiving matching customer requests immediately.',
      'queued');
  end loop;

  return json_build_object('licence_suspended', v_lic_susp, 'insurance_suspended', v_ins_susp,
                           'restored', v_restored, 'grace_days', p_grace_days, 'ran_at', now());
end
fn_norm_trades:
-- SLUG SEPARATORS ARE WORD SEPARATORS (12 Aug 2026). The scraper writes sector as
  -- 'building-materials'; every multi-word alias in taxonomy_trade is written with spaces. \m is a
  -- word boundary, '-' is not a word character, so a two-word alias can never span the hyphen and
  -- 514 leads sat outside the vocabulary over one character. Normalising the INPUT rather than
  -- rewriting 40 trades' aliases into every punctuation variant they might arrive in.
  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct t.code order by t.code), '{}')
  from public.taxonomy_trade t
  where t.active
    and exists (
      select 1 from unnest(t.aliases || t.code) a
      where length(a) >= 3
        and regexp_replace(coalesce(p_text,''), '[-_/.]+', ' ', 'g')
            ~* ('\m' || regexp_replace(a, '([.*+?^${}()|\[\]\\])', '\\\1', 'g'))
    );
fn_norm_roles:
select coalesce(array_agg(distinct r.code order by r.code), '{}')
  from public.taxonomy_role r
  where r.active
    and exists (
      select 1 from unnest(r.aliases || r.code) a
      where length(a) >= 3
        and coalesce(p_text,'') ~* ('\m' || regexp_replace(a, '([.*+?^${}()|\[\]\\])', '\\\1', 'g'))
    );
fn_match_capability:
with w as (
  select coalesce((select value::text::numeric from decision_policy where key='score_w_product'),40)      as w_prod,
         coalesce((select value::text::numeric from decision_policy where key='score_w_brand'),20)        as w_brand,
         coalesce((select value::text::numeric from decision_policy where key='score_w_project_type'),15) as w_ptype,
         coalesce((select value::text::numeric from decision_policy where key='score_w_track_record'),15) as w_track,
         coalesce((select value::text::numeric from decision_policy where key='score_w_size_fit'),10)     as w_size
),
req_auth as (
  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct a),'{}') as codes
  from public.taxonomy_trade t, unnest(t.authority_required) a
  where t.code = any(p_trades)
),
cand as (
  select sc.supplier_id, sc.trades, sc.roles, sc.products_norm, sc.brands, sc.project_types,
         sc.min_project_value, sc.max_project_value, sc.coverage_emirates,
         l.company_name, l.emirate as lead_emirate,
         least(1, greatest(0, coalesce(sp.quote_rate, sp.perf_score, 0))) as track
  from public.supplier_capabilities sc
  join public.leads l on l.id = sc.supplier_id
  left join public.supplier_perf sp on sp.supplier_id = sc.supplier_id
  where sc.confirmed_at is not null                        -- GATE: supplier confirmed their own scope
    and sc.trades && p_trades                              -- GATE: trade intersection
    and not (sc.excluded_trades && p_trades)               -- GATE: declared negative scope
    and public.fn_is_matchable(l.verified, l.banned, l.matching_blocked,
                               l.approval_status, l.permanently_closed, l.chat_strikes)
    and exists (                                            -- GATE: role can actually do this kind of work
      select 1 from public.taxonomy_role r
      where r.code = any(sc.roles)
        and case p_need when 'supplies'    then r.supplies
                        when 'whole_scope' then r.whole_scope
                        else r.executes end
    )
    and not exists (                                        -- GATE: every mandatory authority held
      select 1 from unnest((select codes from req_auth)) a
      where not (sc.authority_approvals ? a)
    )
    and (p_value is null or (                               -- GATE: job size inside their range
          (sc.min_project_value is null or p_value >= sc.min_project_value)
      and (sc.max_project_value is null or p_value <= sc.max_project_value)))
    and (p_emirate is null or                               -- GATE: they cover the emirate asked for
         coalesce(cardinality(sc.coverage_emirates), 0) = 0
      or exists (select 1 from unnest(sc.coverage_emirates) ce where ce ilike p_emirate)
      or l.emirate ilike p_emirate)
),
scored as (
  select c.*,
    (select count(distinct pq) from unnest(p_products) pq
      where exists (select 1 from unnest(c.products_norm) pp
                    where pp ilike '%'||pq||'%' or pq ilike '%'||pp||'%'))::int as product_hits,
    (cardinality(p_brands) > 0 and exists (
       select 1 from unnest(p_brands) bq join unnest(c.brands) bb on bb ilike '%'||bq||'%' or bq ilike '%'||bb||'%'
     )) as brand_hit,
    (p_project_type is not null and exists (
       select 1 from unnest(c.project_types) pt
       where pt ilike '%'||p_project_type||'%' or p_project_type ilike '%'||pt||'%'
     )) as ptype_hit,
    (p_value is not null and c.min_project_value is not null and c.max_project_value is not null) as size_known
  from cand c
)
select s.supplier_id, s.company_name,
  round(
      w.w_prod  * (case when cardinality(p_products) > 0
                        then s.product_hits::numeric / cardinality(p_products) else 0 end)
    + w.w_brand * (case when s.brand_hit then 1 else 0 end)
    + w.w_ptype * (case when s.ptype_hit then 1 else 0 end)
    + w.w_track * s.track
    + w.w_size  * (case when s.size_known then 1 else 0.5 end)
  , 1) as score,
  s.trades, s.roles, s.product_hits, s.brand_hit, s.ptype_hit, round(s.track,3) as track,
  concat_ws(' · ',
    'trades ' || array_to_string(array(select unnest(s.trades) intersect select unnest(p_trades)), '+'),
    case when s.product_hits > 0 then s.product_hits||'/'||cardinality(p_products)||' products' end,
    case when s.brand_hit then 'brand match' end,
    case when s.ptype_hit then 'project type' end,
    case when p_emirate is not null then
      case when coalesce(cardinality(s.coverage_emirates),0) = 0 then 'coverage not stated'
           else 'covers ' || p_emirate end end
  ) as why
from scored s, w
order by score desc, s.track desc, s.supplier_id
limit greatest(1, p_limit);
fn_supplier_capability_chase:
declare
  rec record; v_sent int := 0; v_skipped int := 0; v_escalated int := 0; v_orphans int := 0;
  v_to text; v_chases int; v_ask text; v_have_proposal boolean;
begin
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- A. stalled records
  for rec in
    select sc.supplier_id, sc.review_status, sc.missing_fields, sc.updated_at,
           l.company_name, l.claimed_by, l.email
      from supplier_capabilities sc
      join leads l on l.id = sc.supplier_id
     where sc.confirmed_at is null
       and coalesce(l.claimed, false) = true         -- they have an account. This is not cold outreach.
       and sc.updated_at < now() - make_interval(days => p_days)
       and coalesce(l.banned,false) = false
       and coalesce(l.permanently_closed,false) = false
  loop
    select count(*) into v_chases from notifications
     where type = 'capability_chase' and lead_id = rec.supplier_id;

    -- Stop emailing after p_max_chases and hand to supplier_success as an action instead.
    if v_chases >= p_max_chases then
      if not exists (select 1 from agent_actions
                      where agent='supplier_success' and kind='capability_stalled'
                        and target_id = rec.supplier_id::text and status in ('needs_review','pending')) then
        insert into agent_actions(agent,kind,status,risk,title,recommendation,detail,target_table,target_id)
        values ('supplier_success','capability_stalled','needs_review','medium',
                'Supplier stalled in onboarding: ' || coalesce(rec.company_name,'#'||rec.supplier_id),
                'Chased ' || v_chases || ' times with no response. They cannot receive any inquiry until their scope is confirmed. Consider a call, or retire the registration.',
                jsonb_build_object('supplier_id',rec.supplier_id,'review_status',rec.review_status,
                                   'missing',to_jsonb(rec.missing_fields),'chases',v_chases),
                'leads', rec.supplier_id::text);
        v_escalated := v_escalated + 1;
      end if;
      continue;
    end if;

    -- one chase per 5 days
    if exists (select 1 from notifications where type='capability_chase' and lead_id=rec.supplier_id
                 and created_at > now() - interval '5 days') then
      v_skipped := v_skipped + 1; continue;
    end if;

    v_to := nullif(trim(coalesce(rec.claimed_by, rec.email)), '');
    if v_to is null or position('@' in v_to) = 0 then v_skipped := v_skipped + 1; continue; end if;
    if not (public.fn_email_sendable(v_to)->>'ok')::boolean then v_skipped := v_skipped + 1; continue; end if;

    -- 'insufficient' is the only status meaning we could not read a scope at all. Everything else
    -- ('derived' from the directory, 'awaiting_confirmation' from their documents) means a proposal
    -- is already on their screen and the ask is to correct it.
    v_have_proposal := coalesce(rec.review_status, 'derived') <> 'insufficient';

    -- Reuse the agent's own wording. A generic "please complete your profile" is why these stall.
    v_ask := coalesce(
      (select string_agg('  • ' || m, chr(10)) from unnest(rec.missing_fields) m),
      '  • a company profile or catalogue describing the products and services you supply');

    insert into notifications(type,to_email,to_role,lead_id,channel,subject,body,status)
    values ('capability_chase', v_to, 'supplier', rec.supplier_id, 'email',
      case when v_have_proposal
           then 'One step left — confirm what your company can quote for'
           else 'We need a little more to start sending you work' end,
      'Dear ' || coalesce(rec.company_name,'supplier') || ',' || chr(10) || chr(10) ||
      case when v_have_proposal
        then 'We have already filled in the trades and the role we hold for your company. We just need you to confirm they are right before we start matching you to customer requests — we will not guess your scope on your behalf, so until you confirm it you receive nothing.'
        else 'We have reviewed the documents you uploaded, but we cannot yet tell precisely what work to send you. Until we can, you will not receive customer requests — we would rather send you nothing than send you jobs you do not do.'
      end || chr(10) || chr(10) ||
      case when v_have_proposal then 'Open the "My scope" tab in your supplier portal, correct anything that is wrong, and press Confirm.'
           else 'What we still need:' || chr(10) || v_ask end || chr(10) || chr(10) ||
      'It takes about a minute and only needs doing once.' || chr(10) || chr(10) ||
      'QuotesDone',
      'queued');
    v_sent := v_sent + 1;
  end loop;

  ---------------------------------------------------------------- B. approved but no record at all
  for rec in
    select l.id as supplier_id, l.company_name
      from leads l
      left join supplier_capabilities sc on sc.supplier_id = l.id
     where l.approval_status = 'approved'
       and coalesce(l.banned,false) = false
       and coalesce(l.matching_blocked,false) = false
       and sc.supplier_id is null
  loop
    if not exists (select 1 from agent_actions
                    where agent='supplier_success' and kind='capability_missing'
                      and target_id = rec.supplier_id::text and status in ('needs_review','pending')) then
      insert into agent_actions(agent,kind,status,risk,title,recommendation,detail,target_table,target_id)
      values ('supplier_success','capability_missing','needs_review','high',
              'Approved supplier has no capability record: ' || coalesce(rec.company_name,'#'||rec.supplier_id),
              'This supplier is approved but invisible to matching, because fn_match_capability requires a supplier-confirmed capability record. They will receive zero inquiries and will conclude the platform does not work. Run capability_agent analyze for them.',
              jsonb_build_object('supplier_id',rec.supplier_id),
              'leads', rec.supplier_id::text);
      v_orphans := v_orphans + 1;
    end if;
  end loop;

  insert into agent_runs(agent,status,counts,note,started_at,finished_at)
  values ('supplier_success','ok',
          jsonb_build_object('chased',v_sent,'skipped',v_skipped,'escalated',v_escalated,'no_capability_record',v_orphans),
          'capability chase: ' || v_sent || ' chased, ' || v_escalated || ' escalated after ' || p_max_chases ||
          ' attempts, ' || v_orphans || ' approved supplier(s) flagged with no capability record at all',
          now(), now());

  return json_build_object('chased',v_sent,'skipped',v_skipped,'escalated',v_escalated,'no_capability_record',v_orphans);
end
fn_category_sales:
declare
  rec record; v_hot int := 0; v_gap int := 0; v_cats int := 0; v_slug text; v_label text;
begin
  ---------------------------------------------------------------- HOT LEADS
  -- Quotes are in, the customer has not revealed. Every one of these is uncollected revenue.
  for rec in
    select i.id, i.category, i.emirate, count(q.id) as n_quotes, min(q.created_at) as first_quote
      from inquiries i
      join quotes q on q.inquiry_id = i.id and q.status = 'submitted'
     where not exists (select 1 from transactions tr where tr.inquiry_id = i.id and tr.revealed_at is not null)
       and coalesce(i.status,'') <> 'split'
     group by i.id, i.category, i.emirate
    having min(q.created_at) < now() - make_interval(hours => p_min_age_hours)
  loop
    v_slug := 'cat:' || lower(coalesce(nullif(trim(rec.category),''),'uncategorised'));
    v_label := coalesce(nullif(trim(rec.category),''),'Uncategorised');
    -- one open hot_lead per inquiry
    if not exists (select 1 from agent_actions
                    where kind = 'hot_lead' and target_id = rec.id::text
                      and status in ('needs_review','pending','open','proposed')) then
      insert into agent_actions(agent,kind,status,risk,title,recommendation,detail,target_table,target_id,assumptions,expected_impact,cost)
      values (v_slug,'hot_lead','needs_review','medium',
              'Hot lead — ' || v_label || ' / ' || coalesce(nullif(trim(rec.emirate),''),'UAE') ||
                ': ' || rec.n_quotes || ' quote(s), not revealed',
              'nudge the customer to reveal',
              jsonb_build_object('inquiry_id',rec.id,'category',rec.category,'emirate',rec.emirate,
                                 'quotes',rec.n_quotes,'waiting_since',rec.first_quote),
              'inquiries', rec.id::text,
              -- s36 (13 Aug 2026): what this nudge takes on trust.
              jsonb_build_array(
                'That the customer has SEEN the quotes. The reveal gate hides supplier identity, not the fact that offers arrived; whether they have opened the portal at all is not measured here.',
                'That ' || rec.n_quotes || ' quote(s) is enough to decide on. Quoting is blind, so a customer who is waiting may be waiting for one more comparable offer rather than hesitating over these.',
                'The age is measured from the FIRST quote (' || to_char(rec.first_quote at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || 'Z), so an inquiry whose quotes arrived days apart looks older than the customer''s actual wait for a comparable set.'),
              'This is the one point in the funnel where money changes hands. A quoted inquiry that is never revealed is the supplier''s work and the platform''s fee both thrown away.',
              'No spend. One nudge to the customer. The reveal fee is theirs to pay and is not a discount to offer.');
      v_hot := v_hot + 1;
    end if;
  end loop;

  ---------------------------------------------------------------- SUPPLY GAPS
  -- Category+emirate combinations where finalized demand found nobody. Feeds supplier activation.
  for rec in
    select coalesce(nullif(trim(i.category),''),'uncategorised') as category,
           coalesce(nullif(trim(i.emirate),''),'UAE') as emirate,
           count(*) as n_inquiries
      from inquiries i
     where i.rfq_ready is true
       and coalesce(i.status,'') <> 'split'
       and not exists (select 1 from inquiry_matches m where m.inquiry_id = i.id)
       and i.created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
     group by 1,2
  loop
    v_slug := 'cat:' || lower(rec.category);
    if not exists (select 1 from agent_actions
                    where kind = 'supply_gap' and agent = v_slug
                      and detail->>'emirate' = rec.emirate
                      and status in ('needs_review','pending','open','proposed')) then
      insert into agent_actions(agent,kind,status,risk,title,recommendation,detail,target_table,target_id,assumptions,expected_impact,cost)
      values (v_slug,'supply_gap','needs_review','high',
              'Supply gap — ' || rec.category || ' / ' || rec.emirate || ': no suppliers matched',
              'source or activate suppliers in this category',
              jsonb_build_object('category',rec.category,'emirate',rec.emirate,'inquiries',rec.n_inquiries),
              'inquiries', null,
              -- s36 (13 Aug 2026): what this gap takes on trust.
              jsonb_build_array(
                'A gap means the matcher wrote no inquiry_matches row. That does NOT distinguish "no supplier exists in this category" from "suppliers exist but none has declared this capability" - the second is fixable today and the first is not.',
                'The window is 30 days, so a gap already closed by a supplier who joined yesterday keeps appearing until the inquiry ages out of it.',
                'Category and emirate are the customer''s intake as it was recorded. A mis-categorised inquiry manufactures a gap in a category with no real demand behind it.'),
              'An RFQ in a category with no supplier cannot be quoted at all, so the request is lost before price ever matters. Supply is the binding constraint on revenue.',
              'No spend to decide. Filling it costs invitation volume and sending reputation, which the invite ramp caps - or nothing at all, if a supplier already on file simply has not declared the capability.');
      v_gap := v_gap + 1;
    end if;
  end loop;

  select count(distinct coalesce(nullif(trim(category),''),'uncategorised')) into v_cats from inquiries;

  insert into agent_runs(agent,status,counts,note,started_at,finished_at)
  values ('category_sales','ok',
          jsonb_build_object('hot',v_hot,'gaps',v_gap,'categories',v_cats),
          'category sweep: ' || v_hot || ' new hot lead(s), ' || v_gap || ' new supply gap(s) across ' || v_cats || ' categories',
          now(), now());

  return json_build_object('hot',v_hot,'gaps',v_gap,'categories',v_cats);
end

fn_page_high_agent_action:
DECLARE v_founder text;
BEGIN
  IF lower(coalesce(NEW.risk,'')) IN ('high','critical')
     -- K21. Was: NEW.agent IN ('finance_ai','security_ai','operations_ai'). That set could never
     -- match a security action. a00_agent_action_resolve_addressee runs BEFORE this trigger and
     -- resolves the addressee through org_agents, so a row written as 'security_ai' arrives here
     -- as 'security'. Measured: inserting agent='security_ai' reads back as 'security', and
     -- notifications has 0 rows of type 'agent_escalation' in its entire history — the founder has
     -- never been paged by this trigger. A prefix match survives the resolver in both directions
     -- and does not need a keep-list that has to be remembered every time an agent is renamed.
     AND NEW.agent ~ '^(finance|security|operations)'
     AND lower(coalesce(NEW.status,'pending')) = 'pending' THEN
  -- K20 cutover. A high or critical pending action from finance, security or operations is the declared start of W29. Placed INSIDE the risk branch, so an ordinary agent action does not open an incident.
  perform public.fn_kernel_source_emit('dbtrigger:public.agent_actions:trg_page_high_agent_action', jsonb_build_object(
    'source_ref',  NEW.id::text,
    'raw_payload', jsonb_build_object('incident_ref', 'agent_action:' || NEW.id::text, 'agent', NEW.agent, 'kind', NEW.kind, 'risk', NEW.risk, 'title', NEW.title)));
    v_founder := coalesce(
      (SELECT value FROM app_secrets WHERE key='founder_email'),
      nullif(split_part((SELECT value FROM app_secrets WHERE key='admin_emails'), ',', 1), ''),
      'management@quotesdone.com');
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM notifications
      WHERE type='agent_escalation' AND body LIKE '%action #'||NEW.id||'%'
        AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
    ) THEN
      INSERT INTO notifications(type, to_email, to_role, channel, status, subject, body)
      VALUES('agent_escalation', v_founder, 'admin', 'email', 'queued',
        '['||upper(NEW.risk)||'] '||coalesce(NEW.title, NEW.kind, 'Agent escalation'),
        coalesce(NEW.recommendation, NEW.title, '')||E'\n\nAgent: '||coalesce(NEW.agent,'?')||' · action #'||NEW.id||' · open the OS to decide.');
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END

fn_autonomy_audit:
with per as (
    select d.dept_key, d.name,
      (select max(created_at) from org_memory m where m.scope=d.dept_key and m.kind='plan')   as last_plan,
      (select max(created_at) from org_memory m where m.scope=d.dept_key and m.kind='lesson') as last_lesson,
      (select count(*) from org_tasks t where t.dept_key=d.dept_key and t.status in ('assigned','proposed','in_progress')) as open_tasks,
      (select count(*) from org_tasks t where t.dept_key=d.dept_key and t.status='done' and t.updated_at > now()-interval '7 days') as done_7d
    from org_departments d where d.active
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'as_of', now(),
    'departments', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'dept', dept_key, 'name', name,
        'last_plan', last_plan, 'last_lesson', last_lesson, 'open_tasks', open_tasks, 'done_7d', done_7d,
        'status', case
          when (last_plan is null or last_plan < now()-interval '4 days') and open_tasks=0 and done_7d=0 then 'red'
          when (last_plan is null or last_plan < now()-interval '3 days') then 'amber'
          else 'green' end
      ) order by dept_key) from per),
    'summary', (select jsonb_build_object(
        'green', count(*) filter (where (last_plan is not null and last_plan >= now()-interval '3 days')),
        'stalled', count(*) filter (where (last_plan is null or last_plan < now()-interval '4 days') and open_tasks=0 and done_7d=0))
      from per)
  );

fn_schema_export:
with t as (
  select c.relname as rel,
    'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.'||quote_ident(c.relname)||E' (
'||
    string_agg('  '||quote_ident(a.attname)||' '||format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod)||
      case a.attidentity when 'a' then ' GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY' when 'd' then ' GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY' else '' end||
      case when a.attgenerated='s' then ' GENERATED ALWAYS AS ('||pg_get_expr(ad.adbin,ad.adrelid)||') STORED'
           when ad.adbin is not null then ' DEFAULT '||pg_get_expr(ad.adbin,ad.adrelid) else '' end||
      case when a.attnotnull then ' NOT NULL' else '' end, E',
' order by a.attnum)
    ||E'
);' as tbl_ddl
  from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace and n.nspname='public'
  join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped
  left join pg_attrdef ad on ad.adrelid=c.oid and ad.adnum=a.attnum
  where c.relkind='r' and not exists(select 1 from pg_depend d where d.objid=c.oid and d.deptype='e')
  group by c.relname
)
select
  '-- QuotesDone — FULL SCHEMA EXPORT (generated from the live database)'||E'
'
  ||'-- Excludes: secret VALUES (key names listed below), and table ROW DATA (PII).'||E'
'
  ||'-- Order is best-effort; this is a faithful reference mirror, not a guaranteed one-click restore.'||E'

'
  ||'-- ===== EXTENSIONS =====' ||E'
'|| coalesce((select string_agg('CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS '||quote_ident(extname)||' WITH SCHEMA '||quote_ident(nx.nspname)||';', E'
' order by extname) from pg_extension e join pg_namespace nx on nx.oid=e.extnamespace),'')
  ||E'

-- ===== SEQUENCES =====
'|| coalesce((select string_agg('CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS public.'||quote_ident(sequence_name)||';', E'
' order by sequence_name) from information_schema.sequences where sequence_schema='public'),'')
  ||E'

-- ===== TABLES ('||(select count(*) from t)||') =====
'|| coalesce((select string_agg(tbl_ddl, E'

' order by rel) from t),'')
  ||E'

-- ===== CONSTRAINTS =====
'|| coalesce((select string_agg('ALTER TABLE public.'||quote_ident(c.relname)||' ADD CONSTRAINT '||quote_ident(con.conname)||' '||pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid)||';', E'
' order by case con.contype when 'p' then 1 when 'u' then 2 when 'c' then 3 else 9 end, c.relname) from pg_constraint con join pg_class c on c.oid=con.conrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace and n.nspname='public' where con.contype in ('p','u','c','f')),'')
  ||E'

-- ===== INDEXES =====
'|| coalesce((select string_agg(pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid)||';', E'
' order by ic.relname) from pg_index i join pg_class ic on ic.oid=i.indexrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=ic.relnamespace and n.nspname='public' where not exists(select 1 from pg_constraint con where con.conindid=i.indexrelid) and not exists(select 1 from pg_depend d where d.objid=ic.oid and d.deptype='e')),'')
  ||E'

-- ===== VIEWS =====
'|| coalesce((select string_agg('CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.'||quote_ident(viewname)||' AS '||definition, E'

' order by viewname) from pg_views where schemaname='public'),'')
  ||E'

-- ===== FUNCTIONS =====
'|| coalesce((select string_agg(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid), E'

' order by p.proname) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace and n.nspname='public' where p.prokind in ('f','p') and not exists(select 1 from pg_depend d where d.objid=p.oid and d.deptype='e')),'')
  ||E'

-- ===== TRIGGERS =====
'|| coalesce((select string_agg(pg_get_triggerdef(tg.oid)||';', E'
' order by c.relname) from pg_trigger tg join pg_class c on c.oid=tg.tgrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace and n.nspname='public' where not tg.tgisinternal),'')
  ||E'

-- ===== ROW LEVEL SECURITY (enable) =====
'|| coalesce((select string_agg('ALTER TABLE public.'||quote_ident(relname)||' ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;', E'
' order by relname) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace and n.nspname='public' where relkind='r' and relrowsecurity),'')

fn_os_health:
DECLARE res jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'generated_at', now(),
    'failing_crons', coalesce((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('job', j.jobname, 'status', lr.status, 'when', lr.end_time,
                                          'message', left(coalesce(lr.return_message,''),160))
                       ORDER BY lr.end_time DESC)
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (jobid) jobid, status, end_time, return_message
              FROM cron.job_run_details
             WHERE start_time > now() - interval '7 days'
             ORDER BY jobid, start_time DESC) lr
      JOIN cron.job j ON j.jobid = lr.jobid
      WHERE lr.status = 'failed' AND lr.end_time > now() - interval '24 hours'
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'agent_errors_24h', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.agent_runs WHERE status='error' AND started_at > now() - interval '24 hours'),
    'top_error_agents', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_object('agent',agent,'errors',count(*)) x FROM public.agent_runs WHERE status='error' AND started_at > now()-interval '24 hours' GROUP BY agent ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 6) q),'[]'::jsonb),
    'health_check_fails_24h', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.health_checks WHERE ok=false AND created_at > now()-interval '24 hours'),
    'ai_health_fails', coalesce((SELECT value FROM public.app_secrets WHERE key='ai_health_fails'),'0'),
    'payments_7d_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.transactions WHERE revealed_at > now()-interval '7 days'),
    'payments_7d_revenue_aed', coalesce((SELECT round(sum(reveal_fee)::numeric,2) FROM public.transactions WHERE revealed_at > now()-interval '7 days'),0),
    -- CAN A REQUEST REACH ANYONE? Each number is counted at the gate it actually has to pass, so
    -- the drop between them says WHERE the reach is lost rather than only that it is small.
    'supplier_reach', jsonb_build_object(
      'leads', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.leads),
      'with_capability', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.supplier_capabilities WHERE coalesce(cardinality(trades),0) > 0),
      'confirmed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.supplier_capabilities WHERE confirmed_at IS NOT NULL),
      -- the real ceiling: confirmed AND the lead itself still admissible to matching
      'matchable_now', (
        SELECT count(*) FROM public.supplier_capabilities sc
        JOIN public.leads l ON l.id = sc.supplier_id
        WHERE sc.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
          AND coalesce(cardinality(sc.trades),0) > 0
          AND public.fn_is_matchable(l.verified, l.banned, l.matching_blocked,
                                     l.approval_status, l.permanently_closed, l.chat_strikes)),
      'meaning', 'matchable_now is the most suppliers the structured matcher can shortlist for any request. fn_match_capability requires a supplier to have CONFIRMED their own scope; that gate is deliberate. When this is far below with_capability the shortage is confirmations, not suppliers.'
    )
  ) INTO res;
  RETURN res;
END

fn_suppliers_board:
declare out jsonb;
begin
  with base as (
    select l.id, l.company_name,
      coalesce(nullif(trim(l.sector),''),'general') as sector,
      coalesce(nullif(trim(l.emirate),''),'—') as emirate,
      coalesce(l.rating, l.app_rating) as rating,
      l.verified, (l.approved_at is not null) as approved, l.banned,
      (l.invited_at is not null) as invited, l.claimed, (l.registration_submitted_at is not null) as registered,
      coalesce(l.capability_score,0) as capability_score, l.created_at,
      case when l.approved_at is not null then 'approved' when l.verified then 'verified'
           when l.registration_submitted_at is not null then 'registered' when l.invited_at is not null then 'invited'
           when l.contacted then 'contacted' else 'sourced' end as stage
    from leads l
    where (coalesce(p_search,'') = '' or l.company_name ilike '%'||p_search||'%' or l.sector ilike '%'||p_search||'%' or l.emirate ilike '%'||p_search||'%')
      and (coalesce(p_sector,'') = '' or l.sector = p_sector)
  ),
  ranked as (select *, row_number() over (partition by stage order by created_at desc, id desc) as rn from base),
  stagecounts as (select stage, count(*) as c from base group by stage)
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'total', (select count(*) from base),
    'stages', (
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key', s.key, 'label', s.label,
        'count', coalesce((select c from stagecounts sc where sc.stage=s.key),0),
        'cards', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'company_name',r.company_name,'sector',r.sector,'emirate',r.emirate,'rating',r.rating,'verified',r.verified,'approved',r.approved,'banned',r.banned,'capability_score',r.capability_score) order by r.rn) from ranked r where r.stage=s.key and r.rn<=12),'[]'::jsonb))
        order by s.ord)
      from (values ('sourced','Sourced',1),('contacted','Contacted',2),('invited','Invited',3),('registered','Registered',4),('verified','Verified',5),('approved','Approved',6)) s(key,label,ord)
    ),
    'rows', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',b.id,'company_name',b.company_name,'sector',b.sector,'emirate',b.emirate,'rating',b.rating,'verified',b.verified,'approved',b.approved,'banned',b.banned,'invited',b.invited,'registered',b.registered,'stage',b.stage,'capability_score',b.capability_score,'created_at',b.created_at) order by b.created_at desc, b.id desc),'[]'::jsonb)
             from (select * from base order by created_at desc, id desc limit greatest(1,least(p_limit,200)) offset greatest(0,p_offset)) b),
    'sectors', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label',x.sector,'n',x.n) order by x.n desc),'[]'::jsonb) from (select sector, count(*) n from base group by sector order by count(*) desc limit 12) x)
  ) into out;
  return out;
end
fn_entity_activity:
declare out jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; l public.leads%rowtype;
begin
  -- comments (all entities)
  out := out || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','comment','title','Comment','actor',c.author,'body',c.body,'at',c.created_at)) from public.entity_comments c where c.entity=p_entity and c.entity_id=p_id),'[]'::jsonb);
  -- audit trail (all entities)
  out := out || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','audit','title',a.action,'actor',a.actor,'at',a.at,'ok',a.ok)) from public.os_audit_log a where a.entity_id=p_id and (a.entity=p_entity or (p_entity='supplier' and a.entity in ('leads','supplier','suppliers')))),'[]'::jsonb);
  if p_entity = 'supplier' then
    select * into l from public.leads where id = p_id::bigint;
    if l.id is not null then
      out := out || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','agent','title',coalesce(nullif(btrim(aa.title),''), aa.kind),'actor',aa.agent,'body',aa.recommendation,'at',aa.created_at,'status',aa.status)) from public.agent_actions aa where aa.target_table='leads' and aa.target_id::text = p_id),'[]'::jsonb);
      out := out || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','milestone','title',v.label,'actor','system','at',v.ts)) from (values
        ('Sourced', l.created_at),('Scraped', l.scraped_at),('Invited', l.invited_at),('AI reviewed', l.ai_reviewed_at),
        ('Documents extracted', l.doc_extracted_at),('Capability enriched', l.capability_enriched_at),
        ('Registration submitted', l.registration_submitted_at),('Terms accepted', l.accepted_terms_at),
        ('Terms signed', l.signed_terms_at),('Approved', l.approved_at)
      ) v(label, ts) where v.ts is not null),'[]'::jsonb);
    end if;
  end if;
  -- QD_RFQ_TRACE: the inquiry lifecycle, assembled from the rows that already record it.
  if p_entity in ('rfq','inquiry') and p_id ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$' then
    out := out || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','milestone','title',v.label,'actor','system','at',v.ts))
      from public.inquiries i cross join lateral (values
             ('Inquiry created', i.created_at),
             ('Moved to stage: '||coalesce(i.pipeline_stage,'(none)'), i.stage_changed_at),
             ('Completed'||coalesce(' — '||i.outcome,''), i.completed_at)
           ) v(label, ts)
     where i.id = p_id::uuid and v.ts is not null),'[]'::jsonb);

    out := out || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','decision',
        'title','Routed to category '||coalesce(i.category,'(none)')||
                case when coalesce(i.rfq_ready,false) then ' — brief complete' else ' — brief NOT complete' end,
        'actor','route_inquiry','body',left(coalesce(i.routing::text,''),400),'at',i.created_at))
      from public.inquiries i where i.id = p_id::uuid and i.routing is not null),'[]'::jsonb);

    out := out || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','document',
        'title',coalesce(d.kind,'document')||' '||coalesce(d.file_name,''),'actor','doc_extract',
        'body','status '||coalesce(d.status,'?')||case when coalesce(d.indexed,false) then ', indexed' else '' end,
        'at',coalesce(d.processed_at,d.created_at)))
      from public.documents d where d.ref_table='inquiries' and d.ref_id::text = p_id),'[]'::jsonb);

    out := out || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','match',
        'title','Dispatched to supplier #'||m.supplier_id||coalesce(' ('||ld.company_name||')',''),
        'actor','dispatch_inquiry',
        'body',coalesce(m.match_reason,'')||coalesce(' score '||m.similarity,''),'at',m.sent_at))
      from public.inquiry_matches m left join public.leads ld on ld.id = m.supplier_id
     where m.inquiry_id = p_id::uuid),'[]'::jsonb);

    out := out || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','quote',
        'title','Quotation AED '||q.quote_amount||' from supplier #'||q.supplier_id,
        'actor',coalesce(q.source,'form'),
        'body','status '||coalesce(q.status,'?')||coalesce(', quality '||q.quality::text,''),
        'at',q.created_at,'status',q.status))
      from public.quotes q where q.inquiry_id = p_id::uuid),'[]'::jsonb);

    out := out || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','comparison',
        'title','Quotation comparison produced','actor','quote_compare',
        'body',left(coalesce(c.explanation_en::text,''),400),'at',c.created_at))
      from public.comparison_run_v2 c where c.inquiry_id = p_id::uuid),'[]'::jsonb);

    out := out || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','reveal',
        'title','Supplier revealed to the customer for AED '||t.reveal_fee,'actor','customer','at',t.revealed_at))
      from public.transactions t where t.inquiry_id = p_id::uuid and t.revealed_at is not null),'[]'::jsonb);

    out := out || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','event','title',e.event_type,
        'actor',coalesce(e.actor,'system'),'at',e.occurred_at))
      from public.company_event e where e.entity_type in ('inquiry','inquiries') and e.entity_id = p_id),'[]'::jsonb);

    out := out || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','agent',
        'title',coalesce(nullif(btrim(aa.title),''), aa.kind),'actor',aa.agent,
        'body',aa.recommendation,'at',aa.created_at,'status',aa.status))
      from public.agent_actions aa where aa.target_table='inquiries' and aa.target_id::text = p_id),'[]'::jsonb);
  end if;


  -- CONFIGURATION ENTITIES. pricing_config, model_policy and prompts are changed by the company
  -- itself, and their history is the row-level change log rather than the action log. Without this
  -- branch "when did AI change pricing" had no reader at all.
  if p_entity in ('pricing_config','model_policy','prompts','config') then
    out := out || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'kind','change','title', u.op || ' on ' || u.table_name,
        'actor', coalesce(u.actor,'system'), 'at', u.created_at,
        'reverted', u.reverted, 'row_id', u.row_id) order by u.created_at desc)
      from (select * from public.undo_log u
             where u.table_name = p_entity
               and (coalesce(p_id,'') = '' or u.row_id::text = p_id)
             order by u.created_at desc limit 50) u), '[]'::jsonb);
  end if;

  return coalesce((select jsonb_agg(e) from (select e from jsonb_array_elements(out) e where (e->>'at') is not null order by (e->>'at') desc limit 80) z),'[]'::jsonb);
end

        'text', coalesce(p.content->>'all', p.content->>'text', left(p.content::text,400)),
        'channels', to_jsonb(p.channels), 'status', p.status, 'mode', p.mode, 'error', p.error, 'created_at', p.created_at
      ) order by p.created_at desc) from social_posts p),'[]'::jsonb),
    'blog', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', b.id, 'title', b.title, 'slug', b.slug, 'category', b.category, 'excerpt', b.excerpt,
        'published', b.published, 'published_at', b.published_at, 'body_html', left(b.body_html, 24000)
      ) order by b.updated_at desc) from blog_posts b),'[]'::jsonb),
    'review', (select coalesce(fn_review_pending(),'[]'::jsonb))
  );
fn_knowledge_gaps:
with base as (
    select ca.slug, ca.name, ca.emoji,
      (select count(*) from agent_knowledge k where k.agent_key = ca.slug or k.agent_key = 'cat:'||ca.slug) as items,
      (select max(updated_at) from agent_knowledge k where k.agent_key = ca.slug or k.agent_key = 'cat:'||ca.slug) as last_updated,
      (select min(d.os_key) from os_knowledge_domain d
        where d.domain_key = 'cat:'||ca.slug and d.ownership = 'owns') as owner_os
    from category_agents ca where coalesce(ca.active,true)
  ),
  scored as (
    select slug, name, emoji, items, last_updated, owner_os,
      case when last_updated is null then null else floor(extract(epoch from (now()-last_updated))/86400)::int end as days_stale,
      case when items = 0 then 'missing'
           when last_updated < now() - (p_stale_days||' days')::interval then 'stale'
           when items < p_thin_min then 'thin'
           else 'ok' end as status
    from base
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'thresholds', jsonb_build_object('stale_days', p_stale_days, 'thin_min', p_thin_min),
    'summary', jsonb_build_object(
      'total', (select count(*) from scored),
      'ok', (select count(*) from scored where status='ok'),
      'stale', (select count(*) from scored where status='stale'),
      'thin', (select count(*) from scored where status='thin'),
      'missing', (select count(*) from scored where status='missing'),
      'unowned', (select count(*) from scored where owner_os is null),
      'coverage_pct', round(100.0 * (select count(*) from scored where status='ok') / nullif((select count(*) from scored),0), 1)
    ),
    'agents', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'slug', slug, 'name', name, 'emoji', emoji, 'items', items, 'owner_os', owner_os,
        'last_updated', last_updated, 'days_stale', days_stale, 'status', status
      ) order by case status when 'stale' then 0 when 'thin' then 1 when 'missing' then 2 else 3 end, days_stale desc nulls last, slug)
      from scored), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
fn_knowledge_exam_summary:
with recent as (
    select * from knowledge_exam_results where created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
  ),
  per as (
    select agent_key,
      count(*) as examined,
      count(*) filter (where verdict='correct') as correct,
      count(*) filter (where verdict in ('wrong','partial','not_covered')) as gaps,
      count(*) filter (where filled) as filled,
      max(created_at) as last_exam
    from recent group by agent_key
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'overall', jsonb_build_object(
      'question_bank', (select count(*) from knowledge_exam_questions),
      'exams_30d', (select count(*) from recent),
      'agents_examined', (select count(*) from per),
      'gaps_filled_30d', (select count(*) from recent where filled),
      'avg_score', (select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where verdict='correct')/nullif(count(*),0),1) from recent)
    ),
    'agents', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'agent_key', agent_key, 'examined', examined, 'correct', correct,
        'score_pct', round(100.0*correct/nullif(examined,0),1),
        'gaps', gaps, 'filled', filled, 'last_exam', last_exam
      ) order by round(100.0*correct/nullif(examined,0),1) asc nulls first) from per), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
fn_exam_pick_agent:
with last_sat as (
    select (select agent_key from knowledge_exam_results order by created_at desc limit 1) as k
  ),
  -- Want a category next only if the last one sat was NOT a category. A null last_sat (no exam has
  -- ever been sat) starts with an employee, which is the population that matters more.
  want as (
    select coalesce((select k from last_sat) not like 'cat:%', false) as want_cat
  ),
  ranked as (
    select k.agent_key,
           (k.agent_key like 'cat:%') as is_cat,
           e.last_exam
    from (select distinct agent_key from agent_knowledge where agent_key <> '_global') k
    left join (select agent_key, max(created_at) last_exam from knowledge_exam_results group by agent_key) e
      on e.agent_key = k.agent_key
  )
  select agent_key from ranked
  -- false sorts first, so rows whose population matches what we want come first; everything after
  -- that is the original ordering, and the second population is still reachable when the first is
  -- empty.
  order by (is_cat is distinct from (select want_cat from want)), last_exam asc nulls first, agent_key
  limit 1;
fn_bump_exam_question: update knowledge_exam_questions set times_asked = coalesce(times_asked,0)+1, last_asked = now() where id = p_id;
fn_self_review:
declare v_found int := 0;
begin
  -- Stale knowledge: past its review date
  insert into self_review (review_type, subject, finding, evidence, proposal)
  select 'stale_knowledge', k.agent_key||' / '||k.topic,
         'Knowledge past its review date',
         'review_due '||k.review_due||', owner '||coalesce(k.owner_agent,'none')||', confidence '||coalesce(k.confidence::text,'unset'),
         'Re-research and revalidate, or mark superseded'
  from agent_knowledge k
  where k.review_due < current_date
    and not exists (select 1 from self_review s where s.review_type='stale_knowledge'
                     and s.subject = k.agent_key||' / '||k.topic and s.status='proposed');
  get diagnostics v_found = row_count;

  -- Departments that cannot act
  insert into self_review (review_type, subject, finding, evidence, proposal)
  select 'overloaded_dept', d.dept_key,
         'Department has authority but no wired executor',
         (select count(*)::text from org_authority a where a.dept_key=d.dept_key)||' authority rules, 0 executors',
         'Wire an executor or remove the authority rule'
  from org_departments d
  where d.active
    and not exists (select 1 from org_action_executor e where e.department=d.dept_key and e.active)
    and not exists (select 1 from self_review s where s.review_type='overloaded_dept' and s.subject=d.dept_key and s.status='proposed');

  -- Employees with no KPI
  insert into self_review (review_type, subject, finding, evidence, proposal)
  select 'missed_kpi', a.agent_key,
         'Employee has no measurable KPI',
         'title '||coalesce(a.title,'none')||', department '||a.department,
         'Assign a KPI tied to a company goal, or retire the role'
  from org_agents a
  where a.active
    and not exists (select 1 from employee_kpi k where k.agent_key=a.agent_key and k.active)
    and not exists (select 1 from self_review s where s.review_type='missed_kpi' and s.subject=a.agent_key and s.status='proposed');

  -- Recurring failures: any agent failing more than 3 times in 7 days
  insert into self_review (review_type, subject, finding, evidence, proposal)
  select 'recurring_failure', r.agent,
         'Agent failing repeatedly',
         count(*)||' failures in 7 days; latest: '||left(coalesce(max(r.note),''),160),
         'Diagnose root cause; this is an automation candidate if the fix is mechanical'
  from agent_runs r
  where r.started_at > now() - interval '7 days' and r.status='error'
  group by r.agent having count(*) > 3
    and not exists (select 1 from self_review s where s.review_type='recurring_failure' and s.subject=r.agent and s.status='proposed');

  -- Categories with supply but no standard knowledge
  insert into self_review (review_type, subject, finding, evidence, proposal)
  select 'stale_sop', v.catalog_slug,
         'Category has supplier supply but no standard knowledge base',
         v.supplier_supply||' suppliers in pipeline, coverage '||v.coverage,
         'Build the 14-module knowledge base; supplier supply is already there'
  from v_category_coverage v
  where v.coverage <> 'COMPLIANT' and v.supplier_supply >= 100
    and not exists (select 1 from self_review s where s.review_type='stale_sop' and s.subject=v.catalog_slug and s.status='proposed');

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'stale_knowledge', (select count(*) from self_review where review_type='stale_knowledge' and status='proposed'),
    'depts_cannot_act', (select count(*) from self_review where review_type='overloaded_dept' and status='proposed'),
    'employees_no_kpi', (select count(*) from self_review where review_type='missed_kpi' and status='proposed'),
    'recurring_failures', (select count(*) from self_review where review_type='recurring_failure' and status='proposed'),
    'categories_needing_knowledge', (select count(*) from self_review where review_type='stale_sop' and status='proposed'),
    'total_open', (select count(*) from self_review where status='proposed'));
end;
fn_brand_scan:
begin
  -- 1. Supplier claims to be registered but has no trade licence number.
  insert into brand_signal (signal_type, severity, subject_type, subject_id, rule_key, detail, evidence)
  select 'fake_supplier','high','lead', l.id::text, 'no_trade_licence',
         'Supplier reached registration without a trade licence number.',
         jsonb_build_object('company', l.company_name, 'status', l.registration_status)
  from leads l
  where l.registration_submitted_at is not null
    and coalesce(nullif(trim(l.trade_license_no),''), null) is null
  on conflict do nothing;

  -- 2. Licence expired but still approved to receive RFQs.
  insert into brand_signal (signal_type, severity, subject_type, subject_id, rule_key, detail, evidence)
  select 'fake_supplier','critical','lead', l.id::text, 'licence_expired_but_approved',
         'Approved supplier holds an expired trade licence.',
         jsonb_build_object('company', l.company_name, 'expiry', l.license_expiry)
  from leads l
  where l.approval_status = 'approved' and l.license_expiry is not null and l.license_expiry < current_date
  on conflict do nothing;

  -- 3. Two different suppliers claiming the same trade licence number.
  insert into brand_signal (signal_type, severity, subject_type, subject_id, rule_key, detail, evidence)
  select 'fake_supplier','critical','trade_license', t.lic, 'duplicate_trade_licence',
         'The same trade licence number is claimed by more than one supplier record.',
         jsonb_build_object('licence', t.lic, 'count', t.n)
  from (
    select trim(trade_license_no) as lic, count(*) as n
    from leads where coalesce(trim(trade_license_no),'') <> ''
    group by 1 having count(*) > 1
  ) t
  on conflict do nothing;

  -- 4. Supplier name impersonating QuotesDone.
  insert into brand_signal (signal_type, severity, subject_type, subject_id, rule_key, detail, evidence)
  select 'brand_misuse','high','lead', l.id::text, 'name_impersonates_platform',
         'Supplier trading name contains the platform brand.',
         jsonb_build_object('company', l.company_name)
  from leads l
  where l.company_name ~* '(quotes ?done|quotesdone)'
  on conflict do nothing;

  -- 5. Scam RFQ: request for money, gift cards or advance payment inside a buyer brief.
  insert into brand_signal (signal_type, severity, subject_type, subject_id, rule_key, detail, evidence)
  select 'scam_rfq','high','inquiry', i.id::text, 'advance_payment_solicitation',
         'Buyer brief solicits an advance payment, gift card or wire transfer.',
         jsonb_build_object('excerpt', left(coalesce(i.raw_input,''), 240))
  from inquiries i
  where coalesce(i.raw_input,'') ~* '(gift ?card|western union|wire transfer|advance fee|upfront payment to release|crypto payment)'
  on conflict do nothing;

  -- 6. Scam RFQ: attempt to move the conversation off-platform before reveal.
  insert into brand_signal (signal_type, severity, subject_type, subject_id, rule_key, detail, evidence)
  select 'scam_rfq','medium','inquiry', i.id::text, 'off_platform_contact',
         'Buyer brief pushes contact off-platform before a paid reveal.',
         jsonb_build_object('excerpt', left(coalesce(i.raw_input,''), 240))
  from inquiries i
  where coalesce(i.raw_input,'') ~* '(whatsapp me on|call me directly on|contact me at .*@|my number is [+0-9])'
  on conflict do nothing;

  -- 7. Fake review: a supplier with a high rating and an implausible review count for its footprint.
  insert into brand_signal (signal_type, severity, subject_type, subject_id, rule_key, detail, evidence)
  select 'fake_review','medium','lead', l.id::text, 'implausible_review_profile',
         'Perfect rating with a high review count and no verifiable web presence.',
         jsonb_build_object('company', l.company_name, 'rating', l.rating, 'reviews', l.reviews)
  from leads l
  where l.rating is not null and l.rating >= 4.9 and coalesce(l.reviews,0) >= 100
    and coalesce(nullif(trim(l.website),''), null) is null
  on conflict do nothing;

  return query
    select b.rule_key, count(*)::integer
    from brand_signal b
    where b.detected_at > now() - interval '5 minutes'
    group by b.rule_key;
end;
