fn_goal_period_refresh:
declare r record; v numeric; n int := 0; created int := 0;
        v_month text := to_char(now(),'YYYY-MM');
        v_qtr   text := to_char(now(),'YYYY')||'-Q'||extract(quarter from now())::int;
        v_year  text := to_char(now(),'YYYY');
begin
  -- ---- ROLL THE PERIOD FORWARD ---------------------------------------------------------------
  -- A period that never opens is a period that never closes. Each active goal gets a row for the
  -- CURRENT month, quarter and year, carrying forward the target from its most recent row for that
  -- horizon so the target is not silently lost or re-derived differently.
  insert into goal_period (goal_key, horizon, period_label, target_value, owner_dept, status)
  select g.key, h.horizon, h.label,
         (select p.target_value from goal_period p
           where p.goal_key = g.key and p.horizon = h.horizon
           order by p.period_label desc limit 1),
         g.owner_dept, 'open'
    from company_goals g
    cross join (values ('monthly', v_month), ('quarterly', v_qtr), ('annual', v_year)) as h(horizon, label)
   where g.active
     and not exists (select 1 from goal_period p
                      where p.goal_key = g.key and p.horizon = h.horizon and p.period_label = h.label);
  get diagnostics created = row_count;

  -- ---- MEASURE THE CURRENT PERIOD -------------------------------------------------------------
  for r in
    select gp.id, gp.goal_key, gp.target_value, g.measure_sql, g.direction
    from goal_period gp join company_goals g on g.key = gp.goal_key
    where g.active and g.measure_sql is not null
      and gp.period_label in (v_month, v_qtr, v_year)
  loop
    v := null;
    begin execute r.measure_sql into v; exception when others then v := null; end;
    if v is not null then
      update goal_period
         set actual_value = v,
             status = case
               when r.target_value is null or r.target_value = 0 then 'tracking'
               -- 'at_most'/'at_least' is the vocabulary company_goals actually stores. 'down'/'up'
               -- are accepted as synonyms because one row still uses 'up' and a scorer that only
               -- knows one dialect is how 19 goals came to be scored upside down.
               when coalesce(r.direction,'at_least') in ('at_most','down')
                 then case when v <= r.target_value then 'on_track'
                           when v <= r.target_value * 1.1 then 'near' else 'at_risk' end
                 else case when v >= r.target_value then 'on_track'
                           when v >= r.target_value * 0.9 then 'near' else 'at_risk' end
             end,
             updated_at = now()
       where id = r.id;
      n := n + 1;
    end if;
  end loop;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('goal_period_refresh', now(), now(), 'ok',
          jsonb_build_object('updated', n, 'periods_opened', created,
                             'month', v_month, 'quarter', v_qtr, 'year', v_year),
          'Goal periods refreshed: '||created||' period row(s) opened for '||v_month||'/'||v_qtr||'/'||v_year
          ||', '||n||' measured from live SQL. '
          ||(select count(*) from company_goals where active and measure_sql is null)
          ||' active goal(s) still carry no measure_sql and can never produce an actual.');
  return jsonb_build_object('updated', n, 'periods_opened', created);
end
fn_budget_rollup:
declare v_period text := to_char(current_date,'YYYY-MM'); n int := 0; v_degraded int := 0; v_halted int := 0; r record;
begin
  -- Every department is rolled, including the ones that spent nothing. The previous inner join
  -- skipped zero-spend departments entirely, leaving last month's spent_aed and period_label in
  -- place indefinitely. Only rows whose value actually changes are written, so updated_at still
  -- means "this budget moved".
  update department_budget b
     set spent_aed = v.total, period_label = v_period, updated_at = now()
  from (
    select b2.dept_key,
           coalesce((select sum(l.cost_aed) from ai_cost_log l
                      where l.dept_key = b2.dept_key
                        and l.occurred_at >= date_trunc('month', now())), 0) as total
      from department_budget b2
  ) v
  where b.dept_key = v.dept_key
    and (b.spent_aed is distinct from v.total or b.period_label is distinct from v_period);
  get diagnostics n = row_count;

  for r in
    select dept_key, monthly_aed, spent_aed, degrade_at_pct, halt_at_pct,
           round(100.0*spent_aed/nullif(monthly_aed,0),1) as pct
    from department_budget
    where monthly_aed > 0 and spent_aed is not null
  loop
    if r.pct >= r.halt_at_pct then
      v_halted := v_halted + 1;
      insert into founder_alerts (level, event, detail, channel)
      select 'high','ai_budget_halt', r.dept_key||' has spent '||r.pct||'% of its monthly AI budget ('||r.spent_aed||' of '||r.monthly_aed||' AED). Halt threshold '||r.halt_at_pct||'% reached.','email'
      where not exists (select 1 from founder_alerts where event='ai_budget_halt' and detail like r.dept_key||'%' and created_at > now()-interval '24 hours');
      -- The same fact, on the bus, so the Finance OS hears it as well as the founder.
      if not exists (select 1 from company_event where event_type='budget.exceeded'
                       and entity_id = r.dept_key and occurred_at > now()-interval '24 hours') then
        perform public.fn_emit('budget.exceeded','department', r.dept_key, 'cfo',
                  jsonb_build_object('pct', r.pct, 'spent_aed', r.spent_aed,
                                     'monthly_aed', r.monthly_aed, 'halt_at_pct', r.halt_at_pct));
      end if;
    elsif r.pct >= r.degrade_at_pct then
      v_degraded := v_degraded + 1;
      insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
      select r.dept_key, 'AI budget degrade threshold: '||r.dept_key,
             r.dept_key||' has spent '||r.pct||'% of its monthly AI budget. Move non-critical work to the cheaper model tier and enable response caching before the halt threshold at '||r.halt_at_pct||'%.',
             'proposed','gated', false, 'recommend'
      where not exists (select 1 from org_tasks where title='AI budget degrade threshold: '||r.dept_key and status<>'done');
    end if;
  end loop;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('budget_rollup', now(), now(), 'ok',
          jsonb_build_object('depts_changed',n,'degraded',v_degraded,'halted',v_halted),
          'AI spend rolled into department budgets: '||n||' department(s) changed, '||v_degraded||' past degrade threshold, '||v_halted||' past halt.');
  return jsonb_build_object('updated',n,'degraded',v_degraded,'halted',v_halted);
end
fn_exec_meeting:
declare m jsonb; findings jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; actions int := 0; recs jsonb;
  -- the six agenda sections, rebuilt per contribution, plus their company-scoped counterparts
  v_wins text; v_probs text; v_risks text; v_opps text; v_reqs text; v_kpis jsonb;
  v_dept text; v_opp_all int; v_co jsonb; p record; v_challenger text; v_ch int := 0;
  v_period text := to_char(now(),'IYYY-"W"IW');
  v_rev numeric; v_spend numeric; v_sup int; v_open int; v_avail numeric;
  v_red int; v_amber int; v_green int; r record; v_drivers text;
  v_report_id bigint; v_raised int := 0;
begin
  -- ensure the OS reviews for this week exist before the meeting reads them
  if not exists (select 1 from os_review where period = v_period) then
    perform fn_os_review();
  end if;

  select count(*) filter (where health='red'), count(*) filter (where health='amber'), count(*) filter (where health='green')
    into v_red, v_amber, v_green from os_review where period = v_period;

  select coalesce(sum(coalesce(reveal_fee,app_fee,0)),0) into v_rev from transactions where revealed_at > now()-interval '7 days';
  select coalesce(sum(cost_aed),0) into v_spend from ai_cost_log where occurred_at > now()-interval '7 days';
  select count(*) into v_sup from leads where approval_status='approved';
  select count(*) into v_open from org_tasks where status<>'done';
  select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where ok)/nullif(count(*),0),1) into v_avail
    from health_checks where check_kind='http' and created_at > now()-interval '7 days';

  select count(*) into v_opp_all from opportunity where coalesce(status,'open')='open';

  m := jsonb_build_object('week',v_period,'os_green',v_green,'os_amber',v_amber,'os_red',v_red,
       'revenue_7d_aed',v_rev,'ai_spend_7d_aed',round(coalesce(v_spend,0),2),
       'approved_suppliers',v_sup,'supplier_target',860,
       'open_tasks',v_open,'platform_availability_pct',v_avail);

  -- AGENDA ITEM 1..10: every operating system that is not green, named with its owner AND with the
  -- live per-OS figures out of v_os_health that put it there. LEFT JOIN: an OS the view cannot
  -- resolve still reaches the agenda, it just reaches it without drivers.
  for r in
    select o.num, o.name, r2.health, r2.owner_agent, r2.findings,
           h.open_risks, h.kpi_gaps, h.backlog_per_head, h.stale_tasks,
           h.review_pass_pct, h.budget_pct, h.needs_founder_pct,
           -- CAPACITY IS THE ONE DIMENSION v_os_health DOES NOT COMPUTE (6 Aug 2026). It is
           -- resource_pool committed/capacity and it exists only in os_review.metrics, so it
           -- was the one of the eight figures with no reader outside its own writer. Taken off
           -- the report row the meeting is already reading.
           r2.metrics->>'capacity_pct' capacity_pct
    from os_review r2 join operating_system o on o.os_key = r2.os_key
    left join v_os_health h on h.os_key = r2.os_key
    where r2.period = v_period order by
      case r2.health when 'red' then 1 when 'amber' then 2 else 3 end, o.num
  loop
    v_drivers := 'open_risks '||coalesce(r.open_risks::text,'?')
      ||', kpi_gaps '||coalesce(r.kpi_gaps::text,'?')
      ||', capacity_pct '||coalesce(r.capacity_pct,'?')
      ||', backlog_per_head '||coalesce(r.backlog_per_head::text,'?')
      ||', stale_tasks '||coalesce(r.stale_tasks::text,'?')
      ||', review_pass_pct '||coalesce(r.review_pass_pct::text,'?')
      ||', budget_pct '||coalesce(r.budget_pct::text,'?')
      ||', needs_founder_pct '||coalesce(r.needs_founder_pct::text,'?');
    -- THE SIX AGENDA SECTIONS. Each is a count over live rows and the top three by name; a
    -- section with nothing in it states the zero rather than being omitted, because a meeting is
    -- entitled to hear "no open risks" and a missing section is not the same claim.
    v_dept := (select department from org_agents where agent_key = r.owner_agent);

    v_wins := (select count(*) from org_tasks
                where status='done' and updated_at > now()-interval '7 days' and dept_key = v_dept)
      ||' task(s) closed in the last 7 days'
      || coalesce(': '||(select string_agg(w.title, '; ') from (
             select title from org_tasks where status='done'
              and updated_at > now()-interval '7 days' and dept_key = v_dept
              order by updated_at desc limit 3) w), '')||'.';

    v_probs := case when jsonb_typeof(r.findings)='array' and jsonb_array_length(r.findings) > 0
      then (select string_agg(coalesce(e->>'issue', e::text)||coalesce(' — '||(e->>'detail'), ''), '; ')
              from jsonb_array_elements(r.findings) e)
      else 'No unresolved finding recorded for this operating system in '||v_period||'.' end;

    v_kpis := jsonb_build_object('health', r.health,
      'open_risks', r.open_risks, 'kpi_gaps', r.kpi_gaps, 'capacity_pct', r.capacity_pct,
      'backlog_per_head', r.backlog_per_head, 'stale_tasks', r.stale_tasks,
      'review_pass_pct', r.review_pass_pct, 'budget_pct', r.budget_pct,
      'needs_founder_pct', r.needs_founder_pct);

    v_risks := (select count(*) from risk_register
                 where coalesce(status,'open') <> 'closed' and dept_key = v_dept)
      ||' open risk(s) on the register'
      || coalesce(': '||(select string_agg(k.risk, '; ') from (
             select risk from risk_register where coalesce(status,'open') <> 'closed'
              and dept_key = v_dept order by updated_at desc nulls last limit 3) k), '')||'.';

    v_opps := (select count(*) from opportunity op join org_agents oa on oa.agent_key = op.detected_by
                where coalesce(op.status,'open')='open' and oa.department = v_dept)
      ||' open opportunit(ies) attributed to this operating system'
      || coalesce(': '||(select string_agg(x.title, '; ') from (
             select op.title from opportunity op join org_agents oa on oa.agent_key = op.detected_by
              where coalesce(op.status,'open')='open' and oa.department = v_dept
              order by op.value_score desc nulls last limit 3) x), '')
      ||'; '||v_opp_all||' open company-wide.';

    v_reqs := (select count(*) from org_tasks
                where needs_founder and status <> 'done' and dept_key = v_dept)
      ||' item(s) awaiting a founder decision'
      || coalesce(': '||(select string_agg(q.title, '; ') from (
             select title from org_tasks where needs_founder and status <> 'done'
              and dept_key = v_dept order by created_at desc limit 3) q), '')||'.';

    findings := findings || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'item', r.num||'. '||r.name, 'owner', coalesce(r.owner_agent,'unassigned'),
      'health', r.health, 'finding', r.findings::text, 'drivers', v_drivers,
      'wins', v_wins, 'problems', v_probs, 'kpis', v_kpis,
      'risks', v_risks, 'opportunities', v_opps, 'requests', v_reqs));
  end loop;

  -- COMPANY-LEVEL ITEMS the CEO owns directly
  if coalesce(v_rev,0)=0 then
    findings := findings || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('item','Revenue','owner','cfo','health','amber','finding','No revenue recognised in the last 7 days.'));
  end if;
  if v_sup < 860 then
    findings := findings || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('item','Supplier coverage','owner','procurement','health',
      case when v_sup=0 then 'red' else 'amber' end,
      'finding', v_sup||' approved suppliers against a target of 860 (10 in each of 86 categories).'));
  end if;
  if coalesce(v_avail,100) < 99.5 then
    findings := findings || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('item','Platform availability','owner','cto','health','amber','finding','Availability '||coalesce(v_avail,0)||'% against 99.5%.'));
  end if;

  -- The company-level items above are contributions too, so they carry the same six sections,
  -- scoped to the company rather than to one department. Merged rather than typed into each of
  -- the three: an item added later inherits the sections instead of arriving with four.
  v_co := jsonb_build_object(
    'wins', (select count(*) from org_tasks where status='done' and updated_at > now()-interval '7 days')
            ||' task(s) closed company-wide in the last 7 days.',
    'problems', v_red||' operating system(s) red and '||v_amber||' amber in '||v_period||'.',
    'kpis', m,
    'risks', (select count(*) from risk_register where coalesce(status,'open') <> 'closed')
             ||' open risk(s) on the company register.',
    'opportunities', v_opp_all||' open opportunit(ies) company-wide.',
    'requests', (select count(*) from org_tasks where needs_founder and status <> 'done')
                ||' item(s) awaiting a founder decision company-wide.');
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(case when f ? 'wins' then f else f || v_co end order by ord), '[]'::jsonb)
    into findings from jsonb_array_elements(findings) with ordinality as t(f, ord);

  insert into org_tasks (dept_key,title,detail,status,tier,needs_founder,action_class)
  select coalesce((select department from org_agents where agent_key=f->>'owner'),'exec'),
    'Exec meeting '||v_period||': '||(f->>'item'),
    'Health: '||(f->>'health')||'. Owner: '||(f->>'owner')||'. '||(f->>'finding')
    ||coalesce(' Drivers: '||(f->>'drivers')||'.','')
    ||' Raised at the weekly executive meeting. Close it, or bring evidence the standard is wrong.',
    'proposed','advisory',false,'exec_review'
  from jsonb_array_elements(findings) f
  where coalesce(f->>'health','') <> 'green'
    and not exists (select 1 from org_tasks t where t.title='Exec meeting '||v_period||': '||(f->>'item') and t.status<>'done');
  get diagnostics actions = row_count;

  -- AGREED PRIORITIES, RANKED AND OWNED. One object per contribution that is not green, red
  -- before amber and then in operating-system order, which is the order the constitution gives:
  -- compliance and trust sit in the red band before anything amber is opened. `title` is the key
  -- fn_report_recommendation_approve already reads, so the founder's approve control gets a name
  -- rather than 160 characters of JSON.
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'rank', x.rn, 'owner', x.owner, 'priority', x.health,
           'title', x.item, 'why', x.finding) order by x.rn), '[]'::jsonb)
    into recs from (
      select row_number() over (order by case f->>'health' when 'red' then 1 else 2 end, ord) rn,
             f->>'item' item, f->>'owner' owner, f->>'health' health,
             -- an operating system's readable problem statement lives in `problems`; `finding` is
             -- the raw os_review JSON. The three company items are the other way round.
             case when f ? 'drivers' then f->>'problems' else f->>'finding' end finding
        from jsonb_array_elements(findings) with ordinality as t(f, ord)
       where coalesce(f->>'health','') <> 'green') x;
  if jsonb_array_length(recs) = 0 then
    recs := jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('rank', 1, 'owner', 'ceo', 'priority', 'hold',
      'title', 'Hold current priorities',
      'why', 'All ten operating systems green and company metrics within tolerance.'));
  end if;

  insert into exec_reports (officer,period,summary,findings,recommendations,metrics,status)
  values ('ceo',v_period,
    'Weekly executive meeting across ten operating systems. '||v_green||' green, '||v_amber||' amber, '||v_red
    ||' red. '||jsonb_array_length(findings)||' agenda contribution(s), '||actions||' action(s) assigned.',
    findings, recs, m, 'open')
  on conflict do nothing;

  -- THE DEBATE. The CEO's proposed priority order is put to another officer, who evaluates it
  -- through fn_challenge against challenge_heuristic and any prior outcome in institutional_memory
  -- and answers support / concern / recommend_against with its reasoning. The challenger is the
  -- first officer in the list who is not the one proposing, so this is officers challenging each
  -- other rather than the CEO agreeing with itself. Top three only: a debate, not thirteen rows of
  -- boilerplate a week.
  --
  -- In its own block because a challenge that throws must not fail the meeting — the cron's own
  -- success is what exec-meeting-weekly-autostart measures. The number that actually landed goes
  -- into the run note below, so a swallowed failure is visible rather than silent.
  begin
    for p in select (e->>'rank')::int prank, e->>'title' ptitle, e->>'owner' powner
               from jsonb_array_elements(recs) e
              where (e->>'rank')::int <= 3 order by (e->>'rank')::int
    loop
      v_challenger := coalesce((select e2->>'owner' from jsonb_array_elements(recs) e2
                                 where coalesce(e2->>'owner','') <> coalesce(p.powner,'')
                                 order by (e2->>'rank')::int limit 1), 'ceo');
      perform fn_challenge('Exec meeting '||v_period||' priority '||p.prank||': '||p.ptitle,
                           coalesce(p.powner,'ceo'), v_challenger);
      v_ch := v_ch + 1;
    end loop;
  exception when others then
    v_ch := -1;
  end;

  -- THE PRIORITIES REACH THE DECISION QUEUE.
  -- 33 of 40 exec_reports carried recommendations and agent_actions held ZERO row pointing at a
  -- report, so the founder could read the meeting's ranked priorities and had no way to act on
  -- them: the report surface has five approve controls bound to nothing. Each ranked priority is
  -- now raised once per period as an approvable action carrying target_table='exec_reports' and the
  -- report's id, which is what the approve control resolves.
  --
  -- One row per priority per week — typically two, one when every OS is green — so this cannot
  -- flood the queue. A bulk backfill of the 107 recommendation entries sitting in the last 30 days
  -- was deliberately NOT done: it would have taken the paused share of agent_actions from 2.6% to
  -- roughly 10.4% and regressed approval-center-everything-else-automatic, and most of those
  -- entries are superseded weekly anyway.
  --
  -- Its own block, like the debate above: a failure here must not fail the meeting, because the
  -- cron's own success is what exec-meeting-weekly-autostart measures.
  begin
    select id into v_report_id from exec_reports
     where officer='ceo' and period=v_period order by created_at desc limit 1;

    if v_report_id is not null then
      for p in select (e->>'rank')::int prank, e->>'title' ptitle, e->>'owner' powner,
                      e->>'why' pwhy, e->>'priority' phealth
                 from jsonb_array_elements(recs) e order by (e->>'rank')::int
      loop
        if not exists (select 1 from agent_actions a
                        where a.target_table='exec_reports'
                          and a.target_id = v_report_id::text
                          and coalesce(a.title,'') = 'Exec priority '||p.prank||': '||p.ptitle) then
          insert into agent_actions (agent, kind, status, risk, title, recommendation, detail,
                                     target_table, target_id)
          values (coalesce(p.powner,'ceo'), 'report_recommendation', 'pending',
                  case when p.phealth='red' then 'high' else 'medium' end,
                  'Exec priority '||p.prank||': '||p.ptitle,
                  coalesce(p.pwhy,'Ranked priority '||p.prank||' from the '||v_period||' executive meeting.'),
                  jsonb_build_object('source','fn_exec_meeting','period',v_period,'rank',p.prank,
                                     'owner',p.powner,'health',p.phealth,'report_id',v_report_id),
                  'exec_reports', v_report_id::text);
          v_raised := v_raised + 1;
        end if;
      end loop;
    end if;
  exception when others then
    v_raised := -1;
  end;

  insert into agent_runs (agent,started_at,finished_at,status,counts,note)
  values ('exec_meeting',now(),now(),'ok',
    jsonb_build_object('os_green',v_green,'os_amber',v_amber,'os_red',v_red,'findings',jsonb_array_length(findings),'actions',actions,
      'priorities',jsonb_array_length(recs),'challenges',v_ch,'raised_for_approval',v_raised),
    'Executive meeting '||v_period||': '||v_green||' green / '||v_amber||' amber / '||v_red||' red across ten operating systems, '||actions||' actions assigned, '
    ||jsonb_array_length(recs)||' ranked priorities, '
    ||case when v_ch < 0 then 'the challenge round failed' else v_ch||' challenge(s) put to a second officer' end
    ||', '||case when v_raised < 0 then 'raising priorities for approval failed' else v_raised||' priority(ies) raised for founder approval' end||'.');

  return jsonb_build_object('week',v_period,'green',v_green,'amber',v_amber,'red',v_red,
                            'findings',jsonb_array_length(findings),'actions',actions,
                            'priorities',jsonb_array_length(recs),'challenges',v_ch,
                            'raised_for_approval',v_raised,'metrics',m);
end
fn_knowledge_decay:
declare n_decayed int; n_quarantined int; n_tasks int := 0;
begin
  update agent_knowledge
     set confidence = greatest(0.10, round((confidence - (0.05 * greatest(1, floor(extract(epoch from (now() - review_due))/(30*86400)))))::numeric, 2)),
         validation_status = 'stale'
   where review_due < now()
     and coalesce(validation_status,'') <> 'quarantined'
     and confidence > 0.10;
  get diagnostics n_decayed = row_count;

  update agent_knowledge
     set validation_status = 'quarantined'
   where confidence < 0.35 and coalesce(validation_status,'') <> 'quarantined';
  get diagnostics n_quarantined = row_count;

  -- a quarantined expert is a capability gap, so it becomes work
  insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
  select 'knowledge',
         'Knowledge quarantined: '||agent_key,
         count(*)||' knowledge item(s) for '||agent_key||' fell below the confidence floor and are no longer served. '
         ||'Refresh from source and re-validate, or retire the topic.',
         'proposed','advisory', false, 'knowledge_fill'
    from agent_knowledge
   where validation_status='quarantined'
   group by agent_key
  having not exists (select 1 from org_tasks t where t.title='Knowledge quarantined: '||agent_knowledge.agent_key and t.status<>'done');
  get diagnostics n_tasks = row_count;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('knowledge_decay', now(), now(), 'ok',
          jsonb_build_object('decayed',n_decayed,'quarantined',n_quarantined,'tasks',n_tasks),
          'Knowledge decay: '||n_decayed||' item(s) past review lost confidence, '||n_quarantined
          ||' quarantined below the floor, '||n_tasks||' refresh task(s) opened.');

  return jsonb_build_object('decayed',n_decayed,'quarantined',n_quarantined,'tasks',n_tasks);
end
fn_supply_gap_scan:
declare r record; n_scrape int:=0; n_invite int:=0; n_source int:=0; v_uncat int; v_met int; v_total int;
begin
  select count(*) into v_total from v_supply_gap;
  select count(*) into v_met   from v_supply_gap where status='TARGET MET';

  -- 1. Categories that cannot reach the target from the existing pool
  for r in select * from v_supply_gap where status in ('POOL TOO THIN - scrape more','NO POOL - must source from scratch') order by sendable asc limit 25
  loop
    insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
    select 'procurement',
           'Supply gap: '||r.slug,
           r.name||' has '||r.sendable||' sendable lead(s) but needs about '||r.sendable_needed_at_5pct
           ||' to reach 10 approved suppliers at a 5% conversion assumption (shortfall '||r.sendable_shortfall||'). '
           ||'Source more UAE suppliers in this category before inviting - inviting a thin pool burns it without reaching the target.',
           'proposed','advisory', false, 'knowledge_acquire'
    where not exists (select 1 from org_tasks t where t.title='Supply gap: '||r.slug and t.status<>'done');
    if found then if r.sendable=0 then n_source:=n_source+1; else n_scrape:=n_scrape+1; end if; end if;
  end loop;

  -- 2. Categories with enough pool and no invites sent yet
  for r in select * from v_supply_gap where status='READY - not yet invited' order by sendable desc limit 25
  loop
    insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
    select 'procurement','Start invites: '||r.slug,
           r.name||' has '||r.sendable||' sendable leads and no invitations sent. Pool is sufficient for the 10-approved target. Queue it into the invite ramp.',
           'proposed','advisory', false, 'invite'
    where not exists (select 1 from org_tasks t where t.title='Start invites: '||r.slug and t.status<>'done');
    if found then n_invite:=n_invite+1; end if;
  end loop;

  -- 3. Free supply: uncategorised leads are unusable until classified
  select count(*) into v_uncat from leads l
   where not exists (select 1 from lead_category lc where lc.lead_id=l.id)
     and l.email is not null and l.email<>'' and coalesce(l.banned,false)=false;

  if v_uncat > 500 then
    insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, needs_founder, action_class)
    select 'knowledge','Classify '||v_uncat||' uncategorised leads',
           v_uncat||' sendable leads carry no category, so they cannot be targeted and count toward no category''s supply. '
           ||'Classifying them is free supply - it costs no acquisition spend and will partly fill the thin categories. '
           ||'Run the category classifier over the unmapped set.',
           'proposed','advisory', false, 'route_category'
    where not exists (select 1 from org_tasks where title like 'Classify % uncategorised leads' and status<>'done');
  end if;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('supply_gap_scan', now(), now(), 'ok',
          jsonb_build_object('categories',v_total,'target_met',v_met,'scrape_tasks',n_scrape,
                             'source_tasks',n_source,'invite_tasks',n_invite,'uncategorised',v_uncat),
          'Supply gap scan: '||v_met||' of '||v_total||' categories at 10 approved. '
          ||n_scrape||' need more scraping, '||n_source||' have no pool at all, '||n_invite
          ||' ready to invite, '||v_uncat||' leads unclassified.');

  return jsonb_build_object('categories',v_total,'target_met',v_met,'scrape',n_scrape,'source',n_source,'invite',n_invite,'uncategorised',v_uncat);
end
fn_sop_update:
declare r record; n_new int := 0; v_slug text;
begin
  for r in
    select m.id, m.headline, m.detail, m.outcome,
           coalesce(m.os_key,
                    (select d.os_key from org_tasks o join os_department d on d.dept_key = o.dept_key
                      where m.subject_type = 'org_task' and o.id::text = m.subject_id limit 1),
                    (select d.os_key from os_department d where d.dept_key = m.learned_by limit 1)) as os_key
    from institutional_memory m
    where m.outcome in ('worse', 'improved', 'success', 'success_over_dissent')
      and not exists (select 1 from os_runbooks b where b.slug = 'lesson-' || m.id)
    order by m.created_at desc
    limit 25
  loop
    v_slug := 'lesson-' || r.id;
    insert into os_runbooks (slug, title, category, when_to_use, steps, sort, os_key)
    values (v_slug, left(coalesce(r.headline, 'Lesson ' || r.id), 120),
            coalesce(r.os_key, 'operations'),
            case when r.outcome = 'worse'
              then 'Before repeating this change. It was tried and it made things worse.'
              else 'When this situation recurs. This approach was measured and it worked.' end,
            coalesce(r.detail, ''), 100, r.os_key);
    n_new := n_new + 1;
  end loop;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('sop_update', now(), now(), 'ok', jsonb_build_object('runbooks_written', n_new),
    'SOP update: ' || n_new || ' graded lesson(s) written into the runbook library so the company cannot repeat them by accident.');
  return jsonb_build_object('written', n_new);
end
fn_reputation_recompute:
declare r record; n int := 0; v_score numeric; v_tier text;
  v_corr numeric; v_rel numeric; v_cost numeric; v_learn numeric; v_collab numeric;
  v_gated int := 0; v_restored int := 0; v_unmeasured int := 0;
begin
  for r in select agent_key from org_agents where active loop
    -- correctness: graded improvements that moved the metric the right way
    select coalesce(round(100.0*count(*) filter (where verdict='improved')
             /nullif(count(*) filter (where verdict in ('improved','no_change','worse')),0),1), null)
      into v_corr from outcome_record where actor = r.agent_key;
    -- reliability: runs that did not error.
    -- NOTE (10 Aug 2026): for EMPLOYEES this is the wrong table - agent_runs is the cron log and
    -- only nine of its 111 agent values are org_agents keys. Left alone deliberately: every value
    -- present is >= 93, so it only ever raises a score. Do not "fix" it into something that starts
    -- lowering scores without first deciding what employee reliability means.
    select coalesce(round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status<>'error')/nullif(count(*),0),1), null)
      into v_rel from agent_runs where agent = r.agent_key and started_at > now()-interval '30 days';
    -- cost efficiency: share of calls a cheaper model could NOT have served
    select coalesce(round(100.0*count(*) filter (where not coalesce(could_be_cheaper,false))/nullif(count(*),0),1), null)
      into v_cost from ai_cost_log where agent_key = r.agent_key and occurred_at > now()-interval '30 days';

    -- learning speed: UNMEASURABLE, so NULL for everyone. See the header of the 10 Aug change.
    v_learn := null;

    -- collaboration: reviews it took part in that reached approval, over DECIDED VERDICTS ONLY.
    select coalesce(round(100.0*count(*) filter (where decision='approve')/nullif(count(*),0),1), null)
      into v_collab from review_chain
     where (author_agent = r.agent_key or reviewer_agent = r.agent_key)
       and decision in ('approve','reject','request_revision');

    -- ABSENCE OF EVIDENCE IS NOT A SCORE OF 50 (12 Aug 2026). See the header: coalesce(...,50) put
    -- 75 employees who have never executed anything at 51.0, one point above probation and
    -- indistinguishable from a real 50. An employee with no reading on any dimension is now
    -- 'unmeasured' with score NULL, because a score is a measurement and we have not made one.
    if v_corr is null and v_rel is null and v_cost is null and v_learn is null and v_collab is null then
      v_score := null;
      v_tier  := 'unmeasured';
      v_unmeasured := v_unmeasured + 1;
    else
      v_score := round((coalesce(v_corr,50)*0.30 + coalesce(v_rel,50)*0.30 + coalesce(v_cost,50)*0.15
                      + coalesce(v_learn,50)*0.15 + coalesce(v_collab,50)*0.10), 1);
      v_tier := case when v_score >= 85 then 'senior_trusted'
                     when v_score >= 70 then 'trusted'
                     when v_score >= 50 then 'standard' else 'probation' end;
    end if;

    insert into agent_reputation (agent_key,correctness,reliability,cost_efficiency,learning_speed,collaboration,score,tier,computed_at)
    values (r.agent_key,v_corr,v_rel,v_cost,v_learn,v_collab,v_score,v_tier,now())
    on conflict (agent_key) do update set correctness=excluded.correctness, reliability=excluded.reliability,
      cost_efficiency=excluded.cost_efficiency, learning_speed=excluded.learning_speed,
      collaboration=excluded.collaboration, score=excluded.score, tier=excluded.tier, computed_at=now();
    n := n + 1;
  end loop;

  -- probation is a real consequence: any agent below the floor loses autonomous authority.
  -- 'unmeasured' deliberately does NOT trigger this - see the header. No authority is revoked by
  -- introducing the tier.
  with demoted as (
    update employee_authority a set max_tier='gated'
      from agent_reputation p
     where p.agent_key=a.agent_key and p.tier='probation' and a.max_tier='autonomous'
    returning a.agent_key, a.action_class)
  insert into autonomy_control_audit (object, op, direction, old_value, new_value, reason)
  select 'employee_authority:'||agent_key||'/'||action_class, 'reputation_demote', 'tighten',
         'autonomous', 'gated', 'reputation tier fell to probation'
    from demoted;
  get diagnostics v_gated = row_count;

  -- ...and recovery is a real consequence too. NARROWED 12 Aug 2026: this read `tier <> 'probation'`,
  -- which an employee that has never executed anything satisfied - so "never worked" was being
  -- treated as "recovered" and handed back autonomous authority. Recovery now requires a tier that
  -- was actually earned from a reading.
  with restored as (
    update employee_authority a set max_tier='autonomous'
      from agent_reputation p
     where p.agent_key=a.agent_key
       and a.max_tier='gated'
       and p.tier in ('standard','trusted','senior_trusted')
       and a.note = 'Advisory-safe action, may run autonomously'
    returning a.agent_key, a.action_class)
  insert into autonomy_control_audit (object, op, direction, old_value, new_value, reason)
  select 'employee_authority:'||agent_key||'/'||action_class, 'reputation_restore', 'loosen',
         'gated', 'autonomous',
         'reputation recovered above probation and the grant note records the action as advisory-safe'
    from restored;
  get diagnostics v_restored = row_count;

  insert into agent_runs (agent,started_at,finished_at,status,counts,note)
  values ('reputation',now(),now(),'ok',
    jsonb_build_object('scored',n,'gated',v_gated,'restored',v_restored,'unmeasured',v_unmeasured),
    'Reputation recomputed for '||n||' employee(s), of which '||v_unmeasured||' have no reading on '
    ||'any dimension and are recorded as unmeasured with a NULL score rather than a default 50. '
    ||'Probation demotes autonomous authority to gated ('||v_gated||' this run); recovery restores '
    ||'advisory-safe grants ('||v_restored||' this run) and no longer counts unmeasured as recovered.');
  return jsonb_build_object('scored',n,'gated',v_gated,'restored',v_restored,'unmeasured',v_unmeasured);
end
fn_opportunity_scan:
declare r record; n int := 0;
begin
  -- underserved categories that already hold a viable pool: ready demand, no action
  for r in select * from v_supply_gap where status='READY - not yet invited' order by sendable desc limit 10 loop
    insert into opportunity (kind,title,detail,evidence,value_score,effort,confidence,detected_by)
    select 'underserved_category','Untapped pool: '||r.name,
      r.name||' holds '||r.sendable||' sendable suppliers and zero invitations sent. The pool is already sufficient for the 10-approved target.',
      jsonb_build_object('slug',r.slug,'sendable',r.sendable,'approved',r.approved),
      least(100, r.sendable/5.0), 'low', 0.8, 'intel_director'
    where not exists (select 1 from opportunity o where o.title='Untapped pool: '||r.name and o.status='open');
    if found then n := n+1; end if;
  end loop;

  -- categories where knowledge exists but no supply: capability ahead of market
  for r in select * from v_supply_gap where status='NO POOL - must source from scratch' limit 5 loop
    insert into opportunity (kind,title,detail,evidence,value_score,effort,confidence,detected_by)
    select 'unmet_demand','Whitespace: '||r.name,
      'A fully briefed category expert exists for '||r.name||' with zero suppliers anywhere in the pool. Either a genuine market gap worth owning, or a category to retire.',
      jsonb_build_object('slug',r.slug,'sendable',0), 40,'high',0.5,'market_analyst'
    where not exists (select 1 from opportunity o where o.title='Whitespace: '||r.name and o.status='open');
    if found then n := n+1; end if;
  end loop;

  -- cost opportunity
  if (select count(*) filter (where could_be_cheaper) from ai_cost_log where occurred_at>now()-interval '30 days') > 10 then
    insert into opportunity (kind,title,detail,evidence,value_score,effort,confidence,detected_by)
    select 'cost_saving','Over-specified AI calls',
      (select count(*) filter (where could_be_cheaper)||' of '||count(*)||' calls in the last 30 days could have been served by a cheaper model.' from ai_cost_log where occurred_at>now()-interval '30 days'),
      '{}'::jsonb, 60,'low',0.9,'optimisation_eng'
    where not exists (select 1 from opportunity where title='Over-specified AI calls' and status='open');
    if found then n := n+1; end if;
  end if;

  -- ── THE THREE QUESTIONS THE SCAN NEVER ASKED ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  -- The demand-driven one counts REAL inquiries. marketing_category_demand.inquiries_90d includes
  -- qd_demo_fixture rows, so the view's count must not carry a founder-facing opportunity on its own.

  -- GROWING INDUSTRIES — asked as demand against supply, which is what the data supports. Below ten
  -- suppliers is the company's own standard: 860 approved = 10 in each of 86 categories.
  for r in select m.category, i.real_inq inq, coalesce(m.suppliers,0) sup
             from marketing_category_demand m
             cross join lateral (
               select count(*) real_inq from inquiries q
                where coalesce(nullif(q.category,''),'other') = m.category
                  and q.created_at >= now() - interval '90 days'
                  and coalesce(q.brief_source,'') <> 'qd_demo_fixture') i
            where i.real_inq >= 1 and coalesce(m.suppliers,0) < 10
            order by i.real_inq desc, coalesce(m.suppliers,0) asc limit 5 loop
    insert into opportunity (kind,title,detail,evidence,value_score,effort,confidence,detected_by)
    select 'sector_demand','Sector under-supplied: '||r.category,
      'The '||r.category||' industry drew '||r.inq||' inquir(y/ies) in 90 days against '||r.sup
      ||' supplier(s) on the platform, below the standard of ten per category. Demand in this sector '
      ||'is running ahead of the supply able to answer it.',
      jsonb_build_object('category',r.category,'inquiries_90d',r.inq,'suppliers',r.sup,'target_suppliers',10),
      least(100, r.inq*10.0), 'medium', 0.7, 'market_analyst'
    where not exists (select 1 from opportunity o
                       where o.title='Sector under-supplied: '||r.category and o.status='open');
    if found then n := n+1; end if;
  end loop;

  -- SEARCH KEYWORDS WITH NOWHERE TO LAND. Rewritten 14 Aug 2026: this used to require at least one
  -- real inquiry in the category, on a platform with zero inquiries, so it could not fire. The
  -- question does not need demand history — a tracked keyword pattern pointing at a category that
  -- has no landing page is a gap you can measure today. `pages` and `seo_categories` are BOTH
  -- checked because they are two different vocabularies and neither alone covers the catalog: pages
  -- holds site chrome under slugs like 'home' and 'portal', seo_categories holds 24 consumer trades
  -- ('electrical') that do not match the catalog's supplier slugs ('electrical-suppliers').
  -- The real 90-day inquiry count is carried in the evidence rather than used as a gate, so the
  -- opportunity states the demand it actually has instead of implying one it does not.
  for r in select c.slug, c.name,
                  (select count(*) from category_keyword k
                    where k.slug = c.slug and not coalesce(k.negative,false)) kw,
                  (select count(*) from inquiries q
                    where coalesce(nullif(q.category,''),'other') = c.slug
                      and q.created_at >= now() - interval '90 days'
                      and coalesce(q.brief_source,'') <> 'qd_demo_fixture') inq
             from catalog_supplier_categories c
            where not exists (select 1 from pages p where p.slug = c.slug)
              and not exists (select 1 from seo_categories s where s.slug = c.slug)
            order by 3 desc, c.slug limit 5 loop
    continue when r.kw = 0;
    insert into opportunity (kind,title,detail,evidence,value_score,effort,confidence,detected_by)
    select 'search_demand','Keyword demand with no page: '||r.name,
      r.kw||' tracked search keyword pattern(s) point at '||r.name||' and there is no landing page '
      ||'for it — neither a published page nor an SEO category entry. Real inquiries in this '
      ||'category over 90 days: '||r.inq||'. Whether that search volume is RISING is not measured '
      ||'anywhere on this platform, so this is a coverage gap, not a trend claim.',
      jsonb_build_object('category',r.slug,'keyword_patterns',r.kw,'inquiries_90d',r.inq,
                         'has_page',false,'has_seo_category',false,'trend_measured',false),
      least(100, r.kw*2.0), 'low', 0.7, 'market_analyst'
    where not exists (select 1 from opportunity o
                       where o.title='Keyword demand with no page: '||r.name and o.status='open');
    if found then n := n+1; end if;
  end loop;

  -- WEAK COMPETITORS — 27 tracked rivals, every one carrying a written weakness. A low or medium
  -- threat with a stated weakness is the shape of an opening; a high threat is a problem, not one.
  -- Untouched: this one rests on real competitor records, not on inquiries.
  for r in select c.name, coalesce(c.kind,'unclassified') kind, c.weakness, c.threat_level
             from competitor c
            where coalesce(btrim(c.weakness),'') <> ''
              and lower(coalesce(c.threat_level,'')) in ('low','medium')
            order by c.name limit 5 loop
    insert into opportunity (kind,title,detail,evidence,value_score,effort,confidence,detected_by)
    select 'competitive_gap','Weak competitor: '||r.name,
      r.name||' ('||r.kind||', threat '||r.threat_level||') has a recorded weakness: '
      ||left(r.weakness, 240),
      jsonb_build_object('competitor',r.name,'threat_level',r.threat_level,'kind',r.kind),
      case lower(r.threat_level) when 'medium' then 55 else 35 end, 'medium', 0.6, 'intel_director'
    where not exists (select 1 from opportunity o
                       where o.title='Weak competitor: '||r.name and o.status='open');
    if found then n := n+1; end if;
  end loop;

  insert into agent_runs (agent,started_at,finished_at,status,counts,note)
  values ('opportunity_scan',now(),now(),'ok',jsonb_build_object('found',n),
    'Opportunity scan: '||n||' new opportunity(ies) detected without being asked.');
  return jsonb_build_object('found',n);
end

fn_model_benchmark:
begin
  return query
  with s as (
    select o.task_class, o.model_used,
           count(*) as runs,
           round(avg(case when o.ok then 1.0 else 0.0 end), 4) as success_rate,
           round((avg(o.cost_aed) / 3.6725)::numeric, 6) as avg_cost_usd
    from ai_cost_log o
    where o.occurred_at > now() - interval '30 days'
      and o.task_class is not null
      and o.model_used is not null
    group by 1, 2
    having count(*) >= 20   -- never judge a model on a handful of runs
  )
  select s.task_class, s.model_used, s.runs, s.success_rate, s.avg_cost_usd,
         case
           when s.success_rate >= 0.95 then 'GOOD - safe to keep or promote for this class'
           when s.success_rate >= 0.85 then 'ACCEPTABLE - watch'
           else 'POOR - this class needs a stronger tier'
         end
  from s order by s.task_class, s.success_rate desc;

  -- Feed the score back onto the registry so routing can see it. This is the only writer of
  -- model_registry.quality_score, which is why that column was null on all six models.
  update model_registry r set quality_score = q.sr, updated_at = now()
  from (
    select o.model_used, round(avg(case when o.ok then 1.0 else 0.0 end),4) sr
    from ai_cost_log o
    where o.occurred_at > now() - interval '30 days'
      and o.task_class is not null and o.model_used is not null
    group by 1 having count(*) >= 20
  ) q
  where r.model_id = q.model_used;
end
fn_model_autoswitch:
declare r record; v_new text; v_n int := 0;
begin
  for r in
    select o.task_class, o.model_used,
           avg(case when o.ok then 1.0 else 0.0 end) sr, count(*) n
    from ai_cost_log o
    where o.occurred_at > now() - interval '14 days'
      and o.task_class is not null
      and o.model_used is not null
      -- ONLY CALLS THAT REACHED THE MODEL MAY JUDGE IT (14 Aug 2026). A row with no prompt
      -- tokens and no output tokens never got there: it is our own client/gateway abort and
      -- belongs to latency, not to model selection. Sixteen such rows scored
      -- chief_of_staff_decision at 75.4%% and bought opus-4.8 at ~2.3x — a slower model, to
      -- answer a timeout. See scripts/sql/the_autoswitch_repriced_our_own_timeouts.sql.
      and (coalesce(o.prompt_tokens,0) > 0 or coalesce(o.output_tokens,0) > 0)
      -- ONLY CALLS THAT REACHED THE MODEL MAY JUDGE IT (14 Aug 2026). A row with no prompt
      -- tokens and no output tokens never got there: it is our own client/gateway abort and
      -- belongs to latency, not to model selection. Sixteen such rows scored
      -- chief_of_staff_decision at 75.4%% and bought opus-4.8 at ~2.3x — a slower model, to
      -- answer a timeout. See scripts/sql/the_autoswitch_repriced_our_own_timeouts.sql.
      and (coalesce(o.prompt_tokens,0) > 0 or coalesce(o.output_tokens,0) > 0)
    group by 1,2 having count(*) >= 20
       and avg(case when o.ok then 1.0 else 0.0 end) < 0.85
  loop
    -- only act if this model is still the primary for that class
    if not exists (select 1 from model_policy p where p.task_class = r.task_class
                    and p.model_primary = r.model_used and p.active) then continue; end if;

    select mr.model_id into v_new from model_registry mr
     join model_registry cur on cur.model_id = r.model_used
     where mr.active and mr.approved and mr.in_per_mtok_usd > cur.in_per_mtok_usd
     order by mr.in_per_mtok_usd asc limit 1;
    if v_new is null then continue; end if;

    update model_policy set model_primary = v_new where task_class = r.task_class and active;
    v_n := v_n + 1;

    insert into founder_alerts (level, event, detail, channel)
    values ('warn','model_autoswitched',
      'Task class "' || r.task_class || '" was failing on ' || r.model_used || ' (' ||
      round(r.sr*100,1) || '% success over ' || r.n || ' runs, floor 85%). Promoted to ' || v_new ||
      '. Cheaper is only correct while it works; this is the loop that checks.', 'system');

    insert into org_tasks (dept_key, title, detail, status, tier, action_class, needs_founder)
    values ('it', left('Model auto-switched for ' || r.task_class, 200),
      'Automatic promotion after measured failure. Class: ' || r.task_class ||
      E'\nWas: ' || r.model_used || ' at ' || round(r.sr*100,1) || '% success over ' || r.n || ' runs' ||
      E'\nNow: ' || v_new ||
      E'\n\nReview whether the prompt is at fault rather than the model - a badly specified task fails on every tier, and promoting it just costs more.',
      'proposed','supervised','analysis', false);
  end loop;
  return v_n;
end

fn_lead_lifecycle_stage:
select case
    when l.claimed is true
      or l.signed is true
      or l.registration_submitted_at is not null
      or nullif(btrim(coalesce(l.claimed_by, '')), '') is not null
      or nullif(btrim(coalesce(l.approval_status, '')), '') is not null
      or nullif(btrim(coalesce(l.registration_status, '')), '') is not null
      then 'registered'
    when l.portal_updated_at is not null
      or l.accepted_terms_at is not null
      or l.owner_email_verified is true
      then 'responded'
    when lower(btrim(coalesce(l.invite_status, ''))) in ('bounced', 'failed', 'undeliverable', 'invalid', 'rejected')
      then 'undeliverable'
    when (l.invited_at is not null and l.invited_at < now() - interval '14 days')
      or (l.invited_at is null and l.contacted is true and coalesce(l.created_at, now()) < now() - interval '14 days')
      then 'no_response'
    when l.invited_at is not null
      or l.contacted is true
      or nullif(btrim(coalesce(l.invite_status, '')), '') is not null
      then 'contacted'
    else 'not_contacted'
  end

_rfq_concept:
select case
    when k is null or btrim(k) = '' then null
    -- location first: "emirate / area" is a place, not a quantity
    when k ~ '(location|emirate|address|site|floor|region|area/|/area)' then 'loc'
    when k ~ '(quantity|qty|size|sizes|dimension|dimensions|area|volume|units|linear|count|sqm|sqft)' then 'qty'
    when k ~ '(scope|supply_install|install)'         then 'scope'
    when k ~ '(timeline|schedule|duration|deadline|when)' then 'time'
    when k ~ '(budget|price|cost)'                    then 'budget'
    when k ~ '(finish|material|fabric|fibre|colou?r)' then 'material'
    when k ~ '(item|product|element|service)'         then 'item'
    else null end;

fn_kb_route:
with q as (select ' ' || kb_norm(p_text) || ' ' as t),
hits as (
  select a.catalog_num, a.alias, a.language, a.weight, a.negative,
         array_length(string_to_array(a.alias_norm, ' '), 1) as words
  from public.kb_operational_alias a, q
  where length(a.alias_norm) >= 3
    and q.t like '%' || ' ' || a.alias_norm || ' ' || '%'
),
scored as (
  select h.catalog_num,
         sum(case when h.negative then -1 else 1 end * h.weight * h.words) as score,
         jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('alias', h.alias, 'lang', h.language,
                                      'w', h.weight, 'words', h.words, 'neg', h.negative)
                   order by h.weight * h.words desc) as matched,
         array_agg(distinct h.language) as langs
  from hits h group by h.catalog_num
)
select s.catalog_num, c.slug, c.name, s.score, s.matched, s.langs
from scored s join public.catalog_supplier_categories c on c.num = s.catalog_num
where s.score > 0
order by s.score desc, s.catalog_num
limit greatest(p_limit, 1);
fn_kb_next_question:
declare v_scope jsonb; v_next jsonb; v_missing jsonb; v_total int; v_answered int; v_blocking int;
begin
  -- scope = the knowledge subcategories this live catalogue route maps to
  with scope as (
    select m.package_slug, m.subcategory_slug, m.priority
    from public.kb_operational_route_map m where m.catalog_num = p_catalog_num
  ),
  qs as (
    select q.question_id, q.source_question_id, q.field_key, q.question_en, q.question_ar,
           q.answer_type, q.allowed_values, q.unit, q.mandatory, q.on_missing, q.impact,
           q.answerable_by_documents, q.category_slug, q.subcategory_slug,
           coalesce((q.activation->>'order')::int, 999) as ord
    from kb_stage.questions q
    join scope s on s.package_slug = q.category_slug and s.subcategory_slug = q.subcategory_slug
    where q.field_key is not null
  ),
  -- One question per field_key across all mapped subcategories. A composite route (signage maps to
  -- 3 packages) otherwise asks "which emirate?" seven times.
  dedup as (
    select distinct on (field_key) * from qs order by field_key, mandatory desc, ord, question_id
  ),
  open as (
    select * from dedup
    where not (p_answered ? field_key)
       or nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_answered->>field_key, '')), '') is null
  )
  select
    (select to_jsonb(o) from open o order by o.mandatory desc, o.ord, o.question_id limit 1),
    (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('field_key', o.field_key, 'mandatory', o.mandatory,
                                                  'on_missing', o.on_missing) order by o.mandatory desc, o.ord), '[]'::jsonb)
       from open o),
    (select count(*) from dedup where mandatory),
    (select count(*) from dedup d where d.mandatory and p_answered ? d.field_key
        and nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_answered->>d.field_key,'')),'') is not null),
    (select count(*) from open o where o.mandatory
        and (o.on_missing is null or o.on_missing ilike 'block%' or o.on_missing ilike '%block%'))
  into v_next, v_missing, v_total, v_answered, v_blocking;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'catalog_num', p_catalog_num,
    'next_question', v_next,
    'missing', v_missing,
    'mandatory_total', coalesce(v_total, 0),
    'mandatory_answered', coalesce(v_answered, 0),
    'completeness', case when coalesce(v_total,0) = 0 then null
                         else round(coalesce(v_answered,0)::numeric / v_total, 3) end,
    -- The single auditable gate the external reviewer asked for: one boolean, one query, one place.
    'dispatch_eligible', coalesce(v_blocking, 0) = 0,
    'blocking_count', coalesce(v_blocking, 0),
    'source', 'kb_stage.questions (deterministic, no model call)');
end
fn_kb_retrieve:
with gate as (
  select coalesce((public.fn_kb_route_activation_blocked(p_catalog_num)->>'blocked')::boolean, true) as blocked
), scope as (
  select m.package_slug, m.subcategory_slug from public.kb_operational_route_map m, gate
  where m.catalog_num = p_catalog_num and not gate.blocked
), q as (
  select to_tsquery('simple',
           nullif(array_to_string(
             array(select w || ':*' from unnest(regexp_split_to_array(lower(coalesce(p_query,'')), '[^a-z0-9؀-ۿ]+')) w
                   where length(w) >= 3), ' | '), '')) tsq
)
select r.record_id, r.title, left(r.content, 4000), r.module, r.record_type, r.authority,
       r.validation_status, r.confidence, r.source_ids,
       (r.escalation_rule is not null or r.module = 'uae_regulations') as escalate,
       ts_rank(to_tsvector('simple', r.title || ' ' || left(r.content, 4000)), q.tsq) as rank
from kb_stage.records r
join scope s on s.package_slug = r.category_slug and s.subcategory_slug = r.subcategory_slug
cross join q
where r.validation_status in ('reviewed', 'source_verified', 'approved')
  and (p_modules is null or r.module = any (p_modules))
  and (q.tsq is null or to_tsvector('simple', r.title || ' ' || left(r.content, 4000)) @@ q.tsq)
order by rank desc, r.confidence desc nulls last, r.record_id
limit greatest(p_limit, 1);

with tk as (
  -- a target key given directly, plus every target this production key maps onto
  select array(
    select distinct k from (
      select d.department_key k from ops_kb_stage.departments d where d.department_key = p_dept_key
      union
      select c.target_department_key from ops_kb_stage.department_crosswalk c
       where c.production_dept_key = p_dept_key and c.target_exists
    ) z where k is not null) targets
),
q as (
  select to_tsquery('simple', nullif(array_to_string(
      array(select w || ':*' from unnest(regexp_split_to_array(lower(coalesce(p_topic,'')), '[^a-z0-9]+')) w
            where length(w) >= 3), ' | '), '')) tsq
)
select jsonb_build_object(
  'department', p_dept_key,
  'target_departments', (select to_jsonb(targets) from tk),
  'charter', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('department', d.department_key, 'name', d.name,
             'charter', left(d.charter,400), 'north_star', left(d.north_star,240),
             'implementation_status', d.implementation_status) order by d.department_key), '[]'::jsonb)
    from ops_kb_stage.departments d, tk where d.department_key = any(tk.targets)),
  -- Each target role carries the routing pack's model default for that role. The 96
  -- scope='target_employee' rows in model_policy_by_identity are keyed on the same target
  -- department and title as ops_kb_stage.roles and had no reader anywhere; fn_ai_route picked up
  -- only the 24 current_agent rows. deterministic_first is the operative field: the pack says
  -- most of these roles should reach for a rule before a model.
  'roles', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('title', r.title, 'agent_key', r.agent_key,
             'authority_tier', r.authority_tier, 'max_authority', r.max_authority,
             'responsibilities', left(r.responsibilities,300),
             'model_default', case when i.identity_key is null then null else jsonb_build_object(
                 'primary', i.primary_model, 'fallback', i.fallback_model,
                 'deterministic_first', i.deterministic_first,
                 'max_output_tokens', i.max_output_tokens) end) order by r.record_id), '[]'::jsonb)
    from ops_kb_stage.roles r
    cross join tk
    -- identity_key IS the role's agent_key: 96 of 96 join exactly. Matching on department+title
    -- reached only 44 and was my invention, not the data's.
    left join public.model_policy_by_identity i
           on i.scope = 'target_employee' and i.identity_key = r.agent_key
    where r.department_key = any(tk.targets)),
  'company_core', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('title', c.title, 'content', c.body)), '[]'::jsonb)
    from (select r.title, left(r.content,1200) body from ops_kb_stage.records r
          where r.scope_type = 'company' and r.module in ('identity','principles','governance','privacy','language')
            and r.validation_status in ('reviewed','source_verified','approved')
          order by r.record_type limit 8) c),
  'department_knowledge', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(s.x), '[]'::jsonb) from (
      select jsonb_build_object('record_id', r.record_id, 'title', r.title,
                                'content', left(r.content, 1500), 'module', r.module,
                                'implementation_status', r.implementation_status,
                                'authority_tier', r.authority_tier, 'risk_level', r.risk_level,
                                'source_ids', r.source_ids) x
      from ops_kb_stage.records r, q, tk
      where r.scope_type = 'department' and r.scope_key = any(tk.targets)
        and r.validation_status in ('reviewed','source_verified','approved')
        and (q.tsq is null or to_tsvector('simple', r.title || ' ' || left(r.content,4000)) @@ q.tsq)
      order by ts_rank(to_tsvector('simple', r.title || ' ' || left(r.content,4000)), q.tsq) desc,
               r.implementation_status, r.record_id
      limit greatest(p_limit,1)) s),
  'decision_rules', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
             'rule_id', d.rule_id, 'priority', d.priority,
             'when', coalesce(d.condition->>'text', d.condition::text),
             'then', coalesce(d.action->>'text', d.action::text),
             'authority_tier', d.authority_tier,
             'requires_human_review', d.requires_human_review) order by d.priority desc nulls last), '[]'::jsonb)
    from ops_kb_stage.decision_rules d, tk
    where d.department_key = any(tk.targets) and d.enabled),
  -- SOPs come from the pack's own sops projection (steps, definition of done, rollback, SLA),
  -- not from records filtered by record_type: the projection is the structured shape and the
  -- structure is the part an employee needs to actually follow the procedure.
  'sops', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('workflow', s.workflow_key, 'trigger', s.trigger,
             'steps', s.steps, 'definition_of_done', s.definition_of_done,
             'service_level', s.service_level, 'rollback', left(s.rollback,240),
             'authority_tier', s.authority_tier) order by s.record_id), '[]'::jsonb)
    from ops_kb_stage.sops s, tk where s.department_key = any(tk.targets)),
  'exception_playbooks', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('exception', p.exception_key, 'trigger', p.trigger,
                                                 'immediate_actions', p.immediate_actions,
                                                 'recovery', p.recovery) order by p.exception_key), '[]'::jsonb)
    from ops_kb_stage.exception_playbooks p, tk
    where p.department_key = any(tk.targets) and p.enabled),
  'kpis', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('metric', k.metric_name, 'formula', left(k.formula_description,240),
             'direction', k.direction, 'owner', k.owner) order by k.record_id), '[]'::jsonb)
    from ops_kb_stage.kpis k, tk where k.department_key = any(tk.targets) and coalesce(k.enabled,true)),
  'workflows', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('workflow', w.workflow_key, 'name', w.name,
             'trigger', left(w.trigger,200), 'departments', to_jsonb(w.departments),
             'hard_gates', to_jsonb(w.hard_gates), 'implementation_status', w.implementation_status)
             order by w.workflow_key), '[]'::jsonb)
    from ops_kb_stage.workflows w, tk where w.departments && tk.targets and coalesce(w.enabled,true)),
  'handoffs', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('workflow', h.workflow_key,
             'direction', case when h.from_department = any(tk.targets) then 'you send' else 'you receive' end,
             'from', h.from_department, 'to', h.to_department,
             'you_must', case when h.from_department = any(tk.targets) then left(h.sender_action,200)
                              else left(h.receiver_action,200) end,
             'acceptance', left(h.acceptance,160), 'rejection', left(h.rejection,160)) order by h.record_id), '[]'::jsonb)
    from ops_kb_stage.handoffs h, tk
    where (h.from_department = any(tk.targets) or h.to_department = any(tk.targets)) and coalesce(h.enabled,true)),
  -- All 100 pack subscriptions carry active=false: the pack ships them staged and step 18 of
  -- 03_IMPORT_ORDER says stop before activation. Filtering on active would return [] for every
  -- department and the projection would still be unread. They are emitted WITH the flag, because
  -- "your department is supposed to receive this event and does not yet" is the fact the target
  -- operating model is asserting. Setting active=true here would change nothing on the live bus
  -- (public.event_subscription is a different table) and would only dress the flag up as delivery.
  'event_subscriptions', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('event', e.event_type, 'reason', left(e.reason,200),
             'activated', coalesce(e.active,false)) order by e.event_type), '[]'::jsonb)
    from ops_kb_stage.event_subscriptions e, tk
    where e.department_key = any(tk.targets) or e.department_key = 'all'),
  'scenarios', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('scenario', s.scenario_key, 'kind', s.kind,
             'situation', left(s.situation,240), 'expected', left(s.expected_behaviour,240),
             'last_result', s.last_result, 'last_run', s.last_run) order by s.scenario_key), '[]'::jsonb)
    from ops_kb_stage.scenarios s, tk where s.scope_key = any(tk.targets)),
  'templates', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('template', t.template_key, 'purpose', left(t.purpose,200))
             order by t.template_key), '[]'::jsonb)
    from ops_kb_stage.templates t, tk where t.department_key = any(tk.targets)),
  'live_data', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('object', b.object_name, 'kind', b.db_object_kind,
                                                 'purpose', b.read_purpose, 'write_policy', b.write_policy)), '[]'::jsonb)
    from ops_kb_stage.live_bindings b, tk
    where b.department_key = any(tk.targets) and b.mapping_status = 'mapped'),
  'authoritative_sources', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source_id', s2.source_id, 'title', s2.title,
                                                 'publisher', s2.publisher, 'url', s2.url_or_path)), '[]'::jsonb)
    from ops_kb_stage.sources s2
    where exists (select 1 from ops_kb_stage.records r, tk
                  where r.scope_key = any(tk.targets) and s2.source_id = any(r.source_ids))),
  'hard_gates', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('action_class', g.raw->>'action_class',
                                                 'approval_role', g.raw->>'approval_role')), '[]'::jsonb)
    from ops_kb_stage.hard_gates g),
  'institutional_memory', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('headline', m.headline, 'outcome', m.outcome)), '[]'::jsonb)
    from (select headline, outcome from public.institutional_memory order by created_at desc limit 3) m),
  'note', 'Decision rules, SOPs and exception playbooks are ENABLED as of 2026-08-10, after all 282 pack scenarios returned RUNNABLE. Hard gates still bind, and money still routes to the founder. Records marked target_state describe a capability that is NOT built yet.'
);
fn_ops_run_scenarios:
with checked as (
  select s.record_id, s.kind, s.scope_key,
    array_remove(array[
      case when not exists (select 1 from ops_kb_stage.departments d where d.department_key = s.scope_key)
            and s.kind = 'department' then 'department not in the corpus department index' end,
      case when s.kind = 'workflow'
            and not exists (select 1 from ops_kb_stage.workflows w where w.workflow_key = s.scope_key)
           then 'workflow_key does not resolve to an imported workflow' end,
      case when coalesce(btrim(s.expected_behaviour), '') = '' then 'no expected behaviour stated' end,
      case when jsonb_array_length(coalesce(s.pass_criteria, '[]'::jsonb)) = 0 then 'no pass criteria' end,
      case when s.kind = 'department'
            and not exists (select 1 from ops_kb_stage.records r
                            where r.scope_type='department' and r.scope_key = s.scope_key
                              and r.module = 'professional_knowledge')
           then 'department has no professional knowledge to reason from' end,
      case when s.kind = 'department'
            and not exists (select 1 from ops_kb_stage.live_bindings b
                            where b.department_key = s.scope_key and b.mapping_status='mapped')
           then 'department has no resolved live-data binding' end,
      case when s.kind = 'department'
            and not exists (select 1 from ops_kb_stage.decision_rules dr where dr.department_key = s.scope_key)
           then 'department has no decision rules' end
    ], null) as failures
  from ops_kb_stage.scenarios s
)
select c.record_id, c.kind, c.scope_key,
       case when cardinality(c.failures) = 0 then 'RUNNABLE' else 'BLOCKED' end,
       c.failures
from checked c;
fn_supplier_exception_days: select greatest(1, coalesce((select nullif(btrim(value),'')::int from app_secrets where key='supplier_exception_days'), 14));
fn_supplier_exception_close:
update public.leads
     set exception_closed_at = now(),
         exception_outcome = p_outcome,
         licence_gate_reason = case when p_outcome = 'resolved' then null else licence_gate_reason end
   where id = p_lead_id and exception_closed_at is null;
fn_supplier_exception_sweep:
declare v_reminded int := 0; v_rejected int := 0; r record; v_days int := public.fn_supplier_exception_days();
begin
  -- reminders
  for r in
    select l.id, l.company_name, l.claimed_by, l.exception_due_at, l.exception_reminders, l.licence_gate_reason
    from public.leads l
    where l.approval_status = 'action_required'
      and l.exception_closed_at is null
      and l.exception_due_at is not null
      and l.exception_due_at > now()
      and l.claimed_by is not null
      and (l.exception_last_reminder_at is null or l.exception_last_reminder_at < now() - interval '48 hours')
      and (
        (l.exception_reminders = 0 and now() >= l.exception_opened_at + interval '3 days') or
        (l.exception_reminders = 1 and now() >= l.exception_opened_at + interval '7 days') or
        (l.exception_reminders = 2 and now() >= l.exception_opened_at + interval '12 days')
      )
  loop
    insert into public.notifications (type, to_email, to_role, lead_id, subject, body, channel, status)
    values ('supplier_exception_reminder', r.claimed_by, 'supplier', r.id,
            'Action needed to activate your QuotesDone account',
            'Your registration for ' || coalesce(r.company_name,'your company') ||
            ' is not active yet: ' || coalesce(r.licence_gate_reason, 'we could not read a valid, in-date trade licence') ||
            E'.\n\nUpload a clear copy of your current trade licence in your supplier portal and your account activates automatically - there is no approval queue.' ||
            E'\n\nIf we do not receive one by ' || to_char(r.exception_due_at, 'DD Mon YYYY') ||
            ', this registration will be closed automatically. You can register again at any time.',
            'email', 'queued');
    update public.leads
       set exception_reminders = exception_reminders + 1, exception_last_reminder_at = now()
     where id = r.id;
    v_reminded := v_reminded + 1;
  end loop;

  -- expiry -> automatic rejection
  for r in
    select l.id, l.company_name, l.claimed_by, l.licence_gate_reason
    from public.leads l
    where l.approval_status = 'action_required'
      and l.exception_closed_at is null
      and l.exception_due_at is not null
      and l.exception_due_at <= now()
  loop
    update public.leads
       set approval_status = 'rejected',
           rejection_reason = 'Automatically closed after ' || v_days ||
                              ' days without a readable, in-date trade licence (' ||
                              coalesce(r.licence_gate_reason,'licence unreadable') || ')',
           exception_closed_at = now(), exception_outcome = 'expired_auto_rejected'
     where id = r.id;

    if r.claimed_by is not null then
      insert into public.notifications (type, to_email, to_role, lead_id, subject, body, channel, status)
      values ('supplier_exception_expired', r.claimed_by, 'supplier', r.id,
              'Your QuotesDone registration has been closed',
              'We could not activate ' || coalesce(r.company_name,'your registration') || ' because ' ||
              coalesce(r.licence_gate_reason,'we could not read a valid, in-date trade licence') ||
              ', and ' || v_days || ' days have passed.' ||
              E'\n\nNothing is lost - you can register again whenever you have a clear copy of your current trade licence, and activation is immediate once we can read it.' ||
              E'\n\nIf you believe this is a mistake, reply to this email.',
              'email', 'queued');
    end if;

    -- telemetry, not a ticket. The auto-rejection rate is the cost of the fully-automatic policy
    -- and the founder asked for it to stay measurable.
    insert into public.agent_actions (agent, kind, status, risk, title, recommendation, detail, target_table, target_id)
    values ('onboarding', 'supplier_exception_expired', 'logged', 'medium',
            'Registration auto-closed after ' || v_days || ' days - ' || coalesce(r.company_name, 'supplier #' || r.id),
            'No action required. Recorded so the auto-rejection rate stays visible; if genuine businesses appear here, the fully-automatic policy needs revisiting.',
            jsonb_build_object('lead_id', r.id, 'reason', r.licence_gate_reason, 'days', v_days),
            'leads', r.id::text);
    v_rejected := v_rejected + 1;
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object('reminded', v_reminded, 'auto_rejected', v_rejected, 'window_days', v_days);
end
fn_control_mode_minutes: select least(60, greatest(5, coalesce((select nullif(btrim(value),'')::int from app_secrets where key='control_mode_minutes'), 15)));
fn_control_mode_status:
select coalesce(
    -- An open session still reads as Control, disarmed or not: if one exists it is real and it
    -- is audited, and hiding it would be its own lie.
    (select jsonb_build_object(
       'mode','control', 'session_id', s.id, 'reason', s.reason,
       'opened_at', s.opened_at, 'expires_at', s.expires_at,
       'seconds_remaining', greatest(0, extract(epoch from (s.expires_at - now()))::int),
       'actions_used', s.actions_used)
     from public.control_mode_session s
     where s.actor_email = p_actor_email and s.closed_at is null and s.expires_at > now()
     order by s.opened_at desc limit 1),
    -- THE GATE IS OFF. Say so, say who turned it off and when, and say what is still holding —
    -- because "no second factor" is not "no security", and the founder should not read it as one.
    (select jsonb_build_object(
       'mode','disarmed', 'session_id', null,
       'disarmed_at', r.at, 'disarmed_by', r.actor,
       'message','Control Mode is switched off. Changes go through without a code, and every one '
                 ||'of them is still authenticated, attributed and audited. Turned off '
                 ||to_char(r.at at time zone 'UTC','DD Mon YYYY')||' by '||coalesce(r.actor,'an administrator')||'.')
     from public.phase1_rollback_log r
     where public.fn_phase1_disarmed()
     order by r.at desc limit 1),
    jsonb_build_object('mode','observe','session_id', null,
      'message','Observe Mode. Everything is readable; nothing can be changed until Control Mode is opened with a code.'));
fn_otp_hash: select encode(extensions.hmac(p_code, (select value from public.app_secrets where key='otp_hmac_key'), 'sha256'), 'hex');

fn_refund_request:
declare v_id bigint; v_in_window boolean := false; t public.transactions;
begin
  if p_amount_fils is null or p_amount_fils <= 0 then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'amount_required');
  end if;

  select * into t from public.transactions
   where (p_transaction_id is not null and id = p_transaction_id)
      or (p_transaction_id is null and p_quote_id is not null and quote_id = p_quote_id)
      or (p_transaction_id is null and p_quote_id is null and p_payment_intent is not null and payment_ref = p_payment_intent)
   order by revealed_at desc nulls last limit 1;

  -- Recorded, never acted on. Whether the request arrived inside the window promised at reveal
  -- (transactions.refund_deadline, computed by fn_add_working_days when the quote was revealed) is
  -- exactly the kind of thing the founder wants in front of him when he decides — and exactly the
  -- kind of thing that must not decide for him.
  if t.id is not null and t.refund_deadline is not null and t.refund_deadline >= now() then
    v_in_window := true;
  end if;

  insert into public.refunds (transaction_id, inquiry_id, customer_id, supplier_lead_id, quote_id,
                              stripe_payment_intent, stripe_charge_id,
                              amount_fils, reason_code, reason_note, requested_by,
                              within_auto_window, status, reconciliation_note)
  values (t.id, coalesce(p_inquiry_id, t.inquiry_id), coalesce(p_customer_id, t.customer_id),
          coalesce(p_supplier_lead_id, t.supplier_id), coalesce(p_quote_id, t.quote_id),
          coalesce(p_payment_intent, t.payment_ref), p_charge_id,
          p_amount_fils, p_reason_code, p_note, p_requested_by,
          v_in_window, 'requested',
          'HELD FOR THE FOUNDER. Every refund waits for his decision, whatever the amount and '
       || 'whether or not it is inside the promised window — founder instruction, 17 Aug 2026. '
       || 'This one is ' || round(p_amount_fils / 100.0, 2) || ' AED and is '
       || case when v_in_window then 'inside' else 'outside' end || ' the window promised at reveal.')
  returning id into v_id;

  if t.id is not null then
    update public.transactions
       set refund_status = 'requested',
           refund_reason = coalesce(refund_reason, p_reason_code),
           refund_requested_at = coalesce(refund_requested_at, now()),
           refund_note = coalesce(p_note, refund_note)
     where id = t.id;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'refund_id', v_id, 'transaction_id', t.id,
                            'status', 'requested',
                            'within_auto_window', v_in_window,
                            'auto_approved', false,
                            'awaiting', 'founder');
end

fn_supplier_subscription:
with pc as (select * from public.pricing_config order by id limit 1),
       s as (
         select
           (select nullif(value,'')::numeric from public.app_secrets where key='supplier_subscription_aed')  as fee,
           (select nullif(value,'')::date    from public.app_secrets where key='supplier_subscription_start') as start_date,
           (select nullif(value,'')::int     from public.app_secrets where key='founding_free_limit')         as free_limit
       )
  select
    coalesce((select supplier_reg_fee::numeric from pc), (select fee from s), 1000)                as fee,
    coalesce((select supplier_reg_currency from pc), 'AED')                                        as currency,
    coalesce((select supplier_reg_period   from pc), 'yearly')                                     as period,
    coalesce((select start_date from s), date '2027-08-01')                                        as start_date,
    coalesce((select supplier_free_count from pc), (select free_limit from s), 1000)               as free_limit,
    case when (select supplier_reg_fee from pc) is not null then 'pricing_config'
         when (select fee from s) is not null then 'app_secrets' else 'default' end                as fee_source,
    case when (select start_date from s) is not null then 'app_secrets' else 'default' end         as start_source,
    case when (select supplier_free_count from pc) is not null then 'pricing_config'
         when (select free_limit from s) is not null then 'app_secrets' else 'default' end         as free_source;
