fn_trade_identify:
declare
  v_norm        text := public.fn_norm_text(p_customer_text);
  v_scope       jsonb; v_anchor boolean := false; v_only boolean := false;
  v_named       text[] := '{}'; v_structured text[] := '{}';
  rec           record; v_cand public.inquiry_trade_candidate%rowtype;
  v_cand_id     bigint; v_status text;
  v_confirmed   text[] := '{}'; v_proposed text[] := '{}';
  v_clar_id     bigint; v_ws jsonb;
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.inquiry_workstream_group where id = p_group_id) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'unknown_group');
  end if;

  if p_structured ? 'trades' then
    select array_agg(t) into v_structured
      from jsonb_array_elements_text(p_structured->'trades') t
     where t in (select trade_key from public.mep_trade);
  end if;
  v_structured := coalesce(v_structured, '{}');

  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct p.trade_key), '{}') into v_named
    from public.mep_trade_pattern p
   where p.kind = 'trade_name' and public.fn_term_matches(v_norm, p.pattern_norm, p.lang);

  select coalesce(bool_or(public.fn_term_matches(v_norm, p.pattern_norm, p.lang)), false) into v_anchor
    from public.mep_trade_pattern p where p.kind in ('mep_anchor','mep_full_phrase');
  select coalesce(bool_or(public.fn_term_matches(v_norm, p.pattern_norm, p.lang)), false) into v_only
    from public.mep_trade_pattern p where p.kind = 'scope_only';

  v_scope := public.fn_mep_full_scope(v_norm);

  for rec in
    select t as trade_key, 'structured_answer' as src, 'structured_answer' as wkey,
           1.000::numeric as score, false as ambiguous,
           'Customer selected this trade explicitly in a structured answer.' as reason,
           null::text as term, null::text as slug, null::integer as cat,
           null::text as doc, null::boolean as doc_ok
      from unnest(v_structured) t
    union all
    select p.trade_key, 'customer_text', 'customer_text.trade_name', 0.950, false,
           'Customer text names this trade explicitly ("' || p.pattern || '").',
           p.pattern, null, null, null, null
      from public.mep_trade_pattern p
     where p.kind = 'trade_name' and public.fn_term_matches(v_norm, p.pattern_norm, p.lang)
    union all
    select t.trade_key, 'scope_rule', 'scope_rule.mep_full_scope', 0.900, false,
           'Full-MEP scope established by ' || (v_scope->>'basis') ||
             coalesce(' (anchor "' || (v_scope->>'anchor') || '")','') ||
             '. Route 8 core trades; fire and ELV are never implied.',
           v_scope->>'anchor', null, null, null, null
      from public.mep_trade t
     where t.is_core and (v_scope->>'matched')::boolean and not v_only
    union all
    select am.trade_key, 'alias',
           case when am.n_trades = 1 then 'alias.unique' else 'alias.ambiguous' end,
           case when am.n_trades = 1 then 0.750 else 0.400 end,
           (am.n_trades > 1),
           case when am.n_trades = 1
                then 'Customer text contains "' || am.term || '", a catalogue alias unique to this trade.'
                else 'Customer text contains "' || am.term || '", an alias shared by ' || am.n_trades || ' trades. Ambiguous.' end,
           am.term, am.subcategory_slug, am.catalog_num, null, null
      from (
        select ah.term, ah.trade_key, ah.subcategory_slug, ah.catalog_num,
               count(*) over (partition by ah.term) as n_trades
          from (
            select x.a as term, tr.trade_key,
                   min(s.subcategory_slug) as subcategory_slug, min(m.catalog_num) as catalog_num
              from kb_stage.subcategories s
              join public.kb_operational_route_map m on m.subcategory_slug = s.subcategory_slug
              join public.mep_trade_route tr on tr.catalog_num = m.catalog_num
              cross join lateral (
                select a, 'en' as lng from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(s.aliases_en,'[]'::jsonb)) a
                union all
                select a, 'ar' from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(s.aliases_ar,'[]'::jsonb)) a
              ) x(a, lng)
             where length(x.a) >= 3
               and v_norm like '%' || public.fn_norm_text(x.a) || '%'
               and public.fn_term_matches(v_norm,
                     regexp_replace(public.fn_norm_text(x.a), '([.^$*+?()\[\]{}|\\])', '\\\1', 'g'),
                     x.lng)
             group by x.a, tr.trade_key
          ) ah
      ) am
    union all
    -- Conventional terms that imply a trade without naming it. Never confirm.
    select p.trade_key, 'customer_text', 'customer_text.trade_hint', 0.400, false,
           'Customer text uses "' || p.pattern || '", a term that conventionally implies this trade '
             || 'without naming it. Raised for confirmation, never activated on its own.',
           p.pattern, null, null, null, null
      from public.mep_trade_pattern p
     where p.kind = 'trade_hint' and public.fn_term_matches(v_norm, p.pattern_norm, p.lang)
    union all
    select am.trade_key, 'document_extraction', 'document_extraction', 0.600, false,
           'Detected in approved document ' || am.doc || ' via catalogue alias "' || am.term ||
             '". A document may propose a trade; it may never activate one.',
           am.term, am.subcategory_slug, am.catalog_num, am.doc, true
      from (
        select d->>'document_id' as doc, x.a as term, tr.trade_key,
               min(s.subcategory_slug) as subcategory_slug, min(m.catalog_num) as catalog_num
          from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_documents,'[]'::jsonb)) d
          join kb_stage.subcategories s on true
          join public.kb_operational_route_map m on m.subcategory_slug = s.subcategory_slug
          join public.mep_trade_route tr on tr.catalog_num = m.catalog_num
          cross join lateral (
            select a, 'en' as lng from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(s.aliases_en,'[]'::jsonb)) a
            union all
            select a, 'ar' from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(s.aliases_ar,'[]'::jsonb)) a
          ) x(a, lng)
         where coalesce((d->>'approved')::boolean, false)
           and length(x.a) >= 3
           and public.fn_norm_text(d->>'text') like '%' || public.fn_norm_text(x.a) || '%'
           and public.fn_term_matches(public.fn_norm_text(d->>'text'),
                 regexp_replace(public.fn_norm_text(x.a), '([.^$*+?()\[\]{}|\\])', '\\\1', 'g'),
                 x.lng)
         group by d->>'document_id', x.a, tr.trade_key
      ) am
    order by 4 desc
  loop
    v_status := case
      when rec.ambiguous then 'proposed'
      when coalesce((select w.auto_confirms from public.mep_evidence_weight w
                      where w.weight_key = rec.wkey), false) then 'confirmed'
      else 'proposed' end;

    select * into v_cand from public.inquiry_trade_candidate
     where group_id = p_group_id and trade_key = rec.trade_key;

    if not found then
      insert into public.inquiry_trade_candidate
        (group_id, trade_key, status, evidence_source, match_reason, evidence_score,
         score_basis, requires_confirmation, confirmation_factors)
      values (p_group_id, rec.trade_key, v_status, rec.src, rec.reason, rec.score,
              'rule_weight_provisional', (v_status = 'proposed'),
              jsonb_build_object(
                'source_authority', (select w.source_authority from public.mep_evidence_weight w where w.weight_key = rec.wkey),
                'exactness',        (select w.exactness        from public.mep_evidence_weight w where w.weight_key = rec.wkey),
                'alias_specificity', case when rec.src <> 'alias' then 'not_applicable'
                                          when rec.ambiguous then 'shared_across_trades'
                                          else 'unique_to_trade' end,
                'ambiguous', rec.ambiguous,
                'customer_confirmation_required', (v_status = 'proposed'),
                'weight_key', rec.wkey, 'score_basis', 'rule_weight_provisional'))
      returning id into v_cand_id;
    else
      v_cand_id := v_cand.id;
      if v_cand.status = 'proposed' and v_status = 'confirmed' then
        update public.inquiry_trade_candidate
           set status = 'confirmed', evidence_source = rec.src, match_reason = rec.reason,
               evidence_score = greatest(evidence_score, rec.score), requires_confirmation = false,
               confirmation_factors = coalesce(confirmation_factors,'{}'::jsonb)
                 || jsonb_build_object('upgraded_by', rec.wkey, 'customer_confirmation_required', false)
         where id = v_cand_id;
      elsif v_cand.status = 'proposed' then
        update public.inquiry_trade_candidate
           set evidence_score = greatest(evidence_score, rec.score) where id = v_cand_id;
      end if;
    end if;

    insert into public.inquiry_trade_candidate_evidence
      (candidate_id, evidence_source, matched_term, subcategory_slug, catalog_num,
       document_id, document_approved, evidence_score, score_basis, detail)
    values (v_cand_id, rec.src, rec.term, rec.slug, rec.cat, rec.doc, rec.doc_ok, rec.score,
            'rule_weight_provisional',
            jsonb_build_object('reason', rec.reason, 'weight_key', rec.wkey));
  end loop;

  update public.inquiry_trade_candidate c
     set confirmation_factors = coalesce(c.confirmation_factors,'{}'::jsonb)
       || jsonb_build_object('runner_up_matches',
            (select count(*) from public.inquiry_trade_candidate o
              where o.group_id = c.group_id and o.id <> c.id
                and o.evidence_score >= c.evidence_score
                and o.status in ('proposed','confirmed')))
   where c.group_id = p_group_id;

  for rec in
    select * from public.inquiry_trade_candidate
     where group_id = p_group_id and status = 'confirmed' and workstream_id is null
  loop
    v_ws := public.fn_inquiry_workstream_activate(p_group_id, rec.trade_key, p_actor);
    update public.inquiry_trade_candidate
       set workstream_id = (v_ws->>'workstream_id')::bigint, activated_at = now()
     where id = rec.id;
  end loop;

  select coalesce(array_agg(trade_key order by trade_key),'{}') into v_confirmed
    from public.inquiry_trade_candidate where group_id = p_group_id and status = 'confirmed';
  select coalesce(array_agg(trade_key order by trade_key),'{}') into v_proposed
    from public.inquiry_trade_candidate where group_id = p_group_id and status = 'proposed';

  if cardinality(v_confirmed) = 0 then
    insert into public.inquiry_trade_clarification (group_id, question_en, question_ar, options, reason)
    select p_group_id,
           'Which trades does this enquiry cover?',
           'ما هي التخصصات التي يشملها هذا الطلب؟',
           coalesce(nullif(v_proposed,'{}'), array['hvac','electrical','plumbing','fire','elv']),
           case when v_anchor and not (v_scope->>'matched')::boolean
                then 'An MEP umbrella term was used with no full-scope modifier beside it and no trade named, so the scope is genuinely unknown.'
                when cardinality(v_proposed) > 0
                then 'Evidence exists but none of it is strong enough to activate a trade on its own.'
                else 'No trade evidence was found in the customer text, structured answers or approved documents.' end
    where not exists (select 1 from public.inquiry_trade_clarification c
                       where c.group_id = p_group_id and c.answered_at is null)
    returning id into v_clar_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.inquiry_state_audit (group_id, event, detail, actor)
  values (p_group_id, 'trade_identification_run',
          jsonb_build_object('confirmed', v_confirmed, 'proposed', v_proposed,
                             'mep_anchor', v_anchor, 'full_scope', v_scope,
                             'exclusivity_qualifier', v_only,
                             'named_in_text', v_named, 'structured', v_structured,
                             'clarification_id', v_clar_id), p_actor);

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'confirmed', v_confirmed, 'proposed', v_proposed,
                            'clarification_id', v_clar_id,
                            'clarification_required', (v_clar_id is not null),
                            'mep_anchor', v_anchor, 'full_scope', v_scope,
                            'exclusivity_qualifier', v_only,
                            'score_basis', 'rule_weight_provisional');
end
fn_group_dispatch_report:
declare v_gd public.v_group_dispatch%rowtype; v_blockers jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; r record;
        v_active jsonb; v_out jsonb; v_opt jsonb; v_conf jsonb; v_comp jsonb; v_n_active int;
begin
  select * into v_gd from public.v_group_dispatch where group_id = p_group_id;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'unknown_group'); end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('trade', trade_key, 'disposition', disposition)
                            order by trade_key), '[]'::jsonb), count(*)
    into v_active, v_n_active from public.v_trade_scope_status
   where group_id = p_group_id and coalesce(contributes,false) and coalesce(workstream_active,false);
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('trade', trade_key, 'disposition', disposition,
                                               'reason', reason) order by trade_key), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_out from public.v_trade_scope_status
   where group_id = p_group_id and disposition in ('excluded','by_others','client_supplied');
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('trade', trade_key, 'disposition', disposition,
                                               'reason', reason) order by trade_key), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_opt from public.v_trade_scope_status
   where group_id = p_group_id and disposition in ('optional','future_phase','proposed','unknown');
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('trade', trade_key, 'clauses', clause_indexes,
                                               'reason', reason) order by trade_key), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_conf from public.v_trade_scope_status
   where group_id = p_group_id and coalesce(is_conflict,false);
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('trade', trade_key, 'component', scope_component,
                                               'disposition', disposition) order by trade_key, scope_component), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_comp from public.v_scope_disposition_effective
   where group_id = p_group_id and scope_component <> 'complete_trade_scope' and disposition <> 'included';

  if v_n_active = 0 then
    if jsonb_array_length(v_conf) > 0 then
      v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
        'blocker','scope_confirmation_required','severity','blocking','conflicts', v_conf,
        'detail','Contradictory scope statements of equal specificity. The customer must say which applies.',
        'remedy','Answer the open clarification.'));
    else
      v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(public.fn_p2c1_no_active_trade_blocker(v_out, v_opt));
    end if;
  elsif jsonb_array_length(v_conf) > 0 then
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'blocker','scope_confirmation_required','severity','blocking','conflicts', v_conf,
      'detail','Some trades are active but an unresolved scope conflict remains.'));
  end if;

  if cardinality(v_gd.shared_missing_mandatory) > 0 then
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'blocker','shared_mandatory_missing','severity','blocking',
      'fields', to_jsonb(v_gd.shared_missing_mandatory),
      'detail','Shared project fields required by an active workstream are unanswered.'));
  end if;
  if not v_gd.no_unresolved_shared_conflict then
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'blocker','open_shared_conflict','severity','blocking',
      'fields', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(c.field_id), '[]'::jsonb)
                   from public.inquiry_answer_conflict c
                   join public.field_definition fd on fd.field_id = c.field_id
                  where c.group_id = p_group_id and c.resolved_at is null and fd.scope = 'shared'),
      'detail','A shared field has sources that disagree. Every workstream is affected.'));
  end if;
  for r in select * from public.v_workstream_dispatch
            where group_id = p_group_id and active and not dispatch_eligible loop
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'blocker','trade_not_eligible','severity','blocking','trade_key', r.trade_key,
      'missing_mandatory', to_jsonb(r.missing_mandatory),
      'unresolved_conflicts', to_jsonb(r.blocked_by), 'gate_states', r.gate_states,
      'detail','This trade is not dispatch-eligible, so the group is not.'));
  end loop;
  for r in select gr.gate_key,
                  coalesce((select g.state::text from public.inquiry_gate g
                             where g.group_id = p_group_id and g.workstream_id is null
                               and g.gate_key = gr.gate_key), 'not_evaluated') as state
             from public.inquiry_gate_required gr where gr.level = 'group' loop
    if r.state not in ('passed','not_applicable') then
      v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
        'blocker','group_gate_not_satisfied','severity','blocking','gate_key', r.gate_key,
        'state', r.state,
        'detail', case when r.state = 'not_evaluated'
                       then 'This gate has never been evaluated. Absent reads as failed.'
                       else 'Gate state is ' || r.state || '.' end));
    end if;
  end loop;
  if jsonb_array_length(v_comp) > 0 then
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'blocker','component_scope_restriction','severity','informational','restrictions', v_comp,
      'detail','Parts of an active trade are out of scope. The trade still dispatches; the RFQ must carry the restriction.'));
  end if;
  for r in select trade_key, evidence_score, score_basis, evidence_source
             from public.inquiry_trade_candidate
            where group_id = p_group_id and status = 'proposed' loop
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'blocker','trade_awaiting_confirmation','severity','informational','trade_key', r.trade_key,
      'evidence_source', r.evidence_source, 'evidence_score', r.evidence_score,
      'score_basis', r.score_basis,
      'detail','Proposed but not confirmed. It contributes nothing to dispatch until a person confirms it.'));
  end loop;
  if exists (select 1 from public.inquiry_trade_clarification
              where group_id = p_group_id and answered_at is null) then
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'blocker','open_clarification','severity','blocking',
      'question', (select question_en from public.inquiry_trade_clarification
                    where group_id = p_group_id and answered_at is null limit 1),
      'detail','The customer has been asked to settle the scope.'));
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true, 'group_id', p_group_id,
    'overall_dispatch_eligible', (v_gd.overall_dispatch_eligible and v_n_active > 0
                                  and jsonb_array_length(v_conf) = 0),
    'active_included_trades', v_active, 'excluded_or_by_others_trades', v_out,
    'optional_or_future_trades', v_opt, 'unresolved_scope_conflicts', v_conf,
    'component_scope_restrictions', v_comp,
    'active_workstreams', v_gd.active_workstreams, 'shared_complete', v_gd.shared_complete,
    'group_gate_states', v_gd.gate_states, 'blocking_trades', to_jsonb(v_gd.blocking_trades),
    'blockers', v_blockers, 'blocker_count', jsonb_array_length(v_blockers));
end
fn_p2c1_holdout_checksum:
select encode(extensions.digest(string_agg(
           case_key || '|' || coalesce(text_en,'') || '|' || coalesce(text_ar,'') || '|'
           || array_to_string(expect_active,',') || '|' || expect_dispositions::text || '|'
           || expect_components::text || '|' || expect_clarify::text || '|' || expect_conflict::text,
           E'\n' order by case_key), 'sha256'), 'hex')
    from public.p2c1_holdout_case;
trg_scope_marker_norm: begin new.pattern_norm := public.fn_norm_text(new.pattern); return new; end
fn_scope_inverse: select case when p_disposition = 'included' then 'excluded' else 'included' end;
fn_term_position:
select coalesce(nullif(regexp_instr(p_text_norm,
    case when p_lang = 'ar'
      then '(^|[^[:alnum:]])(وال|بال|فال|كال|ال|لل|و|ف|ب|ك|ل)?'
           || replace(p_pattern_norm, ' ', '[[:space:]]+(ال)?')
           || '(ات|ين|ون|ها|هم|ه)?($|[^[:alnum:]])'
      else '(^|[^[:alnum:]])' || p_pattern_norm || '(es|s)?($|[^[:alnum:]])'
    end), 0), 0);
fn_p2c1_no_active_trade_blocker:
select jsonb_build_object(
    'blocker','no_active_trade','supersedes','no_active_workstream','severity','blocking',
    'excluded_or_by_others', p_out, 'optional_or_future', p_opt,
    'detail','Every detected trade is excluded, by others, optional, future-phase or unconfirmed. There is nothing in scope to dispatch.',
    'remedy','Confirm at least one trade as included, or answer the open clarification.');
trg_holdout_record_immutable:
begin
  raise exception 'holdout result of record is immutable: % is not permitted', tg_op
    using hint = 'The first measurement of a holdout happens once. Re-running it later is a regression run, not a new first result.';
end
fn_terms_integrity:
with s as (
    select 'supplier'::text kind,
           (select value from public.app_secrets where key='terms_version') dv,
           (select value from public.app_secrets where key='terms_sha256_supplier_version') pv,
           (select value from public.app_secrets where key='terms_sha256_supplier') psha,
           (select encode(sha256(convert_to(value,'UTF8')),'hex') from public.app_secrets where key='supplier_terms_html') lsha,
           (select encode(sha256(convert_to(html,'UTF8')),'hex') from public.pages where slug='legal_supplier_body') pubsha
    union all
    select 'customer',
           (select value from public.app_secrets where key='customer_terms_version'),
           (select value from public.app_secrets where key='terms_sha256_customer_version'),
           (select value from public.app_secrets where key='terms_sha256_customer'),
           (select encode(sha256(convert_to(html,'UTF8')),'hex') from public.pages where slug='legal_terms_body'),
           (select encode(sha256(convert_to(html,'UTF8')),'hex') from public.pages where slug='legal_terms_body')
  )
  select kind, dv, pv, psha, lsha,
         pubsha is not distinct from lsha,
         (psha is not distinct from lsha) and (dv is not distinct from pv) and (pubsha is not distinct from lsha)
  from s;
fn_inquiry_dispatch_eligible:
with ws as (
    select d.workstream_id, d.trade_key, d.dispatch_eligible, d.mandatory_complete,
           d.no_unresolved_conflict, d.gates_passed, d.missing_mandatory, d.blocked_by
    from public.inquiry_workstream_group g
    join public.inquiry_workstream w on w.group_id = g.id
    join public.v_workstream_dispatch d on d.workstream_id = w.id
    where g.inquiry_id = p_inquiry_id and w.active
  )
  select case
    when (select count(*) from ws) = 0
      then jsonb_build_object('eligible', true, 'reason', 'no_workstreams', 'workstreams', 0)
    when (select bool_and(dispatch_eligible) from ws)
      then jsonb_build_object('eligible', true, 'reason', 'all_workstreams_eligible',
                              'workstreams', (select count(*) from ws))
    else jsonb_build_object(
      'eligible', false,
      'reason', 'workstream_not_dispatch_eligible',
      'workstreams', (select count(*) from ws),
      'blocking', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'workstream_id', workstream_id, 'trade', trade_key,
          'mandatory_complete', mandatory_complete,
          'no_unresolved_conflict', no_unresolved_conflict,
          'gates_passed', gates_passed,
          'missing_mandatory', to_jsonb(missing_mandatory),
          'blocked_by', to_jsonb(blocked_by)))
        from ws where not dispatch_eligible))
  end;
trg_supplier_brief_immutable: begin raise exception 'inquiry_supplier_brief is append-only: freeze a new version instead of editing version %', OLD.version; end
fn_jsonb_text_array:
select case when j is null or jsonb_typeof(j) <> 'array' then null
              else (select array_agg(x) from jsonb_array_elements_text(j) x) end;
fn_phase1_rollback_log_immutable:
begin
  raise exception 'phase1_rollback_log is append-only; % is not permitted', TG_OP
    using errcode = '42501';
end
fn_phase1_disarmed:
select coalesce((
    select tier = 'disarm' from public.phase1_rollback_log
     where tier in ('disarm','rearm') order by id desc limit 1
  ), false)
fn_phase1_status:
select jsonb_build_object(
    'disarmed', public.fn_phase1_disarmed(),
    'last_rollback_action', (select to_jsonb(l) from public.phase1_rollback_log l order by id desc limit 1),
    'objects', jsonb_build_object(
      'tables',    (select count(*) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
                     where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind='r'
                       and (c.relname like 'control_mode%' or c.relname like 'refund%' or c.relname='phase1_rollback_log')),
      'views',     (select count(*) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
                     where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind='v'
                       and (c.relname like 'v_refund%' or c.relname like 'v_supplier_exception%')),
      'functions', (select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
                     where n.nspname='public'
                       and (p.proname like 'fn_control_mode%' or p.proname like 'fn_refund%'
                            or p.proname like 'fn_supplier_exception%' or p.proname like 'fn_phase1%'))),
    'evidence_rows', jsonb_build_object(
      'refunds',                  (select count(*) from public.refunds),
      'refund_event_quarantine',  (select count(*) from public.refund_event_quarantine),
      'control_mode_audit',       (select count(*) from public.control_mode_audit),
      'control_mode_action',      (select count(*) from public.control_mode_action),
      'gated_actions',            (select count(*) from public.control_mode_action where classification='mutating')),
    'crons', (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(jobname, jsonb_build_object('schedule', schedule, 'active', active)), '{}'::jsonb)
                from cron.job where jobname in ('control_mode_sweep_5min','supplier_exception_sweep_daily')))
fn_authority_rank:
-- How much UNSUPERVISED power the tier confers. advisory advises only; gated needs approval
  -- before acting; supervised acts and is reviewed after; autonomous acts unreviewed.
  select case p when 'advisory' then 0 when 'gated' then 1 when 'supervised' then 2
                when 'autonomous' then 3 else 3 end;   -- unknown tier ranks highest: fail closed
fn_supplier_licence_gate:
-- Mirrors what license_extract writes and, deliberately, what it refuses to write: expiry is left
  -- NULL when the document printed none, because license_extract never guesses. Treating NULL as a
  -- failure would reject perfectly good licences for the crime of an unusual layout, so NULL passes
  -- and the missing-document and missing-number cases carry the weight.
  select case
    when coalesce(p_license_doc_path, '') = '' then
      jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'reason', 'No trade licence document on file.')
    when coalesce(p_trade_license_no, '') = '' then
      jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'reason', 'A trade licence is on file but no licence number could be read from it. Please upload a clearer copy.')
    when p_license_expiry is not null and p_license_expiry < current_date then
      jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'reason', 'The trade licence on file expired on ' || to_char(p_license_expiry, 'DD Mon YYYY') || '.')
    else jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'reason', null)
  end;
fn_matching_strike_limit: select coalesce((select value::text::int from public.decision_policy where key='matching_strike_limit'), 3);
fn_is_matchable:
select coalesce(p_verified, false)                                        -- the rule: verified
     and coalesce(p_banned, false) = false
     and coalesce(p_matching_blocked, false) = false                        -- carries expired documents,
                                                                            -- reconciled daily by
                                                                            -- fn_reconcile_doc_blocks(0)
     and coalesce(p_permanently_closed, false) = false                      -- never RFQ a closed business
     and coalesce(p_approval_status, '') not in ('action_required','rejected')
     and coalesce(p_chat_strikes, 0) < public.fn_matching_strike_limit();   -- the no-response exception
trg_quote_committed_hash:
declare v_text text;
begin
  -- 5 Aug 2026. fn_fraud_scan's `copied_quote` rule groups quotes by committed_hash having more
  -- than one distinct supplier — a control for the same quotation being filed by two suppliers.
  -- It could NEVER fire: the only writer of committed_hash was quote_review_api, deleted in
  -- d79b28e (22 Jul 2026) as proven-dead, and nothing replaced it. The rule has been reading a
  -- column nothing populates ever since.
  --
  -- Hash the WORDS THE SUPPLIER WROTE, deliberately NOT quote_amount: identical amounts on one
  -- RFQ are already caught by the identical_bids rule immediately above it in fn_fraud_scan, and
  -- folding the amount in here would make copied_quote a noisy duplicate of that rule rather than
  -- an independent signal. Two suppliers filing the same PROSE is the thing worth flagging.
  v_text := btrim(lower(regexp_replace(
    coalesce(new.scope,'') || ' ' || coalesce(new.notes,'') || ' ' ||
    coalesce(new.payment_terms,'') || ' ' || coalesce(new.warranty,'') || ' ' ||
    coalesce(new.committed_items::text,''),
    '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g')));
  -- A floor, so thin and boilerplate quotes cannot collide. "supply and install as specified"
  -- legitimately repeats across honest suppliers; a real copied quotation carries far more text.
  -- Below the floor the column stays NULL and fn_fraud_scan skips it (it filters coalesce<>'').
  if length(v_text) >= 40 then
    new.committed_hash := encode(extensions.digest(v_text, 'sha256'), 'hex');
  else
    new.committed_hash := null;
  end if;
  return new;
end
fn_category_knowledge:
-- THE KNOWLEDGE WAS COMPLETE AND UNREACHABLE.
  -- All 84 spec categories carry their 8 modules under agent_key 'cat:<catalogue-slug>', but the
  -- live intake assigns one of 56 LEGACY slugs whose overlap with the catalogue is exactly zero.
  -- lead_trade_map is the bridge; this is the first thing that walks it at read time.
  -- Accepts either vocabulary so callers do not need to know which one they hold.
  with resolved as (
    select coalesce(
      (select c.slug from public.catalog_supplier_categories c where c.slug = p_category),
      (select m.catalog_slug from public.lead_trade_map m
         join public.catalog_supplier_categories c2 on c2.slug = m.catalog_slug
        where m.trade_key = p_category)
    ) as slug
  )
  select r.slug, k.topic, k.content, k.priority, k.layer
    from resolved r
    join public.agent_knowledge k on k.agent_key = 'cat:' || r.slug
   where r.slug is not null
   order by k.priority desc nulls last, k.topic;
fn_intake_slug_for_catalog:
-- The reverse of fn_category_knowledge: catalogue slug -> the legacy intake slug that owns the
  -- checklist. It is 1-to-many (flooring-suppliers is reached by carpets, epoxy-flooring, flooring,
  -- marble-granite and tiling), so the choice has to be deterministic or the same customer wording
  -- would land on a different checklist run to run.
  --
  -- Prefer a key the catalogue slug actually BEGINS with - 'flooring' for flooring-suppliers,
  -- 'aluminium' for aluminium-and-glass-suppliers, 'mep' for mep-suppliers-electromechanical.
  -- That picks the base trade over a facet of it. Where none prefixes, the shortest wins, which
  -- also prefers the base ('carpentry' over 'carpentry-joinery', 'fitout' over
  -- 'commercial-retail-fitout'). Only keys that exist in category_specs are eligible, because the
  -- answer has to be something the checklist lookup can actually use.
  select m.trade_key
    from public.lead_trade_map m
    join (select distinct category from public.category_specs) cs on cs.category = m.trade_key
   where m.catalog_slug = p_catalog_slug
   order by (p_catalog_slug like m.trade_key || '%') desc, length(m.trade_key) asc, m.trade_key asc
   limit 1;
fn_category_questions:
-- THE SPEC'S "INQUIRY QUALIFICATION LOGIC", REACHABLE FOR THE FIRST TIME.
  -- 16,588 questions (4,117 distinct texts, 7,079 mandatory, 14,051 bilingual) live in kb_stage
  -- keyed by FAMILY slug. The intake speaks a legacy slug. The chain is
  --   intake slug -> lead_trade_map -> catalogue slug -> catalog_category_domain -> family
  -- and this walks all of it, accepting either vocabulary at the front.
  --
  -- field_key is NULL on every row; the real supplier-facing key and the ask-order live inside
  -- `activation`. Sorting by that order is the point - it is what makes this an ordered interview
  -- rather than the flat, unordered list category_specs.fields produces.
  --
  -- Deduplicated on question text: a family spans up to 465 subcategories which repeat the generic
  -- spine (emirate, exact need, scope, quantity, date), so without DISTINCT ON the first 20 rows
  -- would be the same question twenty times.
  with fam as (
    select d.domain_slug
      from public.catalog_category_domain d
     where d.catalog_slug = coalesce(
       (select c.slug from public.catalog_supplier_categories c where c.slug = p_category),
       (select m.catalog_slug from public.lead_trade_map m where m.trade_key = p_category))
  )
  select * from (
    select distinct on (q.question_en)
           coalesce(q.activation->>'supplier_facing_field', q.field_key) as field_key,
           case when p_lang = 'ar' and coalesce(q.question_ar,'') <> '' then q.question_ar else q.question_en end as question,
           q.answer_type,
           q.mandatory,
           coalesce((q.activation->>'order')::int, 999) as ask_order
      from kb_stage.questions q
      join fam on fam.domain_slug = q.category_slug
     where coalesce(q.question_en,'') <> ''
     order by q.question_en, q.mandatory desc
  ) x
  order by x.mandatory desc, x.ask_order, x.field_key
  limit greatest(p_limit, 1);
fn_ops_knowledge_search:
declare q_or tsquery; words text[];
begin
  words := array(select w from unnest(regexp_split_to_array(lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_query,''),'[^a-z0-9 ]',' ','g')),'\s+')) w where length(w)>2);
  if array_length(words,1) is null then return; end if;
  begin q_or := to_tsquery('english', array_to_string(words,' | ')); exception when others then return; end;
  return query
    select o.record_id, o.title, o.content, o.record_type, o.authority_tier,
           o.implementation_status, ts_rank(o.tsv, q_or) as rank
      from ops_knowledge o
     where (p_dept is null
            or o.dept_key = p_dept
            -- company principles and the UAE source registry apply to every department, and a
            -- cross-department workflow that names no single owner belongs to all of them by
            -- definition. Without these three branches 884 of 3,959 records were reachable by
            -- nothing at all — the same defect as the corpus itself, one level down.
            or o.scope_type in ('company','external_source')
            or (o.scope_type = 'workflow' and o.dept_key is null))
       and o.tsv @@ q_or
     order by ts_rank(o.tsv, q_or) desc, o.record_id
     limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit,5),20));
end
fn_customer_preference_learn:
declare
  v_consent timestamptz;
  v_existing jsonb;
  v_inferred jsonb;
begin
  if p_customer_id is null then return 0; end if;

  -- CONSENT IS THE GATE, and it reuses the consent the customer already gave. No new column, no
  -- new UI, no second consent vocabulary.
  --
  -- WITHDRAWAL DELETES. The fixture caught this: clearing customer_preference.consented_at is not
  -- withdrawing consent, because consent lives on customers.tos_accepted_at and the next inquiry
  -- simply re-learned and restored the copy. So the absence of consent actively REMOVES the
  -- profile rather than merely declining to refresh it — row absent is indistinguishable from
  -- never consented, which is the property the readers rely on.
  select c.tos_accepted_at into v_consent from customers c where c.id = p_customer_id;
  if v_consent is null then
    delete from customer_preference where customer_id = p_customer_id;
    return 0;
  end if;

  select p.preferences into v_existing from customer_preference p where p.customer_id = p_customer_id;

  -- The same aggregates fn_ws_customer_360 computes live today, persisted instead of recomputed.
  select jsonb_build_object(
           'categories', coalesce(jsonb_agg(distinct i.category) filter (where i.category is not null), '[]'::jsonb),
           'emirates',   coalesce(jsonb_agg(distinct i.emirate)  filter (where i.emirate  is not null), '[]'::jsonb),
           'scope_type', mode() within group (order by i.scope_type),
           'budget_aed_avg', round(avg(nullif(i.expected_value, 0))::numeric, 2),
           'rfqs_seen', count(*))
    into v_inferred
    from inquiries i where i.customer_id = p_customer_id;

  insert into customer_preference (customer_id, preferences, consented_at, updated_at)
  values (p_customer_id,
          jsonb_build_object(
            -- stated is merged, never replaced: an inference must not clear a typed choice.
            'stated',   coalesce(v_existing->'stated', '{}'::jsonb) || coalesce(p_stated, '{}'::jsonb),
            'inferred', coalesce(v_inferred, '{}'::jsonb),
            'source',   'fn_customer_preference_learn'),
          v_consent, now())
  on conflict (customer_id) do update
    set preferences = excluded.preferences,
        consented_at = excluded.consented_at,
        updated_at   = now();
  return 1;
end
fn_emit:
declare v_id bigint;
begin
  -- correlation_id and causation_id are deliberately NOT named here. They carry the column
  -- defaults, which read app.correlation_id / app.causation_event_id — so an event emitted inside
  -- fn_event_dispatch's loop joins the chain it came from, and one emitted from a cron starts its
  -- own. Naming them here would override that and silently break the chain.
  insert into company_event (event_type, entity_type, entity_id, actor, payload)
  values (p_event_type, p_entity_type, p_entity_id, coalesce(p_actor,'system'), coalesce(p_payload,'{}'::jsonb))
  returning id into v_id;
  return v_id;
end
fn_os_health_brief:
declare r record; v_period text; v_n int := 0; v_pool int := 0;
begin
  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 1. ONE CAPACITY ROW PER ACTIVE OS, in the one unit every OS has: its own people's
  -- attention. The seed carried a single company-wide row (550 open tasks, keyed to
  -- leadership), which is why six operating systems reported no capacity at all. Both sides
  -- are measured live — org_agents.max_open_tasks is the declared ceiling, org_tasks the
  -- load — so this figure moves on its own and is falsifiable by looking at the org.
  delete from resource_pool where source_ref = 'org_agents.max_open_tasks';

  insert into resource_pool (resource, kind, owner_dept, unit, capacity, committed,
                             window_label, degrade_at_pct, halt_at_pct, source_ref, note, os_key)
  select 'Employee attention - ' || o.name, 'capacity',
         (select min(od.dept_key) from os_department od where od.os_key = o.os_key),
         'open tasks',
         coalesce((select sum(a.max_open_tasks) from os_department od
                     join org_agents a on a.department = od.dept_key and a.active
                    where od.os_key = o.os_key), 0),
         coalesce((select count(*) from os_department od
                     join org_tasks t on t.dept_key = od.dept_key and t.status <> 'done'
                    where od.os_key = o.os_key), 0),
         'rolling', 80, 100, 'org_agents.max_open_tasks',
         'Open tasks in this OS''s departments against the sum of max_open_tasks for its '
         || 'active staff. Refreshed weekly by fn_os_health_brief.', o.os_key
    from operating_system o where o.active;
  get diagnostics v_pool = row_count;

  -- 2. EVERY OTHER POOLED RESOURCE GETS A MEASURED NUMERATOR TOO. Each expression is the
  -- system of record for that resource; a resource whose consumption nothing records would
  -- otherwise sit at zero for ever and drag the OS's ratio down with it, which is the same
  -- "populated but never measured" defect one level down.
  update resource_pool rp set committed = m.v, updated_at = now()
    from (values
      ('AI token budget - company',
        (select coalesce(sum(cost_aed), 0)::numeric from ai_cost_log
          where occurred_at >= date_trunc('month', now()))),
      ('Supplier invites',
        (select coalesce(sum(sent), 0)::numeric from invite_schedule where day = current_date)),
      ('Outbound email',
        (select count(*)::numeric from notifications
          where coalesce(channel, 'email') = 'email' and created_at > now() - interval '1 day')),
      ('WhatsApp / SMS',
        (select count(*)::numeric from wa_messages where created_at > now() - interval '1 day')
      + (select count(*)::numeric from notifications
          where channel in ('sms', 'whatsapp') and created_at > now() - interval '1 day')),
      -- A FLOOR, NOT A TOTAL: this counts the scheduled invocations, which is every edge call
      -- the database itself can see. Browser and webhook traffic is not in cron.job_run_details.
      ('Edge function invocations',
        (select count(*)::numeric from cron.job_run_details d
           join cron.job j on j.jobid = d.jobid
          where j.command ~* 'net\.http_post' and d.start_time >= date_trunc('month', now()))),
      ('Database storage',
        round(pg_database_size(current_database()) / 1073741824.0, 2)::numeric),
      ('Document storage',
        (select round(coalesce(sum((o.metadata->>'size')::bigint), 0) / 1073741824.0, 2)::numeric
           from storage.objects o)),
      ('Scraping / enrichment',
        (select coalesce(sum(fetched), 0)::numeric from scrape_runs
          where created_at >= date_trunc('month', now()))),
      ('Payment processing',
        (select count(*)::numeric from transactions where revealed_at > now() - interval '1 day'))
    ) as m(resource, v)
   where rp.resource = m.resource;

  -- 3. The report is computed FROM those inputs, so recompute it now that they are current.
  -- Without this the week's capacity_pct would be derived from last Monday's numerator.
  perform fn_os_review();

  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  select max(period) into v_period from os_review;
  if v_period is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('written', 0, 'reason', 'os_review is empty');
  end if;

  -- Only active OSes with an ACTIVE owner: a brief addressed to a departed employee is another
  -- write with no reader, which is the defect this function exists to close.
  for r in
    select o.os_key, o.name, o.owner_agent, rv.health, rv.metrics
      from operating_system o
      join os_review rv  on rv.os_key = o.os_key and rv.period = v_period
      join org_agents  a on a.agent_key = o.owner_agent and a.active
     where o.active
     order by o.num
  loop
    -- Scoped to this function's own rows by source, so it can never touch a memory it did not
    -- write. This is what makes the weekly run idempotent instead of cumulative.
    delete from agent_memory
     where agent_key = r.owner_agent and source = 'fn_os_health_brief';

    -- ->> everywhere, never ->. text || jsonb resolves to jsonb || jsonb and silently builds an
    -- array instead of a sentence; that has already cost this project two call-time failures.
    insert into agent_memory (agent_key, kind, content, source, importance, horizon)
    values (r.owner_agent, 'os_health',
      'OS HEALTH, week ' || v_period || ' - ' || r.name || ' (' || r.os_key || '), which you own. '
      || 'HEALTH SCORE ' || coalesce(r.metrics->>'health_score', '?') || '/100 ('
        || coalesce(r.health, 'unrated') || '). '
      || 'RISK: open_risks ' || coalesce(r.metrics->>'open_risks', '0') || '. '
      || 'PERFORMANCE: kpi_gaps ' || coalesce(r.metrics->>'kpi_gaps', '0') || ' against '
        || coalesce(r.metrics->>'kpis', '0') || ' KPI(s). '
      || 'CAPACITY: capacity_pct ' || coalesce(r.metrics->>'capacity_pct', 'unmeasured') || '%. '
      || 'BACKLOG: ' || coalesce(r.metrics->>'open_tasks', '0') || ' open, stale_tasks '
        || coalesce(r.metrics->>'stale_tasks', '0') || ', backlog_per_head '
        || coalesce(r.metrics->>'backlog_per_head', '0') || '. '
      || 'QUALITY: review_pass_pct ' || coalesce(r.metrics->>'review_pass_pct', 'unmeasured') || '%. '
      || 'COST: budget_pct ' || coalesce(r.metrics->>'budget_pct', '0') || '% of the AI budget. '
      || 'AUTOMATION: needs_founder_pct ' || coalesce(r.metrics->>'needs_founder_pct', '0')
        || '% of open work still needs the founder. '
      || 'Act on the worst figure before it becomes a finding.',
      'fn_os_health_brief', 7, 'short');

    v_n := v_n + 1;
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object('period', v_period, 'written', v_n, 'capacity_rows', v_pool);
end
fn_promote_memory_sweep:
declare r record; n int := 0; n_err int := 0;
begin
  for r in
    select m.id, coalesce(g.department, 'general') as dept
      from agent_memory m
      left join org_agents g on g.agent_key = m.agent_key
     where coalesce(m.horizon, 'short') = 'short'
       and m.kind = 'learned'
       and m.created_at < now() - interval '7 days'
       and length(coalesce(m.content, '')) >= 120
       and not exists (select 1 from memory_promotions p where p.memory_id = m.id)
       and not exists (select 1 from kb_chunks c
                        where c.source_kind = 'memory' and c.source_id = m.id::text)
     order by m.created_at
     limit greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 0)
  loop
    begin
      perform fn_promote_memory(r.id, r.dept, 'memory_sweeper');
      update agent_memory set horizon = 'long' where id = r.id;
      n := n + 1;
    exception when others then
      -- One unpromotable row must not stop the sweep forever; it is counted, not swallowed.
      n_err := n_err + 1;
    end;
  end loop;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('memory_promotion', now(), now(), case when n_err > 0 then 'partial' else 'ok' end,
          jsonb_build_object('promoted', n, 'failed', n_err),
    'Memory promotion sweep: ' || n || ' short-term learned memory(ies) at least a week old promoted '
    || 'into the knowledge base and marked long-term, ' || n_err || ' could not be promoted.');
  return jsonb_build_object('promoted', n, 'failed', n_err);
end
fn_event_consolidate:
declare
  r record; v_outcome text; v_note text; v_backbone text; v_lesson bigint; v_sev text;
  n_closed int := 0; n_lessons int := 0; n_rollups int := 0; n_priorities int := 0;
  v_open_chains bigint := 0;
  -- Bounded like the dispatcher's batch, for the same reason: an unbounded first run on a backlog
  -- is how a burst happens.  The work is finite and the cron is hourly.
  c_max_close    constant int := 200;
  c_max_priority constant int := 25;
begin
  -- ── LINK 7 · the result comes back to the event that caused the work ────────────────────────
  -- A delivery whose task has closed but whose result column is still NULL is precisely the gap:
  -- the OS did the work and the event never heard.  org_tasks.result is the OS's own words; the
  -- status is the fallback when it closed without writing one.
  for r in
    select d.id as delivery_id, d.event_id, d.task_id, d.os_key,
           t.status, t.result, t.title, t.updated_at, e.correlation_id, e.event_type
      from event_delivery d
      join org_tasks t     on t.id = d.task_id
      join company_event e on e.id = d.event_id
     where d.closed_at is null and t.status in ('done','closed')
     order by d.id
     limit c_max_close
  loop
    update event_delivery
       -- ->> not nullif(...,''): org_tasks.result is jsonb and event_delivery.result is text.
       set result    = left(coalesce(nullif(r.result->>'summary',''),
                                     r.status || ': ' || coalesce(r.title,'')), 1000),
           closed_at = coalesce(r.updated_at, now())
     where id = r.delivery_id;
    n_closed := n_closed + 1;

    -- ── LINK 10 · Knowledge captures the lesson from an EVENT outcome ─────────────────────────
    -- Joined through event_delivery.task_id, which is what makes the lesson traceable to a
    -- dispatched event rather than to a task that arrived some other way.
    if not exists (select 1 from institutional_memory m
                    where m.subject_type = 'org_task' and m.subject_id = r.task_id::text) then
      v_lesson := public.fn_task_lesson(r.task_id, 'event_closed',
                    jsonb_build_object('event_type', r.event_type,
                                       'correlation_id', r.correlation_id::text,
                                       'os_key', r.os_key));
      if v_lesson is not null then n_lessons := n_lessons + 1; end if;
    end if;
  end loop;

  -- ── LINK 8 · the Chief of Staff consolidates ACROSS OSes ───────────────────────────────────
  -- One row per business episode, not per event: correlation_id is the episode.  os_count is the
  -- number of distinct Operating Systems the episode touched, which is the difference between a
  -- consolidation and a receipt.
  --
  -- LINK 4 IS READ HERE.  Each OS records an event_assessment — severity, impact, proposed action
  -- — before it raises a task, and until now nothing ever looked at one.  The episode's assessed
  -- severity travels with the consolidation into priority_note and into the priority.updated
  -- payload, so what the OSes said about impact reaches the person re-prioritising on it.
  for r in
    select e.correlation_id,
           min(e.id)                                        as root_event_id,
           (array_agg(e.event_type order by e.id))[1]       as root_type,
           count(distinct d.os_key)                         as os_count,
           count(d.task_id)                                 as tasks_total,
           count(*) filter (where d.closed_at is not null)   as tasks_closed,
           (select count(*) from event_assessment a
              join company_event ae on ae.id = a.event_id
             where ae.correlation_id = e.correlation_id)     as assessed,
           (select max(case a.severity when 'high' then 3 when 'medium' then 2 else 1 end)
              from event_assessment a
              join company_event ae on ae.id = a.event_id
             where ae.correlation_id = e.correlation_id)     as sev_rank
      from company_event e
      join event_delivery d on d.event_id = e.id
     where e.correlation_id is not null
     group by e.correlation_id
  loop
    -- Defence 2: never consolidate a chain a re-prioritisation started.
    if r.root_type = 'priority.updated' then continue; end if;

    v_outcome := case when r.tasks_total = 0                  then 'no_work'
                      when r.tasks_closed = 0                 then 'open'
                      when r.tasks_closed < r.tasks_total     then 'partial'
                      else 'closed' end;
    v_sev := case r.sev_rank when 3 then 'high' when 2 then 'medium' when 1 then 'low'
                             else 'unassessed' end;
    v_note := format('%s across %s OS: %s of %s task(s) closed. Impact: %s assessment(s), highest severity %s.',
                     r.root_type, r.os_count, r.tasks_closed, r.tasks_total,
                     coalesce(r.assessed,0), v_sev);

    insert into event_rollup (correlation_id, root_event_id, event_type, os_count,
                              tasks_total, tasks_closed, outcome, priority_note, consolidated_at)
    values (r.correlation_id, r.root_event_id, r.root_type, r.os_count,
            r.tasks_total, r.tasks_closed, v_outcome, v_note, now())
    on conflict (correlation_id) do update
      set os_count = excluded.os_count, tasks_total = excluded.tasks_total,
          tasks_closed = excluded.tasks_closed, outcome = excluded.outcome,
          priority_note = excluded.priority_note, consolidated_at = excluded.consolidated_at;
    n_rollups := n_rollups + 1;

    -- ── LINK 9 · the CEO re-prioritises off the consolidated outcome ──────────────────────────
    -- The episode must have crossed an OS boundary — a single-OS chain is that OS's own business
    -- and does not move company priorities — and at least one OS must have RETURNED something,
    -- because a priority cannot be revised against an outcome that does not exist yet.
    --   Deliberately not 'closed' only. Measured on production: all 22 cross-OS episodes sit at
    --   0/4 or 1/4 tasks closed, and one task that never closes would hold the whole episode — and
    --   the company's priorities — hostage forever. Link 9 says "off event OUTCOMES", not "off all
    --   of them". One re-prioritisation per episode either way: the dedupe is on correlation_id.
    if v_outcome in ('closed','partial') and r.os_count > 1 and n_priorities < c_max_priority
       and not exists (select 1 from company_event ce
                        where ce.event_type = 'priority.updated'
                          and ce.correlation_id = r.correlation_id) then
      -- xos-14. This event is CAUSED by the root of the chain and belongs to the same chain. The
      -- settings are read by company_event's column defaults, which is why fn_emit does not name
      -- either column.  Defence 1 lives here: same correlation_id => the `not exists` above is
      -- permanently true for this episode from the next run onward.
      perform set_config('app.correlation_id',      r.correlation_id::text, true);
      perform set_config('app.causation_event_id',  r.root_event_id::text,  true);
      perform public.fn_emit('priority.updated', 'event_chain', r.correlation_id::text, 'ceo',
                jsonb_build_object('root_event_id', r.root_event_id, 'root_type', r.root_type,
                                   'os_count', r.os_count, 'tasks_closed', r.tasks_closed,
                                   'assessments', coalesce(r.assessed,0), 'max_severity', v_sev,
                                   'note', v_note));
      perform set_config('app.correlation_id',     '', true);
      perform set_config('app.causation_event_id', '', true);
      n_priorities := n_priorities + 1;
    end if;
  end loop;

  -- The Knowledge OS's declared output. One per run rather than one per lesson: the bus carries
  -- the fact that institutional memory moved, not 58 copies of it.
  if n_lessons > 0 then
    perform public.fn_emit('knowledge.updated', 'institutional_memory', 'event_lessons',
              'knowledge_director', jsonb_build_object('lessons_added', n_lessons));
  end if;

  -- ── xos-15 · somebody looks at the bus ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  -- v_event_backbone is the one surface that says which subscribed event types are live, which
  -- have never fired and which are undelivered.  It had zero readers, which made it a diagram.
  -- chains_open is the consolidation backlog the view now carries: episodes that reached an OS
  -- and have not finished.  Reported here so the number lands in agent_runs rather than only in
  -- the view definition.
  select coalesce(string_agg(event_type || ' ' || state, ', ' order by event_type),
                  'every subscribed event type is LIVE')
    into v_backbone
    from v_event_backbone where state <> 'LIVE';

  select coalesce(sum(chains_open), 0) into v_open_chains from v_event_backbone;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('event_consolidate', now(), now(), 'ok',
          jsonb_build_object('deliveries_closed', n_closed, 'lessons', n_lessons,
                             'rollups', n_rollups, 'priorities_emitted', n_priorities,
                             'chains_open', v_open_chains),
          'Cross-OS contract closed: ' || n_closed || ' delivery result(s) returned, ' || n_lessons
          || ' lesson(s) captured, ' || n_rollups || ' chain(s) consolidated, ' || n_priorities
          || ' re-prioritisation(s) emitted, ' || v_open_chains || ' episode(s) still open. '
          || 'Bus backbone: ' || v_backbone);

  return jsonb_build_object('deliveries_closed', n_closed, 'lessons', n_lessons,
                            'rollups', n_rollups, 'priorities_emitted', n_priorities,
                            'chains_open', v_open_chains, 'bus_backbone', v_backbone);
end
fn_os_knowledge_query:
declare out text := ''; r record; v_line text; v_n int := 0;
begin
  if coalesce(p_os_key,'') = '' then return ''; end if;

  -- The routing table: every domain this OS is recorded as querying, and the OS that owns it.
  -- Restricted to domains that actually have an owner — a 'queries' row pointing at a domain
  -- nobody owns is a gap for fn_knowledge_gaps to report, not an address to send an employee to.
  for r in
    select k.domain_key,
           o.os_key   as owner_os,
           o2.name    as owner_name,
           o2.owner_agent
      from os_knowledge_domain k
      join os_knowledge_domain o
        on o.domain_key = k.domain_key and o.ownership = 'owns' and o.os_key <> k.os_key
      left join operating_system o2 on o2.os_key = o.os_key
     where k.os_key = p_os_key
       and k.ownership <> 'owns'
       and (p_topic is null or k.domain_key ilike '%'||p_topic||'%')
     order by o.os_key, k.domain_key
     limit 40
  loop
    -- operating_system.name already reads "Commercial OS"; only the raw key needs the suffix.
    out := out || '- ' || r.domain_key || ' -> ask ' || coalesce(r.owner_name, r.owner_os || ' OS')
               || coalesce(' (' || r.owner_agent || ')', '') || E'\n';
    v_n := v_n + 1;
  end loop;

  if v_n = 0 then return ''; end if;

  -- With a topic, also carry what the OWNER actually knows, so "query it" is an answer and not a
  -- forwarding address. Sourced from the owning OS's own employees' published knowledge.
  if p_topic is not null then
    select string_agg('  · ' || z.topic || ': ' || left(z.content, 240), E'\n')
      into v_line
      from (select distinct ak.topic, ak.content
              from os_knowledge_domain owns
              join os_department d on d.os_key = owns.os_key
              join org_agents a on a.department = d.dept_key and a.active
              join agent_knowledge ak on ak.agent_key = a.agent_key
             where owns.ownership = 'owns'
               and owns.domain_key ilike '%'||p_topic||'%'
               and coalesce(ak.layer,'profession') in ('profession','state')
               and (ak.topic ilike '%'||p_topic||'%' or ak.content ilike '%'||p_topic||'%')
             limit 4) z;
    if v_line is not null then
      out := out || 'What the owning OS publishes on "' || p_topic || '":' || E'\n' || v_line || E'\n';
    end if;
  end if;

  return out;
end
fn_execution_sweep:
declare v_exec integer := 0; v_trace integer := 0; v_queue jsonb;
begin
  with seen as (
    select a.id,
           case
             when d.id is null                                        then 'cancelled'
             when d.status = 'executed'                               then 'succeeded'
             when d.gate_verdict = 'refused'
               or d.status not in ('approved','executed')             then 'cancelled'
             when a.created_at < now() - make_interval(mins => greatest(coalesce(p_stall_minutes,60), 1))
                                                                      then 'stalled'
             else a.status
           end as new_status,
           d.id as dr_id, d.status as dr_status, d.gate_verdict as dr_verdict
      from public.action_execution a
      left join public.decision_record d on d.id::text = a.request ->> 'decision_record_id'
     where a.status = 'queued')
  update public.action_execution a
     set status      = s.new_status,
         attempts    = coalesce(a.attempts, 0) + 1,
         started_at  = coalesce(a.started_at, now()),
         finished_at = case when s.new_status in ('succeeded','cancelled') then now() else a.finished_at end,
         response    = coalesce(a.response, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
                         'swept_at', now(), 'observed', s.new_status,
                         'decision_record_id', s.dr_id,
                         'decision_status', s.dr_status, 'gate_verdict', s.dr_verdict)
    from seen s
   where s.id = a.id and s.new_status <> 'queued';
  get diagnostics v_exec = row_count;

  update public.decision_trace t
     set outcome_status = a.status,
         outcome        = jsonb_build_object('execution_id', a.id, 'status', a.status,
                            'action_class', a.action_class, 'attempts', a.attempts,
                            'finished_at', a.finished_at),
         evaluated_at   = now()
    from public.action_execution a
   where a.correlation_id = t.correlation_id
     and t.entity_type = 'decision_record'
     and coalesce(t.outcome_status,'') is distinct from a.status;
  get diagnostics v_trace = row_count;

  select jsonb_object_agg(status, n) into v_queue
    from (select status, count(*) n from public.action_execution group by 1) z;

  return jsonb_build_object('executions_settled', v_exec, 'traces_updated', v_trace,
                            'queue', coalesce(v_queue, '{}'::jsonb), 'swept_at', now());
end
fn_execution_run:
declare r record; v_agent text; v_aa bigint; v_queue jsonb;
        v_done integer := 0; v_failed integer := 0; v_cancelled integer := 0;
begin
  for r in
    select a.id, a.correlation_id, a.action_class, a.risk_tier, a.request,
           d.id as dr_id, d.status as dr_status, d.gate_verdict as dr_verdict,
           d.recommendation, d.problem, d.decided_by
      from public.action_execution a
      left join public.decision_record d on d.id::text = a.request ->> 'decision_record_id'
     where a.status in ('queued','stalled')
     order by a.created_at
     limit greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 25), 1)
  loop
    -- NOT EXECUTABLE. The gate refused it, or it never reached the gate, or the decision is gone.
    if r.dr_id is null or coalesce(r.dr_verdict,'') <> 'passed'
       or coalesce(r.dr_status,'') not in ('approved','executed') then
      update public.action_execution
         set status      = 'cancelled',
             attempts    = coalesce(attempts,0) + 1,
             started_at  = coalesce(started_at, now()),
             finished_at = now(),
             response    = coalesce(response,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
                             'ran_at', now(), 'outcome', 'cancelled',
                             'reason', case when r.dr_id is null
                                            then 'the decision this action came from no longer exists'
                                            else format('decision_record %s is %s and the gate said %s — not executable',
                                                        r.dr_id, coalesce(r.dr_status,'?'),
                                                        coalesce(r.dr_verdict,'nothing')) end)
       where id = r.id;
      v_cancelled := v_cancelled + 1;
      continue;
    end if;

    -- WHO THE DECISION NAMED. route_to is the party the engine chose, and it is a real identity in
    -- two different registers: an employee (org_agents) or a category desk (agent_knowledge, where
    -- 'cat:signage' carries 8 rows of its own knowledge). Failing that, the decider carries it.
    v_agent := coalesce(
      (select o.agent_key from public.org_agents o
        where o.agent_key = nullif(btrim(r.request ->> 'route_to'),'') and o.active limit 1),
      (select k.agent_key from public.agent_knowledge k
        where k.agent_key = nullif(btrim(r.request ->> 'route_to'),'') limit 1),
      (select o2.agent_key from public.org_agents o2
        where o2.agent_key = nullif(btrim(r.decided_by),'') and o2.active limit 1));

    if v_agent is null then
      update public.action_execution
         set status      = 'failed',
             attempts    = coalesce(attempts,0) + 1,
             started_at  = coalesce(started_at, now()),
             finished_at = now(),
             response    = coalesce(response,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
                             'ran_at', now(), 'outcome', 'failed',
                             'reason', format('route_to %L resolves to no active employee and no category desk, and decider %L is not an active employee either',
                                              r.request ->> 'route_to', r.decided_by))
       where id = r.id;
      v_failed := v_failed + 1;
      continue;
    end if;

    -- PERFORM IT: the decision is handed to the actor it named.
    insert into public.agent_actions(agent, kind, title, recommendation, detail, risk, status, decided_by)
    values (v_agent, r.action_class,
            left(coalesce(nullif(btrim(r.problem),''), 'decision_record ' || r.dr_id::text), 180),
            coalesce(nullif(btrim(r.recommendation),''), 'carry out the decision on record'),
            jsonb_build_object('decision_record_id', r.dr_id, 'correlation_id', r.correlation_id,
                               'execution_id', r.id, 'route_to', r.request ->> 'route_to',
                               'source', 'fn_execution_run'),
            coalesce(r.risk_tier, 'low'), 'pending', r.decided_by)
    returning id into v_aa;

    -- A BEFORE trigger on agent_actions may swallow the row (dedupe_it_incident returns NULL for a
    -- duplicate open incident). No artefact means nothing was delivered, so it is not a success.
    if v_aa is null then
      update public.action_execution
         set status      = 'failed',
             attempts    = coalesce(attempts,0) + 1,
             started_at  = coalesce(started_at, now()),
             finished_at = now(),
             response    = coalesce(response,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
                             'ran_at', now(), 'outcome', 'failed',
                             'reason', format('delivery to %L was refused by a trigger on agent_actions', v_agent))
       where id = r.id;
      v_failed := v_failed + 1;
      continue;
    end if;

    update public.action_execution
       set status      = 'succeeded',
           attempts    = coalesce(attempts,0) + 1,
           started_at  = coalesce(started_at, now()),
           finished_at = now(),
           response    = coalesce(response,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
                           'ran_at', now(), 'outcome', 'succeeded',
                           'agent_action_id', v_aa, 'delivered_to', v_agent,
                           'decision_record_id', r.dr_id)
     where id = r.id;

    update public.decision_record
       set status = 'executed'
     where id = r.dr_id and status = 'approved';

    v_done := v_done + 1;
  end loop;

  select jsonb_object_agg(status, n) into v_queue
    from (select status, count(*) n from public.action_execution group by 1) z;

  return jsonb_build_object('executed', v_done, 'failed', v_failed, 'cancelled', v_cancelled,
                            'queue', coalesce(v_queue,'{}'::jsonb), 'ran_at', now());
end
fn_decision_outcomes:
-- 'cancelled' is counted and reported but is NOT a failure: it means the decision was withdrawn
  -- or refused before it ran, which the authority gate has already ruled on and which says nothing
  -- about whether decisions OF THIS KIND work when they are carried out. Folding it in would make
  -- three gate refusals suppress a whole decision kind for ninety days, which is a punishment, not
  -- a measurement.
  select jsonb_build_object(
           'decision_type', p_kind,
           'window_days',   greatest(coalesce(p_days, 90), 1),
           'traced',        count(*),
           'graded',        count(*) filter (where t.outcome_status is not null),
           'succeeded',     count(*) filter (where t.outcome_status = 'succeeded'),
           'failed',        count(*) filter (where t.outcome_status in ('failed','stalled')),
           'cancelled',     count(*) filter (where t.outcome_status = 'cancelled'),
           'last_evaluated_at', max(t.evaluated_at))
    from public.decision_trace t
   where t.decision_type = p_kind
     and t.created_at > now() - make_interval(days => greatest(coalesce(p_days, 90), 1));
fn_learning_loop_sweep:
declare
  r record; n_rev int := 0; n_les int := 0; n_err int := 0; v_lid bigint;
begin
  -- LEG A. Bounded to the seven days the requirement is scored over: reviewing a deliverable from
  -- June tells nobody anything and would put a backlog onto the event bus in one burst.
  for r in
    select o.id
      from org_tasks o
     where o.status = 'done'
       and coalesce(o.result->>'deliverable','') <> ''
       and o.updated_at > now() - interval '7 days'
       and not exists (select 1 from review_chain c
                        where c.subject_type = 'org_task' and c.subject_id = o.id::text)
     order by o.updated_at
     limit greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 25), 0)
  loop
    begin
      perform fn_task_review(r.id);
      n_rev := n_rev + 1;
    exception when others then
      -- One unreviewable task must not stop the sweep; it is counted, not swallowed.
      n_err := n_err + 1;
    end;
  end loop;

  -- LEG B. Sees leg A's own inserts (same transaction), so a review written above whose inline
  -- lesson threw is retried here rather than lost.
  --
  -- The population is the rows fn_review_submit/fn_task_review write — stage published, cos_review
  -- or dept_review.  stage='approval' is deliberately NOT in it: those rows are fn_task_approve
  -- routing a task ONTO an approval path before it is worked (it sets status='assigned'), not a
  -- verdict on completed work, and demanding a lesson for a task nobody has done yet is a
  -- requirement no future work could satisfy.
  for r in
    select s.sid,
           case when exists (select 1 from review_chain p
                              where p.subject_type = 'org_task' and p.subject_id = s.sid
                                and p.stage = 'published' and p.decision = 'approve')
                then 'published'
                else coalesce((select d.decision from review_chain d
                                where d.subject_type = 'org_task' and d.subject_id = s.sid
                                  and d.stage in ('cos_review','dept_review') and d.decision is not null
                                order by d.created_at desc, d.id desc limit 1), 'hold') end as outcome,
           coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                              'by', ch.reviewer_agent, 'stance', ch.decision,
                              'reasoning', left(coalesce(ch.reason,''), 300)))
                       from review_chain ch
                      where ch.subject_type = 'org_task' and ch.subject_id = s.sid
                        and ch.stage = 'challenge'), '[]'::jsonb) as dissents,
           coalesce((select rr.reviewer_agent from review_chain rr
                      where rr.subject_type = 'org_task' and rr.subject_id = s.sid
                        and rr.stage in ('cos_review','dept_review') and rr.reviewer_agent is not null
                      order by rr.created_at desc, rr.id desc limit 1), 'the department head') as reviewer
      from (select distinct c.subject_id as sid
              from review_chain c
             where c.subject_type = 'org_task'
               and c.stage in ('published','cos_review','dept_review')
               and c.created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
               and exists (select 1 from org_tasks o where o.id::text = c.subject_id)
               and not exists (select 1 from institutional_memory m
                                where m.subject_type = 'org_task' and m.subject_id = c.subject_id
                                  and m.evidence_ref = 'review_chain:org_task:' || m.subject_id)
             limit greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 25), 0)) s
  loop
    begin
      v_lid := fn_task_lesson(r.sid::bigint, r.outcome,
                 jsonb_build_object('violations', '[]'::jsonb,
                                    'dissents',   r.dissents,
                                    'reviewer',   r.reviewer));
      if v_lid is not null then n_les := n_les + 1; end if;
    exception when others then
      n_err := n_err + 1;
    end;
  end loop;

  insert into agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('learning_loop_sweep', now(), now(), case when n_err > 0 then 'partial' else 'ok' end,
          jsonb_build_object('reviews_run', n_rev, 'lessons_written', n_les, 'failed', n_err),
    'Learning-loop backstop: ' || n_rev || ' completed deliverable(s) that no path had reviewed '
    || 'entered the review chain, ' || n_les || ' review(s) whose lesson never landed had it '
    || 'written from the reviewer''s own verdict, ' || n_err || ' could not be processed.');

  return jsonb_build_object('reviews_run', n_rev, 'lessons_written', n_les, 'failed', n_err);
end
fn_emit_task_assigned:
declare r record; n int := 0;
begin
  for r in
    select t.id, t.dept_key, t.title, t.action_class, t.tier, t.needs_founder, t.decided_by,
           t.created_at as assigned_at
      from org_tasks t
     where t.status = 'assigned'
       -- GATE 1: never re-announce what the dispatcher itself raised from an event.
       and coalesce(t.decided_by, '') <> 'fn_event_dispatch'
       and (p_lookback_minutes <= 0
            or t.created_at > now() - make_interval(mins => p_lookback_minutes))
       -- One announcement per task, forever. This is the idempotency key: re-running the catch-up,
       -- or a task updated again while still assigned, emits nothing further.
       and not exists (select 1 from company_event e
                        where e.event_type = 'task.assigned'
                          and e.entity_type = 'org_task' and e.entity_id = t.id::text)
     order by t.created_at                 -- chronological: announce assignments in the order made
     limit 50                              -- rate cap, in line with fn_event_dispatch's c_max_batch
  loop
    perform public.fn_emit('task.assigned', 'org_task', r.id::text,
              coalesce(r.decided_by, 'system'),
              jsonb_build_object(
                -- GATE 2: the dispatcher reads these two and attaches to the task instead of
                -- creating one. Do not rename them.
                'subject_type', 'org_task',
                'subject_id',   r.id::text,
                'task_id',      r.id,
                'dept_key',     r.dept_key,
                'title',        r.title,
                'action_class', r.action_class,
                'tier',         r.tier,
                'needs_founder', r.needs_founder,
                'assigned_by',  r.decided_by,
                'assigned_at',  r.assigned_at));
    n := n + 1;
  end loop;
  return n;
end
fn_route_party:
select coalesce(
    (select a.agent_key from public.org_agents a
      where a.active and a.agent_key = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_name, '')), '') limit 1),
    (select d.dept_key from public.org_departments d
      where d.dept_key = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_name, '')), '')
        and exists (select 1 from public.org_agents a2
                     where a2.department = d.dept_key and a2.active) limit 1));
fn_approval_policy_match:
select p.id
    from public.procurement_approval_policy p
   where p.organization_id = p_org
     and p.active
     and jsonb_typeof(p.steps) = 'array'
     and jsonb_array_length(p.steps) > 0
     and (p.conditions->>'entity_type' is null or p.conditions->>'entity_type' = p_entity_type)
     and coalesce(p_amount, 0) >= coalesce((p.conditions->>'min_amount')::numeric, 0)
     and (p.conditions->'categories' is null or p_category is null or p.conditions->'categories' ? p_category)
     and (p.conditions->'emirates'   is null or p_emirate  is null or p.conditions->'emirates'   ? p_emirate)
   order by coalesce((p.conditions->>'min_amount')::numeric, 0) desc, p.name

fn_approval_list:
with orgs as (
    select o.id, o.name from public.customer_organization o where o.owner_customer_id = p_customer
    union
    select o.id, o.name from public.customer_organization o
      join public.customer_organization_member m on m.organization_id = o.id
     where m.user_id = p_customer and coalesce(m.active, true)
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'organizations', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'name', name) order by name) from orgs), '[]'::jsonb),
    'policies', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', p.id, 'organization_id', p.organization_id, 'name', p.name,
          'active', p.active, 'conditions', p.conditions, 'steps', p.steps) order by p.name)
        from public.procurement_approval_policy p
       where p.organization_id in (select id from orgs)), '[]'::jsonb),
    'requests', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(x order by x->>'created_at' desc) from (
          select jsonb_build_object(
            'id', r.id, 'organization_id', r.organization_id,
            'entity_type', r.entity_type, 'entity_id', r.entity_id,
            'policy_id', r.policy_id, 'status', r.status,
            'current_step', r.current_step, 'created_at', r.created_at,
            'steps', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                        'step', t.step, 'key', t.step_key, 'label', t.step_label, 'role', t.step_role,
                        'status', t.step_status, 'decided_by', t.decided_by,
                        'decided_at', t.decided_at, 'note', t.decision_note) order by t.step)
                      from public.v_approval_trace t where t.request_id = r.id), '[]'::jsonb)) as x
            from public.procurement_approval_request r
           where r.organization_id in (select id from orgs)) y), '[]'::jsonb));
fn_customer_orders:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', o.id, 'po_no', o.po_no, 'status', o.status,
      'order_date', o.order_date, 'expected_date', o.expected_date,
      'currency', o.currency, 'subtotal', o.subtotal, 'memo', o.memo,
      'inquiry_id', o.inquiry_id, 'quote_id', o.quote_id, 'project_id', o.project_id,
      'approved_at', o.approved_at,
      'lines', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                  'line_no', l.line_no, 'description', l.description, 'qty', l.qty,
                  'unit_price', l.unit_price, 'qty_received', l.qty_received) order by l.line_no)
                from public.po_lines l where l.po_id = o.id), '[]'::jsonb))
      order by o.order_date desc, o.id desc), '[]'::jsonb)
    from public.po_orders o
   where o.customer_id = p_customer;
fn_customer_document_refs:
with me as (
    select c.id
      from public.customers c
     where lower(c.email) = lower(nullif(auth.email(), ''))
        or c.id = auth.uid()
     order by (lower(c.email) = lower(nullif(auth.email(), ''))) desc nulls last
     limit 1
  )
  -- the customer's own uploads
  select 'inquiries'::text, i.id::text, 'inquiry'::text, null::bigint, null::text, true
