    (select r.os_key from public.os_responsibility r, stripped where r.responsibility = stripped.s limit 1),
    (select o.os_key from public.operating_system o, a where o.os_key = a.k and o.active limit 1),
    (select o.os_key from public.operating_system o, stripped where o.os_key = stripped.s and o.active limit 1),
    -- the live department -> OS map, which this function never consulted
    (select d.os_key from public.os_department d
       join public.org_agents g on g.department = d.dept_key, a
      where g.agent_key = a.k limit 1),
    -- a category desk ('cat:signage') is owned by whichever OS owns category coverage
    (select r.os_key from public.os_responsibility r, a
      where a.k like 'cat:%' and r.responsibility = 'category_coverage' limit 1),
    -- last resort: a role name whose stem appears in a responsibility. Ordered by the shortest
    -- responsibility so the most specific owner wins rather than whichever row is read first.
    (select r.os_key from public.os_responsibility r, stripped
      where length(stripped.s) >= 4 and r.responsibility like '%' || stripped.s || '%'
      order by length(r.responsibility), r.responsibility limit 1)
  );
fn_ws_live_company:
select jsonb_build_object(

    -- ── THE PATH: milestone by milestone, with the steps inside each ─────────────────────────
    'goal_path', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'milestone', v.label, 'year_no', v.year_no, 'statement', v.statement,
        'steps', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                     'step', g.goal, 'metric', g.metric, 'target', g.target_value,
                     'unit', g.unit, 'owner_dept', g.owner_dept,
                     'actual', (select p.actual_value from public.goal_period p
                                 where p.goal_key = g.key order by p.updated_at desc limit 1))
                   order by g.sort nulls last), '[]'::jsonb)
                   from public.company_goals g
                  where g.active and coalesce(g.horizon, 'year_' || v.year_no::text) ~* ('year_?' || v.year_no::text)))
      order by v.year_no)
      from public.vision_horizon v where v.active), '[]'::jsonb),
    'roadmap_summary', (select count(*) from public.vision_horizon where active),

    -- ── THE HANDOFF CHAIN: work passing from department to department ────────────────────────
    'handoff_chain', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', c.id, 'subject_type', c.subject_type, 'subject_id', c.subject_id,
        'from_dept', c.dept_key, 'hop', c.stage, 'author_agent', c.author_agent,
        'to_dept', (select g.department from public.org_agents g where g.agent_key = c.reviewer_agent limit 1),
        'reviewer_agent', c.reviewer_agent, 'decision', c.decision,
        'reason', left(coalesce(c.reason, ''), 200), 'confidence', c.confidence,
        'delegated_from', c.delegated_from, 'at', c.created_at)
      order by c.created_at desc)
      from (select * from public.review_chain order by created_at desc limit 25) c), '[]'::jsonb),
    'handoffs_total', (select count(*) from public.review_chain),
    'handoff_stages', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('hop', s.stage, 'n', s.n) order by s.n desc)
      from (select stage, count(*) n from public.review_chain group by 1) s), '[]'::jsonb),

    -- Where an event actually landed, which is the other half of the same sequence.
    'event_delivery', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'event_type', e.event_type, 'to_dept', (select g.department from public.org_agents g where g.agent_key = e.agent_key limit 1),
        'agent_key', e.agent_key, 'os_key', e.os_key, 'delivered_at', e.delivered_at,
        'unroutable_reason', e.unroutable_reason) order by e.delivered_at desc)
      from (select * from public.event_delivery order by delivered_at desc limit 15) e), '[]'::jsonb),

    -- ── THE RISK REGISTER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    'risk_register', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', r.id, 'risk', r.risk, 'category', r.category, 'dept_key', r.dept_key,
        'probability', r.probability, 'impact', r.impact, 'owner_agent', r.owner_agent,
        'mitigation', left(coalesce(r.mitigation, ''), 240), 'status', r.status,
        'review_due', r.review_due)
      -- probability and impact are TEXT on this table, not numbers, so they cannot be multiplied
      -- into a score here. Ordered by review urgency instead, and both values travel to the screen.
      order by r.review_due nulls last, r.updated_at desc nulls last)
      from public.risk_register r where coalesce(r.status, '') <> 'closed'), '[]'::jsonb),

    -- ── INFRASTRUCTURE, the last twin class with no reader ───────────────────────────────────
    -- edge_health_probe is the thirteenth twin object class and the only one nothing the browser
    -- can reach had ever read, so the founder's twin was complete except for the machine it runs on.
    'infrastructure', jsonb_build_object(
      'probes', (select count(*) from public.edge_health_probe),
      'rows', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) order by p.id desc)
        from (select * from public.edge_health_probe order by id desc limit 12) p), '[]'::jsonb)),

    -- ── DEPARTMENT HEALTH, for the twin ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    'department_health', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'dept_key', h.dept_key, 'department', h.department, 'score', h.score,
        'status', h.status, 'basis', h.basis) order by h.score nulls first)
      from public.v_department_health h), '[]'::jsonb),

    'generated_at', now()
  );
fn_report_drilldown:
with b as (select coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_metric), ''), '~none~') m,
                    greatest(coalesce(p_days, 30), 1) d),
  series as (
    select s.taken_at, s.value from public.metric_snapshot s, b
     where s.metric_key ilike '%' || b.m || '%'
       and s.taken_at > now() - (b.d || ' days')::interval
     order by s.taken_at desc limit 60
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'metric', (select m from b), 'window_days', (select d from b),

    -- WHY IT MOVED: the last two readings, and the change between them.
    'series', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('at', taken_at, 'value', value) order by taken_at desc) from series), '[]'::jsonb),
    'latest', (select value from series order by taken_at desc limit 1),
    'previous', (select value from series order by taken_at desc offset 1 limit 1),
    'change', (select (select value from series order by taken_at desc limit 1)
                    - (select value from series order by taken_at desc offset 1 limit 1)),
    'readings', (select count(*) from series),

    'index', (select jsonb_build_object('index_name', c.index_name, 'score', c.score, 'band', c.band,
                'measured_on', c.measured_on, 'dimensions', c.dimensions)
                from public.company_index c, b
               where c.index_name ilike '%' || b.m || '%'
               order by c.measured_on desc limit 1),

    -- THE TARGET it is measured against.
    'target', (select jsonb_build_object('goal_key', g.goal_key, 'horizon', g.horizon,
                 'period_label', g.period_label, 'target_value', g.target_value,
                 'actual_value', g.actual_value, 'status', g.status,
                 'gap', g.target_value - g.actual_value, 'updated_at', g.updated_at)
                from public.goal_period g, b
               where g.goal_key ilike '%' || b.m || '%'
               order by g.updated_at desc limit 1),

    -- WHO CONTRIBUTED: the decisions that named this metric in the window.
    'contributors', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'actor', l.actor, 'os', public.fn_owning_os(l.actor), 'kind', l.kind,
          'decision', l.decision, 'confidence', l.confidence, 'at', l.created_at)
        order by l.created_at desc)
      from (select l.* from public.decision_log l, b
             where l.created_at > now() - (b.d || ' days')::interval
               and (l.decision ilike '%' || b.m || '%' or l.ctx::text ilike '%' || b.m || '%')
             order by l.created_at desc limit 10) l), '[]'::jsonb),
    'generated_at', now()
  );
fn_decision_conflict_scan:
declare v_conflicts int; v_sample text;
begin
  -- The same actor and kind reaching two different verdicts inside a week is either a change of
  -- mind nobody recorded or an inconsistency. Either way the founder should be told which.
  with pairs as (
    select l.actor, l.kind, count(distinct l.decision) k,
           string_agg(distinct l.decision, ' vs ') verdicts
      from public.decision_log l
     where l.created_at > now() - interval '7 days' and coalesce(l.decision,'') <> ''
     group by l.actor, l.kind
    having count(distinct l.decision) > 1)
  select count(*), coalesce(string_agg(actor || '/' || kind || ': ' || verdicts, '; '), '')
    into v_conflicts, v_sample from pairs;

  if v_conflicts > 0 then
    insert into public.founder_alerts(level, event, detail, channel)
      values ('info', 'Governance monitor — conflicting decisions',
              v_conflicts || ' actor/kind pair(s) reached more than one verdict in 7 days. ' || left(v_sample, 900), 'os');
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('monitor', 'conflicting_decisions', 'conflicts', v_conflicts, 'ran_at', now());
end
fn_action_queue_sweep:
declare v_dupes int := 0; v_cleared int := 0;
begin
  -- 1. DUPLICATES. Keep the newest of each (agent, kind, normalised title); supersede the rest.
  --    A leading integer is a COUNT, not an identity: "4 agent run(s) failed in last 24h" and
  --    "10 agent run(s) failed in last 24h" are the same recurring incident reported twice.
  with ranked as (
    select id, agent, kind,
           regexp_replace(title, '^[0-9]+\s+', 'N ') as norm_title,
           first_value(id) over (partition by agent, kind, regexp_replace(title, '^[0-9]+\s+', 'N ')
                                 order by created_at desc) keep_id,
           row_number() over (partition by agent, kind, regexp_replace(title, '^[0-9]+\s+', 'N ')
                              order by created_at desc) rn
      from public.agent_actions
     where status in ('pending','needs_review')
  ), dupes as (select id, keep_id from ranked where rn > 1)
  update public.agent_actions a
     set status = 'superseded',
         decided_by = 'action_queue_sweep',
         decided_at = now(),
         detail = coalesce(a.detail, '{}'::jsonb)
                  || jsonb_build_object('superseded_by', d.keep_id, 'swept_at', now(),
                                        'reason', 'same agent/kind and same title once a leading count is normalised')
    from dupes d where a.id = d.id;
  get diagnostics v_dupes = row_count;

  -- 2. STALE INCIDENTS whose condition has cleared. An incident naming failed runs is a
  --    POINT-IN-TIME observation over its own 24-hour window. Older than 48 hours it is either
  --    already superseded by a newer one above, or nothing has failed in the window it names.
  --    The old global "has anything failed anywhere in 48h" guard is gone: it made this branch
  --    unreachable in any estate that is actually running.
  update public.agent_actions a
     set status = 'auto_resolved',
         decided_by = 'action_queue_sweep',
         decided_at = now(),
         detail = coalesce(a.detail, '{}'::jsonb)
                  || jsonb_build_object('auto_resolved_at', now(),
                                        'reason', 'point-in-time run-failure incident older than 48h; '
                                               || 'any still-live failure is carried by a newer incident')
   where a.status in ('pending','needs_review')
     and a.kind = 'incident'
     and a.created_at < now() - interval '48 hours'
     and a.title ~* 'run\(s\) failed';
  get diagnostics v_cleared = row_count;

  if v_dupes + v_cleared > 0 then
    insert into public.founder_alerts(level, event, detail, channel)
      values ('info', 'Action queue swept',
              v_dupes || ' duplicate(s) superseded and ' || v_cleared
              || ' stale incident(s) auto-resolved. Handoffs, legal flags, customer escalations and '
              || 'recommendations were left untouched — those need you.', 'os');
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object('superseded', v_dupes, 'auto_resolved', v_cleared,
    'still_open', (select count(*) from public.agent_actions where status in ('pending','needs_review')),
    'ran_at', now());
end
fn_capability_verify:
declare v_real int := 0; v_present int := 0; v_absent int := 0; v_failing int := 0;
begin
  update public.critical_capability c
     set last_verdict = case
           when t.last_run is not null then lower(t.state)
           when to_regproc('public.'||c.test_ref) is not null
             or to_regclass('public.'||c.test_ref) is not null
             or exists (select 1 from pg_trigger g where g.tgname = c.test_ref)
             or exists (select 1 from public.scenario_library s where s.scenario_key = c.test_ref)
             then 'mechanism_present'
           else 'mechanism_absent' end,
         last_checked = coalesce(t.last_run,
           (select s.last_run from public.scenario_library s where s.scenario_key = c.test_ref),
           now())
    from public.v_critical_capability_tests t
   where t.capability_key = c.capability_key;

  select count(*) filter (where last_verdict in ('passing','failing')),
         count(*) filter (where last_verdict = 'mechanism_present'),
         count(*) filter (where last_verdict = 'mechanism_absent'),
         count(*) filter (where last_verdict = 'failing')
    into v_real, v_present, v_absent, v_failing
    from public.critical_capability;

  -- A capability that has FAILED is not a log line. It goes to the founder's alert stream with its
  -- own key, once per verdict, so a capability that fails for a week does not raise seven alerts.
  insert into public.founder_alerts (level, event, detail, channel)
  select 'critical', 'Critical capability failing',
         c.capability_key||' — '||c.capability||' (owner: '||coalesce(c.owner_dept,'unassigned')
         ||', test '||coalesce(c.test_ref,'?')||')',
         'os'
    from public.critical_capability c
   where c.last_verdict = 'failing'
     and not exists (select 1 from public.founder_alerts a
                      where a.event = 'Critical capability failing'
                        and a.detail like c.capability_key||' —%'
                        and a.created_at > now() - interval '20 hours');

  insert into public.agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('capability_verify', now(), now(), 'ok',
    jsonb_build_object('exercised', v_real, 'mechanism_present', v_present,
                       'mechanism_absent', v_absent, 'failing', v_failing),
    v_real||' capabilit(ies) carry a real test verdict of which '||v_failing||' are failing; '
    ||v_present||' verified present but never behaviourally exercised; '||v_absent||' missing their mechanism entirely.');

  return jsonb_build_object('exercised', v_real, 'mechanism_present', v_present,
                            'mechanism_absent', v_absent, 'failing', v_failing);
end
trg_company_event_dispatch:
begin
  begin
    -- 20, not 1. See the header: at 1 this delivered only events stamped within the last sixty
    -- seconds, which was 4% of them, and everything else fell through to the 15-minute cron.
    perform public.fn_event_dispatch(20);
  exception when others then
    insert into public.agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
    values ('event_dispatch_trigger', now(), now(), 'error',
      jsonb_build_object('sqlstate', sqlstate),
      'Inline dispatch from the company_event trigger failed: '||left(sqlerrm, 300)
      ||'. The event is stored and event_dispatch_15min will deliver it on the next tick.');
  end;
  return null;
end
fn_action_policies:
select array_remove(array[
    -- action_autonomy: the standing per-kind rule that decides whether the sweep may clear this
    -- action or the founder must see it. The action's own kind selects the answer.
    (select 'action_autonomy: '||coalesce(p_kind,'(no kind)')||' → '||(d.value->>p_kind)
       from public.decision_policy d
      where d.key = 'action_autonomy' and p_kind is not null and d.value ? p_kind),
    -- confidence_min, against this action's own confidence, so two actions of the same kind read
    -- differently. An action with no confidence says that rather than being left blank.
    (select case when p_confidence is null
              then 'confidence_min '||(d.value#>>'{}')||' — this action records no confidence, so the floor cannot be applied'
              else 'confidence_min '||(d.value#>>'{}')||' — this action '||round(p_confidence, 2)::text
                   ||case when p_confidence < (d.value#>>'{}')::numeric then ', below the floor' else ', at or above the floor' end end
       from public.decision_policy d where d.key = 'confidence_min'),
    -- the chairman doctrine list: an action inside it is not a judgement call.
    (select 'founder_review_gates: '||p_kind||' is on the founder-review list'
       from public.decision_policy d
      where d.key = 'founder_review_gates' and p_kind is not null and d.value ? p_kind)
  ], null);
fn_index_slowdown_watch:
declare n int := 0; r record; v_moved text; v_ins int;
begin
  for r in
    select z.index_name, z.measured_on, z.score, z.prev, z.dims, z.prev_dims
      from (select c.index_name, c.measured_on, c.score, c.dimensions dims,
                   lag(c.score)      over (partition by c.index_name order by c.measured_on) prev,
                   lag(c.dimensions) over (partition by c.index_name order by c.measured_on) prev_dims
              from public.company_index c
             where c.measured_on > current_date - 30) z
     where z.prev is not null and z.score < z.prev - 1 and z.measured_on > current_date - 7
       and not exists (select 1 from public.founder_alerts a
                        where a.created_at::date >= z.measured_on
                          and position(z.index_name in coalesce(a.event,'')||' '||coalesce(a.detail::text,'')) > 0)
       and not exists (select 1 from public.evolution_proposal p
                        where p.created_at::date >= z.measured_on
                          and position(z.index_name in coalesce(p.subject,'')||' '||coalesce(p.observation,'')) > 0)
       and not exists (select 1 from public.agent_actions g
                        where g.created_at::date >= z.measured_on
                          and position(z.index_name in coalesce(g.title,'')||' '||coalesce(g.detail::text,'')) > 0)
  loop
    -- WHERE THE DROP CAME FROM, out of the index's own stored dimensions. Only dimensions that
    -- actually fell, biggest mover first, with both values so the size is visible.
    select string_agg(d.k||' '||d.was||' to '||d.now_v, ', ' order by (d.was - d.now_v) desc)
      into v_moved
      from (select k, (r.prev_dims->>k)::numeric was, (r.dims->>k)::numeric now_v
              from jsonb_object_keys(r.dims) k
             where jsonb_typeof(r.dims->k) = 'number'
               and jsonb_typeof(coalesce(r.prev_dims->k,'null'::jsonb)) = 'number'
               and (r.prev_dims->>k)::numeric > (r.dims->>k)::numeric) d;

    insert into public.evolution_proposal (trigger_kind, subject, observation, evidence, proposal, change_class)
    values ('metric_off_target', r.index_name,
      format('%s fell from %s to %s on %s, a drop of %s points. Dimensions that moved down: %s.',
             r.index_name, r.prev, r.score, r.measured_on, round(r.prev - r.score, 2),
             coalesce(v_moved, 'none that the index breaks out — the drop is in the weighting, not in a named dimension')),
      jsonb_build_object('index', r.index_name, 'from', r.prev, 'to', r.score,
                         'fell_by', round(r.prev - r.score, 2), 'measured_on', r.measured_on,
                         'dimensions_down', v_moved),
      format('Find the cause of the %s fall before it compounds. The dimensions above are where it came from; the drop is arithmetic, the reason is not, and only one of those two is in the data.', r.index_name),
      'process')
    -- The partial unique index gets the final say. Its predicate is repeated verbatim so the
    -- arbiter resolves to evolution_proposal_dedupe_idx and nothing else.
    on conflict (trigger_kind, subject, change_class) where status = 'proposed' do nothing;
    -- Count what was written, not what was attempted: a duplicate that was skipped is not an
    -- investigation raised, and the note at the bottom is read as if it were.
    get diagnostics v_ins = row_count;
    n := n + v_ins;
  end loop;

  insert into public.agent_runs (agent, started_at, finished_at, status, counts, note)
  values ('index_slowdown_watch', now(), now(), 'ok', jsonb_build_object('investigated', n),
    case when n = 0 then 'No index lost more than a point in the last 7 days without something already picking it up.'
         else n||' index fall(s) over a point raised for investigation, with the dimensions that moved.' end);

  return jsonb_build_object('investigated', n);
end
fn_knowledge_provenance_stamp:
begin
  -- OWNER. Only when the writer did not name one.
  if NEW.owner_agent is null and coalesce(NEW.agent_key,'') <> '' then
    NEW.owner_agent := case
      when NEW.agent_key like 'cat:%' then 'learning_dev_mgr'
      when NEW.agent_key = '_global'  then 'docs'
      else NEW.agent_key
    end;
  end if;
  if NEW.owner_agent is null then NEW.owner_agent := NEW.agent_key; end if;

  -- CITATION. Each branch reads a reference the writer itself put in the row; anything else is
  -- left NULL here and handled by the fallback below. A source_ref that says "unknown" is worse
  -- than one that is absent, because the check counts it as present — which is exactly why the
  -- fallback now comes after this block instead of before it.
  if NEW.source_ref is null or btrim(NEW.source_ref) = '' then
    NEW.source_ref := case
      -- assets_ingest: content opens 'From company asset "X" (Dropbox: /path)'
      when NEW.topic like 'Asset text: %'
        then 'dropbox_asset:' || coalesce(substring(NEW.content from 'Dropbox: ([^)]+)'),
                                          substring(NEW.topic   from 'Asset text: (.*)'))
      when NEW.topic = 'Company assets (auto-synced from Dropbox)'
        then 'dropbox_asset:manifest'
      -- fn_experience_promote stamps the org_memory id into the topic as [org#123]
      when NEW.topic ~ '\[org#[0-9]+\]'
        then 'org_memory:' || substring(NEW.topic from '\[org#([0-9]+)\]')
      -- trg_ingest_case_lessons: 'Closed-case lesson (RFQ-45)'
      when NEW.topic like 'Closed-case lesson (RFQ-%'
        then 'rfq_case:' || substring(NEW.topic from 'RFQ-([0-9]+)')
      when NEW.topic like 'exam:%'
        then 'knowledge_exam:' || substring(NEW.topic from 'exam:(.*)')
      else null
    end;
  end if;

  -- LAST RESORT, and only now. Nothing above could name a source, so say so honestly.
  if NEW.source_ref is null or btrim(NEW.source_ref) = '' then
    NEW.source_ref := 'unattributed: no provenance was recorded when this item was written';
  end if;

  -- CONFIDENCE, SCORED OFF THE FINAL source_ref. This ran one line after the placeholder was set,
  -- so it matched nothing and fell to 0.50 on every row that had no writer-supplied reference.
  if NEW.confidence is null then
    NEW.confidence := case
      when NEW.source_ref ~* '^(pack|corpus|import|kb_stage|ops_kb_stage|v2026)' then 0.90
      when NEW.source_ref ~* '^authored'     then 0.85
      when NEW.source_ref ~* '^web_research' then 0.70
      when NEW.source_ref ~* '^(knowledge_exam|org_memory|auto_chat|session|dropbox_asset|rfq_case)' then 0.60
      else 0.50 end;
  end if;

  if NEW.supporting_evidence is null then
    NEW.supporting_evidence := 'Basis: ' || NEW.source_ref
      || ' | layer: ' || coalesce(NEW.layer,'unspecified')
      || ' | owner: ' || coalesce(NEW.owner_agent,'unassigned')
      || ' | validation: ' || coalesce(NEW.validation_status,'unvalidated')
      || case when coalesce(NEW.content,'') ~ 'https?://' then ' | the item itself cites at least one URL'
              else ' | the item cites no external source; treat it as internal know-how, not as an authority' end;
  end if;

  return NEW;
end

fn_agent_handoff_inbox:
select string_agg(line, E'\n' order by created_at)
  from (
    select a.created_at,
           -- Bound the WHOLE line, not its parts. Capping title and recommendation separately
           -- still left four employees over budget because the prefix varies ("from Document
           -- Controller" is longer than "doc_task"). 215 x 3 lines + 2 newlines = 647, inside the
           -- 678 this inbox was trimmed to after it timed agent_brain out twice.
           left(
           '- #'||a.id||' ('||extract(day from now() - a.created_at)::int||'d old, '
             ||case when a.kind = 'handoff'
                    then 'from '||coalesce(a.detail->>'from_name', a.detail->>'from', 'a colleague')
                    else a.kind end
             ||case when a.kind = any(fn_agent_inbox_closable_kinds()) then '' else ', FOUNDER DECIDES — do not close' end
             ||'): '
             -- The TITLE was never capped, only the recommendation. With handoffs only that was
             -- harmless; the wider kinds carry long generated titles and the block measured 821
             -- characters for `docs` and 769 for `it` — both ABOVE the 678 this inbox was trimmed
             -- to after it timed agent_brain out twice at ~56s. `it`'s prompt is 30,821 tokens and
             -- its one prior success took 53,139 ms, so the margin is real and small. Capped at 80
             -- so three lines cannot exceed roughly the budget that was proved safe.
             ||coalesce(a.title,'(untitled)')
             ||coalesce(' — '||a.recommendation, '')
           , 215) as line
      from agent_actions a
     where coalesce(public.fn_org_agent_resolve(a.agent), a.agent)
         = coalesce(public.fn_org_agent_resolve(p_agent_key), p_agent_key)
       and a.status in ('pending','needs_review')
     order by a.created_at
     limit 3
  ) z;

declare v_run int; v_block int; v_new_block int; v_keys text[];
begin
  with v as (select * from public.fn_ops_run_scenarios()),
  upd as (
    update ops_kb_stage.scenarios s
       set last_result = v.verdict, last_run = now()
      from v where v.scenario_id = s.record_id
      returning s.record_id, v.verdict, (s.last_result = 'RUNNABLE' and v.verdict = 'BLOCKED') as newly_blocked
  )
  select count(*) filter (where verdict = 'RUNNABLE'),
         count(*) filter (where verdict = 'BLOCKED'),
         count(*) filter (where newly_blocked),
         coalesce(array_agg(record_id) filter (where newly_blocked), '{}')
    into v_run, v_block, v_new_block, v_keys
    from upd;

  if coalesce(v_new_block,0) > 0 then
    insert into public.agent_actions(agent, kind, title, recommendation, detail, risk, status)
    values ('knowledge_eng', 'incident',
            format('%s operations scenario(s) became BLOCKED', v_new_block),
            'A department lost the decision rules, professional knowledge or live-data binding its scenarios depend on. Run select * from fn_ops_run_scenarios() where verdict = ''BLOCKED'' for the reasons.',
            jsonb_build_object('scenarios', to_jsonb(v_keys), 'source', 'fn_ops_scenarios_sweep'),
            'medium', 'pending');
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object('runnable', v_run, 'blocked', v_block,
                            'newly_blocked', v_new_block, 'ran_at', now());
end

fn_tool_readiness:
declare v_tot int; v_connected int; v_blockers int; v_names text[]; v_p0 int;
        v_cond int; v_cond_names text[];
begin
  select count(*),
         count(*) filter (where lower(coalesce(current_status,'')) like 'connected%'),
         count(*) filter (where lower(coalesce(priority,'')) = 'p0')
    into v_tot, v_connected, v_p0
    from public.ai_tool_matrix;

  -- The column is not a boolean. Eight rows say a bare 'Yes'; three say a CONDITIONAL yes —
  -- 'Yes for autonomous supplier discovery' (Apify), 'Yes if CAD/office conversion is enabled'
  -- (CloudConvert), 'Yes unless refactored' (Dropbox). Matching only 'yes' reports 0 blockers and
  -- reads as ready; matching 'yes%' reports 3 and would page about Apify, which was deliberately
  -- cancelled until ~Feb 2027. Both are counted, and only the unconditional ones raise.
  select count(*), coalesce(array_agg(tool || ' (' || coalesce(priority,'?') || ', ' ||
                                      coalesce(current_status,'unknown') || ')' order by priority, tool), '{}')
    into v_blockers, v_names
    from public.ai_tool_matrix
   where lower(coalesce(required_before_launch,'')) = 'yes'
     and lower(coalesce(current_status,'')) not like 'connected%';

  select count(*), coalesce(array_agg(tool || ' — ' || required_before_launch order by tool), '{}')
    into v_cond, v_cond_names
    from public.ai_tool_matrix
   where lower(coalesce(required_before_launch,'')) like 'yes %'
     and lower(coalesce(current_status,'')) not like 'connected%';

  if v_blockers > 0 then
    insert into public.agent_actions(agent, kind, title, recommendation, detail, risk, status)
    values ('it', 'ops_recommendation',
            format('%s tool(s) required before launch are not connected', v_blockers),
            'Connect them or record in ai_tool_matrix why the launch no longer depends on them. A required_before_launch row that stays disconnected is a launch date that has not been re-planned.',
            jsonb_build_object('tools', to_jsonb(v_names), 'source', 'fn_tool_readiness'),
            'medium', 'pending');
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object('tools', v_tot, 'connected', v_connected, 'p0', v_p0,
                            'launch_blockers', v_blockers, 'blocker_list', to_jsonb(v_names),
                            'conditionally_required_not_connected', v_cond,
                            'conditional_list', to_jsonb(v_cond_names),
                            'ran_at', now());
end
fn_action_invoke_dispatch:
declare r record; v_req bigint; v_sent int := 0; v_refused int := 0; v_skipped int := 0;
        v_url text; v_secret text; v_ref text; v_key text;
begin
  select value into v_secret from app_secrets where key = 'cred_action_invoker';
  if v_secret is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('error', 'no cred_action_invoker credential', 'ran_at', now());
  end if;
  -- The project ref is read off an existing cron command rather than hard-coded, so the same
  -- migration file is correct on production and on staging.
  select value into v_ref from app_secrets where key = 'project_ref';
  if v_ref is null then
    select substring(command from 'https://([a-z]+)[.]supabase[.]co') into v_ref
      from cron.job where command like '%supabase.co/functions/v1/%' limit 1;
  end if;
  if v_ref is null then return jsonb_build_object('error','cannot determine project ref','ran_at',now()); end if;

  for r in
    select a.id, a.action_class, a.request, a.idempotency_key, a.attempts,
           e.target, e.kind, e.active, e.risk_tier, e.advisory_safe, e.reversible,
           e.required_authority, e.compensation_action_class, e.idempotency_strategy, e.params,
           e.notifies_human, e.unattended_ok,
           coalesce(e.timeout_seconds, 60) timeout_seconds, coalesce(e.max_attempts, 1) max_attempts
      from public.action_execution a
      join public.org_action_executor e on e.action_class = a.action_class
     where a.status = 'queued' and e.kind = 'edge'
     order by a.created_at
     limit greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 5), 1)
  loop
    -- ---- the three absolute refusals, the human-contact refusal, then the risk tier -----------
    -- notifies_human is checked BEFORE the risk tier on purpose. The tier answers "how much
    -- damage if this is wrong"; notifies_human answers "does a person hear from us either way",
    -- and a message that should not have been sent cannot be un-sent by a low risk score.
    if not r.active
       or coalesce(r.required_authority,'') = 'founder'
       or (not r.reversible and r.compensation_action_class is null)
       or (coalesce(r.notifies_human,false) and not coalesce(r.unattended_ok,false))
       or not (r.risk_tier = 'low' and r.advisory_safe and r.reversible) then
      update public.action_execution
         set response = coalesce(response,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
               'invoker', 'refused', 'at', now(),
               'reason', case
                 when not r.active then 'executor row is inactive'
                 when coalesce(r.required_authority,'') = 'founder' then 'reserved to the founder'
                 when (not r.reversible and r.compensation_action_class is null)
                   then 'not reversible and declares no compensation_action_class'
                 when (coalesce(r.notifies_human,false) and not coalesce(r.unattended_ok,false))
                   then 'notifies_human is true and unattended_ok has not been set for this class — a person hears from us when this runs, and nobody has decided it may run unattended'
                 else format('risk gate: tier=%s advisory_safe=%s reversible=%s — the invoker dispatches low/advisory_safe/reversible only',
                             r.risk_tier, r.advisory_safe, r.reversible) end)
       where id = r.id;
      v_refused := v_refused + 1;
      continue;
    end if;

    -- ---- idempotency: the column exists on both tables and was never consulted ---------------
    v_key := coalesce(nullif(btrim(r.idempotency_key),''),
                      r.action_class || ':' || md5(coalesce(r.request::text,'')));
    if r.idempotency_strategy is distinct from 'none_read_only'
       and exists (select 1 from public.action_execution x
                    where x.id <> r.id and x.status = 'succeeded'
                      and x.idempotency_key = v_key
                      and x.finished_at > now() - interval '24 hours') then
      update public.action_execution
         set status = 'succeeded', finished_at = now(),
             response = coalesce(response,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
               'invoker','deduplicated','at',now(),'idempotency_key',v_key,
               'strategy', r.idempotency_strategy)
       where id = r.id;
      v_skipped := v_skipped + 1;
      continue;
    end if;

    v_url := 'https://' || v_ref || '.supabase.co/functions/v1/' || r.target;
    select net.http_post(
             url := v_url,
             headers := '{"Content-Type":"application/json"}'::jsonb,
             -- org_action_executor.params is the per-executor payload TEMPLATE and it existed,
             -- empty, on all 55 rows. Without it the invoker sent {org_task_id, dept_key, title}
             -- to every target and compliance_archive answered 400 unknown_action — found by
             -- execution on the first real sweep, not by reading. params is the base of the body
             -- so a target's contract is declared as data, not coded into the invoker.
             body := coalesce(r.params, '{}'::jsonb) || coalesce(r.request, '{}'::jsonb)
                     || jsonb_build_object('__secret', v_secret),
             timeout_milliseconds := r.timeout_seconds * 1000)
      into v_req;

    update public.action_execution
       set status = 'running', attempts = coalesce(attempts,0) + 1,
           executor = r.target, idempotency_key = v_key,
           started_at = coalesce(started_at, now()),
           response = coalesce(response,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
             'invoker','dispatched','at',now(),'net_request_id',v_req,'url',v_url,
             'timeout_seconds', r.timeout_seconds, 'attempt', coalesce(r.attempts,0)+1,
             'max_attempts', r.max_attempts)
     where id = r.id;
    v_sent := v_sent + 1;
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object('dispatched', v_sent, 'refused', v_refused,
                            'deduplicated', v_skipped, 'ran_at', now());
end
fn_action_invoke_collect:
declare r record; v_ok int := 0; v_retry int := 0; v_dead int := 0; v_wait int := 0;
        v_status int; v_body text; v_err text; v_good boolean;
begin
  for r in
    select a.id, a.action_class, a.attempts, a.executor,
           (a.response->>'net_request_id')::bigint req,
           coalesce((a.response->>'max_attempts')::int, 1) max_attempts,
           a.started_at
      from public.action_execution a
     where a.status = 'running' and (a.response->>'net_request_id') is not null
  loop
    select status_code, content, error_msg into v_status, v_body, v_err
      from net._http_response where id = r.req;

    if not found then
      if r.started_at < now() - interval '10 minutes' then
        v_status := null; v_err := 'no pg_net response after 10 minutes';
      else
        v_wait := v_wait + 1; continue;
      end if;
    end if;

    -- A 200 IS NOT ENOUGH. quote_compare returned {ok:false,'parse_failed'} at HTTP 200 for weeks.
    v_good := v_status = 200
              and coalesce(v_body,'') <> ''
              and coalesce((nullif(v_body,'')::jsonb ->> 'ok'), 'true') <> 'false';

    if v_good then
      update public.action_execution
         set status = 'succeeded', finished_at = now(),
             response = coalesce(response,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
               'invoker','succeeded','at',now(),'http_status',v_status,
               'body', left(coalesce(v_body,''), 4000))
       where id = r.id;
      v_ok := v_ok + 1;

      begin
        update public.org_tasks k
           set status = 'done', updated_at = now(), last_run_at = now(),
               result = coalesce(k.result,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
                 'mode','executed_by_invoker', 'executor', r.executor,
                 'http_status', v_status, 'at', now(),
                 'summary', left(coalesce(v_body,''), 500),
                 -- SIX KEYS, NOT THREE (12 Aug 2026). See the header: action_worker is the largest
                 -- producer in the estate and emits `outcome`, which none of the original three
                 -- matched, so 254 of 556 invocations in 7 days closed their task with a NULL
                 -- deliverable while carrying real work in the body. Appended, never reordered, so
                 -- anything extracting correctly today is untouched.
                 'deliverable', case
                    when pg_input_is_valid(coalesce(v_body,''), 'jsonb') then coalesce(
                      nullif(btrim(coalesce((v_body::jsonb)->>'recommendation','')),''),
                      nullif(btrim(coalesce((v_body::jsonb)->>'deliverable','')),''),
                      nullif(btrim(coalesce((v_body::jsonb)->>'note','')),''),
                      nullif(btrim(coalesce((v_body::jsonb)->>'outcome','')),''),
                      nullif(btrim(coalesce((v_body::jsonb)->>'summary','')),''),
                      nullif(btrim(coalesce((v_body::jsonb)->>'result','')),''))
                    else nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_body,'')),'') end)
         where k.id = (select (a.request->>'org_task_id')::bigint from public.action_execution a where a.id = r.id)
           and k.status in ('assigned','in_progress');
      exception when others then
        update public.action_execution
           set response = coalesce(response,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
                 'org_task_close', 'refused', 'reason', left(SQLERRM, 400))
         where id = r.id;
      end;
    elsif coalesce(r.attempts,1) < r.max_attempts then
      update public.action_execution
         set status = 'queued',
             response = coalesce(response,'{}'::jsonb) - 'net_request_id' || jsonb_build_object(
               'invoker','retrying','at',now(),'http_status',v_status,
               'error', left(coalesce(v_err, v_body, 'unknown'), 500))
       where id = r.id;
      v_retry := v_retry + 1;
    else
      update public.action_execution
         set status = 'failed', finished_at = now(),
             response = coalesce(response,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
               'invoker','failed','at',now(),'http_status',v_status,
               'error', left(coalesce(v_err, v_body, 'unknown'), 500))
       where id = r.id;
      insert into public.dead_letter(source, source_id, kind, reason, payload, first_failed_at, attempts)
      values ('fn_action_invoke_collect', r.id::text, r.action_class,
              left(coalesce(v_err, v_body, 'http ' || coalesce(v_status::text,'?')), 500),
              jsonb_build_object('executor', r.executor, 'http_status', v_status,
                                 'body', left(coalesce(v_body,''), 2000)),
              now(), coalesce(r.attempts,1));
      v_dead := v_dead + 1;
    end if;
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object('succeeded', v_ok, 'retrying', v_retry, 'dead_lettered', v_dead,
                            'still_in_flight', v_wait, 'ran_at', now());
end

with m as (
  select
    (select count(*) from operating_system) os_rows,
    (select count(distinct os_key) from operating_system) os_keys,

    (select count(*) from org_action_executor) execs,

    (select count(*) from org_action_executor where not reversible and compensation_action_class is null) irrev_no_comp,
    (select count(*) from company_event where occurred_at > now() - interval '30 days') events30,
    (select count(*) from workflow_run) wf_runs,
    (select count(*) from workflow_step) wf_steps,
    (select count(*) from action_execution where status = 'succeeded'
        and response->>'invoker' = 'succeeded') invoked_ok,
    (select count(*) from agent_actions where created_at > now() - interval '30 days') aa30,
    (select count(*) from agent_actions where created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
        and (status = 'pending' or escalated)) aa30_paused,
    -- Work a MACHINE executed, counted by every mechanism that executes it rather than by one
    -- pipeline's status literal. 'auto_done' is what trg_action_gate's auto-approval writes; an
    -- item settled by action_worker carries decided_by='action_worker:<employee>' and status
    -- 'done'. Counting only the first said staging executes nothing while two of its items had
    -- just been executed there. The bar is unchanged — machine-executed work must be non-zero.
    (select count(*) from agent_actions where created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
        and (status = 'auto_done' or decided_by like 'action_worker%')) aa30_auto,
    -- pg_catalog, not information_schema. The information_schema.column_privileges view
    -- materialises every grant on every column in the database and the join was O(columns x
    -- grants): it ran on production and hit the statement timeout on staging, which took the whole
    -- gates function and the scorecard down with it. Filtering by column NAME first and asking
    -- has_column_privilege per candidate is the same question asked cheaply.
    (select count(*) from pg_attribute a
       join pg_class c on c.oid = a.attrelid
       join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
      where n.nspname = 'public' and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped
        and c.relkind in ('r','v','m','p')
        and (a.attname ilike '%customer%email%' or a.attname ilike '%customer%phone%')
        and (has_column_privilege('anon', c.oid, a.attnum, 'SELECT')
             or has_column_privilege('authenticated', c.oid, a.attnum, 'SELECT'))) leak_cols,
    (select count(*) from cron.job where jobname = 'control_mode_sweep_5min' and active) cm_sweep,
    (select count(*) from internal_credential where active and scope @> array['*']) star_creds,
    (select count(*) from internal_credential where active) creds,
    (select count(*) from model_policy where active and tier = 'none') det_pol,
    (select count(*) from model_policy where task_class = 'quote_comparison'
        and coalesce(deterministic_alternative,'') <> '') qc_det,
    -- ai_cost_log, NOT llm_calls. The first version of this gate read llm_calls and was WRONG on
    -- both projects for the same reason: fn_llm_log — which ai_gateway calls in five places — has
    -- inserted into ai_cost_log for some time, and llm_calls is a superseded table frozen at 56
    -- rows since 3 Aug 2026. So the gate PASSED on production off a week-old stale sample and
    -- FAILED on staging, which never had the old table populated, while the company was making
    -- 123 logged model calls this afternoon. ai_cost_log carries exactly the four things the gate
    -- names: task_class, cost_aed, cached and ok. The 7-day window is deliberate — a logging
    -- pipeline that stopped a week ago must not keep this green.
    (select count(*) from ai_cost_log where occurred_at > now() - interval '7 days') llm30,
    (select count(*) from ai_cost_log where occurred_at > now() - interval '7 days'
        and task_class is not null and model_used is not null and ok is not null
        and cached is not null and cost_aed is not null) llm30_full,
    (select count(*) from agent_actions where created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
        and recommendation is not null and confidence is not null) rec_conf,
    (select count(*) from agent_actions where created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
        and recommendation is not null) rec_all,
    (select count(*) from cron.job_run_details d join cron.job j on j.jobid = d.jobid
      where j.jobname = 'smoke_test_30min' and d.status = 'failed'
        and d.start_time > now() - interval '24 hours') smoke_fail_24h,
    (select count(*) from cron.job_run_details d join cron.job j on j.jobid = d.jobid
      where j.jobname = 'smoke_test_30min' and d.start_time > now() - interval '24 hours') smoke_runs_24h,
    (select count(*) from institutional_memory where headline ilike '%rollback rehearsal%'
        and created_at > now() - interval '90 days') rollback_drill,
    (select count(*) from cron.job where active) crons,
    (select count(*) from cron.job_run_details where status = 'failed'
        and start_time > now() - interval '24 hours') cron_fail_24h
)

Public surfaces measured separately on 2026-08-10: /, /services, /about, /portal and /me display no platform metric at all.',

           '''([a-z_]{3,})''\s*,\s*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\s*[,)]', 'g') m

The b6 and b7 PARTIAL rollbacks abort themselves on a post-condition of Stage B 13/14 — a true finding recorded, not weakened.'),

  -- The first version of this predicate was wrong and it is worth saying how: it required zero

                 where d.jobid = (select jobid from cron.job where jobname='watch_failed_runs_hourly')),'0'),
      coalesce((select to_char(max(d.start_time),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') from cron.job_run_details d
                 where d.jobid = (select jobid from cron.job where jobname='watch_failed_runs_hourly')),'never'),
      cron_fail_24h,
      (select count(*) from cron.job where not active),
      (select count(*) from cron.job where active and jobname like '%watch_failed%')) from m)),

  ('Founder approves release report.',
   case when exists (select 1 from public.founder_release_approval
                      where approved_at > now() - interval '30 days')
