fn_handoff_stalled:
select * from public.v_handoff_stalled s
   where p_dept is null or s.from_dept = p_dept or s.to_dept = p_dept
   order by s.days_past_deadline desc, s.deadline
   limit greatest(1, coalesce(p_limit, 50));
fn_classify_llm_failure:
declare
  e text := coalesce(p_err, '');
  k text;
  truncated boolean;
begin
  -- ai_gateway slices lastErr to exactly 200 chars. At 200 the evidence stops before `choices`,
  -- so anything read past that point would be a guess. Say so rather than infer.
  truncated := length(e) >= 200;

  k := case
    -- BILLING FIRST (added 14 Aug 2026). Stable across every OpenRouter model, and not
    -- retryable: retrying an out-of-credit request cannot succeed and burns the wall budget.
    when p_http_status = 402
      or e ~* '(requires more credits|insufficient[_ ]credit|can only afford|quota exceeded|payment required)'
      then 'insufficient_credit'
    -- credentials first: deterministic, and must never be retried
    when p_http_status in (401, 403)
      or e ~* '(unauthor|forbidden|invalid api key|no auth credentials|api[_ ]?key missing)'
      then 'unauthorised'
    when p_http_status = 429
      or e ~* '(rate[ _-]?limit|too many requests|quota exceeded|insufficient (credits|quota)|capacity)'
      then 'rate_limited'
    -- our own stopwatch reads as a model failure unless it is named
    when e ~* '(signal has been aborted|aborterror|the operation was aborted|timed? ?out|etimedout|deadline|gateway_deadline)'
      then 'timeout'
    when e ~* '(not a valid model|model not found|no endpoints found|unknown model|no allowed providers)'
      then 'route_not_registered'
    when p_model is not null
      and not exists (select 1 from model_registry r where r.model_id = p_model and r.active)
      then 'route_not_registered'
    -- a REAL provider error object, or a 5xx with no payload
    when e ~ '"error"\s*:' or e ~* '^\s*\{"error"'
      or (p_http_status between 500 and 599 and e !~ '"object"\s*:\s*"chat\.completion"')
      then 'provider_error'
    -- the shape the certification actually hit
    when e ~ '"object"\s*:\s*"chat\.completion"' or e ~ '^\s*\{"id"\s*:\s*"gen-'
      then 'empty_completion'
    when lower(coalesce(p_finish_reason,'')) = 'length'
      or e ~* '(unexpected end of json|unparseable|invalid json|json parse|content_filter)'
      then 'malformed_output'
    when e ~* '(tool[_ ]call|tool result|tool failed|function call failed)'
      then 'tool_failure'
    when e ~* '(embedding|kb_match|retriev|context slice|no chunks)'
      then 'retrieval_failure'
    when e ~* '(pgrst|sqlstate|does not exist|deadlock detected|connection (reset|refused|closed)|relation .* does not exist)'
      then 'database_failure'
    when e ~* '(route_failed|no route|no model policy|budget|spend guard|ladder empty)'
      then 'orchestration_failure'
    when e ~* '(harness|fixture|test runner|seed(ing)? failed)'
      then 'test_runner_failure'
    else 'unclassified'
  end;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'class_key', k,
    'retryable', (select retryable from llm_failure_class where class_key = k),
    'max_retries', (select max_retries from llm_failure_class where class_key = k),
    'retry_backoff_ms', (select retry_backoff_ms from llm_failure_class where class_key = k),
    'trips_breaker', (select trips_breaker from llm_failure_class where class_key = k),
    'opens_on_first', (select opens_on_first from llm_failure_class where class_key = k),
    -- honesty flag: the caller learns the evidence was cut off, so 'empty_completion' is never
    -- mistaken for a diagnosed root cause
    'evidence_truncated', truncated,
    'latency_ms', p_latency_ms
  );
end
fn_llm_preflight:
select case
    when p_model is null or p_model in ('none','none/deterministic')
      then jsonb_build_object('allowed', true, 'reason', 'deterministic path, no provider call')
    when not exists (select 1 from model_registry r where r.model_id = p_model and r.active)
      then jsonb_build_object('allowed', false, 'class_key', 'route_not_registered',
             'reason', 'model ' || p_model || ' is not an active row in model_registry')
    when exists (select 1 from llm_route_health h
                 where h.model_id = p_model and h.open_until is not null and h.open_until > now())
      then jsonb_build_object('allowed', false, 'class_key', 'route_open',
             'reason', 'circuit open until '
                       || (select h.open_until from llm_route_health h where h.model_id = p_model)
                       || ' after ' || (select h.consecutive_failures from llm_route_health h where h.model_id = p_model)
                       || ' consecutive failures (' || coalesce((select h.opened_class from llm_route_health h where h.model_id = p_model),'?') || ')',
             'open_until', (select h.open_until from llm_route_health h where h.model_id = p_model))
    else jsonb_build_object('allowed', true, 'reason', 'registered, breaker closed')
  end;
fn_llm_retry_allowed:
select coalesce(
    (select c.retryable and p_attempt_no <= c.max_retries
       from llm_failure_class c where c.class_key = p_class_key),
    false);   -- unknown class is NOT retryable: an unnamed failure never earns another attempt
a00_llm_attempt_immutable:
begin
  raise exception
    'llm_attempt is append-only (attempted % on attempt_id %). A retry inserts a new row with the next attempt_no; it never rewrites an earlier attempt, because first-attempt success rate must stay computable.',
    tg_op, coalesce(old.attempt_id::text,'?')
    using errcode = 'restrict_violation';
end
fn_reliability_report:
with win as (select now() - make_interval(days => greatest(coalesce(p_days,7),1)) as since),
  -- the attempt ledger: authoritative, attempt_no known
  a as (
    select llm_attempt.* from llm_attempt, win where llm_attempt.created_at >= win.since
  ),
  -- history: real rows, no attempt number. ai_gateway writes the reason into
  -- model_selected_because, so the class is recovered from what is actually stored - not invented.
  legacy as (
    select l.model_used as model_route, coalesce(l.agent_key,'(unattributed)') as agent_key, l.ok,
           case when l.ok then null else
             fn_classify_llm_failure(
               nullif(split_part(l.model_selected_because,
                      'ALL MODELS FAILED after the full ladder: ', 2), ''),
               null, null, null, l.latency_ms) ->> 'class_key' end as class_key
      from ai_cost_log l, win
     where l.occurred_at >= win.since and l.model_used is not null and l.model_used <> 'none'
  ),
  -- one row per (scope, subject, class) first, then rolled into the jsonb map. No window
  -- functions, no duplicate keys, and an ok row contributes to the totals with a null class.
  ledger_cls as (
    select 'model_route'::text scope, model_route subject, request_id, attempt_no, ok, class_key from a
    union all
    select 'agent', coalesce(agent_key,'(unattributed)'), request_id, attempt_no, ok, class_key from a
  ),
  ledger as (
    select scope, subject,
           count(*) attempts, count(distinct request_id) requests,
           count(*) filter (where attempt_no = 1) first_attempts,
           count(*) filter (where attempt_no = 1 and ok) first_attempt_ok,
           count(distinct request_id) filter (where ok) eventual_ok_requests,
           coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(k, c)
                       from (select class_key k, count(*) c from ledger_cls i
                              where i.scope = o.scope and i.subject = o.subject
                                and i.class_key is not null
                              group by class_key) z), '{}'::jsonb) failures_by_class
      from ledger_cls o group by scope, subject
  ),
  legacy_cls as (
    select 'model_route'::text scope, model_route subject, ok, class_key from legacy
    union all
    select 'agent', agent_key, ok, class_key from legacy
  ),
  legacy_all as (
    select scope, subject, count(*) n,
           coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(k, c)
                       from (select class_key k, count(*) c from legacy_cls i
                              where i.scope = o.scope and i.subject = o.subject
                                and i.class_key is not null
                              group by class_key) z), '{}'::jsonb) cls
      from legacy_cls o group by scope, subject
  )
  select coalesce(l.scope, g.scope), coalesce(l.subject, g.subject),
         coalesce(l.attempts,0), coalesce(l.requests,0),
         coalesce(l.first_attempts,0), coalesce(l.first_attempt_ok,0),
         -- NULL when nothing was measured. A missing input must never score as satisfied.
         case when coalesce(l.first_attempts,0) = 0 then null
              else round(100.0 * l.first_attempt_ok / l.first_attempts, 2) end,
         coalesce(l.eventual_ok_requests,0),
         case when coalesce(l.requests,0) = 0 then null
              else round(100.0 * l.eventual_ok_requests / l.requests, 2) end,
         coalesce(l.failures_by_class,'{}'::jsonb),
         coalesce(g.n,0),
         coalesce(g.cls,'{}'::jsonb),
         exists (select 1 from llm_route_health h
                  where h.model_id = coalesce(l.subject,g.subject)
                    and h.open_until is not null and h.open_until > now())
    from ledger l
    full outer join legacy_all g on g.scope = l.scope and g.subject = l.subject
   order by 1, coalesce(l.attempts,0) + coalesce(g.n,0) desc;
fn_agent_tool_allowed: select exists (select 1 from public.fn_agent_tools(p_agent_key) t where t.tool_id = p_tool_id);
fn_metric_class:
with t as (select lower(coalesce(p_label,'')||' '||coalesce(p_metric,'')||' '||coalesce(p_unit,'')) s)
  select case
    when (select s from t) ~ '(revenue|turnover|gmv|gross merchandise|dirhams earned|recognised|reveal fee|collections?\b|collected)'
      then 'revenue'
    when (select s from t) ~ '(cost|spend|opex|budget|aed per|per call|price paid|burn|bill)'
      then 'cost'
    when (select s from t) ~ '(risk|fraud|breach|incident|violation|exposure|bad debt|chargeback|refund|penalt|non.?complian|complian|unsafe|leak)'
      then 'risk'
    when (select s from t) ~ '(conversion|convert|win rate|close rate|reach a paid|paid reveal|quote.to|acceptance rate|took up|activation rate)'
      then 'conversion'
    when (select s from t) ~ '(accuracy|quality|pass rate|defect|error rate|bounce|first time|satisfaction|rating|csat|nps|completeness|uptime|availabilit|latency|response time|sla|on.?time|rework)'
      then 'quality_metric'
    when (select s from t) ~ '(pipeline|lead|inquir|enquir|invit|sign.?up|registration|registered|coverage|reach|traffic|visitors|response rate|activation|adoption|retention)'
      then 'leading_indicator'
    -- Count-shaped language only. 'sends' and 'messages' were here in the first draft and pulled
    -- "share of sends that hard bounce" — a quality rate — into 'activity'. A classifier that
    -- mislabels a quality metric as busywork is worse than one that says it cannot tell.
    when (select s from t) ~ '(count|number of|volume|tasks|runs|processed|published|reviewed|completed|closed|throughput|per day|per week)'
      then 'activity'
    else 'unclassified' end;
fn_cascade_refresh:
declare
  v_decompose jsonb;
  v_dept_ok int; v_dept_bad int;
  v_kpi_ok int;  v_kpi_bad int;
begin
  v_decompose := public.fn_goal_decompose();
  select measured, failed into v_dept_ok, v_dept_bad from public.fn_dept_objective_measure();
  select measured, failed into v_kpi_ok,  v_kpi_bad  from public.fn_employee_kpi_measure();

  -- NO KPI->OBJECTIVE COLUMN IS WRITTEN HERE, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE.
  -- The first draft of this function bound employee_kpi.serves_objective to the matching
  -- department_objective.id. Staging refused it:
  --   ERROR 23503: Key (serves_objective)=(139) is not present in table "os_objective"
  -- employee_kpi.serves_objective is a foreign key to os_objective, NOT to department_objective.
  -- The column name says "objective"; the constraint says which one, and the two tables are
  -- different layers with different vocabularies. Had the ids happened to overlap, that update
  -- would have joined every role KPI to an unrelated row and nothing would have failed.
  -- The KPI->objective link is therefore resolved at read time in fn_revenue_cascade, on
  -- (department, serves_goal), which is a fact rather than an id coincidence.
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'decompose', v_decompose,
    'department_objectives_measured', v_dept_ok,
    'department_objectives_measure_failed', v_dept_bad,
    'role_kpis_measured', v_kpi_ok,
    'role_kpis_measure_failed', v_kpi_bad,
    'role_kpis_pointing_at_an_os_objective',
      (select count(*) from public.employee_kpi where active and serves_objective is not null),
    'note', 'employee_kpi.serves_objective references os_objective, a second objective table that '
            ||'is measured but carries no company goal_key. It is reported, never written here.');
end
fn_revenue_cascade:
declare
  v_dept text;
  v_name text;
  v_north text;
  v_objectives jsonb;
  v_kpis jsonb;
  v_os jsonb;
  v_agents text[];
begin
  p_role := coalesce(public.fn_org_agent_resolve(p_role), p_role);
  if coalesce(p_dept,'') = '' then
    return jsonb_build_object('error','department_required');
  end if;

  select d.dept_key, d.name, d.north_star into v_dept, v_name, v_north
    from public.org_departments d where d.dept_key = lower(btrim(p_dept)) and d.active;

  if v_dept is null then
    select d.dept_key, d.name, d.north_star into v_dept, v_name, v_north
      from public.org_department_alias a
      join public.org_departments d on d.dept_key = a.dept_key and d.active
     where a.packaged_department = lower(btrim(p_dept)) and not a.is_second_home;
  end if;

  if v_dept is null then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'error','unknown_department',
      'asked_for', p_dept,
      'known_canonical', (select jsonb_agg(dept_key order by dept_key)
                            from public.org_departments where active),
      'known_packaged',  (select jsonb_agg(distinct packaged_department)
                            from public.org_department_alias));
  end if;

  -- Department objectives. Every one reports whether it reconciles upward and whether it carries a
  -- number, separately — a linked objective with no target is a different problem from an unlinked
  -- one, and collapsing them is how 66 sentences passed for a cascade.
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x->>'objective'), '[]'::jsonb) into v_objectives from (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'objective',            o.objective,
      'horizon',              o.horizon,
      'reconciles_to_goal',   o.goal_key,
      'company_goal',         cg.goal,
      -- coalesced, not bare: `null = 'revenue_annual'` is NULL, and an objective that does not
      -- reach the revenue target must read as false, not as an unanswered question.
      'is_the_revenue_target', coalesce(o.goal_key = 'revenue_annual', false),
      'target_value',         o.target_value,
      'unit',                 o.unit,
      'measured',             o.actual_value is not null,
      'actual_value',         o.actual_value,
      'measured_at',          o.measured_at,
      'not_measured_reason', case
          when o.actual_value is not null then null
          when coalesce(o.measure_sql,'') = '' then 'no measure_sql recorded for this objective'
          else 'measure_sql present but has not produced a value; run fn_cascade_refresh()' end,
      'attainment_pct', case
          when o.actual_value is null or o.target_value is null or o.target_value = 0 then null
          else round(100.0 * o.actual_value / o.target_value, 1) end
    ) x
    from public.department_objective o
    left join public.company_goals cg on cg.key = o.goal_key and cg.active
   where o.dept_key = v_dept and o.active) s;

  select array_agg(distinct r.runtime_agent_key) into v_agents
    from public.org_role r
   where r.primary_department_id = v_dept and r.status = 'active'
     and r.runtime_agent_key is not null
     and (p_role is null or r.role_id = p_role or r.runtime_agent_key = p_role);

  -- The KPI -> department objective link is resolved on (this department, the goal the KPI names),
  -- not on employee_kpi.serves_objective — that column is a foreign key to os_objective, a
  -- different table. Where the department holds more than one objective against the same goal, all
  -- of them are listed and none is picked.
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x->>'agent_key', x->>'kpi'), '[]'::jsonb) into v_kpis from (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'agent_key',   k.agent_key,
      'kpi',         k.kpi,
      'metric',      k.metric,
      'class',       coalesce(k.kpi_class, public.fn_metric_class(k.kpi, k.metric, k.unit)),
      'class_source', case when k.kpi_class is not null then 'declared' else 'inferred' end,
      'target_value', k.target_value,
      'unit',        k.unit,
      'measured',    k.actual_value is not null,
      'actual_value', k.actual_value,
      'measured_at', k.measured_at,
      'not_measured_reason', case
          when k.actual_value is not null then null
          when k.no_measure_reason is not null then k.no_measure_reason
          when coalesce(k.measure_sql,'') = '' then 'no measure_sql recorded for this KPI'
          else 'measure_sql present but has not produced a value' end,
      'serves_company_goal',           k.serves_goal,
      'serves_department_objectives',  m.objectives,
      'connects_to_revenue_target',    coalesce(k.serves_goal = 'revenue_annual', false),
      'attainment_pct', case
          when k.actual_value is null or k.target_value is null or k.target_value = 0 then null
          else round(100.0 * k.actual_value / k.target_value, 1) end
    ) x
    from public.employee_kpi k
    left join lateral (
      select jsonb_agg(o.objective order by o.objective) as objectives
        from public.department_objective o
       where o.dept_key = v_dept and o.active and o.goal_key = k.serves_goal) m on true
   where k.active and k.agent_key = any(v_agents)) s;

  -- THE SECOND OBJECTIVE TABLE. os_objective is measured (a sweep populates actual_value) and
  -- carries no goal_key at all, so nothing in it reconciles to a company goal. Hiding it would
  -- make the cascade look complete while a department's most current numbers sat outside it.
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'objective',    oo.objective,
      'measure',      oo.measure,
      'measured',     oo.actual_value is not null,
      'actual_value', oo.actual_value,
      'measured_at',  oo.measured_at,
      'reconciles_to_a_company_goal', false) order by oo.id), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_os
    from public.os_objective oo
    join public.os_department od on od.os_key = oo.os_key
   where od.dept_key = v_dept and oo.active;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'department',            v_dept,
    'department_name',       v_name,
    'asked_for',             p_dept,
    'role_filter',           p_role,
    'north_star',            v_north,
    'company_objective',     public.fn_revenue_trajectory(),
    'department_objectives', v_objectives,
    'operating_system_objectives', v_os,
    'operating_system_objectives_note',
      'A second objective table, measured but carrying no company goal_key. Listed so its numbers '
      ||'are visible; none of them reconciles upward, and that is a gap, not a link.',
    'role_kpis',             v_kpis,
    -- Counts, not a composite. There is deliberately no single number here: an average over items
    -- of which half are unmeasured is the exact instrument that reported 97.7% on a zero-revenue
    -- day, and management cannot act on it.
    'counts', jsonb_build_object(
      'department_objectives',                    jsonb_array_length(v_objectives),
      'department_objectives_linked_to_a_goal',
        (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_objectives) e
          where e->>'reconciles_to_goal' is not null),
      'department_objectives_on_the_revenue_target',
        (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_objectives) e
          where (e->>'is_the_revenue_target')::boolean),
      'department_objectives_measured',
        (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_objectives) e
          where (e->>'measured')::boolean),
      'role_kpis',                                jsonb_array_length(v_kpis),
      'role_kpis_measured',
        (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_kpis) e where (e->>'measured')::boolean),
      'role_kpis_connected_to_the_revenue_target',
        (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_kpis) e
          where (e->>'connects_to_revenue_target')::boolean),
      'role_kpis_that_are_activity_only',
        (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_kpis) e where e->>'class' = 'activity'),
      'role_kpis_unclassified',
        (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_kpis) e where e->>'class' = 'unclassified')),
    'before_you_reallocate',
      'Name the binding constraint first: select public.fn_binding_constraint(). Moving effort to a '
      ||'stage that is not binding changes this department''s activity and not the company''s revenue.');
end
fn_task_commercial_effect:
declare
  v_task bigint := (p->>'task_id')::bigint;
  v_none boolean := coalesce((p->>'no_commercial_effect')::boolean, false);
begin
  if v_task is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'task_id is required');
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from public.org_tasks where id = v_task) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'no such task', 'task_id', v_task);
  end if;

  insert into public.task_commercial_effect as t (
    task_id, no_commercial_effect, no_effect_reason,
    causal_kpi_chain, terminal_goal_key,
    expected_leading_indicator, expected_leading_value,
    expected_outcome, expected_outcome_value, expected_outcome_unit,
    expected_cost_aed, risk, measurement_window_days, owner_agent_key,
    review_trigger, review_date)
  values (
    v_task, v_none, nullif(btrim(coalesce(p->>'no_effect_reason','')),''),
    case when v_none then null else
      (select array_agg(value::text) from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(p->'causal_kpi_chain','[]'::jsonb)) value) end,
    case when v_none then null else nullif(p->>'terminal_goal_key','') end,
    nullif(p->>'expected_leading_indicator',''), (p->>'expected_leading_value')::numeric,
    nullif(p->>'expected_outcome',''), (p->>'expected_outcome_value')::numeric,
    nullif(p->>'expected_outcome_unit',''),
    (p->>'expected_cost_aed')::numeric, nullif(p->>'risk',''),
    (p->>'measurement_window_days')::int, nullif(p->>'owner_agent_key',''),
    nullif(p->>'review_trigger',''), (p->>'review_date')::date)
  on conflict (task_id) do update set
    no_commercial_effect = excluded.no_commercial_effect,
    no_effect_reason     = excluded.no_effect_reason,
    causal_kpi_chain     = excluded.causal_kpi_chain,
    terminal_goal_key    = excluded.terminal_goal_key,
    expected_leading_indicator = excluded.expected_leading_indicator,
    expected_leading_value     = excluded.expected_leading_value,
    expected_outcome     = excluded.expected_outcome,
    expected_outcome_value = excluded.expected_outcome_value,
    expected_outcome_unit  = excluded.expected_outcome_unit,
    expected_cost_aed    = excluded.expected_cost_aed,
    risk                 = excluded.risk,
    measurement_window_days = excluded.measurement_window_days,
    owner_agent_key      = excluded.owner_agent_key,
    review_trigger       = excluded.review_trigger,
    review_date          = excluded.review_date,
    updated_at           = now()
  where t.measured_at is null;   -- a measured claim is history; it is not edited after the fact

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'task_id', v_task,
    'recorded', case when v_none then 'no_commercial_effect' else 'commercial_claim' end);
exception when check_violation then
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'incomplete',
    'detail', sqlerrm,
    'required', 'Either no_commercial_effect with a reason of 10+ characters, or ALL of: '
      ||'causal_kpi_chain, terminal_goal_key, expected_leading_indicator, expected_outcome, '
      ||'expected_cost_aed, risk, measurement_window_days, owner_agent_key, review_trigger, '
      ||'review_date. A partial claim is refused rather than stored as a half-truth.');
end
fn_binding_constraint:
declare
  v_since timestamptz := now() - make_interval(days => greatest(p_days, 1));
  v_visitors_reason text;
  v_stages jsonb;
begin
  select no_measure_reason into v_visitors_reason
    from public.company_goals where key = 'website_visitors';

  with raw as (
    select
      (select count(*) from public.customers  where created_at >= v_since)              as customers,
      (select count(*) from public.inquiries  where created_at >= v_since)              as inquiries,
      (select count(distinct q.inquiry_id) from public.quotes q where q.created_at >= v_since)
                                                                                        as inquiries_quoted,
      (select count(*) from public.quotes     where created_at >= v_since)              as quotes,
      (select count(*) from public.transactions
        where revealed_at >= v_since and refund_confirmed_at is null)                   as paid_reveals,
      (select count(*) from public.supplier_capabilities where confirmed_at is not null) as confirmed_suppliers
  ),
  st as (
    select * from (values
      ('visitors_to_registration', 'Site visitors who register',      null::bigint, null::bigint,
       v_visitors_reason),
      ('registration_to_inquiry',  'Registered customers who post an inquiry',
       (select customers from raw), (select inquiries from raw), null),
      ('inquiry_to_quote',         'Inquiries that receive at least one quote',
       (select inquiries from raw), (select inquiries_quoted from raw), null),
      ('quote_to_paid_reveal',     'Quoted inquiries that reach a paid reveal',
       (select inquiries_quoted from raw), (select paid_reveals from raw), null)
    ) v(stage_key, stage, denominator, numerator, not_measurable_reason))
  select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'stage_key', stage_key,
      'stage', stage,
      'denominator', denominator,
      'numerator', numerator,
      'state', case
        when not_measurable_reason is not null then 'not_instrumented'
        when denominator is null or numerator is null then 'not_measured'
        when denominator = 0 then 'no_demand'
        else 'measured' end,
      'pass_through_pct', case
        when not_measurable_reason is not null or denominator is null
          or numerator is null or denominator = 0 then null
        else round(100.0 * numerator / denominator, 1) end,
      'reason', not_measurable_reason)
    order by stage_key)
    into v_stages from st;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'window_days', p_days,
    'stages', v_stages,
    'confirmed_suppliers', (select count(*) from public.supplier_capabilities where confirmed_at is not null),
    -- The binding stage is the lowest MEASURED pass-through. Stages that are not instrumented or
    -- have no demand are excluded from the ranking and listed separately, because a stage nobody
    -- can measure could easily be the real constraint and must not be quietly ruled out.
    'binding_stage', (
      select e->>'stage_key' from jsonb_array_elements(v_stages) e
       where e->>'state' = 'measured'
       order by (e->>'pass_through_pct')::numeric asc limit 1),
    'binding_pass_through_pct', (
      select (e->>'pass_through_pct')::numeric from jsonb_array_elements(v_stages) e
       where e->>'state' = 'measured'
       order by (e->>'pass_through_pct')::numeric asc limit 1),
    'stages_ranked', (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_stages) e
                       where e->>'state' = 'measured'),
    'stages_excluded_from_the_ranking', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('stage_key', e->>'stage_key',
                                                   'state', e->>'state',
                                                   'reason', e->>'reason')), '[]'::jsonb)
        from jsonb_array_elements(v_stages) e where e->>'state' <> 'measured'),
    'reallocation_rule',
      'Effort moved to a stage other than the binding one changes activity, not revenue. If a stage '
      ||'is listed as not_instrumented, the honest answer is that the binding constraint is not '
      ||'known yet and the first move is to instrument it.',
    'trajectory', public.fn_revenue_trajectory());
end
fn_jsonb_is_empty:
select j is null
      or j = 'null'::jsonb
      or (jsonb_typeof(j) = 'array'  and jsonb_array_length(j) = 0)
      or (jsonb_typeof(j) = 'object' and not exists (select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(j)))
      or (jsonb_typeof(j) = 'string' and btrim(j #>> '{}') = '');
fn_unsafe_check_unstated_assumption:

fn_unsafe_check_fail_open_authz:
declare v jsonb;
begin
  -- LIMB A: an executor that may run unattended, for a department+action_class pair that no
  -- org_authority row covers. Nobody decided these may act; no row said they may not.
  return query
    select 'org_action_executor', e.action_class,
           jsonb_build_object('department', e.department, 'kind', e.kind, 'risk_tier', e.risk_tier,
                              'required_authority', e.required_authority,
                              'notifies_human', e.notifies_human,
                              'why', 'unattended_ok with no org_authority row for its department and action class')
      from public.org_action_executor e
     where e.active
       and coalesce(e.unattended_ok, false)
       and not exists (select 1 from public.org_authority a
                        where a.dept_key = e.department and a.action_class = e.action_class);

  -- LIMB B: probe the guard with inputs it has never seen. Absent configuration must produce
  -- "gated", never "act freely". This limb fires only if the default itself has gone permissive —
  -- which is the failure mode a state scan can never see.
  v := public.fn_ops_authority_check('__probe_no_such_dept__', '__probe_no_such_action__', null, null);
  if coalesce((v->>'may_act_autonomously')::boolean, false)
     or not coalesce((v->>'requires_approval')::boolean, false) then
    return query select 'fn_ops_authority_check', 'default',
      jsonb_build_object('probe_result', v,
        'why', 'the authority guard returned a permissive tier for a department and action class that do not exist');
  end if;
end
fn_unsafe_check_double_refund:
-- more than one live refund against the same charge
  select 'refunds', string_agg(r.id::text, ',' order by r.id),
         jsonb_build_object('charge', k.charge, 'live_refunds', count(*),
                            'total_fils', sum(r.amount_fils),
                            'why', 'more than one refund in a live state against a single charge')
    from public.refunds r
    join lateral (select coalesce(r.stripe_charge_id, r.stripe_payment_intent,
                                  r.original_txn_id::text, r.transaction_id::text) as charge) k on true
   where coalesce(r.status,'') not in ('failed','rejected','cancelled','void','superseded')
     and k.charge is not null
   group by k.charge
  having count(*) > 1
  union all
  -- the same provider refund id recorded twice
  select 'refunds', string_agg(r.id::text, ',' order by r.id),
         jsonb_build_object('stripe_refund_id', r.stripe_refund_id, 'rows', count(*),
                            'why', 'one provider refund id recorded on more than one row')
    from public.refunds r
   where r.stripe_refund_id is not null
   group by r.stripe_refund_id
  having count(*) > 1
  union all
  -- refunded more than was charged
  select 'transactions', t.id::text,
         jsonb_build_object('reveal_fee', t.reveal_fee, 'refund_amount_aed', t.refund_amount_aed,
                            'why', 'refunded amount exceeds the fee that was charged')
    from public.transactions t
   where t.reveal_fee is not null
     and t.refund_amount_aed is not null
     and t.refund_amount_aed > t.reveal_fee;
fn_unsafe_check_credential_exposure:
with secrets as (
    select s.key, s.value
      from public.app_secrets s
     where s.value is not null
       and length(s.value) >= 24
       and (s.key ~ '^cred_' or s.key ~ '(secret|token|password|service_role)' or s.key ~ '_key$')
       and s.key not in ('anon_key','publishable_key')
  ),
  corpus as (
    select 'os_audit_log' src, id::text ref, coalesce(detail::text,'') txt from public.os_audit_log
    union all select 'org_tasks', id::text, coalesce(detail,'')||' '||coalesce(result::text,'') from public.org_tasks
    union all select 'agent_actions', id::text,
           coalesce(detail::text,'')||' '||coalesce(evidence::text,'')||' '||coalesce(recommendation,'')
      from public.agent_actions
    union all select 'notifications', id::text, coalesce(subject,'')||' '||coalesce(body,'') from public.notifications
    union all select 'agent_tool_call', id::text, coalesce(args::text,'') from public.agent_tool_call
    union all select 'decision_trace', id::text,
           coalesce(decision::text,'')||' '||coalesce(outcome::text,'')||' '||coalesce(assumptions::text,'')
      from public.decision_trace
  )
  select c.src, c.ref,
         jsonb_build_object('secret_key', s.key,
                            'why', 'the live value of this credential appears verbatim in an agent-written field')
    from corpus c join secrets s on position(s.value in c.txt) > 0
  union all
  select c.src, c.ref,
         jsonb_build_object('why', 'a credential-shaped string appears in an agent-written field')
    from corpus c
   where c.txt ~ '(sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|sk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}|eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----)';

fn_agent_tools:
with me as (
    select a.agent_key, a.department,
           coalesce((select array_agg(i.packaged_role_id) from org_role_identity i
                      where i.agent_key = a.agent_key), '{}'::text[]) as role_ids
    from org_agents a
   where a.agent_key = coalesce(public.fn_org_agent_resolve(p_agent_key), p_agent_key)
     and a.active
  )
  select t.tool_id, t.purpose, t.kind, t.impl_kind, t.impl_target,
         t.input_schema, t.timeout_seconds, t.max_attempts, t.backoff,
         t.failure_behaviour, t.requires_current_data, t.required_credential
  from agent_tool t, me
  where t.active
    and t.staging_available
    and (p_kind is null or t.kind = p_kind)
    and (t.authorised_departments = '{}'::text[]
         or '*' = any(t.authorised_departments)
         or me.department = any(t.authorised_departments))
    and (t.authorised_roles = '{}'::text[]
         or '*' = any(t.authorised_roles)
         or me.role_ids && t.authorised_roles)
  order by t.kind, t.tool_id;
fn_phase_a_organization_violations:
-- active canonical department
  select 'department_not_active', r.role_id, r.primary_department_id
    from public.org_role r
    left join public.org_departments d on d.dept_key = r.primary_department_id
   where r.status='active' and (d.dept_key is null or not d.active)
  union all
  -- primary manager, with the CEO/founder boundary as the single exception
  select 'no_primary_manager', r.role_id, 'manager_role_id is null'
    from public.org_role r
   where r.status='active' and r.runtime_mode <> 'knowledge_overlay'
     and r.manager_role_id is null and r.role_id <> 'ceo'
  union all
  select 'manager_not_active', r.role_id, r.manager_role_id
    from public.org_role r
   where r.status='active' and r.manager_role_id is not null
     and not exists (select 1 from public.org_role m where m.role_id=r.manager_role_id and m.status='active')
  union all
  -- role class: every active role declares which kind of thing it is
  select 'no_role_class', r.role_id, coalesce(r.runtime_mode,'(null)')
    from public.org_role r
   where r.status='active' and coalesce(r.runtime_mode,'') = ''
  union all
  -- necessity, and the reason for it
  select 'no_necessity_status', r.role_id, 'necessity_status is null'
    from public.org_role r
   where r.status='active' and coalesce(btrim(r.necessity_status),'') = ''
  union all
  -- organizational purpose
  select 'no_organizational_purpose', r.role_id, 'necessity_reason/responsibilities empty'
    from public.org_role r
   where r.status='active'
     and coalesce(length(btrim(r.necessity_reason)),0) < 10
     and coalesce(length(btrim(r.responsibilities)),0) < 10
  union all
  -- owned decisions. Overlays own category judgement rather than decisions, and say so in their
  -- necessity_reason, so the rule is scoped to accountable roles rather than relaxed for everyone.
  select 'no_owned_decisions', r.role_id, 'owned_decisions is empty'
    from public.org_role r
   where r.status='active' and r.runtime_mode <> 'knowledge_overlay'
     and coalesce(cardinality(r.owned_decisions),0) = 0
  union all
  -- forbidden decisions: a role with no stated limits has no limits
  select 'no_forbidden_decisions', r.role_id, 'forbidden_decisions is empty'
    from public.org_role r
   where r.status='active' and r.runtime_mode <> 'knowledge_overlay'
     and coalesce(cardinality(r.forbidden_decisions),0) = 0
  union all
  -- AT LEAST ONE WORKFLOW, REVIEW OR MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITY. This is also the rule that catches
  -- a role retained only to keep a count at 90: such a role manages nobody, owns no workflow,
  -- appears in no step and reviews nothing.
  select 'no_responsibility', r.role_id, 'owns no workflow, no step, manages nobody, reviews nothing'
    from public.org_role r
   where r.status='active' and r.runtime_mode <> 'knowledge_overlay'
     and not exists (select 1 from public.org_workflow_ownership o where o.accountable_role_id = r.role_id)
     and not exists (select 1 from public.org_workflow_step s where s.accountable_role_id = r.role_id)
     and not exists (select 1 from public.org_workflow_ownership o where o.independent_reviewer = r.role_id)
     and not exists (select 1 from public.org_role m where m.manager_role_id = r.role_id and m.status='active')
     and not exists (select 1 from public.workflow_step w where w.actor_role = r.role_id)
     and not exists (select 1 from public.employee_workflow e where e.agent_key = r.runtime_agent_key)
     -- contributing to a workflow IS a responsibility. It is not ACCOUNTABILITY, which is why
     -- contributors are still refused as owners two rules down, but a role that contributes to a
     -- workflow is doing something and is not a row kept to make a count.
     and not exists (select 1 from public.org_workflow_ownership o where r.role_id = any(o.contributors))
  union all
  -- a contributor must be an active role or one of the three declared class terms
  select 'contributor_resolves_to_nobody', o.workflow_id, c
    from public.org_workflow_ownership o, unnest(o.contributors) c
   where not exists (select 1 from public.org_role r where r.role_id = c and r.status='active')
     and c not in ('department heads', 'category overlays', 'broad domain specialists')
  union all
  -- creator/reviewer separation, at the workflow and at the role
  select 'owner_reviews_own_workflow', o.workflow_id, o.accountable_role_id
    from public.org_workflow_ownership o
   where o.independent_reviewer = o.accountable_role_id
  union all
  select 'contributor_is_owner', o.workflow_id, o.accountable_role_id
    from public.org_workflow_ownership o
   where o.accountable_role_id = any(o.contributors)
  union all
  -- founder boundary
  select 'owns_founder_reserved_decision', r.role_id, d.decision_key
    from public.org_role r, public.founder_reserved_decision d, unnest(d.match_any) m(needle)
   where r.status='active'
     and position(m.needle in lower(array_to_string(r.owned_decisions,' | '))) > 0
  union all
  -- reporting cycles, walked rather than assumed
  select 'reporting_cycle', u.root, 'chain does not terminate'
    from (
      with recursive up(root, cur, depth, path) as (
        select role_id, manager_role_id, 1, array[role_id] from public.org_role where status='active'
        union all
        select u.root, r.manager_role_id, u.depth+1, u.path || r.role_id
          from up u join public.org_role r on r.role_id = u.cur and r.status='active'
         where u.depth < 30 and not r.role_id = any(u.path))
      select distinct root from up where depth >= 30) u
  union all
  select 'self_management', r.role_id, r.manager_role_id
    from public.org_role r where r.status='active' and r.manager_role_id = r.role_id
  union all
  -- duplicate active role identity
  select 'duplicate_active_identity', x.runtime_agent_key, 'held by more than one active role'
    from (select runtime_agent_key from public.org_role
           where status='active' and runtime_agent_key is not null
           group by 1 having count(*) > 1) x
  union all
  -- unresolved historical alias, both directions
  select 'retired_role_resolves_to_nobody', r.role_id, 'no alias'
    from public.org_role r
   where r.status = 'retired'
     and not exists (select 1 from public.org_role_alias a where a.alias = r.role_id)
  union all
  select 'alias_points_at_a_dead_role', a.alias, a.role_id
    from public.org_role_alias a
    join public.org_role r on r.role_id = a.role_id
   where r.status <> 'active'
  union all
  -- overlay ownership
  select 'overlay_is_not_a_category_overlay', r.role_id, 'not category_overlay_NNN_'
    from public.org_role r
   where r.status='active' and r.runtime_mode='knowledge_overlay'
     and r.role_id !~ '^category_overlay_[0-9]{3}_'
  union all
  select 'overlay_holds_a_runtime_employee', r.role_id, r.runtime_agent_key
    from public.org_role r
   where r.status='active' and r.runtime_mode='knowledge_overlay' and r.runtime_agent_key is not null
  union all
  select 'overlay_owns_a_workflow', o.workflow_id, o.accountable_role_id
    from public.org_workflow_ownership o join public.org_role r on r.role_id = o.accountable_role_id
   where r.runtime_mode = 'knowledge_overlay'
  union all
  select 'overlay_states_no_limit', r.role_id, 'necessity_reason does not say what it cannot decide'
    from public.org_role r
   where r.status='active' and r.runtime_mode='knowledge_overlay'
     and coalesce(r.necessity_reason,'') not ilike '%cannot decide%';
fn_phase_a_deferred_items:
select 'DEFERRED_TO_LATER_PHASES', v.rule, v.role_id, v.detail
    from public.fn_org_role_violations_all() v
   where v.rule in ('no_kpi','no_knowledge','no_authority','no_tools','no_evaluation',
                    'runtime_agent_inactive','no_model_policy');
fn_phase_b_resolve_role:
select r.role_id
  from public.org_role r
  where r.status = 'active'
    and r.runtime_mode <> 'knowledge_overlay'
    and r.role_id = coalesce(
      (select role_id from public.org_role where role_id = p_token and status = 'active'),
      (select a.role_id from public.org_role_alias a where a.alias = p_token limit 1)
    )
  limit 1;
fn_phase_b_transition_allowed:
select exists (select 1 from public.phase_b_workflow_transition
                  where from_state = p_from and to_state = p_to);
fn_phase_b_step_transition_allowed:
select exists (select 1 from public.phase_b_step_transition
                  where from_state = p_from and to_state = p_to);

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ business integrity
integrity(check_name, expected, actual) as (
  values
    -- W12 dispatch must sit behind quote readiness, an approved safe package and an approved
    -- supplier.  Readiness is DECIDED in W05 under GATE-011 and consumed by W12 through its
    -- start event, so a check that demanded a gate literally scoped to W12 was measuring
    -- something other than what it names.  What the invariant actually requires is that the
    -- dispatch workflow cannot start without readiness having been established upstream, and
    -- that the gate establishing it exists.  Both halves are asserted.
    ('integrity.dispatch_start_event_requires_quote_ready', '0',
      (select count(*)::text from public.phase_b_workflow
        where workflow_id = 'W12' and start_event !~* 'quote.?ready')),
    ('integrity.quote_readiness_gate_absent_upstream', '0',
      (case when exists (select 1 from public.phase_b_gate
                          where gate_name ~* 'quote.?read'
                            and (workflow_scope like '%W05%' or workflow_scope like '%W12%'))
            then '0' else '1' end)),
    ('integrity.dispatch_start_event_requires_safe_package', '0',
      (select count(*)::text from public.phase_b_workflow
        where workflow_id = 'W12' and start_event !~* 'supplier.?safe')),
    ('integrity.dispatch_without_safe_package_gate', '0',
      (case when exists (select 1 from public.phase_b_gate where workflow_scope like '%W12%'
                          and gate_name ~* 'safe') then '0' else '1' end)),
    ('integrity.dispatch_without_approved_supplier_gate', '0',
      (case when exists (select 1 from public.phase_b_gate where workflow_scope like '%W12%'
                          and gate_name ~* 'supplier') then '0' else '1' end)),
    ('integrity.dispatch_without_idempotency_gate', '0',
      (case when exists (select 1 from public.phase_b_gate where workflow_scope like '%W12%'
                          and gate_name ~* 'idempot') then '0' else '1' end)),
    -- every W12 step must declare an idempotency scope, or "duplicate assignment path = 0"
    -- is a promise nothing keeps
    ('integrity.dispatch_steps_without_idempotency_scope', '0',
      (select count(*)::text from public.phase_b_workflow_step
        where workflow_id = 'W12' and coalesce(idempotency_scope,'') = '')),
    ('integrity.reveal_without_reconciled_payment_gate', '0',
      (case when exists (select 1 from public.phase_b_gate where workflow_scope like '%W15%'

    ('integrity.mutable_accepted_terms_record', '0',

    ('integrity.mutable_approved_safe_package', '0',
      (select count(*)::text from public.phase_b_business_object
        where object_id ~* 'safe' and record_policy not in ('immutable','immutable_after_approval','append_only'))),
    ('integrity.platform_rewrites_supplier_quotation', '0',

       case when c.expected = 'gt0' then c.actual = 'gt0' else c.actual = c.expected end

  select * from counts union all select * from owners union all select * from coverage
  union all select * from graph union all select * from handoffs union all select * from authority
  union all select * from integrity union all select * from boundaries
) c
order by 1;
fn_phase_b_gate_attachment:
with scoped as (
    -- expand workflow_scope; 'ALL' means every canonical workflow. Both ';' and '/' appear as
    -- separators across the package's registries, so both are split on.
    select g.gate_id, g.gate_name, g.gate_type, w.workflow_id
    from public.phase_b_gate g
    join public.phase_b_workflow w
      on g.workflow_scope = 'ALL'
      or w.workflow_id = any (string_to_array(replace(g.workflow_scope, '/', ';'), ';'))
  )
  -- gates that govern the phase rather than a step
  select s.gate_id, s.workflow_id, null::text, 'phase_level'
  from scoped s
  where s.gate_type = 'phase_boundary' or s.gate_id = 'GATE-001'

  union all
  -- GATE-008 closure completeness -> the workflow's closure step
  select s.gate_id, s.workflow_id, st.step_id, 'declared_step_property'
  from scoped s
  join public.phase_b_workflow_step st on st.workflow_id = s.workflow_id and st.is_closure_step
  where s.gate_id = 'GATE-008'

  union all
  -- GATE-005 founder boundary -> steps that carry a founder gate
  select s.gate_id, s.workflow_id, st.step_id, 'declared_step_property'
  from scoped s
  join public.phase_b_workflow_step st on st.workflow_id = s.workflow_id
   and st.founder_gate is not null and lower(st.founder_gate) <> 'none'
  where s.gate_id = 'GATE-005'

  union all
  -- GATE-004 creator/reviewer separation -> steps that carry an independent reviewer
  select s.gate_id, s.workflow_id, st.step_id, 'declared_step_property'
  from scoped s
  join public.phase_b_workflow_step st on st.workflow_id = s.workflow_id
   and st.independent_reviewer_role_id is not null
  where s.gate_id = 'GATE-004'

  union all
  -- GATE-007 complete handoff -> steps that send one
  select distinct s.gate_id, s.workflow_id, h.from_step_id, 'declared_step_property'
  from scoped s
  join public.phase_b_handoff h on h.workflow_id = s.workflow_id
  where s.gate_id = 'GATE-007'

  union all
  -- gates that govern every step
  select s.gate_id, s.workflow_id, st.step_id, 'universal'
  from scoped s
  join public.phase_b_workflow_step st on st.workflow_id = s.workflow_id
  where s.gate_id in ('GATE-002','GATE-003','GATE-006')

  union all
  -- workflow-scoped gates with no finer anchor declared in the package
  select s.gate_id, s.workflow_id, st.step_id, 'workflow_scope'
  from scoped s
  join public.phase_b_workflow_step st on st.workflow_id = s.workflow_id
  where s.gate_id not in ('GATE-001','GATE-002','GATE-003','GATE-004','GATE-005',
                          'GATE-006','GATE-007','GATE-008')
    and s.gate_type <> 'phase_boundary';
fn_phase_b_effective_errata:
select 'EX-006',
         'exception is complete: escalation owner, required response and closure condition present, and escalation is independent of detection',
         format('escalation=%s detection=%s response=%s closure=%s',
                e.escalation_owner_role_id, e.detection_owner_role_id,
                case when e.required_response <> '' then 'present' else 'MISSING' end,
                case when e.closure_condition <> '' then 'present' else 'MISSING' end),
         e.escalation_owner_role_id <> '' and e.required_response <> ''
           and e.closure_condition <> '' and e.escalation_owner_role_id <> e.detection_owner_role_id
  from public.phase_b_exception e where e.exception_id = 'EX-006'

  union all
  select 'W13',
         'primary business object references an existing canonical object',
         format('primary_object=%s exists=%s', w.primary_object, (o.object_id is not null)),
         o.object_id is not null
  from public.phase_b_workflow w
  left join public.phase_b_business_object o on o.object_id = w.primary_object
  where w.workflow_id = 'W13'

  union all
  select 'W22',
         'workflow has exactly one explicit closure step, it is the step reaching WORKFLOW_COMPLETE, and GATE-008 is attached to it',
         format('closure_steps=%s reaches_complete=%s gate_008_attached_to=%s',
                (select count(*) from public.phase_b_workflow_step where workflow_id='W22' and is_closure_step),
                (select bool_and(next_step_if_pass = 'WORKFLOW_COMPLETE')
                   from public.phase_b_workflow_step where workflow_id='W22' and is_closure_step),
                coalesce((select string_agg(a.step_id, ',') from public.fn_phase_b_gate_attachment() a
                           where a.gate_id='GATE-008' and a.workflow_id='W22'), 'NONE')),
         (select count(*) from public.phase_b_workflow_step where workflow_id='W22' and is_closure_step) = 1
         and (select bool_and(next_step_if_pass = 'WORKFLOW_COMPLETE')
                from public.phase_b_workflow_step where workflow_id='W22' and is_closure_step)
         and exists (select 1 from public.fn_phase_b_gate_attachment() a
                      where a.gate_id='GATE-008' and a.workflow_id='W22' and a.step_id is not null);
fn_phase_b_structure_digest:
with
-- workflow ownership: who is accountable, and who independently reviews
workflow_ownership as (
  select w.workflow_id sortkey,
         w.workflow_id||'|'||w.accountable_role_id||'|'||coalesce(w.independent_reviewer_role_id,'') x
  from public.phase_b_workflow w
),
step_ownership as (
  select s.step_id sortkey,
         s.step_id||'|'||s.accountable_role_id||'|'||coalesce(s.independent_reviewer_role_id,'')
         ||'|'||s.actor_kind x
  from public.phase_b_workflow_step s
),
-- workflow order: sequence and both onward paths
workflow_order as (
  select s.step_id sortkey,
         s.workflow_id||'|'||s.step_no::text||'|'||s.step_id||'|'||s.next_step_if_pass
         ||'|'||s.next_step_if_fail||'|'||s.is_closure_step::text x
  from public.phase_b_workflow_step s
),
-- states and transitions, workflow and step
states_and_transitions as (
  select 'A'||state sortkey, 'wf_state|'||state||'|'||terminal::text x from public.phase_b_workflow_state
  union all
  select 'B'||state, 'step_state|'||state||'|'||terminal::text from public.phase_b_step_state
  union all
  select 'C'||from_state||'>'||to_state, 'wf_transition|'||from_state||'|'||to_state
    from public.phase_b_workflow_transition
  union all
  select 'D'||from_state||'>'||to_state, 'step_transition|'||from_state||'|'||to_state
    from public.phase_b_step_transition
),
gates as (
  select g.gate_id sortkey,
         g.gate_id||'|'||g.gate_name||'|'||g.workflow_scope||'|'||g.gate_type
         ||'|'||g.required_evidence||'|'||g.pass_result||'|'||g.fail_result x
  from public.phase_b_gate g
),
business_rules as (
  select r.rule_id sortkey, r.rule_id||'|'||r.rule_name||'|'||r.workflow_scope||'|'||r.rule_type
         ||'|'||r.rule_text x
  from public.phase_b_business_rule r
),
-- handoff accountability: the three named parties and the edge they sit on
handoff_accountability as (
  select h.handoff_id sortkey,
         h.handoff_id||'|'||h.from_step_id||'|'||h.to_step_id||'|'||h.sending_role_id
         ||'|'||h.receiving_role_id||'|'||h.return_owner_role_id||'|'||h.handoff_type x
  from public.phase_b_handoff h
),
-- category-overlay authority: where an overlay may be accountable, and which placeholders may be
overlay_authority as (
  select 'A'||s.step_id sortkey, 'overlay_step|'||s.step_id||'|'||s.workflow_id||'|'||s.step_type x
  from public.phase_b_workflow_step s where s.actor_kind = 'category_overlay'
  union all
  select 'B'||a.actor_token, 'actor|'||a.actor_token||'|'||a.actor_type||'|'||a.may_be_accountable::text
  from public.phase_b_dynamic_actor a
),
founder_boundaries as (
  select b.boundary_id sortkey,
         b.boundary_id||'|'||b.boundary_name||'|'||b.workflow_scope||'|'||b.decision_owner
         ||'|'||b.phase_b_enforcement x
  from public.phase_b_founder_boundary b
),
all_subjects as (
  select 'workflow_ownership' s, sortkey, x from workflow_ownership
  union all select 'step_ownership', sortkey, x from step_ownership
  union all select 'workflow_order', sortkey, x from workflow_order
  union all select 'states_and_transitions', sortkey, x from states_and_transitions
  union all select 'gates', sortkey, x from gates
  union all select 'business_rules', sortkey, x from business_rules
  union all select 'handoff_accountability', sortkey, x from handoff_accountability
  union all select 'overlay_authority', sortkey, x from overlay_authority
  union all select 'founder_boundaries', sortkey, x from founder_boundaries
)
select s,
       count(*)::bigint,
       encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(x, chr(10) order by sortkey), 'UTF8')), 'hex')
from all_subjects group by s order by s;
fn_phase_c_trace_write:
declare v_id bigint; v_status text;
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.phase_c_trace_policy where trace_policy_id = p_policy) then
    raise exception 'unknown trace policy %', p_policy using errcode = '23503';
  end if;
  v_status := coalesce(p_body->>'status','open');
  insert into public.phase_c_trace (
    trace_policy_id, subject_kind, subject_ref, command_id, run_id, step_run_id, task_id,
    actor_role_id, manager_role_id, system_actor_id, component_id, authority_result,
    reviewer_role_id, reviewer_independent, gates, rules, evidence_refs, input_hash,
    output_hash, state_before, state_after, event_ids, status, sealed_at, parent_trace_id)
  values (
    p_policy,
    coalesce(p_body->>'subject_kind', 'unknown'), coalesce(p_body->>'subject_ref', ''),
    (p_body->>'command_id')::bigint, (p_body->>'run_id')::bigint,
    (p_body->>'step_run_id')::bigint, (p_body->>'task_id')::bigint,
    coalesce(p_body->>'actor_role_id',''), coalesce(p_body->>'manager_role_id',''),
    coalesce(p_body->>'system_actor_id',''), coalesce(p_body->>'component_id',''),
    coalesce(p_body->>'authority_result',''), coalesce(p_body->>'reviewer_role_id',''),
    (p_body->>'reviewer_independent')::boolean,
    coalesce(p_body->'gates','[]'::jsonb), coalesce(p_body->'rules','[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce(p_body->'evidence_refs','[]'::jsonb), coalesce(p_body->>'input_hash',''),
    coalesce(p_body->>'output_hash',''), coalesce(p_body->>'state_before',''),
    coalesce(p_body->>'state_after',''), coalesce(p_body->'event_ids','[]'::jsonb),
    v_status,
    case when v_status = 'sealed' then now() end,
    (p_body->>'parent_trace_id')::bigint)
  returning trace_id into v_id;
  if v_id is null then
    raise exception 'phase_c_trace_write produced no row for policy %', p_policy using errcode = '23502';
  end if;
  return v_id;
end
fn_phase_c_workflow_transition_allowed:
select exists (select 1 from public.phase_b_workflow_transition
                 where from_state = p_from and to_state = p_to);
fn_phase_c_task_transition_allowed:
select exists (select 1 from public.phase_c_task_transition
                 where from_state = p_from and to_state = p_to);
fn_phase_c_outbox_claim:
begin
  return query
  update public.phase_c_event_outbox o set status = 'claimed', claimed_at = now(), attempts = o.attempts + 1
  where o.outbox_id in (
    select outbox_id from public.phase_c_event_outbox
    where status in ('pending','retry_wait') and next_attempt_at <= now()
    order by outbox_id for update skip locked limit greatest(1, coalesce(p_limit, 20)))
  returning *;
end
fn_phase_c_outbox_settle:
begin
  raise exception
    'fn_phase_c_outbox_settle is READ_ONLY_HISTORICAL and no longer settles anything (outbox_id %)',
    p_outbox_id
    using errcode = '23514',
          detail = 'It is recorded READ_ONLY_HISTORICAL in kernel_retired_path and it was still '
                || 'updating phase_c_event_outbox, which is not read-only by any reading. It also '
                || 'carried a latent cast defect that surfaced as "invalid input syntax for type '
                || 'timestamp with time zone" whenever it was called with an empty error string.',
          hint = 'fn_kernel_outbox_deliver is the delivery worker and has been since K5. It claims '
              || 'a batch, records each attempt, and marks delivered only in its success branch. '
              || 'The rows this routine settled historically are untouched and still readable.';
end
fn_founder_command_message_immutable:
begin
  raise exception 'founder_command_message %: the founder''s own words are append-only', old.message_id
    using errcode = '23514';
end
fn_phase_c_no_new_founder_approval_path:
begin
  raise exception
    'Phase C founder autonomy: % is not an approval path any more. The founder receives exactly one routine manual approval, a specific refund decision. Route this to the internal authority gate (fn_phase_c_authority_check) instead.',
    tg_table_name using errcode = '23514';
end
fn_phase_c_non_refund_founder_approvals:
select (select count(*) from public.founder_approval_request
           where action_class <> 'refund_decision' and state = 'pending')
       + (select count(*) from public.founder_release_approval where approved_at is null)
       + (select count(*) from public.procurement_approval_request where status = 'pending');
fn_phase_c_task_create:
declare v_id bigint; v_owner text; v_manager text; v_dept text; v_key text;
begin
  select role_id into v_owner from public.fn_phase_c_resolve_actor(p_body->>'accountable_role_id');
  if v_owner is null or not public.fn_phase_c_actor_may_own(v_owner) then
    raise exception 'fn_phase_c_task_create: owner % does not resolve to an active canonical role',
      coalesce(p_body->>'accountable_role_id', '(null)') using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  select r.manager_role_id, r.primary_department_id into v_manager, v_dept
    from public.org_role r where r.role_id = v_owner;
  v_key := coalesce(nullif(p_body->>'idempotency_key',''),
    'task:' || md5(coalesce(p_body->>'source_ref','') || ':' || v_owner || ':' || coalesce(p_body->>'objective','')));
  insert into public.phase_c_task (
    source_kind, source_ref, command_id, run_id, workflow_id, step_id, accountable_role_id,
    manager_role_id, department_id, objective, required_inputs, requested_output,
    acceptance_criteria, closure_criteria, priority, due_at, sla_policy_id, reviewer_required,
    reviewer_role_id, authority_class, idempotency_key, state)
  values (
    coalesce(p_body->>'source_kind','management'), coalesce(p_body->>'source_ref',''),
    (p_body->>'command_id')::bigint, (p_body->>'run_id')::bigint,
    nullif(p_body->>'workflow_id',''), nullif(p_body->>'step_id',''),
    v_owner, coalesce(v_manager,''), coalesce(v_dept,''),
    coalesce(p_body->>'objective','(objective not stated)'),
    coalesce(p_body->>'required_inputs',''), coalesce(p_body->>'requested_output',''),
    coalesce(p_body->>'acceptance_criteria','Evidence-backed outcome accepted by the manager.'),
    coalesce(p_body->>'closure_criteria','Closure criteria of the bound workflow satisfied.'),
    coalesce(p_body->>'priority','P2'), (p_body->>'due_at')::timestamptz,
    coalesce(p_body->>'sla_policy_id',''),
    coalesce((p_body->>'reviewer_required')::boolean, false),
    coalesce(p_body->>'reviewer_role_id',''),
    coalesce(p_body->>'authority_class','routine_operational_decision'),
    v_key, 'queued')
  on conflict (idempotency_key) do nothing
  returning task_id into v_id;
  if v_id is null then
    select task_id into v_id from public.phase_c_task where idempotency_key = v_key;
  end if;
  if v_id is null then
    raise exception 'fn_phase_c_task_create wrote no row and found none for key %', v_key using errcode = '23502';
  end if;
  return v_id;
end
fn_phase_c_handoff_overdue:
select h.handoff_run_id, h.handoff_id, h.sending_role_id, h.receiving_role_id, h.due_at,
         round(extract(epoch from (now() - h.due_at)) / 3600.0, 1)
  from public.phase_c_handoff_run h
  where h.status = 'open' and h.due_at is not null and h.due_at < now()
  order by h.due_at;
fn_phase_c_baseline_drift: select check_name, expected, actual from public.fn_phase_c_invariants() where not ok;
fn_phase_c_gates_for_step:
select g.gate_id, g.gate_name, g.gate_type, g.workflow_scope
  from public.phase_b_workflow_step s
  join public.phase_b_gate g
    on g.workflow_scope = 'ALL'
    or s.workflow_id = any (string_to_array(replace(g.workflow_scope, ' ', ''), ';'))
  where s.step_id = p_step_id
  order by g.gate_id;
fn_founder_command_inbox:
select jsonb_build_object(
    'as_of', now(),
    'commands', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(x order by x->>'command_id' desc) from (
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'command_id', c.command_id, 'state', c.state, 'intent', c.intent_id,
          'outcome', c.outcome, 'priority', c.priority, 'due_at', c.due_at,
          'said', left(m.raw_text, 240), 'at', c.created_at,
          'owner', c.command_owner_role_id,
          'plan', (select p.summary from public.founder_command_plan p where p.command_id = c.command_id),
          'clarification', (select cl.question from public.founder_command_clarification cl
                            where cl.command_id = c.command_id and cl.answered_at is null
                            order by cl.clarification_id desc limit 1),
          'tasks_open', (select count(*) from public.phase_c_task t
                         where t.command_id = c.command_id and t.closed_at is null),
          'tasks_blocked', (select count(*) from public.phase_c_task t
                            where t.command_id = c.command_id and t.state = 'blocked'),
          'owners', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(distinct t.accountable_role_id), '[]'::jsonb)
                     from public.phase_c_task t where t.command_id = c.command_id),
          'overlays_invoked', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(o.overlay_id), '[]'::jsonb)
                               from public.founder_command_overlay_invocation o where o.command_id = c.command_id)
        ) x
        from public.founder_command c
        join public.founder_command_message m on m.message_id = c.message_id
        order by c.command_id desc
        limit greatest(1, coalesce(p_limit, 25))
      ) s), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- The ONE thing that is his to decide.  Nothing else in the company reaches this list.
    'awaiting_your_decision', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'request_id', a.request_id, 'transaction', a.subject_ref, 'prepared_by', a.prepared_by_role_id,
        'note', a.amount_note, 'since', a.created_at, 'command_id', a.command_id))
      from public.founder_approval_request a where a.state = 'pending'), '[]'::jsonb),
    'blocked_tasks', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'task_id', t.task_id, 'owner', t.accountable_role_id, 'manager', t.manager_role_id,
        'blocker', t.blocker, 'resolution_owner', t.blocker_owner_role_id, 'since', t.updated_at))
      from public.phase_c_task t where t.state = 'blocked'), '[]'::jsonb),
    'overdue_handoffs', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'handoff_run_id', h.handoff_run_id, 'handoff', h.handoff_id, 'sender', h.sender,
        'receiver', h.receiver, 'hours_late', h.hours_late))
      from public.fn_phase_c_handoff_overdue() h), '[]'::jsonb),
    'counts', jsonb_build_object(
      'commands', (select count(*) from public.founder_command),
      'open_commands', (select count(*) from public.founder_command where closed_at is null),
      'open_tasks', (select count(*) from public.phase_c_task where closed_at is null),
      'awaiting_founder', (select count(*) from public.founder_approval_request where state = 'pending'),
      'non_refund_awaiting_founder', public.fn_phase_c_non_refund_founder_approvals())
  );
fn_founder_command_thread:
select jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', c.command_id is not null,
    'command_id', c.command_id,
    'said', m.raw_text,
    'said_at', m.received_at,
    'said_by', m.founder_identity,
    'secretary', c.command_owner_role_id,

                      where i.command_id = c.command_id order by i.version desc limit 1),
    'intent', c.intent_id,
    'outcome', c.outcome,
    'state', c.state,
    'priority', c.priority,
    'due_at', c.due_at,
    'workflows', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(w.workflow_id || ' — ' || b.workflow_name order by w.workflow_id)

                           where w.command_id = c.command_id), '[]'::jsonb),

                          'manager', t.manager_role_id,
                          'department', t.department_id,
                          'state', t.state,
                          'objective', left(t.objective, 300),
                          'acceptance', t.acceptance_criteria,
                          'closure', t.closure_criteria,
                          'reviewer', nullif(t.reviewer_role_id, ''),
                          'blocker', nullif(t.blocker, ''),
                          'blocker_owner', nullif(t.blocker_owner_role_id, ''),
                          'due_at', t.due_at,
                          'trace_id', t.trace_id) order by t.task_id)
                       from public.phase_c_task t where t.command_id = c.command_id), '[]'::jsonb),

                            'task_id', n.task_id, 'note', n.note, 'evidence', n.evidence,
                            'trace_id', n.trace_id) order by n.note_id)
                          from public.founder_command_progress_note n
                          where n.command_id = c.command_id), '[]'::jsonb),
    'overlays_invoked', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(o.overlay_id order by o.overlay_id)
                                  from public.founder_command_overlay_invocation o
                                  where o.command_id = c.command_id), '[]'::jsonb),
    'clarification', (select cl.question from public.founder_command_clarification cl
                      where cl.command_id = c.command_id order by cl.clarification_id desc limit 1),
    'completion', (select jsonb_build_object('summary', k.summary, 'evidence', k.evidence, 'at', k.closed_at)
                   from public.founder_command_completion k where k.command_id = c.command_id),
    'history', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(

fn_phase_c_reporting_map_drift:
-- FIRST, THE SUBJECT ITSELF. Every other branch below reads phase_c_reporting_authority, so an
  -- empty table would make all of them return nothing and the check would report perfect agreement
  -- with an authority that is no longer there. Absent input must not score as satisfied: the row
  -- count is asserted against the founder-approved shape before anything is compared to it.
  select 'authority_not_recorded', 'phase_c_reporting_authority',
         '90 standing roles', count(*)::text
    from public.phase_c_reporting_authority having count(*) <> 90
  union all
  select 'overlay_authority_not_recorded', 'phase_c_overlay_binding',
         '86 category overlays', count(*)::text
    from public.phase_c_overlay_binding having count(*) <> 86
  union all
  -- a standing role the map names that the organisation cannot resolve
  select 'unresolved_role', a.canonical_role_id, a.live_role_id, '(no active org_role)'
    from public.phase_c_reporting_authority a
   where not exists (select 1 from public.org_role r
                      where r.role_id = a.live_role_id and r.status = 'active')
  union all
  select 'primary_manager', a.canonical_role_id, a.manager_role_id, coalesce(r.manager_role_id,'founder')
    from public.phase_c_reporting_authority a
    join public.org_role r on r.role_id = a.live_role_id
   where coalesce(r.manager_role_id,'founder') is distinct from a.manager_role_id
  union all
  select 'primary_department', a.canonical_role_id, a.department_id, r.primary_department_id
    from public.phase_c_reporting_authority a
    join public.org_role r on r.role_id = a.live_role_id
   where r.primary_department_id is distinct from a.department_id
  union all
  select 'role_class', a.canonical_role_id, a.role_class||'/'||a.runtime_mode, r.runtime_mode
    from public.phase_c_reporting_authority a
    join public.org_role r on r.role_id = a.live_role_id
   where r.runtime_mode is distinct from a.runtime_mode
  union all
  -- the department head the map names must be the head the department records
  select 'department_head', a.canonical_role_id, a.department_head_role_id, coalesce(d.lead_agent,'(none)')
    from public.phase_c_reporting_authority a
    join public.org_departments d on d.dept_key = a.department_id
    left join public.org_role h on h.role_id = a.department_head_role_id
   where d.lead_agent is distinct from h.runtime_agent_key
  union all
  -- the path to the founder, WALKED in the live graph rather than assumed, and compared with the
  -- approved path. This is also the cycle check: a chain that loops never reaches the founder, so
  -- the walk returns null and the row is reported.
  select 'reporting_path', a.canonical_role_id, a.reporting_path, coalesce(w.walked,'(never reaches the founder)')
    from public.phase_c_reporting_authority a
    left join lateral (
      with recursive up(cur, depth, path) as (
        select a.live_role_id, 0, a.live_role_id
        union all
        select coalesce(r.manager_role_id,'founder'), u.depth+1,
               u.path||' > '||coalesce(r.manager_role_id,'founder')
          from up u join public.org_role r on r.role_id = u.cur and r.status='active'
         where u.depth < 20 and u.cur <> 'founder')
      select path as walked from up where cur = 'founder' order by depth limit 1
    ) w on true
   where w.walked is distinct from a.reporting_path
  union all
  -- one live role standing in for two canonical roles
  select 'duplicate_active_identity', x.live_role_id, 'one canonical role', x.n::text
    from (select live_role_id, count(*) n from public.phase_c_reporting_authority
           group by 1 having count(*) > 1) x
  union all
  select 'self_management', a.canonical_role_id, a.manager_role_id, r.manager_role_id
    from public.phase_c_reporting_authority a
    join public.org_role r on r.role_id = a.live_role_id
   where r.manager_role_id = r.role_id
  union all
  -- An identity that cannot act, or one that acts as an employee nobody models.
  --
  -- runtime_enabled=false is treated separately from the rest, and deliberately so. Phase A
  -- deferred product_ux_designer's tools, knowledge, KPI and authority to a later phase with the
  -- founder's approval, and switching the role OFF is the correct consequence of that deferral —
  -- a role left enabled with no tools is the worse state, not the better one. So a disabled role
  -- is reported unless fn_phase_a_deferred_items() is currently carrying it. That exemption is not
  -- a hole: it is checked against the live deferral list on every call, so the moment the deferral
  -- is closed — or the moment any OTHER role is switched off — this fires. A missing agent key, an
  -- agent absent from org_agents, or an inactive agent are never exempt.
  select 'identity_cannot_act', a.canonical_role_id, 'an active runtime identity',
         coalesce(r.runtime_agent_key,'(none)')
           || case when r.runtime_enabled then '' else ' runtime_enabled=false' end
           || case when g.agent_key is null then ' not in org_agents'
                   when g.active is not true then ' agent inactive' else '' end
    from public.phase_c_reporting_authority a
    join public.org_role r on r.role_id = a.live_role_id
    left join public.org_agents g on g.agent_key = r.runtime_agent_key
   where r.runtime_agent_key is null
      or g.agent_key is null
      or g.active is not true
      or (r.runtime_enabled is not true
          and not exists (select 1 from public.fn_phase_a_deferred_items() d
                           where d.role_id = r.role_id))
  union all
  -- OVERLAYS: the governance facts the founder's instruction lists, one row per failing overlay
  select 'overlay_unbound', o.overlay_id, 'a live category overlay', coalesce(o.live_role_id,'(none)')
    from public.phase_c_overlay_binding o
   where not exists (select 1 from public.org_role r
                      where r.role_id = o.live_role_id and r.status='active'
                        and r.runtime_mode='knowledge_overlay')
  union all
  select 'overlay_department', o.overlay_id, 'marketplace', r.primary_department_id
    from public.phase_c_overlay_binding o join public.org_role r on r.role_id = o.live_role_id
   where r.primary_department_id is distinct from 'marketplace'
  union all
  select 'overlay_accountable_manager', o.overlay_id, 'marketplace_director reachable',
         array_to_string(r.escalation_targets,'+')
    from public.phase_c_overlay_binding o join public.org_role r on r.role_id = o.live_role_id
   where not ('marketplace_director' = any(r.escalation_targets))
  union all
  select 'overlay_invocation_role', o.overlay_id, 'inquiry_router', coalesce(o.invocation_role_id,'(none)')
    from public.phase_c_overlay_binding o
   where o.invocation_role_id is distinct from 'inquiry_router'
  union all
  select 'overlay_result_returns_to', o.overlay_id, 'rfq_qualification_manager',
         coalesce(o.result_returns_to_role_id,'(none)')
    from public.phase_c_overlay_binding o
   where o.result_returns_to_role_id is distinct from 'rfq_qualification_manager'
  union all
  select 'overlay_returns_unreachable', o.overlay_id, 'rfq_qualification_manager in handoff_targets',
         array_to_string(r.handoff_targets,'+')
    from public.phase_c_overlay_binding o join public.org_role r on r.role_id = o.live_role_id
   where not ('rfq_qualification_manager' = any(r.handoff_targets))
  union all
  select 'overlay_broad_domain_escalation', o.overlay_id,
         coalesce(o.broad_domain_escalation_role_id,'(unrecorded)'), array_to_string(r.escalation_targets,'+')
    from public.phase_c_overlay_binding o join public.org_role r on r.role_id = o.live_role_id
   where o.broad_domain_escalation_role_id is null
      or not (o.broad_domain_escalation_role_id = any(r.escalation_targets))
  union all
  -- the three governance owners the map names must exist and be able to act
  select 'overlay_governance_owner', g.who, g.who, 'missing or not active'
    from (values ('category_curator'),('taxonomy_manager'),('knowledge_validator')) g(who)
   where not exists (select 1 from public.org_role r where r.role_id = g.who and r.status='active')
  union all
  -- an overlay that could decide something the map forbids it
  select 'overlay_authority', o.overlay_id, 'advisory, holding no runtime employee',
         r.authority_level||coalesce(' as '||r.runtime_agent_key,'')
    from public.phase_c_overlay_binding o join public.org_role r on r.role_id = o.live_role_id
   where r.authority_level <> 'advisory' or r.runtime_agent_key is not null
  union all
  select 'overlay_states_no_money_limit', o.overlay_id, 'cannot move money or decide a refund',
         'no such forbidden_decision'
    from public.phase_c_overlay_binding o join public.org_role r on r.role_id = o.live_role_id
   where not exists (select 1 from unnest(r.forbidden_decisions) f where f ilike '%money%')
  union all
  -- THE CHAIN OF COMMAND. Normal autonomous work may not route through the founder or the Chief of
  -- Staff. The two founder-facing workflows are the declared exception — W01 founder mandate to
  -- company objectives, W02 company target miss and corrective management — and they are named
  -- rather than pattern-matched, so a new workflow cannot quietly join them.
  select 'autonomous_work_routes_through_chief_of_staff', s.step_id,
         'an accountable department role', s.accountable_role_id
    from public.phase_c_step_binding s
   where s.accountable_role_id in ('chief_of_staff','founder')
     and s.workflow_id not in ('W01','W02')
  union all
  -- the founder's single routine approval
  select 'non_refund_founder_approval', c.action_class, 'refund_decision is the only one',
         'founder_approval_required'
    from public.phase_c_action_class c
   where c.founder_approval_required and c.action_class <> 'refund_decision';
