fn_phase_d_injected_defect_report:
select r.defect_id,
         r.category,
         coalesce(p.verdict, r.status)                                            as status,
         case when p.probe_id is null then r.observed
              else p.observed || ' [§8 probe ' || p.probe_id
                   || coalesce(' · HTTP ' || p.http_status::text, '')
                   || ' · executed ' || to_char(p.ran_at at time zone 'utc','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || 'Z]'
         end                                                                      as observed,
         -- The nine §8 defects with no probe mapping keep their specific mechanism text, but the
         -- prefix is corrected: "SECTION 8 NOT BUILT" became false on 19 Aug 2026 when the seven
         -- probes ran. Leaving it would be a blocker that lies about why it is a blocker — the
         -- reader would conclude the capability is missing when it exists and simply does not
         -- reach this case. The replace is a no-op on the 29 non-§8 NOT_RUN rows.
         case when p.probe_id is not null then null
              else replace(r.blocker,
                     'SECTION 8 NOT BUILT — ',
                     'SECTION 8 WAS EXECUTED 2026-08-19 AND DOES NOT REACH THIS CASE — ')
         end                                                                      as blocker
    from public.fn_phase_d_run_injected_defects() r
    left join public.phase_d_section8_defect_map m on m.defect_id = r.defect_id
    left join public.phase_d_section8_probe_result p
           on p.probe_id = m.probe_id and p.verdict <> 'NOT_RUN'
fn_phase_d_step_inputs:
declare
  sr public.phase_c_workflow_step_run%rowtype;
  r  public.phase_c_workflow_run%rowtype;
  w  public.phase_b_workflow%rowtype;
  s  public.phase_b_workflow_step%rowtype;
  b  public.phase_d_handler_binding%rowtype;
  v_keys   text[];
  v_k      text;
  v_val    jsonb;
  v_src    text;
  v_in     jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_prov   jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_res    text[] := '{}';
  v_unres  text[] := '{}';
  v_fx_val jsonb;   -- F11
  v_fx_src text;    -- F11
  v_cmd    bigint;
begin
  select * into sr from public.phase_c_workflow_step_run where step_run_id = p_step_run_id;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'fn_phase_d_step_inputs: no step run %', p_step_run_id using errcode = '23503';
  end if;
  select * into r  from public.phase_c_workflow_run    where run_id  = sr.run_id;
  select * into s  from public.phase_b_workflow_step   where step_id = sr.step_id;
  select * into w  from public.phase_b_workflow        where workflow_id = r.workflow_id;
  select * into b  from public.phase_d_handler_binding where step_id = sr.step_id;

  select coalesce(sc.required_keys, '{}') into v_keys
    from public.phase_d_handler_schema sc
   where sc.step_id = sr.step_id and sc.schema_kind = 'input';
  if v_keys is null then v_keys := '{}'; end if;

  -- The founder command that caused this run, if one did. W01 is started by
  -- fn_founder_command_submit through os_api, so for that workflow this is the real instruction.
  select l.command_id into v_cmd
    from public.founder_command_workflow_link l where l.run_id = sr.run_id limit 1;
  if v_cmd is null then v_cmd := r.command_id; end if;

  foreach v_k in array v_keys loop
    v_val := null; v_src := null;

    if v_k = 'workflow_record' then
      v_src := 'phase_c_workflow_run + phase_b_workflow + phase_b_workflow_step';
      v_val := jsonb_build_object(
        'run_id', r.run_id, 'workflow_id', r.workflow_id, 'workflow_name', w.workflow_name,
        'domain', w.domain, 'criticality', w.criticality, 'primary_object', w.primary_object,
        'business_object_id', nullif(btrim(coalesce(r.business_object_id,'')),''),
        'object_version', r.object_version, 'run_state', r.state, 'start_event', r.start_event,
        'run_accountable_role_id', r.accountable_role_id, 'opened_at', r.opened_at,
        'step_id', sr.step_id, 'step_name', s.step_name,
        'step_accountable_role_id', sr.accountable_role_id,
        'required_inputs', s.required_inputs, 'required_output', s.required_output,
        'acceptance_criteria', s.acceptance_criteria, 'closure_criteria', s.closure_criteria);

    elsif v_k = 'prior_accepted_outputs' then
      -- THE RECORD of what this run has already accepted. The kernel stores the accepted output's
      -- sha256, never the payload, so the hash IS the identity of the accepted output and the
      -- effect ledger row IS what it produced. Nothing here is reconstructed from prose.
      -- A count of 0 is a fact about a first step, not an absence: the object is returned with
      -- count 0 rather than an empty array, because fn_phase_d_schema_validate reads [] as missing.
      v_src := 'phase_c_workflow_step_run(completed) + phase_d_effect_ledger, this run only';
      select jsonb_build_object(
               'count', count(*),
               'run_id', sr.run_id,
               'outputs', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                   'step_id', pr.step_id, 'step_run_id', pr.step_run_id,
                   'output_hash', pr.output_hash, 'authority_result', pr.authority_result,
                   'gates_evaluated', pr.gates_evaluated, 'finished_at', pr.finished_at,
                   'effects', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                                  'effect_id', el.effect_id, 'effect_type', el.effect_type,
                                  'effect_object_id', el.effect_object_id,
                                  'result_reference', el.result_reference,
                                  'state_after', el.state_after) order by el.effect_id)
                                from public.phase_d_effect_ledger el
                               where el.step_run_id = pr.step_run_id), '[]'::jsonb))
                 order by pr.step_run_id), '[]'::jsonb))
        into v_val
        from public.phase_c_workflow_step_run pr
       where pr.run_id = sr.run_id
         and pr.state = 'completed'
         and pr.step_run_id < sr.step_run_id;

    elsif v_k = 'applicable_policy' then
      v_src := 'phase_d_rule_enforcement + phase_d_gate_contract, in scope for this step';
      v_val := jsonb_build_object(
        'step_id', sr.step_id, 'founder_gate', b.founder_gate,
        'rule_count', coalesce(cardinality(b.rule_ids), 0),
        'gate_count', coalesce(cardinality(b.gate_ids), 0),
        'rules', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                    'rule_id', re.rule_id, 'rule_type', re.rule_type,
                    'enforcement_kind', re.enforcement_kind, 'enforcement_point', re.enforcement_point,
                    'refusal_code', re.refusal_code, 'applies_when', re.applies_when,
                    'status', re.status) order by re.rule_id)
                  from public.phase_d_rule_enforcement re
                 where re.rule_id = any (coalesce(b.rule_ids,'{}'))), '[]'::jsonb),
        'gates', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                    'gate_id', gc.gate_id, 'predicate_kind', gc.predicate_kind,
                    'refusal_code', gc.refusal_code, 'evidence_keys', to_jsonb(gc.evidence_keys),
                    'correction_owner', gc.correction_owner) order by gc.gate_id)
                  from public.phase_d_gate_contract gc
                 where gc.gate_id = any (coalesce(b.gate_ids,'{}'))), '[]'::jsonb));

    elsif v_k in ('founder_instruction','founder_mandate') then
      v_src := 'founder_command via founder_command_workflow_link / phase_c_workflow_run.command_id';
      select jsonb_build_object(
               'command_id', fc.command_id, 'outcome', fc.outcome, 'state', fc.state,
               'priority', fc.priority, 'command_owner_role_id', fc.command_owner_role_id,
               'primary_role_id', fc.primary_role_id,
               'founder_initiated_only', fc.founder_initiated_only,
               'refund_semantics', fc.refund_semantics, 'created_at', fc.created_at)
        into v_val
        from public.founder_command fc where fc.command_id = v_cmd;

    elsif v_k = 'current_approved_founder_policies' then
      v_src := 'governance_policy + policy_rules(active)';
      select jsonb_build_object(
               'governance_policy_count', (select count(*) from public.governance_policy),
               'governance_policy', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                   'id', gp.id, 'domain', gp.domain, 'policy', gp.policy, 'rule', gp.rule,
                   'enforced_by', gp.enforced_by, 'enforcement', gp.enforcement,
                   'owner_dept', gp.owner_dept) order by gp.id)
                   from public.governance_policy gp), '[]'::jsonb),
               'policy_rules', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                   'id', pr2.id, 'name', pr2.name, 'severity', pr2.severity, 'scope', pr2.scope)
                   order by pr2.id) from public.policy_rules pr2 where pr2.active), '[]'::jsonb))
        into v_val;

    elsif v_k in ('current_company_objective','approved_company_objectives_and_department_mandates') then
      v_src := 'company_goals(active) + org_departments(active)';
      select jsonb_build_object(
               'goal_count', (select count(*) from public.company_goals where active),
               'goals', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                   'key', cg.key, 'goal', cg.goal, 'metric', cg.metric,
                   'target_value', cg.target_value, 'unit', cg.unit, 'period', cg.period,
                   'owner_dept', cg.owner_dept, 'horizon', cg.horizon, 'deadline', cg.deadline)
                   order by cg.sort, cg.key) from public.company_goals cg where cg.active), '[]'::jsonb),
               'departments', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                   'dept_key', od.dept_key, 'name', od.name) order by od.dept_key)
                   from public.org_departments od where od.active), '[]'::jsonb))
        into v_val;

    elsif v_k = 'department_mandates' then
      v_src := 'org_departments(active)';
      select jsonb_build_object(
               'count', count(*),
               'departments', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                   'dept_key', od.dept_key, 'name', od.name, 'charter', od.charter,
                   'north_star', od.north_star) order by od.dept_key), '[]'::jsonb))
        into v_val
        from public.org_departments od where od.active;

    elsif v_k = 'kpi_tree' then
      v_src := 'company_goals(active) grouped by owner_dept';
      select jsonb_build_object(
               'metric_count', (select count(*) from public.company_goals where active),
               'by_department', coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(q.dept, q.metrics), '{}'::jsonb))
        into v_val
        from (select coalesce(nullif(btrim(cg.owner_dept),''),'(unassigned)') as dept,
                     jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key', cg.key, 'metric', cg.metric,
                       'target_value', cg.target_value, 'unit', cg.unit) order by cg.key) as metrics
                from public.company_goals cg where cg.active group by 1) q;

    elsif v_k = 'current_company_state' then
      v_src := 'measured counts: active goals, active departments, open runs, open tasks';
      select jsonb_build_object(
               'measured_at', now(),
               'active_goals', (select count(*) from public.company_goals where active),
               'active_departments', (select count(*) from public.org_departments where active),
               'open_workflow_runs', (select count(*) from public.phase_c_workflow_run
                                       where closed_at is null),
               'open_tasks', (select count(*) from public.phase_c_task where closed_at is null))
        into v_val;

    elsif v_k in ('strategy_options','strategy_option','current_baseline','issued_initiatives',
                  'complete_ownership_and_measurement_setup') then
      -- These are produced by an EARLIER step of the same run. They resolve only once that step has
      -- completed; before that they are genuinely absent and the step must wait, not guess.
      v_src := 'prior completed step runs of this run';
      select jsonb_build_object(
               'produced_by_count', count(*),
               'produced_by', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                 'step_id', pr.step_id, 'output_hash', pr.output_hash,
                 'finished_at', pr.finished_at) order by pr.step_run_id), '[]'::jsonb))
        into v_val
        from public.phase_c_workflow_step_run pr
       where pr.run_id = sr.run_id and pr.state = 'completed' and pr.step_run_id < sr.step_run_id;
      if coalesce((v_val->>'produced_by_count')::int, 0) = 0 then
        v_val := null;   -- nothing has produced it yet: unresolved, not an empty pass
      end if;

    elsif v_k = 'budget_envelope' then
      -- E9. The prior body said "NO TABLE IN THIS ESTATE HOLDS THESE" and named this key.
      -- public.department_budget holds monthly_aed, spent_aed and the two degrade/halt thresholds
      -- for every active department. That IS a budget envelope. It is read here, not invented.
      v_src := 'department_budget joined to org_departments(active)';
      select jsonb_build_object(
               'measured_at', now(),
               'department_count', count(*),
               'monthly_aed_total', coalesce(sum(db.monthly_aed), 0),
               'spent_aed_total',   coalesce(sum(db.spent_aed), 0),
               'departments', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                   'dept_key', db.dept_key, 'monthly_aed', db.monthly_aed,
                   'spent_aed', db.spent_aed, 'period_label', db.period_label,
                   'degrade_at_pct', db.degrade_at_pct, 'halt_at_pct', db.halt_at_pct,
                   'updated_at', db.updated_at) order by db.dept_key), '[]'::jsonb))
        into v_val
        from public.department_budget db
        join public.org_departments od on od.dept_key = db.dept_key and od.active;
      -- No budget row is not an empty envelope; it is an unanswered question.
      if coalesce((v_val->>'department_count')::int, 0) = 0 then v_val := null; end if;

    elsif v_k = 'resource_envelope' then
      -- Money AND people, because a resource envelope that names only money cannot bound a plan
      -- this company executes with 90 active agents across 10 departments.
      v_src := 'department_budget + org_departments(active) + org_agents(active)';
      select jsonb_build_object(
               'measured_at', now(),
               'active_departments', (select count(*) from public.org_departments where active),
               'active_agents',      (select count(*) from public.org_agents where active),
               'monthly_aed_total',  coalesce((select sum(monthly_aed) from public.department_budget), 0),
               'spent_aed_total',    coalesce((select sum(spent_aed)   from public.department_budget), 0),
               'by_department', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                   'dept_key', od.dept_key, 'name', od.name,
                   'monthly_aed', db.monthly_aed, 'spent_aed', db.spent_aed,
                   'agents', (select count(*) from public.org_agents a
                               where a.active and a.department = od.dept_key))
                   order by od.dept_key)
                 from public.org_departments od
                 left join public.department_budget db on db.dept_key = od.dept_key
                where od.active), '[]'::jsonb))
        into v_val;
      if coalesce((v_val->>'active_departments')::int, 0) = 0 then v_val := null; end if;

    elsif v_k = 'current_cash_budget_and_commitments' then
      -- Budget is what may be spent; commitments are what already has been. Both come from rows:
      -- department_budget for the envelope and the posted general journal for the commitments.
      -- A cash POSITION is not claimed — no table in this estate holds a bank balance, and saying
      -- so is better than deriving one.
      v_src := 'department_budget + gl_journal(posted) — budget and commitments; NO cash position, '
            || 'because no relation in this estate holds one';
      select jsonb_build_object(
               'measured_at', now(),
               'cash_position_available', false,
               'cash_position_note', 'no relation in this estate holds a bank balance',
               'budget_monthly_aed', coalesce((select sum(monthly_aed) from public.department_budget), 0),
               'budget_spent_aed',   coalesce((select sum(spent_aed)   from public.department_budget), 0),
               'budget_by_department', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                   'dept_key', db.dept_key, 'monthly_aed', db.monthly_aed, 'spent_aed', db.spent_aed,
                   'halt_at_pct', db.halt_at_pct) order by db.dept_key)
                 from public.department_budget db), '[]'::jsonb),
               'posted_journal_entries', (select count(*) from public.gl_journal where status = 'posted'),
               'commitments', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                   'entry_no', j.entry_no, 'entry_date', j.entry_date, 'memo', j.memo,
                   'source', j.source, 'currency', j.currency) order by j.entry_date desc, j.entry_no desc)
                 from (select * from public.gl_journal
                        where status = 'posted' order by entry_date desc, entry_no desc limit 50) j),
                 '[]'::jsonb))
        into v_val;
      if coalesce((v_val->>'budget_monthly_aed')::numeric, 0) = 0
         and coalesce((v_val->>'posted_journal_entries')::int, 0) = 0 then
        v_val := null;   -- neither a budget nor a commitment on file: genuinely unanswered
      end if;

    elsif v_k = 'external_and_internal_evidence' then
      -- INTERNAL evidence is what the company recorded about itself; EXTERNAL is what it recorded
      -- about the world. Both halves are named separately so a reader can see which one is thin,
      -- and external_available is a measured boolean rather than an implied one.
      v_src := 'company_event(30d) + company_index(90d) + decision_trace(30d)';
      select jsonb_build_object(
               'measured_at', now(),
               'window', '30 days for events and decisions, 90 days for measured indices',
               'internal_event_count',    (select count(*) from public.company_event
                                            where occurred_at > now() - interval '30 days'),
               'internal_decision_count', (select count(*) from public.decision_trace
                                            where created_at > now() - interval '30 days'),
               'measured_index_count',    (select count(*) from public.company_index
                                            where measured_on > current_date - 90),
               'measured_indices', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                   'index_name', ci.index_name, 'score', ci.score, 'band', ci.band,
                   'measured_on', ci.measured_on) order by ci.measured_on desc, ci.index_name)
                 from (select distinct on (index_name) index_name, score, band, measured_on
                         from public.company_index where measured_on > current_date - 90
                        order by index_name, measured_on desc) ci), '[]'::jsonb),
               'event_types', coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(t.event_type, t.n)
                 from (select event_type, count(*) n from public.company_event
                        where occurred_at > now() - interval '30 days'
                        group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 25) t), '{}'::jsonb),
               'external_available', false,
               'external_note', 'no external-signal relation is on file; supplier discovery has been '
                             || 'paused since 2026-08-10 and nothing else in this estate records an '
                             || 'outside source')
        into v_val;
      if coalesce((v_val->>'internal_event_count')::int, 0) = 0
         and coalesce((v_val->>'measured_index_count')::int, 0) = 0
         and coalesce((v_val->>'internal_decision_count')::int, 0) = 0 then
        v_val := null;
      end if;

    else
      -- Every key the frozen registry declares is now named above. This branch is the fail-closed
      -- default for a key added later: unresolved, never a placeholder, because a placeholder makes
      -- the step complete on a fact it never had.
      v_val := null;
      v_src := null;
    end if;


    -- F11. THE FIXTURE DOOR, AND ONLY AFTER EVERY REAL SOURCE HAS BEEN TRIED.
    --
    -- The founder's section B: "A deterministic handler must not invent business content. The
    -- scenario catalogue supplies explicit test values... The handler receives the fixture as
    -- input. The handler must not generate the fixture itself."
    --
    -- This is where the fixture becomes an input. It runs in the RESOLVER, which is called by
    -- fn_phase_d_dispatch_step before fn_phase_d_handler_execute is entered, so the handler is
    -- handed a value and never reaches for one. And it runs LAST: a key a real row can answer is
    -- answered by that row, and the fixture never shadows a fact.
    --
    -- fn_phase_d_fixture_input returns NO ROW unless fn_phase_d_fixture_context() verifies an hmac
    -- over the current txid keyed by a secret no role can read. In production there is no such
    -- context, so this block resolves nothing, the key stays unresolved, and its rule or gate
    -- refuses exactly as it did before this file existed.
    if v_val is null or v_val = 'null'::jsonb then
      select fi.value, fi.provenance || format(' [fixture %s v%s %s]', fi.fixture_id,
                                               fi.fixture_version, left(fi.checksum, 12))
        into v_fx_val, v_fx_src
        from public.fn_phase_d_fixture_input(p_step_run_id, 'CONTEXT_KEY', v_k) fi;
      if v_fx_val is not null then
        v_in := v_in || jsonb_build_object(v_k, v_fx_val);
        v_prov := v_prov || jsonb_build_object(v_k, v_fx_src);
        v_res := v_res || v_k;
        v_fx_val := null; v_fx_src := null;
        continue;
      end if;
    end if;
    if v_val is null or v_val = 'null'::jsonb then
      v_unres := v_unres || v_k;
    else
      v_in   := v_in   || jsonb_build_object(v_k, v_val);
      v_prov := v_prov || jsonb_build_object(v_k, v_src);
      v_res  := v_res  || v_k;
    end if;
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'step_run_id', p_step_run_id, 'step_id', sr.step_id, 'run_id', sr.run_id,
    'declared_keys', to_jsonb(v_keys),
    'inputs', v_in, 'provenance', v_prov,
    'resolved', to_jsonb(v_res), 'unresolved', to_jsonb(v_unres));
end
fn_phase_d_dispatch_step:
declare
  sr public.phase_c_workflow_step_run%rowtype;
  v_step_run bigint := nullif(p_input->>'step_run_id','')::bigint;
  v_actor    text   := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_input->>'actor_role_id','')),'');
  v_kind     text   := coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_input->>'opened_by_kind'),''),'(unstated)');
  v_ref      text   := coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_input->>'opened_by_ref'),''),'(unstated)');
  v_idem     text   := coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_input->>'idempotency_key'),''),'');
  v_wf       text;
  v_on       text;
  v_depth    int;
  v_in       jsonb;
  v_cx       jsonb;
  v_res      jsonb;
  v_unres    text[];
  v_err      text;
  v_bkey     text;   -- E25
  v_owner    text;   -- E25
  v_scope    text;   -- E25
  v_own_rel  text;   -- J06
  v_own_col  text;   -- J07
  v_owner_unfit boolean;   -- J07
  v_owner_fit   text;      -- J07
  v_own_ns   text;   -- J06
  v_code     text;
begin
  if v_step_run is null or v_actor is null then
    raise exception 'fn_phase_d_dispatch_step: step_run_id and actor_role_id are required (got %, %)',
      coalesce(v_step_run::text,'(null)'), coalesce(v_actor,'(null)') using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select * into sr from public.phase_c_workflow_step_run where step_run_id = v_step_run;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'fn_phase_d_dispatch_step: no step run %', v_step_run using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  if not exists (select 1 from public.phase_d_handler_binding hb where hb.step_id = sr.step_id)
     or not exists (select 1 from public.phase_d_step_effect se where se.step_id = sr.step_id) then
    return jsonb_build_object('dispatched', false, 'outcome', 'NO_BINDING', 'step_id', sr.step_id);
  end if;

  select b2.workflow_id into v_wf from public.phase_d_handler_binding b2 where b2.step_id = sr.step_id;
  if v_idem = '' then v_idem := 'kernel|' || sr.run_id || '|' || sr.step_id; end if;

  v_on    := lower(coalesce(nullif(btrim(current_setting('app.phase_d_dispatch', true)),''), 'on'));
  v_depth := coalesce(nullif(btrim(current_setting('app.phase_d_dispatch_depth', true)),'')::int, 0);

  if v_on = 'off' then
    insert into public.phase_d_dispatch
      (step_run_id, run_id, step_id, workflow_id, opened_by_kind, opened_by_ref, actor_role_id,
       outcome, refusal_code, reason, dispatch_depth)
    values (v_step_run, sr.run_id, sr.step_id, v_wf, v_kind, v_ref, v_actor,
            'DISPATCH_OFF', 'pd_dispatch_off',
            'app.phase_d_dispatch is off for this transaction', v_depth);
    return jsonb_build_object('dispatched', false, 'outcome', 'DISPATCH_OFF');
  end if;

  if v_depth >= 64 then
    insert into public.phase_d_dispatch
      (step_run_id, run_id, step_id, workflow_id, opened_by_kind, opened_by_ref, actor_role_id,
       outcome, refusal_code, reason, dispatch_depth)
    values (v_step_run, sr.run_id, sr.step_id, v_wf, v_kind, v_ref, v_actor,
            'DEPTH_LIMIT', 'pd_dispatch_depth_limit',
            format('dispatch depth %s reached at step %s', v_depth, sr.step_id), v_depth);
    return jsonb_build_object('dispatched', false, 'outcome', 'DEPTH_LIMIT', 'depth', v_depth);
  end if;

  perform set_config('app.phase_d_dispatch_depth', (v_depth + 1)::text, true);

  begin
    v_in := public.fn_phase_d_step_inputs(v_step_run);
    select array_agg(x) into v_unres
      from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(v_in->'unresolved','[]'::jsonb)) x;
    v_unres := coalesce(v_unres, '{}');

    if cardinality(v_unres) > 0 then
      insert into public.phase_d_dispatch
        (step_run_id, run_id, step_id, workflow_id, opened_by_kind, opened_by_ref, actor_role_id,
         outcome, refusal_code, reason, unresolved_keys, inputs_provenance, dispatch_depth)
      values (v_step_run, sr.run_id, sr.step_id, v_wf, v_kind, v_ref, v_actor,
              'INPUTS_UNRESOLVED', 'pd_input_unresolved',
              format('%s of the %s declared input keys resolve from no real source: %s',
                     cardinality(v_unres),
                     jsonb_array_length(coalesce(v_in->'declared_keys','[]'::jsonb)),
                     array_to_string(v_unres, ', ')),
              v_unres, coalesce(v_in->'provenance','{}'::jsonb), v_depth);
      perform set_config('app.phase_d_dispatch_depth', v_depth::text, true);
      return jsonb_build_object('dispatched', false, 'outcome', 'INPUTS_UNRESOLVED',
                                'unresolved', to_jsonb(v_unres));
    end if;

    -- D37. The same treatment for what the RULES and GATES read. Unresolved keys are not supplied,
    -- so a rule that needs one refuses instead of passing on a placeholder.
    v_cx := public.fn_phase_d_step_context(v_step_run);

    -- E25. THE DISPATCH WITHHELD THE TWO FIELDS THE WRITE SERVICE REQUIRES, AND IT KNEW BOTH.
    --
    -- fn_phase_d_effect_produce raises pd_effect_owner_or_key_missing for DOMAIN_MUTATION and
    -- VERSIONED_ARTIFACT unless the CALL names business_key and owner_ref. That is the right
    -- behaviour for the routine -- a record written under an owner it chose for itself would be the
    -- auto-vivified account defect in a new place -- but the kernel dispatch passed neither and had
    -- no branch that could. The R3 independent acceptance measured the consequence: 125 of 257 steps
    -- structurally excluded before any rule was consulted, and the only two steps that executed were
    -- KERNEL_ONLY_TRANSITION ones that write no business object at all.
    --
    -- Neither field is invented here. Both are READ, and where they cannot be read the step still
    -- refuses:
    --
    --   owner_ref  COMPANY-scoped object -> phase_c_workflow_step_run.accountable_role_id, which is
    --              the frozen registry's own answer to who is accountable for this step. Not chosen.
    --              CUSTOMER- or SUPPLIER-scoped -> the owner column of the run's OWN business row,
    --              and null when no such row exists. A customer is never conjured to own a record.
    --
    --   business_key  the run's business_object_id, and ONLY when it actually carried the
    --              '<object>:' prefix of the object this step writes -- 'inquiry:<uuid>' is an
    --              identity, 'outbox:195' and a probe label are not. fn_phase_d_step_context reports
    --              key_is_prefixed for exactly this decision.
    --
    -- jsonb_strip_nulls means an underivable field is ABSENT rather than null, so the write service
    -- sees precisely what it saw before and refuses in precisely the same way.
    v_scope := v_cx#>>'{business_object,ownership_scope}';
    if coalesce((v_cx#>>'{business_object,key_is_prefixed}')::boolean, false) then
      v_bkey := nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_cx#>>'{business_object,object_key}','')),'');
    end if;

    -- F13. A STEP THAT WRITES AN OBJECT OTHER THAN ITS RUN'S PRIMARY HAD NO KEY IT COULD EVER GET.
    --
    -- E25 derives business_key from the run's business_object_id and only when it carries the
    -- '<object>:' prefix of the object THIS STEP writes -- which is right, and which means a step
    -- like W01-S07 (run is company_objective:..., step writes the initiative object) can never be prefixed
    -- and refuses with pd_effect_owner_or_key_missing on every drive. That is correct in
    -- production: nothing has told the estate which initiative this is.
    --
    -- Inside a verified Phase D fixture run there IS an answer, and it is a read rather than an
    -- invention: the scenario either already created a record of that object -- in which case this
    -- step mutates THAT record -- or it did not, in which case the key is derived deterministically
    -- from (fixture run, object, run), so the same scenario driven twice produces the same key and
    -- a replay collides with itself instead of creating a second record.
    if v_bkey is null and public.fn_phase_d_fixture_context() is not null then
      -- H05. AN APPEND_ONLY OBJECT IS NEVER WRITTEN UNDER THE SCENARIO'S EXISTING KEY. Its policy is
      -- that a correction is a NEW key, so the scenario's record is not "the record this step
      -- mutates" -- this step appends beside it. The key is derived from the step as well as the
      -- run, so each appending step is its own record and a replay of one step run is one record.
      if exists (select 1 from public.phase_d_business_object_binding bb
                  where bb.object_id = (v_cx#>>'{business_object,object_id}')
                    and bb.policy_family = 'APPEND_ONLY') then
        v_bkey := md5(format('phase_d_fixture:%s:%s:%s:%s',
                             public.fn_phase_d_fixture_context(),
                             v_cx#>>'{business_object,object_id}', sr.run_id, sr.step_id))::uuid::text;
      end if;
    end if;
    if v_bkey is null and public.fn_phase_d_fixture_context() is not null then
      select coalesce(sc.contributed_value, sc.business_key) into v_bkey
        from public.phase_d_scenario_record sc
       where sc.fixture_run_id = public.fn_phase_d_fixture_context()
         and sc.object_id = (v_cx#>>'{business_object,object_id}')
       order by sc.scenario_record_id limit 1;
      if v_bkey is null and (v_cx#>>'{business_object,object_id}') is not null then
        v_bkey := md5(format('phase_d_fixture:%s:%s:%s',
                             public.fn_phase_d_fixture_context(),
                             v_cx#>>'{business_object,object_id}', sr.run_id))::uuid::text;
      end if;
    end if;
    v_owner := nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_cx#>>'{business_object,row_owner_ref}','')),'');
    if v_owner is null and coalesce(v_scope,'COMPANY') = 'COMPANY' then
      v_owner := nullif(btrim(coalesce(sr.accountable_role_id,'')),'');

      -- J07. A ROLE IS NOT ALWAYS WHAT THE OWNER COLUMN HOLDS. E25 made the accountable role the
      -- owner of a COMPANY-scoped write, which is right about WHO is accountable and says nothing
      -- about what the column stores. Measured 23 Aug 2026 on W01-S07: the object is initiative,
      -- the relation public.org_tasks, the owner column dept_key, and
      --
      --   insert or update on table "org_tasks" violates foreign key constraint
      --   "org_tasks_dept_key_fkey"      -- FOREIGN KEY (dept_key) REFERENCES org_departments(dept_key)
      --
      -- because a role id is not a department key. The column's own foreign key settles it: where
      -- the accountable role does not satisfy that key, the answer is the value from this role's
      -- OWN registry row that does. public.org_role.primary_department_id resolves against
      -- public.org_departments for all 180 roles; public.org_agents.department is the same fact
      -- under the runtime key, and is tried second for a role recorded only there.
      --
      -- Nothing is invented and nothing is chosen: two candidates, both read off the role's own
      -- record, each TESTED against the foreign key before it is used. A role whose registry row
      -- satisfies neither leaves the owner exactly as E25 left it, and the write refuses as before.
      select cl3.relname, ns3.nspname, a4.attname
        into v_own_rel, v_own_ns, v_own_col
        from public.phase_d_object_write_map wm3
        join pg_attribute a3 on a3.attrelid = to_regclass(wm3.target_relation)
                            and a3.attname = wm3.owner_column and a3.attnum > 0
        join pg_constraint c3 on c3.conrelid = a3.attrelid and c3.contype = 'f'
                             and a3.attnum = any (c3.conkey)
        join pg_class cl3 on cl3.oid = c3.confrelid
        join pg_namespace ns3 on ns3.oid = cl3.relnamespace
        join pg_attribute a4 on a4.attrelid = c3.confrelid and a4.attnum = c3.confkey[1]
       where wm3.object_id = v_cx#>>'{business_object,object_id}'
         and coalesce(btrim(wm3.owner_column),'') <> ''
       limit 1;

      if v_own_rel is not null and v_owner is not null then
        execute format('select not exists (select 1 from %I.%I where %I::text = $1)',
                       v_own_ns, v_own_rel, v_own_col)
          into v_owner_unfit using v_owner;
        if coalesce(v_owner_unfit, false) then
          execute format(
            'select c.v from (select r.primary_department_id::text v, 1 ord from public.org_role r'
            || ' where r.role_id = $1'
            || ' union all select a.department::text, 2 from public.org_agents a where a.agent_key = $1) c'
            || ' where c.v is not null'
            || '   and exists (select 1 from %I.%I t where t.%I::text = c.v)'
            || ' order by c.ord limit 1',
            v_own_ns, v_own_rel, v_own_col)
            into v_owner_fit using v_owner;
          if v_owner_fit is not null then v_owner := v_owner_fit; end if;
        end if;
      end if;
      v_own_rel := null; v_own_ns := null; v_own_col := null;
    end if;

    -- F37. THE SAME HOLE F13 CLOSED FOR THE KEY, STILL OPEN FOR THE OWNER.
    --
    -- E25 gave a COMPANY-scoped object an owner -- the frozen registry's own accountable role for
    -- the step -- and left CUSTOMER- and SUPPLIER-scoped objects to row_owner_ref, which reads the
    -- owner column of the run's OWN business row. A step that CREATES the first record of such an
    -- object has no such row yet, so the owner is unresolvable by construction and the step refuses
    -- with pd_effect_owner_or_key_missing on every drive. Measured: W10-S01
    -- (supplier_verification_case), W18-S01 (customer_case) and W19-S01 (supplier_retention_case)
    -- are the FIRST handler refusal of their whole workflow, for exactly this.
    --
    -- In production that refusal is right and it stays: a supplier case owned by a supplier this
    -- routine picked would be the auto-vivified account defect one table over.
    --
    -- Inside a verified Phase D fixture run there is a real answer and it is a READ. The scenario
    -- factory created the parent -- a supplier, a customer -- through the canonical services and
    -- recorded it in public.phase_d_scenario_record with its own owner_ref and ownership_scope.
    -- This takes THAT owner, matched on the scope the object declares. It invents nothing, it
    -- cannot fire outside a fixture context, and where the scenario created no parent of that scope
    -- the owner is still null and the step still refuses.
    if v_owner is null
       and coalesce(v_scope,'COMPANY') <> 'COMPANY'
       and public.fn_phase_d_fixture_context() is not null then
      -- J06. WHICH SCENARIO RECORD IS THE OWNER. The block below took the FIRST record of the same
      -- ownership scope, and "same scope" is not an identity. Measured 23 Aug 2026 on one built
      -- scenario, SUPPLIER-scoped records in scenario_record_id order:
      --
      --   supplier_safe_package   owner=9385a4f3-...   <- the INQUIRY's uuid, and the first row
      --   supplier_account        owner=5909be81-...   key=37090
      --   supplier_terms_acceptance owner=37090
      --   supplier_capability     owner=37090
      --   supplier_assignment     owner=37090
      --
      -- so every SUPPLIER-scoped write inherited an inquiry's uuid as its supplier, and
      -- public.supplier_capabilities.supplier_id is bigint: "invalid input syntax for type bigint:
      -- 65d2c329-64dd-0209-1544-e87ef8a30684" -- pd_effect_value_malformed, on W09-S03 and W12-S06.
      --
      -- The owner column already says what it wants, in the schema: it carries a FOREIGN KEY to the
      -- relation that holds the owning party. Read that, find the business object bound to that
      -- relation, and take the key the scenario gave THAT object. Nothing is chosen by position, by
      -- naming convention or by a list of scopes; every step is a read of a record the estate
      -- already holds. Where the owner column carries no foreign key, or the scenario created no
      -- such party, the previous behaviour stands and the step still refuses when it resolves
      -- nothing.
      select cl2.relname, ns2.nspname into v_own_rel, v_own_ns
        from public.phase_d_object_write_map wm2
        join pg_attribute a2 on a2.attrelid = to_regclass(wm2.target_relation)
                            and a2.attname = wm2.owner_column and a2.attnum > 0
        join pg_constraint c2 on c2.conrelid = a2.attrelid and c2.contype = 'f'
                             and a2.attnum = any (c2.conkey)
        join pg_class cl2 on cl2.oid = c2.confrelid
        join pg_namespace ns2 on ns2.oid = cl2.relnamespace
       where wm2.object_id = v_cx#>>'{business_object,object_id}'
         and coalesce(btrim(wm2.owner_column),'') <> ''
       limit 1;

      if v_own_rel is not null then
        select nullif(btrim(coalesce(sc.business_key,'')),'') into v_owner
          from public.phase_d_scenario_record sc
          join public.phase_d_business_object_binding bb on bb.object_id = sc.object_id
         where sc.fixture_run_id = public.fn_phase_d_fixture_context()
           and bb.canonical_relation = v_own_ns || '.' || v_own_rel
           and coalesce(btrim(sc.business_key),'') <> ''
         order by sc.scenario_record_id
         limit 1;
      end if;

      if v_owner is null then
        select nullif(btrim(coalesce(sc.owner_ref,'')),'') into v_owner
          from public.phase_d_scenario_record sc
         where sc.fixture_run_id = public.fn_phase_d_fixture_context()
           and sc.ownership_scope = v_scope
           and coalesce(btrim(sc.owner_ref),'') <> ''
         order by sc.scenario_record_id
         limit 1;
      end if;
    end if;

    v_res := public.fn_phase_d_handler_execute(jsonb_build_object(
      'step_run_id',       v_step_run,
      'actor_role_id',     v_actor,
      'idempotency_key',   v_idem || '|phase_d',
      'inputs',            v_in->'inputs',
      'context',           v_cx->'context',
      'gate_evidence',     v_cx->'context',
      'execution_context', 'production',
      'correlation_id',    p_input->>'correlation_id',
      'causation_id',      'kernel_dispatch:' || v_kind || ':' || v_ref)
      || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'business_key',      v_bkey,
      'owner_ref',         v_owner)));

    insert into public.phase_d_dispatch
      (step_run_id, run_id, step_id, workflow_id, opened_by_kind, opened_by_ref, actor_role_id,
       outcome, inputs_provenance, effect_id, dispatch_depth)
    values (v_step_run, sr.run_id, sr.step_id, v_wf, v_kind, v_ref, v_actor,
            'EXECUTED',
            coalesce(v_in->'provenance','{}'::jsonb) || coalesce(v_cx->'provenance','{}'::jsonb),
            nullif(v_res#>>'{phase_d,business_effect,effect_id}','')::bigint, v_depth);

    perform set_config('app.phase_d_dispatch_depth', v_depth::text, true);
    return jsonb_build_object('dispatched', true, 'outcome', 'EXECUTED',
             'handler_id', v_res#>>'{phase_d,handler_id}',
             'effect_id',  v_res#>'{phase_d,business_effect,effect_id}');

  exception
    when others then
      v_err  := SQLERRM;
      -- E26. AN UNCLASSIFIED REFUSAL IS AN INSTRUMENT GAP, NOT A CATEGORY.
      -- Once E25 stopped the dispatch withholding business_key and owner_ref, two steps reached the
      -- real business write for the first time and failed on a NOT NULL column of the target
      -- relation -- public.opportunity.kind. That is a genuine and interesting refusal: the payload
      -- carries an IDENTITY for the record but not its CONTENT, and the content of an opportunity is
      -- a judgement no deterministic handler can make while the reasoning capability is held. It
      -- deserves to be named. Recorded as pd_unclassified it looked like a bug in the dispatch.
      --
      -- A raised Phase D or kernel code still wins; this only names what used to fall through.
      v_code := coalesce((regexp_match(v_err, '\((pd_[a-z0-9_]+|k[0-9]+_[a-z0-9_]+)\)'))[1],
        case SQLSTATE
          when '23502' then 'pd_effect_payload_incomplete'   -- not-null column the payload did not fill
          when '23503' then 'pd_effect_reference_unresolved'  -- foreign key the payload pointed nowhere
          when '23505' then 'pd_effect_identity_collision'    -- unique key already taken
          when '23514' then 'pd_effect_check_violated'        -- a check constraint on the target relation
          when '22P02' then 'pd_effect_value_malformed'       -- a value the target column cannot parse
          else 'pd_unclassified' end);
      insert into public.phase_d_dispatch
        (step_run_id, run_id, step_id, workflow_id, opened_by_kind, opened_by_ref, actor_role_id,
         outcome, refusal_code, sqlstate_code, reason, unresolved_keys, inputs_provenance,
         dispatch_depth)
      values (v_step_run, sr.run_id, sr.step_id, v_wf, v_kind, v_ref, v_actor,
              -- E19. This column used to say REFUSED whether the handler had judged the evidence
              -- and rejected it, or had never been given any. Those are different events, and the
              -- 2026-08-20 acceptance audit read the second as the first. Both are refusals and
              -- neither is a pass; only the name differs.
              case when v_code = 'pd_evidence_absent' then 'REFUSED_EVIDENCE_ABSENT' else 'REFUSED' end,
              v_code, SQLSTATE, left(v_err, 1000),
              coalesce((select array_agg(x) from jsonb_array_elements_text(
                          coalesce(v_cx->'unresolved','[]'::jsonb)) x), '{}'),
              coalesce(v_cx->'provenance','{}'::jsonb), v_depth);
      perform set_config('app.phase_d_dispatch_depth', v_depth::text, true);
      return jsonb_build_object('dispatched', false,
                                'outcome', case when v_code = 'pd_evidence_absent'
                                                then 'REFUSED_EVIDENCE_ABSENT' else 'REFUSED' end,
                                'refusal_code', v_code, 'sqlstate', SQLSTATE);
  end;
end
fn_phase_d_dispatch_state:
with d as (select * from public.phase_d_dispatch)
  select 'dispatch_is_wired_into_both_openers'::text,
         'true'::text,
         (select (bool_and(p.prosrc ~ '\mfn_phase_d_dispatch_step\s*\('))::text from pg_proc p
           where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
             and p.proname in ('fn_kernel_open_step','fn_kernel_workflow_start')),
         (select bool_and(p.prosrc ~ '\mfn_phase_d_dispatch_step\s*\(') from pg_proc p
           where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
             and p.proname in ('fn_kernel_open_step','fn_kernel_workflow_start'))
  union all
  select 'dispatches_with_an_unexplained_outcome',
         '0',
         (select count(*)::text from d where outcome <> 'EXECUTED'
            and btrim(coalesce(refusal_code,'')) in ('','(none)')),
         (select count(*) from d where outcome <> 'EXECUTED'
            and btrim(coalesce(refusal_code,'')) in ('','(none)')) = 0
  union all
  select 'dispatches_that_hit_the_depth_limit',
         '0',
         (select count(*)::text from d where outcome = 'DEPTH_LIMIT'),
         (select count(*) from d where outcome = 'DEPTH_LIMIT') = 0
  union all
  select 'executed_dispatches_with_no_effect_row',
         '0',
         (select count(*)::text from d where outcome = 'EXECUTED' and effect_id is null),
         (select count(*) from d where outcome = 'EXECUTED' and effect_id is null) = 0
  union all
  select 'refusals_classified_as_pd_unclassified',
         '0',
         (select count(*)::text from d where refusal_code = 'pd_unclassified'),
         (select count(*) from d where refusal_code = 'pd_unclassified') = 0;
fn_phase_d_application_connection_measur:
begin
  with per_wf as (
    select b.workflow_id,
           bool_or(c.source_component_id like 'dbtrigger:%') filter (
             where c.current_activation = 'ACTIVE'
               and c.source_class in ('A NEW_WORK_REQUEST','B EXISTING_WORKFLOW_SIGNAL')) as has_trigger,
           bool_or(c.source_component_id like 'edge:%') filter (
             where c.current_activation = 'ACTIVE'
               and c.source_class in ('A NEW_WORK_REQUEST','B EXISTING_WORKFLOW_SIGNAL')) as has_edge,
           string_agg(distinct c.source_component_id, ', ') filter (
             where c.current_activation = 'ACTIVE'
               and c.source_class in ('A NEW_WORK_REQUEST','B EXISTING_WORKFLOW_SIGNAL')) as sources
      from public.phase_d_handler_binding b
      left join public.phase_c_source_cutover c
             on split_part(c.target_workflow, ' ', 1) = b.workflow_id
     group by b.workflow_id
  ), per_wf2 as (
    select p.*,
           exists (select 1 from public.founder_command_workflow_link l
                    where l.workflow_id = p.workflow_id) as has_founder_command
      from per_wf p
  )
  update public.phase_d_handler_binding b
     set application_connection =
           case
             when (coalesce(w.has_edge,false) or w.has_founder_command) and coalesce(w.has_trigger,false)
               then 'FULL_APPLICATION_PATH_CONNECTED'
             when coalesce(w.has_trigger,false) then 'AUTONOMOUS_SOURCE_CONNECTED_HELD'
             when coalesce(w.has_edge,false) or w.has_founder_command then 'API_CONNECTED'
             else 'KERNEL_INTERNAL_ONLY'
           end,
         application_connection_evidence =
           case
             when coalesce(w.sources,'') <> '' or w.has_founder_command
               then format('phase_c_source_cutover ACTIVE class A/B: [%s]%s',
                           coalesce(w.sources,'(none)'),
                           case when w.has_founder_command
                                then '; founder_command_workflow_link has a row for this workflow'
                                else '' end)
             else 'no ACTIVE class A or B source targets this workflow, and no founder command has ever started it'
           end,
         application_connection_measured_at = now()
    from per_wf2 w
   where w.workflow_id = b.workflow_id;

  return query
    select b.application_connection, count(*)::int
      from public.phase_d_handler_binding b
     group by 1 order by 2 desc;
end
fn_phase_d_actual_caller_measure:
begin
  update public.phase_d_step_effect e
     set actual_caller = coalesce(
           (select format('%s via %s -> %s, last %s',
                     d.opened_by_kind, d.opened_by_ref, d.outcome,
                     to_char(d.dispatched_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'))
              from public.phase_d_dispatch d
             where d.step_id = e.step_id
             order by d.dispatch_id desc limit 1),
           'NOT_YET_REACHED - no path has opened this step');
  return query
    select e.actual_caller, count(*)::int from public.phase_d_step_effect e group by 1 order by 2 desc;
end
fn_phase_d_contract_state:
with p as (
    select 'schema_output_w17_s06'::text sid
  ),
  probe(nm, res) as (
    values
      ('wrong_types_are_refused',
       (select valid from public.fn_phase_d_schema_validate('schema_output_w17_s06',
         '{"status":12345,"output":true,"acceptance_assertions":"not-an-array","evidence_refs":99,
           "decision":[1,2],"rationale":{"x":1},"authority_ref":-1}'::jsonb))),
      ('out_of_domain_status_is_refused',
       (select valid from public.fn_phase_d_schema_validate('schema_output_w17_s06',
         '{"status":"purple-elephant","output":"o","acceptance_assertions":["a"],"evidence_refs":["e"],
           "decision":"NOT_A_DECISION","rationale":"r","authority_ref":"auth"}'::jsonb))),
      ('invented_keys_are_refused',
       (select valid from public.fn_phase_d_schema_validate('schema_output_w17_s06',
         '{"status":"ok","output":"o","acceptance_assertions":["a"],"evidence_refs":["e"],
           "decision":"APPROVE","rationale":"r","authority_ref":"auth",
           "totally_invented_field":"x","refund_amount_aed":999999}'::jsonb))),
      ('a_string_zero_denominator_is_refused',
       (select valid from public.fn_phase_d_schema_validate('schema_output_w02_s08',
         (select jsonb_object_agg(k, case when k='denominator' then to_jsonb('0'::text)
                                          when k='numerator' then to_jsonb(1)
                                          when k='status' then to_jsonb('ok'::text)
                                          when k in ('acceptance_assertions','evidence_refs')
                                               then jsonb_build_array('x')
                                          else to_jsonb('x'::text) end)
            from unnest((select required_keys from public.phase_d_handler_schema
                          where schema_id='schema_output_w02_s08')) k)))),
      ('a_conforming_payload_is_accepted',
       (select valid from public.fn_phase_d_schema_validate('schema_output_w17_s06',
         '{"status":"completed","output":"o","acceptance_assertions":["a"],"evidence_refs":["e"],
           "decision":"APPROVE","rationale":"r","authority_ref":"auth"}'::jsonb))),
      ('a_missing_required_key_is_still_refused',
       (select valid from public.fn_phase_d_schema_validate('schema_output_w17_s06',
         '{"status":"ok"}'::jsonb))),
      ('an_unknown_schema_is_still_refused',
       (select valid from public.fn_phase_d_schema_validate('schema_output_does_not_exist',
         '{"status":"ok"}'::jsonb)))
  )
  select nm,
         case when nm in ('a_conforming_payload_is_accepted') then 'accepted' else 'refused' end,
         case when res then 'accepted' else 'refused' end,
         case when nm in ('a_conforming_payload_is_accepted') then res else not res end
    from probe
  union all
  select 'every_schema_types_every_required_key', '0',
         (select count(*)::text from public.phase_d_handler_schema sc
           where exists (select 1 from unnest(sc.required_keys) k where not (sc.field_types ? k))),
         (select count(*) from public.phase_d_handler_schema sc
           where exists (select 1 from unnest(sc.required_keys) k where not (sc.field_types ? k))) = 0
  union all
  select 'every_schema_carries_a_version', '514',
         (select count(*)::text from public.phase_d_handler_schema where schema_version >= 1),
         (select count(*) from public.phase_d_handler_schema where schema_version >= 1) = 514;
fn_phase_d_bounded:
select case
           when p_text is null then ''
           when length(p_text) <= greatest(p_max, 1) then p_text
           else left(p_text, greatest(p_max, 1)) || ' …[+'
                || (length(p_text) - greatest(p_max, 1))::text || ' chars]'
         end;
fn_phase_d_effect_reachability:
-- THE JOIN IS ON WHAT THE BRANCH WRITES, NOT ON WHAT THE ROW DECLARES. fn_phase_d_effect_produce
  -- hardcodes 'review_record' for every REVIEW_VERDICT step and writes only the ledger for
  -- EXTERNAL_EFFECT_INTENT and MEASUREMENT_RECORD, so e.effect_object_id is the wrong key for 60 of
  -- the 257 and reading it was the E5 defect.
  with resolved as (
    select e.step_id, e.workflow_id, e.expected_effect_type,
           case
             when e.expected_effect_type = 'CAPABILITY_REQUEST'
               then '(nothing — the branch raises pd_capability_unavailable)'
             when e.expected_effect_type in
                  ('KERNEL_ONLY_TRANSITION','EXTERNAL_EFFECT_INTENT','MEASUREMENT_RECORD')
               then 'public.phase_d_effect_ledger'
             else (select ob.canonical_relation
                     from public.phase_d_business_object_binding ob
                    where ob.object_id = case when e.expected_effect_type = 'REVIEW_VERDICT'
                                              then 'review_record' else e.effect_object_id end)
           end as writes_relation,
           case
             when e.expected_effect_type in
                  ('CAPABILITY_REQUEST','KERNEL_ONLY_TRANSITION','EXTERNAL_EFFECT_INTENT',
                   'MEASUREMENT_RECORD')
               then null
             else (select ob.relation_kind
                     from public.phase_d_business_object_binding ob
                    where ob.object_id = case when e.expected_effect_type = 'REVIEW_VERDICT'
                                              then 'review_record' else e.effect_object_id end)
           end as relation_kind
      from public.phase_d_step_effect e
  ),
  -- THE ATTEMPT, WHERE THERE IS ONE. Last dispatch per step, by dispatch_id. This is the only
  -- source in the function that is a record of something that happened.
  observed as (
    select distinct on (d.step_id)
           d.step_id, d.outcome, d.refusal_code, d.reason, d.unresolved_keys, d.dispatched_at
      from public.phase_d_dispatch d
     order by d.step_id, d.dispatch_id desc
  ),
  -- THE PRECONDITIONS, LABELLED AS PRECONDITIONS. Applicability is asked of fn_phase_d_rule_applies
  -- for every rule bound to the step; a rule that is bound but not applicable blocks nothing.
  pre as (
    select hb.step_id,
           (hb.capability_dependency <> 'NONE') as capability_held,
           (hb.provider_dependency   <> 'NONE') as provider_held,
           (select array_agg(rid order by rid) from unnest(hb.rule_ids) rid
             where (select a.applies from public.fn_phase_d_rule_applies(rid, hb.step_id) a)) as applicable_rules
      from public.phase_d_handler_binding hb
  )
  select r.step_id, r.workflow_id, r.expected_effect_type,
         case
           when r.expected_effect_type = 'CAPABILITY_REQUEST' then 'REFUSAL_IS_THE_DECLARED_EFFECT'
           when r.writes_relation = 'public.phase_d_effect_ledger' then 'WRITES_ONLY_THE_PHASE_D_LEDGER'
           when r.relation_kind = 'PHASE_D_OBJECT_VIEW' then 'WRITES_ONLY_THE_PHASE_D_OBJECT_STORE'
           when r.writes_relation in ('public.customers','public.inquiries','public.quotes',
                                      'public.transactions','public.notifications')
             then 'WRITES_A_ZERO_RESIDUE_TABLE'
           when r.relation_kind = 'EXISTING_TABLE' then 'WRITES_AN_EXISTING_TABLE_NOT_UNDER_THE_RULE'
           else 'UNRESOLVED'
         end,
         -- blocker
         case
           when o.step_id is not null and o.outcome = 'EXECUTED'
             then format('none — the last dispatch of this step reached EXECUTED at %s', o.dispatched_at)
           when o.step_id is not null
             then format('%s (%s): %s', o.outcome, coalesce(o.refusal_code,'(no code)'),
                         left(coalesce(o.reason,'(no reason recorded)'), 400))
           when p.capability_held or p.provider_held
             then 'PRECONDITION: the capability or provider boundary raises for any execution_context '
                  || 'other than test, and the kernel path hard-codes production. The refusal is the '
                  || 'contract, not a defect.'
           when r.expected_effect_type in ('DOMAIN_MUTATION','VERSIONED_ARTIFACT')
             then 'PRECONDITION: fn_phase_d_effect_produce requires a caller-supplied business_key '
                  || 'and owner_ref for a step that writes ' || coalesce(r.writes_relation,'a business object')
                  || '. It refuses rather than choosing them, deliberately.'
           when coalesce(cardinality(p.applicable_rules),0) > 0
             then 'PRECONDITION: ' || cardinality(p.applicable_rules)::text
                  || ' hard rule(s) apply to this step and read facts about a business subject — '
                  || array_to_string(p.applicable_rules, ', ')
           else 'PRECONDITION: none identified at contract level; no dispatch has been committed for '
                || 'this step, so nothing here is a measurement of why.'
         end,
         -- blocker_source: the whole point of this file
         case when o.step_id is not null then 'OBSERVED_DISPATCH'
              else 'CONTRACT_PRECONDITION_NOT_YET_OBSERVED' end,
         coalesce(r.writes_relation, '(unresolved — no binding for the object this branch writes)'),
         exists (select 1 from public.phase_d_effect_ledger l where l.step_id = r.step_id)
    from resolved r
    left join observed o on o.step_id = r.step_id
    left join pre p      on p.step_id = r.step_id;
fn_phase_d_object_record_contract:
declare
  c public.phase_d_object_state_contract%rowtype;
  b public.phase_d_business_object_binding%rowtype;
  v_money text[];
begin
  select * into c from public.phase_d_object_state_contract where object_id = new.object_id;
  if not found then
    -- FAIL CLOSED. An object with no state contract is a gap in the registry, not a licence.
    raise exception 'phase_d_object_record: object % has no row in phase_d_object_state_contract, so there is no domain to check its state against. Register the object before writing it. (pd_object_no_state_contract)',
      new.object_id using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if not (new.state = any (c.allowed_states)) then
    -- RAISE has no %L. It is a format() placeholder, and using it here printed the state followed
    -- by a stray "L" until this line said so.
    raise exception 'phase_d_object_record: % is a %-family object and state "%" is not one of [%]. (pd_object_state_outside_domain)',
      new.object_id, c.policy_family, new.state, array_to_string(c.allowed_states, ', ')
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  select * into b from public.phase_d_business_object_binding where object_id = new.object_id;
  if found then
    if new.owner_scope is distinct from b.ownership_scope then
      raise exception 'phase_d_object_record: % declares ownership_scope % and this record carries %. The scope is the object''s, not the caller''s. (pd_object_owner_scope_mismatch)',
        new.object_id, coalesce(b.ownership_scope,'(none)'), coalesce(new.owner_scope,'(none)')
        using errcode = '23514';
    end if;

    -- Every one of the 56 objects is owned by COMPANY, CUSTOMER or SUPPLIER. There is no unowned
    -- object, so an empty owner_ref is a record nobody is accountable for.
    if coalesce(btrim(coalesce(new.owner_ref,'')),'') = '' then
      raise exception 'phase_d_object_record: % is owned at % scope and this record names no owner_ref. (pd_object_owner_missing)',
        new.object_id, coalesce(b.ownership_scope,'(unstated)') using errcode = '23514';
    end if;

    -- A MONEY AMOUNT MAY NOT RIDE IN ON A NON-FINANCIAL OBJECT, AT ANY DEPTH, IN ANY NOTATION.
    -- Three conditions, and the FIRST is the one E27 added: an IDENTIFIER is never an amount.
    -- `refund_id`, `invoice_no`, `price_ref` name things; whether their value happens to be numeric
    -- is irrelevant, and E24 got this wrong by allowing a numeric string without excluding them.
    if coalesce(b.policy_family,'') <> 'TRANSACTION_RECORD' then
      select array_agg(distinct k order by k) into v_money
        from jsonb_path_query(new.payload, '$.**') node,
             lateral jsonb_each(case when jsonb_typeof(node) = 'object' then node else '{}'::jsonb end) e(k, v)
       where k !~* '_(id|ref|no|key|code)$'
         and (k ~* '(^|_)(amount|price|charge|payout|subtotal|total|fee|cost|refund|invoice)(_|$)'
              or k ~* '_(aed|usd|eur|gbp)$')
         and (jsonb_typeof(v) = 'number'
              -- E35. THE STRING ARM REQUIRED A WHOLLY NUMERIC STRING, so two notations for the
              -- same amount walked past it and the R4 acceptance named both:
              --     refund_amount_aed: "AED 999999"   ACCEPTED - a currency prefix
              --     refund_amount_aed: "1e6"          ACCEPTED - scientific notation
              -- Neither is an identifier and neither was ever going to be one: they are quantities
              -- written the way a person and a JSON serialiser respectively write them. A rule that
              -- reads a number but not the same number with AED in front of it is testing the
              -- notation, not the subject.
              --
              -- The identifier exclusion above still settles those cases first and is unchanged, so
              -- refund_id, invoice_no and price_ref are as accepted as they were after E27 -
              -- whatever notation their value takes.
              --
              -- The third residual note the audit raised, price_code: 999999, is NOT closed here
              -- and I am not pretending it is. `_code` is on the identifier-exclusion list by
              -- deliberate choice in E27, the auditor judged that trade correct, and widening the
              -- money side to reach it would put every *_code key back in front of the rule that
              -- blocked eleven legitimate workflows. It is a named hole, and it stays named.
              -- E40. A THIRD AND FOURTH NOTATION, AND THE SECOND ONE SHOULD NOT HAVE TAKEN FOUR
              -- INCREMENTS TO FIND. E24 caught numbers, E27 numeric strings, E35 currency prefixes
              -- and scientific notation; the R7 acceptance found two more on a money-shaped
              -- non-identifier key:
              --     refund_amount_aed: "0x1F"      ACCEPTED -- hexadecimal
              --     refund_amount_aed: "AED٩٩٩"    ACCEPTED -- ٩٩٩ is 999
              -- This company sells in the UAE. An amount written in the digit script of its own
              -- market is not an edge case, and every arm of this rule anchored on ASCII [0-9].
              or (jsonb_typeof(v) = 'string'
                  and (v #>> '{}' ~* '^[[:space:]]*(aed|usd|eur|gbp|\$|€|£)?[[:space:]]*-?[0-9][0-9,]*(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?[[:space:]]*(aed|usd|eur|gbp)?[[:space:]]*$'
                       or v #>> '{}' ~* '^[[:space:]]*(aed|usd|eur|gbp|\$|€|£)?[[:space:]]*0x[0-9a-f]+[[:space:]]*$'
                       -- Arabic-Indic U+0660..0669 and Extended Arabic-Indic U+06F0..06F9. A
                       -- money-shaped key that is not an identifier, carrying digits in any script,
                       -- is carrying a quantity.
                       or v #>> '{}' ~ '[٠-٩۰-۹]')));
      if v_money is not null then
        raise exception 'phase_d_object_record: % is a %-family object and its payload carries money amount(s) [%] — a money-shaped key that is not an identifier, holding a quantity, at any depth. Only a TRANSACTION_RECORD object may. (pd_object_money_key_on_non_financial_object)',
          new.object_id, b.policy_family, array_to_string(v_money, ', ') using errcode = '23514';
      end if;
    end if;
  end if;

  return new;
end
fn_phase_d_fixture_operation:
select g.operation_key from public.phase_d_test_context_grant g
   where g.fixture_run_id = public.fn_phase_d_fixture_context();
fn_phase_d_scenario_record_write:
declare
  v_run bigint := public.fn_phase_d_fixture_context();
  v_id  bigint;
begin
  if v_run is null then
    raise exception 'fn_phase_d_scenario_record_write: no verified Phase D fixture context. The evidence manifest is written only inside an audited fixture run. (pd_fixture_no_test_context)'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  insert into public.phase_d_scenario_record
    (fixture_run_id, fixture_id, fixture_version, source_checksum, object_id, business_key,
     owner_ref, ownership_scope, state, canonical_relation, canonical_service, result_reference,
     contributes_ref, contributed_value, contributes_kind, trace_id, provenance, expected_effect,
     canonical_ref)
  values (v_run,
          p_input->>'fixture_id',
          coalesce(nullif(p_input->>'fixture_version','')::int, 1),
          p_input->>'source_checksum',
          p_input->>'object_id',
          p_input->>'business_key',
          nullif(p_input->>'owner_ref',''),
          coalesce(nullif(p_input->>'ownership_scope',''),'COMPANY'),
          nullif(p_input->>'state',''),
          nullif(p_input->>'canonical_relation',''),
          coalesce(nullif(p_input->>'canonical_service',''),'fn_phase_d_object_write'),
          nullif(p_input->>'result_reference',''),
          nullif(p_input->>'contributes_ref',''),
          nullif(p_input->>'contributed_value',''),
          nullif(p_input->>'contributes_kind',''),
          nullif(p_input->>'trace_id','')::bigint,
          coalesce(nullif(p_input->>'provenance',''),
                   'PHASE_D_FIXTURE_DO_NOT_PUBLISH — created by the zero-persistence scenario factory inside a transaction that is aborted'),
          nullif(p_input->>'expected_effect',''),
          -- F44/F45. The canonical reference the write service returned. The scenario row's own
          -- scenario_record_id is never the business object identity.
          p_input->'canonical_ref')
  on conflict (fixture_run_id, object_id, business_key) do update
     set state = excluded.state, result_reference = excluded.result_reference,
         contributed_value = excluded.contributed_value
  returning scenario_record_id into v_id;
  return v_id;
end
fn_phase_d_fixture_input:
declare
  v_run  bigint := public.fn_phase_d_fixture_context();
  sr     public.phase_c_workflow_step_run%rowtype;
  v_wf   text;
  r      record;
  v_ckey text;   -- F47: the identity a context key that names an object resolves to
begin
  -- NO VERIFIED FIXTURE CONTEXT, NO FIXTURE. This single line is the production boundary.
  if v_run is null then return; end if;

  select * into sr from public.phase_c_workflow_step_run where step_run_id = p_step_run_id;
  if not found then return; end if;
  select b.workflow_id into v_wf from public.phase_d_handler_binding b where b.step_id = sr.step_id;

  if p_scope = 'CONTEXT_KEY' then
    -- (1) A REFERENCE RESOLVES TO WHAT THIS RUN ACTUALLY CREATED, and to the value the stage
    --     CONTRIBUTED rather than to its row id -- see F09 on inquiry_route_set.
    -- F40. A STAGE THAT CONTRIBUTED NOTHING STILL ANSWERED, WITH ITS OWN ROW ID.
    --
    -- coalesce(contributed_value, business_key) means a stage whose contributed_value was never set
    -- answers the key with the primary key of the row it created. Measured: the artifact_revision
    -- stage declares contributes_ref = 'artifact_sha256', sets no contributed_value, and so
    -- resolved artifact_sha256 to 44208 -- a row id. BR-036 then refused with "artifact_sha256
    -- 44208 is not a SHA-256 digest (64 hexadecimal characters), so it was not computed over any
    -- artifact", which was true, and which no fixture could correct: a non-null wrong value blocks
    -- the catalogue fallback below, because that fallback exists only for a key NOTHING answered.
    --
    -- The fallback to business_key is kept where it is right -- a RESULT_KEY stage contributes the
    -- identity of what it created, and that IS its business key -- and refused where it is not.
    -- A stage that declares it contributes a value and supplies none now contributes NOTHING, so
    -- the object-payload branch below and then the committed catalogue get their turn, and a key
    -- with no answer anywhere stays unresolved and its rule refuses.
    -- ---- F47. A KEY THAT NAMES AN OBJECT IS ANSWERED FROM THAT OBJECT'S REFERENCE --------------
    --
    -- Twelve of the 33 context keys the 54 business rules declare are references to a business
    -- object rather than values in their own right. Which object each names is recorded in
    -- public.phase_d_context_key_object, and the identity then comes from that object's canonical
    -- reference -- so the answer is the same one fn_phase_d_ref_resolve would give and the same one
    -- the rule looks up, whichever store the object lives in.
    --
    -- THIS RUNS BEFORE THE STAGE'S OWN contributes_ref, and that is the point. Before F43 the
    -- answer depended on which stage happened to declare it and what that stage set; now it depends
    -- on the OBJECT, which is what the key is about. A stage no longer has to be classified
    -- correctly for a rule to be given the right subject.
    select sc.canonical_ref->>'canonical_identity' into v_ckey
      from public.phase_d_context_key_object m
      join public.phase_d_scenario_record sc
        on sc.object_id = m.object_id
       and sc.fixture_run_id = v_run
     where m.context_key = p_key
       and sc.canonical_ref is not null
     order by sc.scenario_record_id
     limit 1;
    if v_ckey is not null then
      value := to_jsonb(v_ckey);
      provenance := format('the canonical reference of the %s this fixture run created, resolved '
                        || 'through public.phase_d_context_key_object',
                           (select object_id from public.phase_d_context_key_object where context_key = p_key));
      select sc.fixture_id, sc.fixture_version, sc.source_checksum
        into fixture_id, fixture_version, checksum
        from public.phase_d_context_key_object m
        join public.phase_d_scenario_record sc
          on sc.object_id = m.object_id and sc.fixture_run_id = v_run
       where m.context_key = p_key order by sc.scenario_record_id limit 1;
      return next; return;
    end if;

    -- F45. THE CANONICAL REFERENCE, OR NOTHING. There is no coalesce chain here on purpose: a
    -- fallback among the scenario row id, the object-record key, the business key and the relation
    -- primary key is precisely the guessing the founder's ruling of 23 Aug 2026 removes. An identity
    -- stage answers from the reference the write service returned; a PAYLOAD_VALUE or STATE stage
    -- answers with the value it settled; anything else contributes nothing and the key falls through
    -- to the object payload, then to the committed catalogue, then to an explicit refusal.
    select case when sc.contributes_kind in ('PAYLOAD_VALUE','STATE') then sc.contributed_value
                when sc.canonical_ref is not null
                  then sc.canonical_ref->>'canonical_identity'
                else null end v,
           sc.object_id o,
           sc.canonical_relation cr, sc.fixture_id fi, sc.fixture_version fv, sc.source_checksum ck
      into r
      from public.phase_d_scenario_record sc
     where sc.fixture_run_id = v_run and sc.contributes_ref = p_key
     order by sc.scenario_record_id limit 1;
    if found and r.v is not null then
      value := to_jsonb(r.v);
      provenance := format('phase_d_scenario_record: the %s created by fixture run %s through %s',
                           r.o, v_run, coalesce(r.cr,'its canonical service'));
      fixture_id := r.fi; fixture_version := r.fv; checksum := r.ck;
      return next; return;
    end if;

    -- (1b) A FACT THE SCENARIO RECORDED ON ONE OF ITS OWN ROWS. terms_version and terms_hash are
    --      the example: they are not keys and not authorable content -- they are read off the
    --      published document and written onto the acceptance record, so the honest place to find
    --      them is that record's own payload.
    select o.payload->p_key v, sc.object_id ob, sc.canonical_relation cr, sc.fixture_id fi,
           sc.fixture_version fv, sc.source_checksum ck
      into r
      from public.phase_d_scenario_record sc
      join public.phase_d_object_record o
        on o.object_id = sc.object_id and o.business_key = sc.business_key
     where sc.fixture_run_id = v_run and o.payload ? p_key
       and jsonb_typeof(o.payload->p_key) <> 'null'
     order by sc.scenario_record_id desc limit 1;
    if found then
      value := r.v;
      provenance := format('phase_d_object_record.payload of the %s created by fixture run %s',
                           r.ob, v_run);
      fixture_id := r.fi; fixture_version := r.fv; checksum := r.ck;
      return next; return;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- (2) CONTENT COMES FROM THE COMMITTED CATALOGUE, most specific row first.
  for r in
    select c.* from public.phase_d_fixture_catalogue c
     where c.scope = p_scope and c.field_key = p_key
       and (c.step_id is null or c.step_id = sr.step_id)
       and (c.workflow_id is null or c.workflow_id = v_wf)
     order by (c.step_id is not null) desc, (c.workflow_id is not null) desc, c.fixture_id
     limit 1
  loop
    value := r.value;
    provenance := format('phase_d_fixture_catalogue %s v%s (%s) — %s',
                         r.fixture_id, r.fixture_version, r.checksum, r.expected_result);
    fixture_id := r.fixture_id; fixture_version := r.fixture_version; checksum := r.checksum;
    return next; return;
  end loop;
  return;
end
fn_phase_d_fixture_catalogue_state:
with c as (select * from public.phase_d_fixture_catalogue),
       unmarked as (
         select * from c
          where jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string'
            and value #>> '{}' not like '%PHASE_D_FIXTURE_DO_NOT_PUBLISH%'),
       exempt as (select * from unmarked where length(btrim(coalesce(marker_exemption,''))) >= 60),
       drifted as (select * from c where checksum <> public.fn_phase_d_fixture_row_digest(c.*))
  select 'catalogue_entries'::text, 'at least 40'::text,
         (select count(*)::text from c), (select count(*) from c) >= 40
  union all
  select 'text_fixtures_without_the_marker_and_without_an_exemption', '0',
         (select count(*)::text from unmarked
           where length(btrim(coalesce(marker_exemption,''))) < 60),
         not exists (select 1 from unmarked
                      where length(btrim(coalesce(marker_exemption,''))) < 60)
  union all
  -- DISCLOSED, NOT ABSORBED. This row is green while every exempt fixture still states why it
  -- cannot carry the marker, and it prints the count so a reader sees the size of the exemption
  -- rather than a bare green.
  select 'text_fixtures_marker_exempt',
         'each one stating, in 60 characters or more, why the value cannot carry the marker',
         (select count(*)::text || ' of ' || (select count(*) from c
                                               where jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string')::text
                                || ' text fixtures: '
                                || coalesce(string_agg(field_key, ', ' order by fixture_id),'(none)')
            from exempt),
         (select count(*) from unmarked) = (select count(*) from exempt)
  union all
  select 'financial_fixtures_without_a_declared_currency', '0',
         (select count(*)::text from c where value_kind = 'number'
            and field_key ~ '(amount|fee|price|fils|aed|cost|total)' and currency is null),
         not exists (select 1 from c where value_kind = 'number'
            and field_key ~ '(amount|fee|price|fils|aed|cost|total)' and currency is null)
  union all
  select 'rows_whose_checksum_does_not_match_their_content', '0',
         (select count(*)::text from drifted), not exists (select 1 from drifted)
  union all
  select 'catalogue_rows_naming_a_step_that_is_not_frozen', '0',
         (select count(*)::text from c where step_id is not null
            and not exists (select 1 from public.phase_b_workflow_step s where s.step_id = c.step_id)),
         not exists (select 1 from c where step_id is not null
            and not exists (select 1 from public.phase_b_workflow_step s where s.step_id = c.step_id))
  union all
  select 'scenario_records_still_committed', '0',
         (select count(*)::text from public.phase_d_scenario_record),
         not exists (select 1 from public.phase_d_scenario_record)
  union all
  select 'fixture_contexts_still_committed', '0',
         (select count(*)::text from public.phase_d_test_context_grant),
         not exists (select 1 from public.phase_d_test_context_grant);
fn_phase_d_fixture_row_digest:
select encode(sha256(convert_to(concat_ws(chr(31),
    r.fixture_id, r.fixture_version::text, coalesce(r.workflow_id,''), coalesce(r.step_id,''),
    r.scope, r.field_key, r.value::text, r.value_kind, coalesce(r.currency,''),
    r.expected_schema, r.expected_result, r.prohibited_external_use,
    coalesce(r.marker_exemption,'')), 'UTF8')), 'hex');
fn_phase_d_capability_answer:
select jsonb_build_object(
           'result_id', r.result_id, 'request_id', r.request_id, 'provider_mode', r.provider_mode,
           'fixture_id', r.fixture_id, 'fixture_version', r.fixture_version,
           'fixture_hash', r.fixture_hash, 'payload', r.payload,
           'payload_digest', r.payload_digest, 'evidence', r.evidence)
    from public.phase_d_capability_result r
    join public.phase_d_capability_request q on q.request_id = r.request_id
   where q.step_run_id = p_step_run_id
   order by r.result_id desc limit 1;
fn_phase_d_capability_state:
with dep as (select * from public.phase_d_handler_binding where capability_dependency <> 'NONE'),
       -- The two routines, with every comment line removed, so the grep below reads CODE.
       code as (
         select p.proname,
                (select string_agg(l, chr(10))
                   from unnest(string_to_array(p.prosrc, chr(10))) l
                  where btrim(l) not like '--%') src
           from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace
          where n.nspname = 'public'
            and p.proname in ('fn_phase_d_handler_execute','fn_phase_d_effect_produce')),
       bypass as (
         select * from code where src ~ 'capability_dependency <> ''NONE'' and v_ctx <> ''test''')
  select 'capability_dependent_steps'::text, '21'::text,
         (select count(*)::text from dep), (select count(*) from dep) = 21
  union all
  select 'capability_dependent_steps_without_a_contract', '0',
         (select count(*)::text from dep
